author.name: Zixiong Yu, Jun Rao, Guhan Chen, Songtao Tian, Bohan Li, Jiansheng Wei, Min Zhang, Xiaojun Meng

entry.summary: Proposes MathAgent, a framework for synthesizing mathematical reasoning data through adversarial evolution of constraint graphs. Uses a Legislator-Executor paradigm where the Legislator evolves problem blueprints and the Executor instantiates them into natural language.

entry.title: The Past Is Not Past: Memory-Enhanced Dynamic Reward Shaping

author.name: Yang Liu, Enxi Wang, Yufei Gao, Weixin Zhang, Bo Wang, Zhiyuan Zeng, Yikai Zhang, Yining Zheng, Xipeng Qiu

entry.summary: Proposes MEDS, a memory-enhanced reward shaping framework for LLM RL that penalizes recurring error patterns across rollouts using density-based clustering of intermediate representations. Addresses reduced sampling diversity in RL training.

entry.title: Do LLMs Know Tool Irrelevance? Demystifying Structural Alignment Bias in Tool Invocations

author.name: Yilong Liu, Xixun Lin, Pengfei Cao, Ge Zhang, Fang Fang, Yanan Cao

entry.summary: Identifies 'structural alignment bias' in LLM tool use - models invoke tools when query attributes match parameter types even when the tool is semantically irrelevant. Introduces SABEval benchmark to study this phenomenon.

entry.title: Retrieval as Generation: A Unified Framework with Self-Triggered Information Planning

author.name: Bo Li, Mingda Wang, Gexiang Fang, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye

entry.summary: Proposes GRIP, a unified RAG framework that embeds retrieval control directly into token-level generation through control-token emission. The model decides when to retrieve, how to reformulate queries, and when to stop - all within decoding.

entry.title: Policy Split: Incentivizing Dual-Mode Exploration in LLM Reinforcement with Dual-Mode Entropy Regularization

author.name: Jiashu Yao, Heyan Huang, Chuwei Luo, Daiqing Wu, Zeming Liu, Yuhang Guo, Yangyang Kang

entry.summary: Proposes Policy Split, a dual-mode RL approach for LLMs that bifurcates the policy into normal and high-entropy exploration modes using a shared model with dual entropy regularization. Shows consistent improvements over entropy-guided RL baselines across model sizes.

entry.title: AffordSim: A Scalable Data Generator and Benchmark for Affordance-Aware Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Mingyang Li, Haofan Xu, Haowen Sun, Xinzhe Chen, Sihua Ren, Liqi Huang, Xinyang Sui, Chenyang Miao, Qiongjie Cui, Zeyang Liu, Xingyu Chen, Xuguang Lan

entry.summary: Introduces AffordSim, the first simulation framework integrating open-vocabulary 3D affordance prediction into robotic manipulation data generation. Uses VoxAfford model to enhance trajectory generation with semantically correct interactions.

entry.title: Grounded World Model for Semantically Generalizable Planning

author.name: Quanyi Li, Lan Feng, Haonan Zhang, Wuyang Li, Letian Wang, Alexandre Alahi, Harold Soh

entry.summary: Proposes Grounded World Model (GWM) learned in a vision-language-aligned latent space for model predictive control, enabling language-conditioned goal specification instead of requiring goal images.

entry.title: StarVLA-$\alpha$: Reducing Complexity in Vision-Language-Action Systems

author.name: Jinhui Ye, Ning Gao, Senqiao Yang, Jinliang Zheng, Zixuan Wang, Yuxin Chen, Pengguang Chen, Yilun Chen, Shu Liu, Jiaya Jia

entry.summary: Introduces StarVLA-α, a simplified VLA baseline designed to study design choices under controlled conditions. Systematically evaluates action modeling, robot-specific pretraining, and interface design while minimizing confounders.

entry.title: Last-Iterate Convergence of Randomized Kaczmarz and SGD with Greedy Step Size

author.name: Micha{\l} Derezi\'nski, Xiaoyu Dong

entry.summary: Proves O(1/t^{3/4}) last-iterate convergence for SGD with greedy step size over smooth quadratics in the interpolation regime, improving on the previous O(1/t^{1/2}) bound. Introduces stochastic contraction processes.

entry.title: A Tale of Two Temperatures: Simple, Efficient, and Diverse Sampling from Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Theo X. Olausson, Metod Jazbec, Xi Wang, Armando Solar-Lezama, Christian A. Naesseth, Stephan Mandt, Eric Nalisnick

entry.summary: Shows that tempered versions of confidence-based remasking heuristics improve diversity in diffusion language model sampling. Introduces formal model of fork tokens to study entropy at decision points.

entry.title: Attention Sink in Transformers: A Survey on Utilization, Interpretation, and Mitigation

author.name: Zunhai Su, Hengyuan Zhang, Wei Wu, Yifan Zhang, Yaxiu Liu, He Xiao, Qingyao Yang, Yuxuan Sun, Rui Yang, Chao Zhang, Keyu Fan, Weihao Ye, Jing Xiong, Hui Shen, Chaofan Tao, Taiqiang Wu, Zhongwei Wan, Yulei Qian, Yuchen Xie, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey on Attention Sink phenomenon in transformers—where disproportionate attention focuses on uninformative tokens—covering utilization, interpretation, and mitigation strategies.

entry.title: Exact Finite-Sample Variance Decomposition of Subagging: A Spectral Filtering Perspective

author.name: Ye Su, Mingrui Ye, Yining Wang, Jipeng Guo, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Derives the first exact finite-sample variance decomposition for subagging using Hoeffding-ANOVA decomposition, showing subagging operates as a deterministic low-pass spectral filter that attenuates c-th order interaction variance by α^c. Provides principled guidance for choosing resampling ratios.

entry.title: INCRT: An Incremental Transformer That Determines Its Own Architecture

author.name: Giansalvo Cirrincione

entry.summary: Introduces INCRT, a transformer architecture that incrementally determines its own structure during training by adding heads when insufficient and pruning redundant ones, addressing the observation that 50-80% of heads can be removed post-training.

entry.title: Flow-Controlled Scheduling for LLM Inference with Provable Stability Guarantees

author.name: Zhuolun Dong, Junyu Cao

entry.summary: Proposes a flow-control framework for LLM inference that controls prompt admission rates to prevent memory overflow from unknown decode lengths. Derives necessary and sufficient stability conditions with provable guarantees.

entry.title: Learning Discrete Diffusion of Graphs via Free-Energy Gradient Flows

author.name: Dario Rancati, Jan Maas, Francesco Locatello

entry.summary: Proposes the first computational framework for discrete diffusion models using gradient flows with appropriate metric W_K on the probability simplex, connecting widely-used discrete diffusion paths to variational principles.

entry.title: Self-Calibrating Language Models via Test-Time Discriminative Distillation

author.name: Mohamed Rissal Hedna, Jan Strich, Martin Semmann, Chris Biemann

entry.summary: Introduces SECL, a self-calibrating method for LLMs that leverages the finding that P(True) token probability is better calibrated than verbalized confidence, using discriminative distillation at test time.

entry.title: Global monitoring of methane point sources using deep learning on hyperspectral radiance measurements from EMIT

author.name: Vishal V. Batchu, Michelangelo Conserva, Alex Wilson, Anna M. Michalak, Varun Gulshan, Philip G. Brodrick, Andrew K. Thorpe, Christopher V. Arsdale

entry.summary: Presents MAPL-EMIT, an end-to-end vision transformer framework for global methane point source detection using hyperspectral radiance from the EMIT instrument. Significantly lowers detection limits by leveraging complete radiance spectrum with spatial context.

entry.title: A Deep Generative Approach to Stratified Learning

author.name: Randy Martinez, Rong Tang, Lizhen Lin

entry.summary: Develops deep generative approaches for learning distributions on stratified spaces (unions of manifolds of varying dimensions). Proposes both a mixture of VAEs approach and a diffusion-based framework with convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Differentially Private Verification of Distribution Properties

author.name: Elbert Du, Cynthia Dwork, Pranay Tankala, Linjun Zhang

entry.summary: Initiates the study of differentially private distribution property testing with prover assistance. Maps the landscape of DP prover-aided proofs and shows private-coin vs public-coin protocol complexity gaps differ from non-private setting.

entry.title: Revisiting Compositionality in Dual-Encoder Vision-Language Models: The Role of Inference

author.name: Imanol Miranda, Ander Salaberria, Eneko Agirre, Gorka Azkune

entry.summary: Argues CLIP's poor compositionality stems from global cosine similarity inference, not from representation quality. Shows that fine-grained region-segment alignment at inference dramatically improves compositional performance without updating encoders.

entry.title: Universality of first-order methods on random and deterministic matrices

author.name: Nicola Gorini, Chris Jones, Dmitriy Kunisky, Lucas Pesenti

entry.summary: Analyzes general first-order methods (GFOM) dynamics via traffic distributions of input matrices, extending AMP Gaussianity results beyond random matrices to deterministic ones. Explains why AMP works for structured inputs.

entry.title: Spoiler Alert: Narrative Forecasting as a Metric for Tension in LLM Storytelling

author.name: Peiqi Sui, Yutong Zhu, Tianyi Cheng, Peter West, Richard Jean So, Hoyt Long, Ari Holtzman

entry.summary: Introduces the 100-Endings metric for measuring narrative tension in LLM storytelling by forecasting story endings at each sentence position. Shows LLM stories have systematically less tension than human literary fiction.

entry.title: FAITH: Factuality Alignment through Integrating Trustworthiness and Honestness

author.name: Xiaoning Dong, Chengyan Wu, Yajie Wen, Yu Chen, Yun Xue, Jing Zhang, Wei Xu, Bolei Ma

entry.summary: Proposes FAITH, a post-training framework for factuality alignment that integrates natural-language uncertainty signals with external knowledge, moving beyond numeric confidence scores. Augments training data with confidence descriptions and external knowledge.

entry.title: Instruction Data Selection via Answer Divergence

author.name: Bo Li, Mingda Wang, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye

entry.summary: Proposes Answer Divergence-Guided Selection (ADG) for instruction data selection, using geometric structure of multi-sample outputs to identify high-value training examples. Fine-tuning on 10K ADG-selected examples outperforms larger datasets.

entry.title: How You Ask Matters! Adaptive RAG Robustness to Query Variations

author.name: Yunah Jang, Megha Sundriyal, Kyomin Jung, Meeyoung Cha

entry.summary: Introduces the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating Adaptive RAG robustness to query surface variations. Discovers that small surface-level changes dramatically alter retrieval decisions and answer quality.

entry.title: Polyglot Teachers: Evaluating Language Models for Multilingual Synthetic Data Generation

author.name: Lester James V. Miranda, Ivan Vuli\'c, Anna Korhonen

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates which LLMs make effective multilingual teachers for synthetic data generation, introducing a Polyglot Score metric. Evaluates 10 LMs across 6 languages generating 1.4M+ SFT examples.

entry.title: Triviality Corrected Endogenous Reward

author.name: Xinda Wang, Zhengxu Hou, Yangshijie Zhang, Bingren Yan, Jialin Liu, Chenzhuo Zhao, Zhibo Yang, Bin-Bin Yang, Feng Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes TCER (Triviality Corrected Endogenous Reward) for RL-based open-ended text generation, addressing the triviality bias where confidence rewards cause policy collapse toward high-probability outputs.

entry.title: Hidden Failures in Robustness: Why Supervised Uncertainty Quantification Needs Better Evaluation

author.name: Joe Stacey, Hadas Orgad, Kentaro Inui, Benjamin Heinzerling, Nafise Sadat Moosavi

entry.summary: Systematic study of supervised uncertainty probes across models, tasks, and OOD settings, training over 2,000 probes. Finds poor robustness in current methods, especially for long-form generations, with robustness driven more by layer selection than architecture.

entry.title: Seeing No Evil: Blinding Large Vision-Language Models to Safety Instructions via Adversarial Attention Hijacking

author.name: Jingru Li, Wei Ren, Tianqing Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes Attention-Guided Visual Jailbreaking that manipulates attention patterns to bypass safety alignment in LVLMs by suppressing attention to safety tokens and anchoring generation on adversarial image features.

entry.title: FF3R: Feedforward Feature 3D Reconstruction from Unconstrained views

author.name: Chaoyi Zhou, Run Wang, Feng Luo, Mert D. Pes\'e, Zhiwen Fan, Yiqi Zhong, Siyu Huang

entry.summary: FF3R is an annotation-free feed-forward framework that unifies geometric and semantic 3D reconstruction from unconstrained multi-view images without requiring camera poses, depth maps, or semantic labels.

entry.title: Prompt Relay: Inference-Time Temporal Control for Multi-Event Video Generation

author.name: Gordon Chen, Ziqi Huang, Ziwei Liu

entry.summary: Prompt Relay introduces inference-time temporal control for multi-event video generation, enabling precise timing, duration, and transitions between events without semantic entanglement.

entry.title: Long-Horizon Streaming Video Generation via Hybrid Attention with Decoupled Distillation

author.name: Ruibin Li, Tao Yang, Fangzhou Ai, Tianhe Wu, Shilei Wen, Bingyue Peng, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Hybrid Forcing improves streaming video generation by adding lightweight linear temporal attention to preserve long-range context beyond sliding windows, plus decoupled distillation for efficient training.

entry.title: PhyMix: Towards Physically Consistent Single-Image 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Implicit--Explicit Optimization

author.name: Dongli Wu, Jingyu Hu, Ka-Hei Hui, Xiaobao Wei, Chengwen Luo, Jianqiang Li, Zhengzhe Liu

entry.summary: PhyMix introduces a Physics Evaluator measuring 9 sub-constraints for 3D indoor scene generation and proposes a framework integrating physics feedback into both training and inference, establishing the first physics consistency benchmark.

entry.title: Agentic Video Generation: From Text to Executable Event Graphs via Tool-Constrained LLM Planning

author.name: Nicolae Cudlenco, Mihai Masala, Marius Leordeanu

entry.summary: Presents an agentic system where an LLM constructs a formal Graph of Events specification that is deterministically executed in a 3D game engine, providing ground truth annotations for video generation.

entry.title: Visual Enhanced Depth Scaling for Multimodal Latent Reasoning

author.name: Yudong Han, Yong Wang, Zaiquan Yang, Zhen Qu, Liyuan Pan, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Reveals that in multimodal latent reasoning, visual tokens suffer from systematic under-optimization due to language bias, with higher and more volatile gradient norms. Proposes visual re-weighting and adaptive depth scaling to address these limitations in multimodal models.

entry.title: Finetune Like You Pretrain: Boosting Zero-shot Adversarial Robustness in Vision-language Models

author.name: Songlong Xing, Weijie Wang, Zhengyu Zhao, Jindong Gu, Philip Torr, Nicu Sebe

entry.summary: AdvFLYP proposes adversarial finetuning for CLIP that follows the pretraining recipe (contrastive learning) rather than standard classification-based adversarial training. Improves zero-shot adversarial robustness transferability.

entry.title: POINTS-Long: Adaptive Dual-Mode Visual Reasoning in MLLMs

author.name: Haicheng Wang, Yuan Liu, Yikun Liu, Zhemeng Yu, Zhongyin Zhao, Yangxiu You, Zilin Yu, Le Tian, Xiao Zhou, Jie Zhou, Weidi Xie, Yanfeng Wang

entry.summary: POINTS-Long introduces a dual-mode MLLM with dynamic visual token scaling inspired by human vision (focus and standby modes). Addresses scalability challenges from growing visual token sequences in long-video scenarios.

entry.title: GazeVaLM: A Multi-Observer Eye-Tracking Benchmark for Evaluating Clinical Realism in AI-Generated X-Rays

author.name: David Wong, Zeynep Isik, Bin Wang, Marouane Tliba, Gorkem Durak, Elif Keles, Halil Ertugrul Aktas, Aladine Chetouani, Cagdas Topel, Nicolo Gennaro, Camila Lopes Vendrami, Tugce Agirlar Trabzonlu, Amir Ali Rahsepar, Laetitia Perronne, Matthew Antalek, Onural Ozturk, Gokcan Okur, Andrew C. Gordon, Ayis Pyrros, Frank H. Miller, Amir Borhani, Hatice Savas, Eric Hart, Elizabeth Krupinski, Ulas Bagci

entry.summary: GazeVaLM provides a public eye-tracking dataset from 16 radiologists viewing real and synthetic chest X-rays, enabling comparison between human and AI perception for clinical realism assessment of AI-generated medical images.

entry.title: LARY: A Latent Action Representation Yielding Benchmark for Generalizable Vision-to-Action Alignment

author.name: Dujun Nie, Fengjiao Chen, Qi Lv, Jun Kuang, Xiaoyu Li, Xuezhi Cao, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: LARY Benchmark evaluates latent action representations for both high-level semantic actions and low-level robotic control. Curates over one million samples to bridge the gap between human video data and robot learning.

entry.title: Decoding Ancient Oracle Bone Script via Generative Dictionary Retrieval

author.name: Yin Wu, Gangjian Zhang, Jiayu Chen, Chang Xu, Yuyu Luo, Nan Tang, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Reframes Oracle Bone Script decipherment from classification to dictionary-based retrieval using deep learning guided by character evolution principles. Generates comprehensive synthetic dictionary for matching undeciphered characters.

entry.title: ComSim: Building Scalable Real-World Robot Data Generation via Compositional Simulation

author.name: Yiran Qin, Jiahua Ma, Li Kang, Wenzhan Li, Yihang Jiao, Xin Wen, Xiufeng Song, Heng Zhou, Jiwen Yu, Zhenfei Yin, Xihui Liu, Philip Torr, Yilun Du, Ruimao Zhang

entry.summary: ComSim proposes compositional simulation combining classical and neural simulation for scalable robot training data generation. Uses closed-loop real-sim-real augmentation pipeline for action-video pairs.

entry.title: Beyond Silicon: Materials, Mechanisms, and Methods for Physical Neural Computing

author.name: Stefan Fischer, Nihat Ay, Olaf Landsiedel, Esfandiar Mohammadi, Sebastian Otte, Bernd-Christian Renner, Nele Ru{\ss}winkel

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of physical implementations of neural computation beyond silicon, covering memristive devices, photonic circuits, mechanical metamaterials, microfluidic networks, chemical systems, and biological neural tissue.

entry.title: Monday AI Radar #21

author.name: Against Moloch

entry.summary: Weekly AI news roundup focused on Claude Mythos Preview, highlighting its exceptional cybersecurity capabilities, its position as a potential next-generation leap, and the tension between being Anthropic's most aligned and most dangerous model simultaneously.

entry.title: 5 Hypotheses for Why Models Fail on Long Tasks

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: Proposes five hypotheses for why AI models fail disproportionately on long tasks: error compounding, context window limits, lack of self-correction, planning horizon limits, and metacognitive deficits. Discusses implications for AI evaluations.

entry.title: Stopping AI is easier than Regulating it.

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: David Krueger argues that stopping AI development (via international treaty to dismantle compute supply chains) is easier than regulating it, because regulation requires ongoing monitoring while stopping is binary and verifiable.

entry.title: You're gonna need a bigger boat (benchmark), METR

author.name: Eye You

entry.summary: Critiques METR's AI evaluation methodology on three grounds: egregiously large confidence intervals that are misleadingly presented, insufficient sample sizes for long-duration tasks, and gaps in tested agent configurations.

entry.title: ASPIRin: Action Space Projection for Interactivity-Optimized Reinforcement Learning in Full-Duplex Speech Language Models

author.name: Chi-Yuan Hsiao, Ke-Han Lu, Yu-Kuan Fu, Guan-Ting Lin, Hsiao-Tsung Hung, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Proposes ASPIRin, an RL framework for full-duplex speech language models that decouples turn-taking decisions from content generation using Action Space Projection, preventing generative collapse from temporal RL optimization.

entry.title: Time is Not a Label: Continuous Phase Rotation for Temporal Knowledge Graphs and Agentic Memory

author.name: Weixian Waylon Li, Jiaxin Zhang, Xianan Jim Yang, Tiejun Ma, Yiwen Guo

entry.summary: Introduces RoMem, a temporal knowledge graph module that uses continuous phase rotation to model time-varying facts in agent memory. A Semantic Speed Gate learns volatility scores for relations, distinguishing persistent facts from evolving ones.

entry.title: Spotlight and Shadow: Attention-Guided Dual-Anchor Introspective Decoding for MLLM Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Yebo Wu, Han Jin, Zhijiang Guo, Li Li

entry.summary: DaID introduces dual-anchor introspective decoding for MLLM hallucination mitigation, identifying Spotlight and Shadow layers to amplify visual signals and suppress textual inertia using attention-guided selection.

entry.title: Learning Long-term Motion Embeddings for Efficient Kinematics Generation

author.name: Nick Stracke, Kolja Bauer, Stefan Andreas Baumann, Miguel Angel Bautista, Josh Susskind, Bj\"orn Ommer

entry.summary: Learns highly compressed (64x temporal compression) long-term motion embeddings from large-scale trajectories for efficient generation of realistic motions from text prompts or spatial pokes.

entry.title: Seven simple steps for log analysis in AI systems

author.name: Magda Dubois, Ekin Zorer, Maia Hamin, Joe Skinner, Alexandra Souly, Jerome Wynne, Harry Coppock, Lucas Satos, Sayash Kapoor, Sunischal Dev, Keno Juchems, Kimberly Mai, Timo Flesch, Lennart Luettgau, Charles Teague, Eric Patey, JJ Allaire, Lorenzo Pacchiardi, Jose Hernandez-Orallo, Cozmin Ududec

entry.summary: Proposes a standardized seven-step pipeline for analyzing logs produced by AI systems interacting with tools and users, illustrated with the Inspect Scout library. Addresses the lack of standardized approaches for understanding model behaviors through log analysis.

entry.title: Pioneer Agent: Continual Improvement of Small Language Models in Production

author.name: Dhruv Atreja, Julia White, Nikhil Nayak, Kelton Zhang, Henrijs Princis, George Hurn-Maloney, Ash Lewis, Urchade Zaratiana

entry.summary: Pioneer Agent automates the lifecycle of small language model deployment: data curation, training, failure diagnosis, and regression avoidance in a closed-loop system. Handles both cold-start and production modes.

entry.title: Learning from Emptiness: De-biasing Listwise Rerankers with Content-Agnostic Probability Calibration

author.name: Hang Lv, Hongchao Gu, Ruiqing Yang, Liangyue Li, Zulong Chen, Defu Lian, Hao Wang, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: CapCal is a training-free method to remove positional bias from generative listwise rerankers by estimating bias distributions via content-free placeholders and correcting logits through entropy-adaptive contrastive calibration.

entry.title: STARS: Skill-Triggered Audit for Request-Conditioned Invocation Safety in Agent Systems

author.name: Guijia Zhang, Shu Yang, Xilin Gong, Di Wang

entry.summary: STARS proposes continuous risk estimation for skill invocations in agent systems, combining static capability assessment with request-conditioned risk models. Creates SIA-Bench with 3,000 invocation scenarios.

entry.title: Dead Cognitions: A Census of Misattributed Insights

author.name: Aaron Tuor, claude. ai

entry.summary: Identifies 'attribution laundering' in AI chat systems: models perform cognitive work then credit users for the insights, systematically eroding users' ability to assess their own contributions. The paper itself is an artifact of this process.

entry.title: A Progressive Training Strategy for Vision-Language Models to Counteract Spatio-Temporal Hallucinations in Embodied Reasoning

author.name: Xiaoda Yang, Shuai Yang, Can Wang, Jingyang Xue, Menglan Tang, Checheng Yu, Xunzhe Zhou, Sashuai Zhou, Tao Jin, Lixin Yang, Xiangyu Yue, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Addresses multi-image reasoning hallucination in VLMs through a progressive training framework: first supervised pre-training on a new CoT dataset with spatiotemporal steps, then fine-tuning with weakly supervised signals. Targets the gap between forward and reverse temporal reasoning.

entry.title: CheeseBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Rodent Behavioral Neuroscience Paradigms

author.name: Zacharie Bugaud

entry.summary: Introduces CheeseBench, a benchmark evaluating LLMs on nine classical behavioral neuroscience paradigms (mazes, operant chambers, etc.) where agents must discover goals from ASCII observations and rewards, mimicking rodent behavioral experiments.

entry.title: Diffusion-CAM: Faithful Visual Explanations for dMLLMs

author.name: Haomin Zuo, Yidi Li, Luoxiao Yang, Xiaofeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Diffusion-CAM, the first interpretability method specifically designed for diffusion-based multimodal LLMs, addressing the mismatch between existing CAM methods (designed for sequential models) and parallel denoising architectures.

entry.title: From Attribution to Action: A Human-Centered Application of Activation Steering

author.name: Tobias Labarta, Maximilian Dreyer, Katharina Weitz, Wojciech Samek, Sebastian Lapuschkin

entry.summary: Introduces an interactive workflow combining SAE-based attribution with activation steering for vision models, implemented as a web tool. Conducts expert interviews (N=8) to study how practitioners reason about and apply activation steering on CLIP. Bridges the gap between XAI explanation and actionable intervention.

entry.title: SemaClaw: A Step Towards General-Purpose Personal AI Agents through Harness Engineering

author.name: Ningyan Zhu, Huacan Wang, Jie Zhou, Feiyu Chen, Shuo Zhang, Ge Chen, Chen Liu, Jiarou Wu, Wangyi Chen, Xiaofeng Mou, Yi Xu

entry.summary: Discusses SemaClaw, positioned as a step toward general-purpose personal AI agents through 'harness engineering' - designing infrastructure to make unconstrained agents controllable and production-reliable. References the rise of OpenClaw in early 2026.

entry.title: StreamServe: Adaptive Speculative Flows for Low-Latency Disaggregated LLM Serving

author.name: Satyam Kumar, Arpit Singh Gautam, Kailash Talreja, Saurabh Jha

entry.summary: Introduces StreamServe, a disaggregated prefill-decode serving architecture combining metric-aware routing with adaptive speculative decoding that tunes speculation depth online from runtime signals.

entry.title: Token-Budget-Aware Pool Routing for Cost-Efficient LLM Inference

author.name: Huamin Chen, Xunzhuo Liu, Junchen Jiang, Bowei He, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Proposes token-budget-aware pool routing for LLM serving that estimates request token budgets and dispatches to right-sized pools, addressing the 4-8x concurrency waste from worst-case provisioning.

entry.title: Agentic AI in Engineering and Manufacturing: Industry Perspectives on Utility, Adoption, Challenges, and Opportunities

author.name: Kristen M. Edwards, Maxwell Bauer, Claire Jacquillat, A. John Hart, Faez Ahmed

entry.summary: Qualitative study based on 30+ interviews examining how agentic AI is being adopted in engineering and manufacturing. Finds adoption constrained more by data fragmentation and regulatory requirements than model capability.

entry.title: The Deployment Gap in AI Media Detection: Platform-Aware and Visually Constrained Adversarial Evaluation

author.name: Aishwarya Budhkar, Trishita Dhara, Siddhesh Sheth

entry.summary: Identifies a 'deployment gap' in AI media detectors, showing that near-perfect lab performance collapses under realistic platform transforms like compression, resizing, and meme-style modifications.

entry.title: ExecTune: Effective Steering of Black-Box LLMs with Guide Models

author.name: Vijay Lingam, Aditya Golatkar, Anwesan Pal, Ben Vo, Narayanan Sadagopan, Alessandro Achille, Jun Huan, Anoop Deoras, Stefano Soatto

entry.summary: Introduces ExecTune, a Guide-Core Policy framework where a guide model generates strategies executed by a black-box core LLM, formalizing the concept of 'guide-averaged executability' for cost-sensitive utility optimization.

entry.title: MedLVR: Latent Visual Reasoning for Reliable Medical Visual Question Answering

author.name: Suyang Xi, Songtao Hu, Yuxiang Lai, Wangyun Dan, Yaqi Liu, Shansong Wang, Xiaofeng Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MedLVR, a latent visual reasoning framework for medical VQA that introduces an explicit visual evidence state into autoregressive decoding, interleaving latent reasoning segments to maintain visual grounding.

entry.title: Relational Preference Encoding in Looped Transformer Internal States

author.name: Jan Kirin

entry.summary: Studies how looped transformers encode human preference in internal iteration states, finding that preference is encoded predominantly relationally (pairwise differences) rather than independently, with a lightweight evaluator achieving 95.2% accuracy.

entry.title: Closed-Form Concept Erasure via Double Projections

author.name: Chi Zhang, Jingpu Cheng, Zhixian Wang, Ping Liu

entry.summary: Presents a closed-form concept erasure method for diffusion models using double projections, achieving training-free removal of unwanted concepts without distorting unrelated ones.

entry.title: CircuitSynth: Reliable Synthetic Data Generation

author.name: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Jiahao Sun, Thomas Lukasiewicz

entry.summary: Proposes CircuitSynth, a neuro-symbolic framework for reliable synthetic data generation that decouples semantic reasoning from surface realization using a Probabilistic Sentential Decision Diagram distilled from a teacher LLM.

entry.title: CodaRAG: Connecting the Dots with Associativity Inspired by Complementary Learning

author.name: Cheng-Yen Li, Xuanjun Chen, Claire Lin, Wei-Yu Chen, Wenhua Nie, Hung-Yi Lee, Jyh-Shing Roger Jang

entry.summary: Proposes CodaRAG, a RAG framework inspired by Complementary Learning Systems that evolves retrieval from passive lookup to active associative discovery through knowledge consolidation, associative navigation, and reflective synthesis.

entry.title: PepBenchmark: A Standardized Benchmark for Peptide Machine Learning

author.name: Jiahui Zhang, Rouyi Wang, Kuangqi Zhou, Tianshu Xiao, Lingyan Zhu, Yaosen Min, Yang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces PepBenchmark, a standardized benchmark for peptide machine learning with 29 canonical and 6 non-canonical peptide datasets, standardized preprocessing pipeline, and comprehensive evaluation of 17+ models.

entry.title: WaveMoE: A Wavelet-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Shunyu Wu, Jiawei Huang, Weibin Feng, Boxin Li, Xiao Zhang, Erli Meng, Dan Li, Jian Lou, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes WaveMoE, a wavelet-enhanced mixture-of-experts foundation model for time series forecasting that jointly processes time and frequency domain features through dual-path architecture.

entry.title: SCOPE: Signal-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation Enhancement with Dual-Path Adaptive Weighting

author.name: Binbin Zheng, Xing Ma, Yiheng Liang, Jingqing Ruan, Xiaoliang Fu, Kepeng Lin, Benchang Zhu, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: Proposes SCOPE, a dual-path adaptive framework for on-policy distillation that routes rollouts by correctness into different supervision paths with teacher-perplexity-weighted KL distillation.

entry.title: Deep-Reporter: Deep Research for Grounded Multimodal Long-Form Generation

author.name: Fangda Ye, Zhifei Xie, Yuxin Hu, Yihang Yin, Shurui Huang, Shikai Dong, Jianzhu Bao, Shuicheng Yan

entry.summary: Introduces Deep-Reporter, an agentic framework for grounded multimodal long-form generation that orchestrates multimodal search, checklist-guided synthesis, and recurrent context management for expert-quality reports.

entry.title: Compliant But Unsatisfactory: The Gap Between Auditing Standards and Practices for Probabilistic Genotyping Software

author.name: Angela Jin, Alexander Asemota, Dan E. Krane, Nathaniel D. Adams, Rediet Abebe

entry.summary: Examines how audit standards for probabilistic genotyping software used in the US criminal legal system fail to ensure meaningful evaluation, identifying gaps between intended outcomes and actual auditing practices. Highlights how poorly designed standards can lend credibility to inadequate AI systems.

entry.title: ReSpinQuant: Efficient Layer-Wise LLM Quantization via Subspace Residual Rotation Approximation

author.name: Suyoung Kim, Sunghyun Wee, Hyeonjin Kim, Kyomin Hwang, Hyunho Lee, Nojun Kwak

entry.summary: Proposes ReSpinQuant, a post-training quantization framework for LLMs that bridges global and layer-wise rotation methods using subspace residual rotation approximation. Achieves inference efficiency of global methods with accuracy closer to layer-wise approaches.

entry.title: 3D-Anchored Lookahead Planning for Persistent Robotic Scene Memory via World-Model-Based MCTS

author.name: Bronislav Sidik, Dror Mizrahi

entry.summary: Introduces 3D-ALP, a planning system for robotic manipulation that combines MCTS with a 3D-consistent world model, maintaining persistent spatial memory that survives occlusion. Achieves 0.650 success rate vs 0.006 for reactive baselines on memory-required steps.

entry.title: METER: Evaluating Multi-Level Contextual Causal Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Pengfeng Li, Chen Huang, Chaoqun Hao, Hongyao Chen, Xiao-Yong Wei, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Introduces METER, a benchmark evaluating LLMs' contextual causal reasoning across all three levels of the causal hierarchy (association, intervention, counterfactual) under unified context. Reveals significant performance decline as tasks ascend the hierarchy and identifies failure modes.

entry.title: From Translation to Superset: Benchmark-Driven Evolution of a Production AI Agent from Rust to Python

author.name: Jinhua Wang, Biswa Sengupta

entry.summary: Describes LLM-assisted continuous code translation of a production Rust codebase (648K LOC) into Python (41K LOC), using agent benchmarks as objective function. The Python port achieves near-parity on SWE-bench Verified (73.8% vs 70.0%).

entry.title: Towards Autonomous Mechanistic Reasoning in Virtual Cells

author.name: Yunhui Jang, Lu Zhu, Jake Fawkes, Alisandra Kaye Denton, Dominique Beaini, Emmanuel Noutahi

entry.summary: Introduces VCR-Agent, a multi-agent framework for autonomous mechanistic reasoning in virtual cells, representing biological reasoning as mechanistic action graphs with verification. Integrates biologically grounded knowledge retrieval.

entry.title: On the Robustness of Watermarking for Autoregressive Image Generation

author.name: Andreas M\"uller, Denis Lukovnikov, Shingo Kodama, Minh Pham, Anubhav Jain, Jonathan Petit, Niv Cohen, Asja Fischer

entry.summary: Studies vulnerability of watermarking schemes for autoregressive image generators, introducing three new attacks: VQ regeneration, adversarial optimization, and frequency injection. Demonstrates that current AR watermarking is fragile.

entry.title: ClawGUI: A Unified Framework for Training, Evaluating, and Deploying GUI Agents

author.name: Fei Tang, Zhiqiong Lu, Boxuan Zhang, Weiming Lu, Jun Xiao, Yueting Zhuang, Yongliang Shen

entry.summary: Presents ClawGUI, an open-source unified framework for training (with RL), evaluating, and deploying GUI agents. Addresses infrastructure gaps including environment instability and silently drifting evaluation protocols.

entry.title: NeuroFlow: Toward Unified Visual Encoding and Decoding from Neural Activity

author.name: Weijian Mai, Mu Nan, Yu Zhu, Jiahang Cao, Rui Zhang, Yuqin Dai, Chunfeng Song, Andrew F. Luo, Jiamin Wu

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroFlow, the first unified framework jointly modeling visual encoding (stimuli→brain) and decoding (brain→stimuli) within a single flow model. Introduces NeuroVAE for modeling neural variability.

entry.title: CodeQuant: Unified Clustering and Quantization for Enhanced Outlier Smoothing in Low-Precision Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Xiangyang Yin, Xingyu Liu, Tianhua Xia, Bo Bao, Vithursan Thangarasa, Valavan Manohararajah, Eric Sather, Sai Qian Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CodeQuant, a unified quantization-and-clustering scheme for smoothing activation outliers in Mixture-of-Experts models via learnable rotation and residual absorption. Targets the key bottleneck of outliers in low-precision MoE deployment.

entry.title: CausalGaze: Unveiling Hallucinations via Counterfactual Graph Intervention in Large Language Models

author.name: Linggang Kong, Lei Wu, Yunlong Zhang, Xiaofeng Zhong, Zhen Wang, Yongjie Wang, Yao Pan

entry.summary: Introduces CausalGaze, a hallucination detection framework using structural causal models to actively intervene on LLM internal states via counterfactual graph manipulation, shifting from passive observation to active intervention.

entry.title: TempusBench: An Evaluation Framework for Time-Series Forecasting

author.name: Denizalp Goktas, Gerardo Ria\~no-Brice\~no, Alif Abdullah, Aryan Nair, Chenkai Shen, Beatriz de Lucio, Alexandra Magnusson, Farhan Mashrur, Ahmed Abdulla, Shawrna Sen, Mahitha Thippireddy, Gregory Schwartz, Amy Greenwald

entry.summary: Introduces TempusBench, an evaluation framework for time-series foundation models addressing issues like outdated datasets, data leakage, narrow evaluation metrics, and lack of metadata in current benchmarks.

entry.title: VTC: DNN Compilation with Virtual Tensors for Data Movement Elimination

author.name: Muyan Hu, Ahan Gupta, Jiachen Yuan, Vima Gupta, Taeksang Kim, Xin Xu, Janardhan Kulkarni, Ofer Dekel, Vikram Adve, Charith Mendis

entry.summary: Introduces VTC, a tensor compilation framework using virtual tensors to eliminate all unnecessary data movement in DNN workloads including LLMs, tracking data movement via index mappings rather than physical transfers.

entry.title: FlowHijack: A Dynamics-Aware Backdoor Attack on Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Xinyuan An, Tao Luo, Gengyun Peng, Yaobing Wang, Kui Ren, Dongxia Wang

entry.summary: Introduces FlowHijack, the first backdoor attack targeting flow-matching VLA models (like π₀) for robotics, exploiting the vector field dynamics with a τ-conditioned injection strategy.

entry.title: Learning What's Real: Disentangling Signal and Measurement Artifacts in Multi-Sensor Data, with Applications to Astrophysics

author.name: Pablo Mercader-Perez, Carolina Cuesta-Lazaro, Daniel Muthukrishna, Jeroen Audenaert, V. Ashley Villar, David W. Hogg, Marc Huertas-Company, William T. Freeman

entry.summary: Proposes a deep learning framework using dual-encoder architecture and counterfactual generation to disentangle physical signals from measurement artifacts in multi-sensor data. Applied to astrophysics, it enables better cross-instrument data fusion by explicitly separating intrinsic signals from sensor-specific effects.

entry.title: Generating Hadamard matrices with transformers

author.name: Geordie Williamson, Oded Yacobi, Paul Zinn-Justin

entry.summary: Uses transformer neural networks combined with local search (PatternBoost framework) to construct Hadamard matrices, particularly of Goethals-Seidel type. Produces large numbers of inequivalent matrices up to order 244.

entry.title: AIM: Intent-Aware Unified world action Modeling with Spatial Value Maps

author.name: Liaoyuan Fan, Zetian Xu, Chen Cao, Wenyao Zhang, Mingqi Yuan, Jiayu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces AIM, an intent-aware unified world action model that bridges video generation models and robot control via spatial value maps encoding task-relevant interaction structure, rather than decoding actions directly from visual representations.

entry.title: Reason Only When Needed: Efficient Generative Reward Modeling via Model-Internal Uncertainty

author.name: Chao Xue, Yao Wang, Mengqiao Liu, Di Liang, Xingsheng Han, Peiyang Liu, Xianjie Wu, Chenyao Lu, Lei Jiang, Yu Lu, Haibo Shi, Shuang Liang, Minlong Peng, Flora D. Salim

entry.summary: Proposes E-GRM, an efficient generative reward model that uses model-internal uncertainty to selectively apply Chain-of-Thought prompting only for complex inputs, avoiding unnecessary computation for simpler tasks.

entry.title: Self-Correcting RAG: Enhancing Faithfulness via MMKP Context Selection and NLI-Guided MCTS

author.name: Shijia Xu, Zhou Wu, Xiaolong Jia, Yu Wang, Kai Liu, April Xiaowen Dong

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Correcting RAG that formulates context selection as a multi-dimensional knapsack problem (MMKP) and uses NLI-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search for generation with self-correction.

entry.title: YIELD: A Large-Scale Dataset and Evaluation Framework for Information Elicitation Agents

author.name: Victor De Lima, Grace Hui Yang

entry.summary: Introduces YIELD, a 26M-token dataset of 2,281 human-to-human dialogues for Information Elicitation Agents, formalizing information elicitation as a finite-horizon POMDP. Covers academic interviewing, judicial, and journalistic settings.

entry.title: HiEdit: Lifelong Model Editing with Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yangfan Wang, Tianyang Sun, Chen Tang, Jie Liu, Wei Cai, Jingchi Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes HiEdit, a hierarchical RL framework for lifelong model editing that adaptively identifies knowledge-relevant layers for each edit, avoiding the catastrophic forgetting caused by applying edits to fixed layers.

entry.title: MIXAR: Scaling Autoregressive Pixel-based Language Models to Multiple Languages and Scripts

author.name: Chen Hu, Yintao Tai, Antonio Vergari, Frank Keller, Alessandro Suglia

entry.summary: Introduces MIXAR, the first generative pixel-based language model trained on eight languages with different scripts. Demonstrates substantial improvement over previous pixel-based models and robustness to unseen languages.

entry.title: Self-Evolving LLM Memory Extraction Across Heterogeneous Tasks

author.name: Yuqing Yang, Tengxiao Liu, Wang Bill Zhu, Taiwei Shi, Linxin Song, Robin Jia

entry.summary: Formalizes heterogeneous memory extraction for LLM assistants and introduces BEHEMOTH, a benchmark of 18 datasets spanning personalization, problem-solving, and agentic tasks. Shows no single extraction prompt dominates across task types.

entry.title: MimicLM: Zero-Shot Voice Imitation through Autoregressive Modeling of Pseudo-Parallel Speech Corpora

author.name: Tao Feng, Yuxiang Wang, Yuancheng Wang, Xueyao Zhang, Dekun Chen, Chaoren Wang, Xun Guan, Zhizheng Wu

entry.summary: MimicLM proposes an autoregressive approach to voice imitation that creates pseudo-parallel speech corpora to avoid the scarcity of real triplet training data. The method avoids complex disentanglement architectures and overcomes quality ceilings of synthetic speech targets.

entry.title: Immunizing 3D Gaussian Generative Models Against Unauthorized Fine-Tuning via Attribute-Space Traps

author.name: Jianwei Zhang, Sihan Cao, Chaoning Zhang, Ziming Hong, Jiaxin Huang, Pengcheng Zheng, Caiyan Qin, Wei Dong, Yang Yang, Tongliang Liu

entry.summary: GaussLock is the first approach to defend 3D Gaussian generative models against unauthorized fine-tuning by embedding attribute-space traps that degrade model performance when adversaries attempt to steal pre-trained knowledge.

entry.title: Counting to Four is still a Chore for VLMs

author.name: Duy Le Dinh Anh, Patrick Amadeus Irawan, Tuan Van Vo

entry.summary: COUNTINGTRICKS evaluates VLM counting failures through behavioral and mechanistic analysis, showing count-relevant evidence exists in early layers but degrades through the model, and attention heads barely specialize for counting.

entry.title: U$^{2}$Flow: Uncertainty-Aware Unsupervised Optical Flow Estimation

author.name: Xunpei Sun, Wenwei Lin, Yi Chang, Gang Chen

entry.summary: U²Flow is the first unsupervised optical flow framework that jointly estimates flow and per-pixel uncertainty, using augmentation consistency for uncertainty supervision without ground truth.

entry.title: ExpertEdit: Learning Skill-Aware Motion Editing from Expert Videos

author.name: Arjun Somayazulu, Kristen Grauman

entry.summary: ExpertEdit enables skill-driven motion editing trained on unpaired expert videos, allowing automatic transformation of a person's motion to reflect higher skill levels. From Kristen Grauman's group, it learns expert motion priors without paired input-output data or explicit edit guidance at inference.

entry.title: Immune2V: Image Immunization Against Dual-Stream Image-to-Video Generation

author.name: Zeqian Long, Ozgur Kara, Haotian Xue, Yongxin Chen, James M. Rehg

entry.summary: Immune2V provides the first systematic defense against image-to-video deepfake generation, analyzing why I2V models are robust against naive adversarial attacks and proposing targeted immunization strategies.

entry.title: Do Thought Streams Matter? Evaluating Reasoning in Gemini Vision-Language Models for Video Scene Understanding

author.name: Shivam Sharma, Sankalp Nagaonkar, Ashish Choithani, Ashutosh Trivedi

entry.summary: Evaluates how internal reasoning traces ('thought streams') affect video scene understanding in Gemini models. Introduces metrics for thought usefulness and shows reasoning gains plateau, with GPT-5 as evaluator.

entry.title: Decoupled Similarity for Task-Aware Token Pruning in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Kexin Ma, Jing Xiao, Chaofeng Chen, Geyong Min, Guibo Zhu, Jinqiao Wang, Liang Liao

entry.summary: DeSAP proposes a decoupled similarity-aware pruning method for task-aware visual token pruning in large vision-language models. It captures fine-grained cross-modal relevance to make more informed pruning decisions within the visual encoder.

entry.title: Geoparsing: Diagram Parsing for Plane and Solid Geometry with a Unified Formal Language

author.name: Peijie Wang, Ming-Liang Zhang, Jun Cao, Chao Deng, Dekang Ran, Hongda Sun, Pi Bu, Xuan Zhang, Yingyao Wang, Jun Song, Bo Zheng, Fei Yin, Cheng-Lin Liu

entry.summary: Designs a unified formal language for both plane and solid geometry diagram parsing and constructs GDP-29K dataset with 29K samples. Addresses the perception bottleneck of MLLMs in geometric reasoning.

entry.title: HDR Video Generation via Latent Alignment with Logarithmic Encoding

author.name: Naomi Ken Korem, Mohamed Oumoumad, Harel Cain, Matan Ben Yosef, Urska Jelercic, Ofir Bibi, Yaron Inger, Or Patashnik, Daniel Cohen-Or

entry.summary: Shows that logarithmic encoding, commonly used in cinema, naturally aligns HDR imagery with pretrained generative model latent spaces, enabling lightweight HDR video generation without learning new representations.

entry.title: ViserDex: Visual Sim-to-Real for Robust Dexterous In-hand Reorientation

author.name: Arjun Bhardwaj, Maximum Wilder-Smith, Mayank Mittal, Vaishakh Patil, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: ViserDex uses 3D Gaussian Splatting with domain randomization in Gaussian representation space for sim-to-real transfer of monocular RGB-based dexterous in-hand object reorientation.

entry.title: Winner-Take-All Spiking Transformer for Language Modeling

author.name: Chenlin Zhou, Sihang Guo, Jiaqi Wang, Dongyang Ma, Kaiwei Che, Baiyu Chen, Qingyan Meng, Zhengyu Ma, Yonghong Tian

entry.summary: Introduces Winner-Take-All mechanisms into spiking transformers for language modeling, proposing softmax-free spike-driven self-attention modules (WSSA and CWSSA) suitable for neuromorphic deployment.

entry.title: Vision-Language-Action Model, Robustness, Multi-modal Learning, Robot Manipulation

author.name: Yuhan Xie, Yuping Yan, Yunqi Zhao, Handing Wang, Yaochu Jin

entry.summary: Proposes STRONG-VLA, a decoupled fine-tuning framework that separates robustness training from task-aligned refinement for Vision-Language-Action models. Uses a curriculum of multimodal perturbations in Stage I followed by task refinement, addressing the common conflict between robustness and task fidelity in VLA models.

entry.title: Which Relations Can Be Generalized Implicitly?

author.name: J Bostock

entry.summary: Presents experimental findings on which algebraic relations transformers can implicitly generalize: they can grok abelian group operations more easily than non-abelian ones, and cannot grok truncated infinite groups. Conjectures that transformers can implicitly generalize problems solvable in certain complexity classes.

entry.title: The policy surrounding Mythos marks an irreversible power shift

author.name: sil

entry.summary: Argues that Anthropic's restricted release of Claude Mythos Preview marks an irreversible shift where the public will never again have access to the state-of-the-art AI model, with Glasswing representing a new paradigm of tiered access.

entry.title: OOWM: Structuring Embodied Reasoning and Planning via Object-Oriented Programmatic World Modeling

author.name: Hongyu Chen, Liang Lin, Guangrun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Object-Oriented World Modeling (OOWM), applying software engineering formalisms to structure embodied AI reasoning. Replaces linear chain-of-thought with explicit symbolic state/transition representations for robotic planning.

entry.title: Spatial Competence Benchmark

author.name: Jash Vira, Ashley Harris

entry.summary: SCBench evaluates spatial competence in LLMs across hierarchical capability levels, requiring executable outputs verified by deterministic checkers. Shows frontier models have monotonically decreasing accuracy up the capability ladder.

entry.title: FinTrace: Holistic Trajectory-Level Evaluation of LLM Tool Calling for Long-Horizon Financial Tasks

author.name: Yupeng Cao, Haohang Li, Weijin Liu, Wenbo Cao, Anke Xu, Lingfei Qian, Xueqing Peng, Minxue Tang, Zhiyuan Yao, Jimin Huang, K. P. Subbalakshmi, Zining Zhu, Jordan W. Suchow, Yangyang Yu

entry.summary: FinTrace is a benchmark of 800 expert-annotated trajectories across 34 financial task categories for evaluating LLM tool-calling at the trajectory level, with 9 metrics across 4 axes. Addresses gaps in financial tool-use evaluation.

entry.title: ClawVM: Harness-Managed Virtual Memory for Stateful Tool-Using LLM Agents

author.name: Mofasshara Rafique, Laurent Bindschaedler

entry.summary: ClawVM introduces virtual memory management for stateful LLM agents, treating state as typed pages with fidelity invariants and token budgets. Addresses recurring failures from lost state after compaction and bypassed flushes.

entry.title: TorchUMM: A Unified Multimodal Model Codebase for Evaluation, Analysis, and Post-training

author.name: Yinyi Luo, Wenwen Wang, Hayes Bai, Hongyu Zhu, Hao Chen, Pan He, Marios Savvides, Sharon Li, Jindong Wang

entry.summary: Presents TorchUMM, the first unified codebase for evaluating, analyzing, and post-training unified multimodal models across diverse architectures, tasks (understanding, generation, editing), and datasets.

entry.title: Min-$k$ Sampling: Decoupling Truncation from Temperature Scaling via Relative Logit Dynamics

author.name: Yuanhao Ding, Meimingwei Li, Esteban Garces Arias, Matthias A{\ss}enmacher, Christian Heumann, Chongsheng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Min-k Sampling, a dynamic truncation strategy for LLM decoding that identifies 'semantic cliffs' in sorted logit distributions, decoupling truncation from temperature scaling and achieving temperature invariance.

entry.title: EmergentBridge: Improving Zero-Shot Cross-Modal Transfer in Unified Multimodal Embedding Models

author.name: Jincheng Xie, Xingchen Xiao, Runheng Liu, Zhongyi Huang, Yu Zheng, Heyan Huang

entry.summary: Proposes EmergentBridge, an embedding-level bridging framework that improves zero-shot cross-modal transfer for unpaired modality pairs without requiring exhaustive pairwise supervision. Addresses the sparse-pairing problem in unified multimodal embedding spaces.

entry.title: Retrieval Is Not Enough: Why Organizational AI Needs Epistemic Infrastructure

author.name: Federico Bottino, Carlo Ferrero, Nicholas Dosio, Pierfrancesco Beneventano

entry.summary: Argues that organizational AI needs epistemic infrastructure beyond retrieval - systems must distinguish binding decisions from hypotheses, contested claims from settled ones. Presents OIDA framework with typed Knowledge Objects carrying epistemic metadata.

entry.title: Beyond Offline A/B Testing: Context-Aware Agent Simulation for Recommender System Evaluation

author.name: Nicolas Bougie, Gian Maria Marconi, Xiaotong Ye, Narimasa Watanabe

entry.summary: Introduces ContextSim, an LLM agent framework that simulates believable user proxies for recommender system evaluation by anchoring interactions in daily life activities (time, location, needs).

entry.title: Tuning Qwen2.5-VL to Improve Its Web Interaction Skills

author.name: Alexandra Yakovleva, Henrik P\"arssinen, Harri Valpola, Juho Kannala, Alexander Ilin

entry.summary: Fine-tunes Qwen2.5-VL-32B to improve web interaction reliability, addressing inaccurate element localization, instruction sensitivity, and overoptimistic action assessment biases.

entry.title: Characterizing Performance-Energy Trade-offs of Large Language Models in Multi-Request Workflows

author.name: Md. Monzurul Amin Ifath, Israat Haque

entry.summary: First systematic characterization of performance-energy trade-offs in multi-request LLM inference workflows (document summarization, search copilots, multi-agent programming).

entry.title: Learning noisy phase transition dynamics from stochastic partial differential equations

author.name: Luning Sun, Van Hai Nguyen, Shusen Liu, John Klepeis, Fei Zhou

entry.summary: Develops physics-aware ML surrogates for 3D stochastic Cahn-Hilliard equation that preserve stochasticity, conservation laws, and physical interpretability by parameterizing at the inter-cell flux level.

entry.title: Assessing Privacy Preservation and Utility in Online Vision-Language Models

author.name: Karmesh Siddharam Chaudhari, Youxiang Zhu, Amy Feng, Xiaohui Liang, Honggang Zhang

entry.summary: Investigates privacy risks from uploading images to Online Vision-Language Models, exploring how contextual relationships in images can lead to direct or indirect exposure of Personally Identifiable Information.

entry.title: LAST: Leveraging Tools as Hints to Enhance Spatial Reasoning for Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Shi-Yu Tian, Zhi Zhou, Kun-Yang Yu, Ming Yang, Yang Chen, Ziqiao Shang, Lan-Zhe Guo, Yu-Feng Li

entry.summary: Proposes LAST, a framework that leverages specialized vision tools (segmentation, depth estimation) as hints to enhance spatial reasoning in multimodal LLMs, addressing challenges of invoking heterogeneous tools and interpreting their outputs.

entry.title: RoboLab: A High-Fidelity Simulation Benchmark for Analysis of Task Generalist Policies

author.name: Xuning Yang, Rishit Dagli, Alex Zook, Hugo Hadfield, Ankit Goyal, Stan Birchfield, Fabio Ramos, Jonathan Tremblay

entry.summary: Introduces RoboLab, a simulation benchmarking framework for evaluating robotic foundation models that addresses performance saturation and domain overlap issues in existing benchmarks, testing true generalization under controlled perturbations.

entry.title: A Minimal Model of Representation Collapse: Frustration, Stop-Gradient, and Dynamics

author.name: Louie Hong Yao, Yuhao Li, Shengchao Liu

entry.summary: Introduces a minimal analytical model for studying representation collapse in self-supervised learning, deriving closed-form dynamics and fixed points to understand the role of stop-gradient and asymmetry.

entry.title: CoSToM:Causal-oriented Steering for Intrinsic Theory-of-Mind Alignment in Large Language Models

author.name: Mengfan Li, Xuanhua Shi, Yang Deng

entry.summary: Proposes CoSToM, a causal-oriented steering framework for Theory of Mind alignment in LLMs, transitioning from mechanistic interpretation to active intervention to align internal knowledge with external behavior.

entry.title: IMPACT: A Dataset for Multi-Granularity Human Procedural Action Understanding in Industrial Assembly

author.name: Di Wen, Zeyun Zhong, David Schneider, Manuel Zaremski, Linus Kunzmann, Yitian Shi, Ruiping Liu, Yufan Chen, Junwei Zheng, Jiahang Li, Jonas Hemmerich, Qiyi Tong, Patric Grauberger, Arash Ajoudani, Danda Pani Paudel, Sven Matthiesen, Barbara Deml, J\"urgen Beyerer, Luc Van Gool, Rainer Stiefelhagen, Kunyu Peng

entry.summary: Introduces IMPACT, a synchronized five-view RGB-D dataset for industrial assembly understanding with 112 trials, bimanual annotation, anomaly taxonomy, and cognitive load measurement. First real industrial assembly benchmark with this combination.

entry.title: Toward Accountable AI-Generated Content on Social Platforms: Steganographic Attribution and Multimodal Harm Detection

author.name: Xinlei Guan, David Arosemena, Tejaswi Dhandu, Kuan Huang, Meng Xu, Miles Q. Li, Bingyu Shen, Ruiyang Qin, Umamaheswara Rao Tida, Boyang Li

entry.summary: Introduces a steganographic attribution framework that embeds cryptographic identifiers into AI-generated images and uses multimodal harm detection as a trigger for verification. Evaluates five watermarking methods.

entry.title: GeoMeld: Toward Semantically Grounded Foundation Models for Remote Sensing

author.name: Maram Hasan, Md Aminur Hossain, Savitra Roy, Souparna Bhowmik, Ayush V. Patel, Mainak Singha, Subhasis Chaudhuri, Muhammad Haris Khan, Biplab Banerjee

entry.summary: Presents GeoMeld, a 2.5M sample multimodal remote sensing dataset with spatially aligned heterogeneous modalities and an agentic captioning framework for semantically grounded language supervision.

entry.title: NSFL: A Post-Training Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzy Logic Framework for Boolean Operators in Neural Embeddings

author.name: Vladi Vexler, Ofer Idan, Gil Lederman, Dima Sivov

entry.summary: Introduces NSFL (Neuro-Symbolic Fuzzy Logic), a post-training framework for implementing Boolean operators in neural embedding spaces using t-norms and Neuro-Symbolic Deltas without retraining.

entry.title: Too Nice to Tell the Truth: Quantifying Agreeableness-Driven Sycophancy in Role-Playing Language Models

author.name: Arya Shah, Deepali Mishra, Chaklam Silpasuwanchai

entry.summary: Systematically investigates how persona agreeableness influences sycophancy across 13 small open-weight LLMs (0.6B-20B), developing a benchmark of 275 personas. Quantifies the relationship between personality traits and sycophantic behavior.

entry.title: Regional Explanations: Bridging Local and Global Variable Importance

author.name: Salim I. Amoukou, Nicolas J-B. Brunel

entry.summary: Analyzes fundamental limitations of Local Shapley Values and LIME, showing they can assign importance to irrelevant features. Proposes Regional explanations that bridge local and global importance with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: THEIA: Learning Complete Kleene Three-Valued Logic in a Pure-Neural Modular Architecture

author.name: Augustus Haoyang Li

entry.summary: Presents THEIA, a modular neural architecture that learns complete Kleene three-valued logic end-to-end without symbolic solvers. Achieves compositional generalization from 5-step training to 500-step evaluation at 99.97% accuracy.

entry.title: S$^3$: Structured Sparsity Specification

author.name: Ayoub Ghriss

entry.summary: Introduces S³, an algebraic framework for specifying, composing, and implementing structured sparse patterns in neural networks. Supports diverse patterns from N:M to channel pruning and integrates with OBD/OBS.

entry.title: Emulating Non-Differentiable Metrics via Knowledge-Guided Learning: Introducing the Minkowski Image Loss

author.name: Filippo Quarenghi, Ryan Cotsakis, Tom Beucler

entry.summary: Proposes the Minkowski Image Loss framework to bridge the 'differentiability gap' in Earth system deep learning, approximating non-differentiable scientific metrics with differentiable versions using temperature-controlled sigmoids.

entry.title: Synthius-Mem: Brain-Inspired Hallucination-Resistant Persona Memory Achieving 94.4% Memory Accuracy and 99.6% Adversarial Robustness on LoCoMo

author.name: Artem Gadzhiev, Andrew Kislov

entry.summary: Introduces Synthius-Mem, a brain-inspired structured persona memory system for LLM agents that achieves 94.4% memory accuracy and 99.6% adversarial robustness on LoCoMo benchmark. Addresses hallucination in long-term agent memory.

entry.title: General365: Benchmarking General Reasoning in Large Language Models Across Diverse and Challenging Tasks

author.name: Junlin Liu, Shengnan An, Shuang Zhou, Dan Ma, Shixiong Luo, Ying Xie, Yuan Zhang, Wenling Yuan, Yifan Zhou, Xiaoyu Li, Ziwen Wang, Xuezhi Cao, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: Introduces General365, a benchmark assessing LLMs' general reasoning by restricting background knowledge to K-12 level, decoupling reasoning from domain expertise. Tests complex constraints, nested logic, and semantic interference.

entry.title: Efficient Matrix Implementation for Rotary Position Embedding

author.name: Chen Minqi, Zhongqi Yue, Shihao Zhang, Yun Xu, Peng Wu, kaixiang Xu, Zeyi Huang, Hanwang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RoME, a mathematically equivalent reformulation of Rotary Position Embedding using unified matrix transformations instead of vector split/merge operations, achieving computational efficiency gains especially in multi-dimensional settings.

entry.title: Mitigating Privacy Risk via Forget Set-Free Unlearning

author.name: Aviraj Newatia, Michael Cooper, Viet Nguyen, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: Introduces partially-blind unlearning that removes training data influence from models using auxiliary information rather than requiring direct access to the forget set. Addresses the paradox that organizations must retain data to unlearn it.

entry.title: Learning to Adapt: In-Context Learning Beyond Stationarity

author.name: Zhen Qin, Jiachen Jiang, Zhihui Zhu

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of in-context learning under non-stationary (time-varying) task distributions, bridging the gap between existing stationary ICL theory and real-world scenarios where target functions change over time.

entry.title: Gradient-Variation Regret Bounds for Unconstrained Online Learning

author.name: Yuheng Zhao, Andrew Jacobsen, Nicol\`o Cesa-Bianchi, Peng Zhao

entry.summary: Develops parameter-free algorithms for unconstrained online learning with gradient-variation regret bounds, achieving O(||u||sqrt(V_T(u))) without needing prior knowledge of comparator norm or smoothness. Extends to dynamic regret and SEA model.

entry.title: Autonomous Diffractometry Enabled by Visual Reinforcement Learning

author.name: J. Oppliger, M. Stifter, A. R\"uegg, I. Bia{\l}o, L. Martinelli, P. G. Freeman, D. Prabhakaran, J. Zhao, Q. Wang, J. Chang

entry.summary: Introduces an autonomous crystal alignment system using model-free RL that learns to navigate Laue diffraction patterns to find high-symmetry orientations without crystallography knowledge. Develops human-like strategies across crystal symmetry classes.

entry.title: Byzantine-Robust Distributed SGD: A Unified Analysis and Tight Error Bounds

author.name: Boyuan Ruan, Xiaoyu Wang, Ya-Feng Liu

entry.summary: Provides unified convergence analysis for Byzantine-robust distributed SGD with and without local momentum under general data heterogeneity. Establishes tight error bounds and proves local momentum reduces error floors from Byzantine attacks.

entry.title: One-Step Score-Based Density Ratio Estimation

author.name: Wei Chen, Qibin Zhao, John Paisley, Junmei Yang, Delu Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes OS-DRE, a one-step score-based density ratio estimation framework that combines analytic solutions with score-based methods, avoiding repeated function evaluations while maintaining accuracy for large distribution discrepancies.

entry.title: Trustworthy Feature Importance Avoids Unrestricted Permutations

author.name: Emanuele Borgonovo, Francesco Cappelli, Xuefei Lu, Elmar Plischke, Cynthia Rudin

entry.summary: Proposes three new approaches to feature importance that avoid unrestricted permutations: conditional model reliance with Gaussian transformation, Knockoffs, and restricted ALE plots. Shows these reduce/eliminate extrapolation errors.

entry.title: HTAA: Enhancing LLM Planning via Hybrid Toolset Agentization & Adaptation

author.name: Chengrui Huang, Junshuo Zhang, Zhiyuan Ma, Xikun Wang, Ximeng Wang, Menghua Jiang, Gang Zeng, Zhaobing Han, Shen Gao, Shuo Shang

entry.summary: Proposes HTAA, a hierarchical framework for scalable tool-use planning that encapsulates frequently co-used tools into specialized agent tools and uses asymmetric planner adaptation for coordination.

entry.title: DeCoVec: Building Decoding Space based Task Vector for Large Language Models via In-Context Learning

author.name: Feiyang Li, Yile Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DeCoVec, a training-free framework that constructs task vectors in the decoding space by capturing logit distribution differences between few-shot and zero-shot prompts, then steers generation by injecting this vector.

entry.title: ProGAL-VLA: Grounded Alignment through Prospective Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Nastaran Darabi, Amit Ranjan Trivedi

entry.summary: Proposes ProGAL-VLA for grounding alignment in Vision-Language-Action models using 3D entity-centric graphs and contrastive alignment loss. Improves robustness under perturbations and reduces language ignorance significantly.

entry.title: Reasoning Resides in Layers: Restoring Temporal Reasoning in Video-Language Models with Layer-Selective Merging

author.name: Zihang Fu, Haonan Wang, Jian Kang, Kenji Kawaguchi, Jiaying Wu

entry.summary: Proposes MERIT, a training-free layer-wise model merging framework for restoring temporal reasoning in video-language models that was degraded during visual alignment. Searches over self-attention merging recipes between VLM and text-only backbone.

entry.title: Text-Guided 6D Object Pose Rearrangement via Closed-Loop VLM Agents

author.name: Sangwon Baik, Gunhee Kim, Mingi Choi, Hanbyul Joo

entry.summary: Demonstrates that VLMs can achieve strong 6D object pose rearrangement through closed-loop iterative reasoning with inference-time techniques, despite their known struggles with 3D understanding.

entry.title: RobustMedSAM: Degradation-Resilient Medical Image Segmentation via Robust Foundation Model Adaptation

author.name: Jieru Li, Matthew Chen, Micky C. Nnamdi, J. Ben Tamo, Benoit L. Marteau, May D. Wang

entry.summary: RobustMedSAM combines MedSAM's medical domain adaptation with RobustSAM's corruption robustness through module-wise checkpoint fusion, addressing the joint challenge of medical adaptation and real-world image degradation.

entry.title: On The Application of Linear Attention in Multimodal Transformers

author.name: Armin Gerami, Seyedehanita Madani, Ramani Duraiswami

entry.summary: Investigates linear attention as a replacement for quadratic attention in multimodal transformers, evaluating across ViT scales on LAION-400M and showing competitive ImageNet zero-shot performance with significant compute savings.

entry.title: MedVeriSeg: Teaching MLLM-Based Medical Segmentation Models to Verify Query Validity Without Extra Training

author.name: Ziqian Lu, Qinyue Tong, Jun Liu, Yunlong Yu

entry.summary: MedVeriSeg is a training-free framework that enables LISA-like medical segmentation models to reject false queries by analyzing similarity distribution patterns between [SEG] tokens and image features.

entry.title: Real-Time Human Reconstruction and Animation using Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Devdoot Chatterjee, Zakaria Laskar, C. V. Jawahar

entry.summary: Presents a generalizable feed-forward Gaussian splatting framework for real-time human reconstruction and animation from multi-view RGB, using SMPL-X-anchored Gaussians with unconstrained auxiliary Gaussians.

entry.title: Point2Pose: Occlusion-Recovering 6D Pose Tracking and 3D Reconstruction for Multiple Unknown Objects Via 2D Point Trackers

author.name: Tzu-Yuan Lin, Ho Jae Lee, Kevin Doherty, Yonghyeon Lee, Sangbae Kim

entry.summary: Point2Pose is a model-free method for causal 6D pose tracking of multiple unknown rigid objects from monocular RGB-D, using 2D point trackers for long-range correspondences and instant occlusion recovery.

entry.title: MMRareBench: A Rare-Disease Multimodal and Multi-Image Medical Benchmark

author.name: Junzhi Ning, Jiashi Lin, Yingying Fang, Wei Li, Jiyao Liu, Cheng Tang, Chenglong Ma, Wenhao Tang, Tianbin Li, Ziyan Huang, Guang Yang, Junjun He

entry.summary: MMRareBench is the first rare-disease benchmark evaluating multimodal and multi-image clinical capabilities of MLLMs across diagnosis, treatment planning, cross-image evidence alignment, and clinical reasoning tracks.

entry.title: HO-Flow: Generalizable Hand-Object Interaction Generation with Latent Flow Matching

author.name: Zerui Chen, Rolandos Alexandros Potamias, Shizhe Chen, Jiankang Deng, Cordelia Schmid, Stefanos Zafeiriou

entry.summary: HO-Flow synthesizes realistic hand-object interaction sequences from text and 3D objects using an interaction-aware VAE and masked latent flow matching. From researchers including Cordelia Schmid and Stefanos Zafeiriou.

entry.title: Online Reasoning Video Object Segmentation

author.name: Jinyuan Liu, Yang Wang, Zeyu Zhao, Weixin Li, Song Wang, Ruize Han

entry.summary: Studies Online Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (ORVOS), where models must segment objects from natural language queries using only past/current frames without future information. Introduces a benchmark (ORVOSB) for evaluation.

entry.title: Representations Before Pixels: Semantics-Guided Hierarchical Video Prediction

author.name: Efstathios Karypidis, Spyros Gidaris, Nikos Komodakis

entry.summary: Re2Pix decomposes video prediction into semantic representation prediction followed by representation-guided visual synthesis. First predicts future scene structure in foundation model feature space, then renders with diffusion.

entry.title: SyncFix: Fixing 3D Reconstructions via Multi-View Synchronization

author.name: Deming Li, Abhay Yadav, Cheng Peng, Rama Chellappa, Anand Bhattad

entry.summary: SyncFix enforces cross-view consistency during diffusion-based scene refinement by formulating it as a joint latent bridge matching problem. Trains on image pairs but generalizes to arbitrary view counts.

entry.title: LIDEA: Human-to-Robot Imitation Learning via Implicit Feature Distillation and Explicit Geometry Alignment

author.name: Yifu Xu, Bokai Lin, Xinyu Zhan, Hongjie Fang, Yong-Lu Li, Cewu Lu, Lixin Yang

entry.summary: LIDEA enables human-to-robot imitation learning through implicit feature distillation in 2D visual domain and explicit geometric alignment in 3D space, bridging the embodiment gap between human hands and robot arms.

entry.title: Political Violence Is Never Acceptable

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi strongly condemns political violence against tech leaders after an attempted Molotov cocktail attack on Sam Altman's home, arguing it is both immoral and counterproductive regardless of disagreements about AI policy.

entry.title: Help Without Being Asked: A Deployed Proactive Agent System for On-Call Support with Continuous Self-Improvement

author.name: Fengrui Liu, Xiao He, Tieying Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Vigil, a proactive AI agent system for cloud service on-call support that assists throughout the entire ticket lifecycle rather than just initial interaction. The system continuously self-improves by learning from escalated cases.

entry.title: General-purpose LLMs as Models of Human Driver Behavior: The Case of Simplified Merging

author.name: Samir H. A. Mohammad, Wouter Mooi, Arkady Zgonnikov

entry.summary: Tests OpenAI o3 and Gemini 2.5 Pro as standalone closed-loop driver agents in a merging scenario, comparing their behavior against human driving data. Explores LLMs as behavioral models for autonomous vehicle safety assessment.

entry.title: SVSR: A Self-Verification and Self-Rectification Paradigm for Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Zhe Qian, Nianbing Su, Zhonghua Wang, Hebei Li, Zhongxing Xu, Yueying Li, Fei Luo, Zhuohan Ouyang, Yanbiao Ma

entry.summary: SVSR integrates self-verification and self-rectification into multimodal reasoning through a three-stage training paradigm with forward/backward reasoning traces, preference optimization, and reinforcement learning.

entry.title: From Perception to Planning: Evolving Ego-Centric Task-Oriented Spatiotemporal Reasoning via Curriculum Learning

author.name: Xiaoda Yang, Yuxiang Liu, Shenzhou Gao, Can Wang, Jingyang Xue, Lixin Yang, Yao Mu, Tao Jin, Shuicheng Yan, Zhimeng Zhang, Zhou Zhao

entry.summary: Presents EgoTSR, a curriculum-based framework for learning task-oriented spatiotemporal reasoning in embodied, egocentric settings. Evolves from spatial understanding to task-state assessment to long-horizon planning, with a large-scale supporting dataset.

entry.title: Learning Preference-Based Objectives from Clinical Narratives for Sequential Treatment Decision-Making

author.name: Daniel J. Tan, Kay Choong See, Mengling Feng

entry.summary: Proposes CN-PR, a framework for learning RL reward functions from clinical discharge summaries by treating them as trajectory-level preference supervision. Uses LLMs to derive preferences from narratives for sequential treatment decision-making.

entry.title: SRBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Sequential Recommendation with Large Language Models

author.name: Jianhong Li, Zeheng Qian, Wangze Ni, Haoyang Li, Hongwei Yao, Yang Bai, Kui Ren

entry.summary: Proposes SRBench, a comprehensive benchmark for sequential recommendation with LLMs covering accuracy, fairness, stability, and efficiency. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks that overemphasize accuracy.

entry.title: Assessing Model-Agnostic XAI Methods against EU AI Act Explainability Requirements

author.name: Francesco Sovrano, Giulia Vilone, Michael Lognoul

entry.summary: Assesses model-agnostic XAI methods against EU AI Act explainability requirements, proposing a qualitative-to-quantitative scoring framework for compliance evaluation.

entry.title: Active Inference with a Self-Prior in the Mirror-Mark Task

author.name: Dongmin Kim, Hoshinori Kanazawa, Yasuo Kuniyoshi

entry.summary: Presents a computational model where mirror self-recognition behavior emerges through active inference with a self-prior (Transformer-based), without external reward. A simulated infant discovers and removes a sticker on its face in the mirror.

entry.title: Heterogeneous Consensus-Progressive Reasoning for Efficient Multi-Agent Debate

author.name: Yiqing Liu, Hantao Yao, Wu Liu, Allen He, Yongdong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes HCP-MAD, an efficient multi-agent debate framework that uses consensus as a dynamic signal to route simple tasks to lightweight pair-agent debates and complex tasks to expanded collaboration. Reduces token costs while maintaining reasoning quality.

entry.title: Should We be Pedantic About Reasoning Errors in Machine Translation?

author.name: Calvin Bao, Marine Carpuat

entry.summary: Analyzes reasoning errors in machine translation across multiple language pairs, proposing an automated annotation protocol and testing interventions from hedging to oracle corrections on reasoning traces.

entry.title: Cross-Cultural Value Awareness in Large Vision-Language Models

author.name: Phillip Howard, Xin Su, Kathleen C. Fraser

entry.summary: Conducts multi-dimensional analysis of cultural value awareness in LVLMs, investigating how cultural contexts in images (religion, nationality, socioeconomic status) influence model judgments about a person's values.

entry.title: Semantic Manipulation Localization

author.name: Zhenshan Tan, Chenhan Lu, Yuxiang Huang, Ziwen He, Xiang Zhang, Yuzhe Sha, Xianyi Chen, Tianrun Chen, Zhangjie Fu

entry.summary: Introduces Semantic Manipulation Localization (SML), a new task focused on detecting subtle meaning-altering edits that don't leave obvious low-level artifacts, beyond traditional image manipulation localization.

entry.title: Adapting 2D Multi-Modal Large Language Model for 3D CT Image Analysis

author.name: Yang Yu, Dunyuan Xu, Yaoqian Li, Xiaomeng Li, Jinpeng Li, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: Proposes adapting well-trained 2D multimodal LLMs for 3D CT image analysis, addressing the scarcity of 3D medical training data. Transfers 2D vision encoders to 3D tasks for medical report generation and visual QA.

entry.title: How Many Tries Does It Take? Iterative Self-Repair in LLM Code Generation Across Model Scales and Benchmarks

author.name: Johin Johny Arimbur

entry.summary: Investigates iterative self-repair in LLM code generation across 7 models and 3 families, finding universal improvements of +4.9 to +30 percentage points with up to 5 repair attempts. Gemini 2.5 Flash achieves highest rates.

entry.title: VidAudio-Bench: Benchmarking V2A and VT2A Generation across Four Audio Categories

author.name: Qian Zhang, Yuqin Cao, Yixuan Gao, Xiongkuo Min

entry.summary: Introduces VidAudio-Bench, a multi-task benchmark for video-to-audio generation evaluation covering sound effects, music, speech, and singing across 11 models with 13 task-specific metrics.

entry.title: AffordGen: Generating Diverse Demonstrations for Generalizable Object Manipulation with Afford Correspondence

author.name: Jiawei Zhang, Kaizhe Hu, Yingqian Huang, Yuanchen Ju, Zhengrong Xue, Huazhe Xu

entry.summary: Proposes AffordGen, using 3D generative models and vision foundation models to generate diverse robot manipulation trajectories via semantic keypoint correspondence across 3D meshes for training generalizable policies.

entry.title: Harnessing Photonics for Machine Intelligence

author.name: Hanqing Zhu, Shupeng Ning, Hongjian Zhou, Ziang Yin, Ray T. Chen, Jiaqi Gu, David Z. Pan

entry.summary: Reviews photonic computing from a circuits-and-systems perspective for AI acceleration, analyzing where photonics can deliver end-to-end advantages over electronic systems in the post-Moore era.

entry.title: Mem$^2$Evolve: Towards Self-Evolving Agents via Co-Evolutionary Capability Expansion and Experience Distillation

author.name: Zihao Cheng, Zeming Liu, Yingyu Shan, Xinyi Wang, Xiangrong Zhu, Yunpu Ma, Hongru Wang, Yuhang Guo, Wei Lin, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Mem²Evolve, a framework for self-evolving LLM agents that co-evolves capability expansion (creating new tools/agents) with experience distillation (accumulating knowledge). Addresses the limitation of treating these processes independently.

entry.title: Optimal Stability of KL Divergence under Gaussian Perturbations

author.name: Jialu Pan, Yufeng Zhang, Nan Hu, Keqin Li

entry.summary: Establishes a sharp stability bound for KL divergence under Gaussian perturbations for arbitrary (non-Gaussian) distributions under mild moment conditions. Has applications to out-of-distribution detection with flow-based models.

entry.title: ShapShift: Explaining Model Prediction Shifts with Subgroup Conditional Shapley Values

author.name: Tom Bewley, Salim I. Amoukou, Emanuele Albini, Saumitra Mishra, Manuela Veloso
