entry.summary: Proposes ShapShift, a Shapley value method for explaining model prediction shifts using decision tree-defined subgroups. Attributes shifts to changes in conditional probabilities at tree split nodes, with extensions to ensembles and black-box models.

entry.title: Exploring Knowledge Conflicts for Faithful LLM Reasoning: Benchmark and Method

author.name: Tianzhe Zhao, Jiaoyan Chen, Shuxiu Zhang, Haiping Zhu, Qika Lin, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark and method for studying knowledge conflicts in RAG between external text and knowledge graphs. Addresses the underexplored problem of conflicts across multiple external knowledge sources rather than external vs. parametric knowledge.

entry.title: Learning to Forget -- Hierarchical Episodic Memory for Lifelong Robot Deployment

author.name: Leonard B\"armann, Joana Plewnia, Alex Waibel, Tamim Asfour

entry.summary: Presents H²-EMV, a framework for lifelong robot episodic memory that learns selective forgetting through user interaction. Uses hierarchical memory construction and language-model-based relevance estimation with learned rules updated via user feedback.

entry.title: One Scale at a Time: Scale-Autoregressive Modeling for Fluid Flow Distributions

author.name: Mario Lino, Nils Thuerey

entry.summary: Introduces scale-autoregressive modeling (SAR) for generating fluid flow distributions on unstructured meshes, sampling hierarchically from coarse to fine. Avoids error accumulation of time-stepping surrogates and reduces cost of diffusion methods.

entry.title: NovBench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Academic Paper Novelty Assessment

author.name: Wenqing Wu, Yi Zhao, Yuzhuo Wang, Siyou Li, Juexi Shao, Yunfei Long, Chengzhi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces NovBench, the first large-scale benchmark for evaluating LLMs' ability to assess research novelty in academic papers. Comprises 1,684 paper-review pairs from a leading NLP conference.

entry.title: A Triadic Suffix Tokenization Scheme for Numerical Reasoning

author.name: Olga Chetverina

entry.summary: Introduces Triadic Suffix Tokenization (TST), a deterministic scheme that partitions numbers into three-digit triads with explicit magnitude markers. Aims to fix numerical reasoning errors caused by inconsistent subword tokenization of numbers.

entry.title: CodeTracer: Towards Traceable Agent States

author.name: Han Li, Yifan Yao, Letian Zhu, Rili Feng, Hongyi Ye, Jiaming Wang, Yancheng He, Pengyu Zou, Lehan Zhang, Xinping Lei, Haoyang Huang, Ken Deng, Ming Sun, Zhaoxiang Zhang, He Ye, Jiaheng Liu

entry.summary: Presents CodeTracer, a tracing architecture for debugging code agents that parses heterogeneous run artifacts to identify error chains and state transitions. Addresses the growing difficulty of debugging multi-stage agentic workflows.

entry.title: Multi-ORFT: Stable Online Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Multi-Agent Diffusion Planning in Cooperative Driving

author.name: Haojie Bai, Aimin Li, Ruoyu Yao, Xiongwei Zhao, Tingting Zhang, Xing Zhang, Lin Gao, and Jun Ma

entry.summary: Presents Multi-ORFT, coupling scene-conditioned diffusion pre-training with stable online reinforcement post-training for multi-agent cooperative driving planning. Uses inter-agent attention and AdaLN-Zero conditioning.

entry.title: Below-ground Fungal Biodiversity Can be Monitored Using Self-Supervised Learning Satellite Features

author.name: Robin Young, Michael E. Van Nuland, E. Toby Kiers, Tom\'a\v{s} V\v{e}trovsk\'y, Petr Kohout, Petr Baldrian, Srinivasan Keshav

entry.summary: Demonstrates that self-supervised learning features from satellite imagery can predict below-ground ectomycorrhizal fungal richness, explaining over half the variance across ~12,000 field samples spanning Europe and Asia.

entry.title: The Phase Is the Gradient: Equilibrium Propagation for Frequency Learning in Kuramoto Networks

author.name: Mani Rash Ahmadi

entry.summary: Proves that in Kuramoto oscillator networks at equilibrium, physical phase displacement equals the loss gradient with respect to natural frequencies. Shows frequency learning outperforms coupling-weight learning on sparse architectures.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust PAC-Bayesian Control

author.name: Domagoj Herceg, Duarte Antunes

entry.summary: Presents a distributionally robust PAC-Bayesian framework for certifying learning-based controllers that handles unbounded losses and distribution shifts (sim-to-real gap) using Wasserstein distance and System Level Synthesis.

entry.title: SpectralLoRA: Is Low-Frequency Structure Sufficient for LoRA Adaptation? A Spectral Analysis of Weight Updates

author.name: Rajveer Singh

entry.summary: Performs systematic spectral analysis of LoRA weight updates via DCT, finding they are universally dominated by low-frequency components. Shows 10x storage reduction with minimal accuracy loss by retaining only 10% of frequency coefficients.

entry.title: Robust Adversarial Policy Optimization Under Dynamics Uncertainty

author.name: Mintae Kim, Koushil Sreenath

entry.summary: Proposes dual-formulation distributionally robust RL using Boltzmann reweighting over dynamics ensembles and adversarial temperature approximation to handle sim-to-real gaps. Addresses over-conservatism in existing robust RL.

entry.title: Beyond Fixed False Discovery Rates: Post-Hoc Conformal Selection with E-Variables

author.name: Meiyi Zhu, Osvaldo Simeone

entry.summary: Introduces post-hoc conformal selection (PH-CS) using e-variables, allowing users to adaptively choose FDR levels after observing data rather than fixing them a priori. Provides anytime-valid guarantees.

entry.title: Eliciting Medical Reasoning with Knowledge-enhanced Data Synthesis: A Semi-Supervised Reinforcement Learning Approach

author.name: Haolin Li, Shuyang Jiang, Ruipeng Zhang, Jiangchao Yao, Ya Zhang, Yanfeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MedSSR, a framework combining knowledge-enhanced data synthesis for rare diseases with semi-supervised reinforcement learning to improve medical reasoning in LLMs without expensive chain-of-thought distillation.

entry.title: Differentiable free energy surface: a variational approach to directly observing rare events using generative deep-learning models

author.name: Shuo-Hui Li, Chen Chen, Yao-Wen Zhang, Ding Pan

entry.summary: Introduces VaFES, a dataset-free framework for computing free energy surfaces using tractable-density generative models, enabling direct identification of rare events without extensive sampling of transitions.

entry.title: Shuffling the Data, Stretching the Step-size: Sharper Bias in constant step-size SGD

author.name: Konstantinos Emmanouilidis, Emmanouil-Vasileios Vlatakis-Gkaragkounis, Rene Vidal

entry.summary: Analyzes Random Reshuffling and Richardson-Romberg extrapolation for constant step-size SGD in variational inequality problems. Shows these techniques provide sharper bias bounds and complementary benefits for finite-sum min-max optimization.

entry.title: Omnimodal Dataset Distillation via High-order Proxy Alignment

author.name: Yuxuan Gao, Xiaohao Liu, Xiaobo Xia, Tongliang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces HoPA for omnimodal dataset distillation, capturing high-order cross-modal alignments via a compact proxy to handle more than two modalities. First work to systematically address dataset distillation beyond bimodal settings.

entry.title: Neural Generalized Mixed-Effects Models

author.name: Yuli Slavutsky, Sebastian Salazar, David M. Blei

entry.summary: Replaces the linear function in generalized linear mixed-effects models with neural networks, creating Neural GMMs (NGMMs). Introduces efficient optimization combining Laplace approximation with stochastic gradient methods.

entry.title: Structure-Grounded Knowledge Retrieval via Code Dependencies for Multi-Step Data Reasoning

author.name: Xinyi Huang, Mingzhe Lu, Haoyu Dong

entry.summary: Proposes SGKR, a retrieval framework that organizes domain knowledge using function-call dependency graphs rather than pure lexical/embedding similarity. Targets multi-step data reasoning tasks where relevant knowledge is grounded in code dependencies.

entry.title: Dialectic-Med: Mitigating Diagnostic Hallucinations via Counterfactual Adversarial Multi-Agent Debate

author.name: Zhixiang Lu, Jionglong Su

entry.summary: Proposes Dialectic-Med, a multi-agent framework using adversarial dialectics with proponent, opponent, and judge agents to mitigate diagnostic hallucinations in multimodal medical LLMs through visual falsification.

entry.title: Back to Basics: Let Conversational Agents Remember with Just Retrieval and Generation

author.name: Yuqian Wu, Wei Chen, Zhengjun Huang, Junle Chen, Qingxiang Liu, Kai Wang, Xiaofang Zhou, Yuxuan Liang

entry.summary: Argues that the bottleneck in conversational memory isn't architecture but signal sparsity in the latent knowledge manifold. Identifies Decisive Evidence Sparsity and Dual-Level Redundancy as key phenomena, showing simple retrieval+generation suffices.

entry.title: Visual Late Chunking: An Empirical Study of Contextual Chunking for Efficient Visual Document Retrieval

author.name: Yibo Yan, Mingdong Ou, Yi Cao, Jiahao Huo, Xin Zou, Shuliang Liu, James Kwok, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Proposes ColChunk, a plug-and-play framework for efficient visual document retrieval that uses hierarchical clustering on patch embeddings with 2D position priors to reduce vector count while preserving context.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Synthetic-to-Real Handwritten Text Recognition via Task Analogies

author.name: Carlos Garrido-Munoz, Aniello Panariello, Silvia Cascianelli, Angelo Porrello, Simone Calderara, Jorge Calvo-Zaragoza, Rita Cucchiara

entry.summary: Tackles zero-shot synthetic-to-real handwriting recognition by learning how model parameters change across domains in source languages and transferring these corrections to new target languages without any real data.

entry.title: Do vision models perceive illusory motion in static images like humans?

author.name: Isabella Elaine Rosario (Columbia University), Fan L. Cheng (Columbia University), Zitang Sun (Kyoto University), Nikolaus Kriegeskorte (Columbia University)

entry.summary: Evaluates whether optical flow DNNs can perceive illusory motion in static images (Rotating Snakes illusion), finding most models fail, revealing fundamental differences between human and machine motion processing.

entry.title: YUV20K: A Complexity-Driven Benchmark and Trajectory-Aware Alignment Model for Video Camouflaged Object Detection

author.name: Yiyu Liu, Shuo Ye, Chao Hao, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: YUV20K introduces a large-scale benchmark for video camouflaged object detection with 24K annotated frames targeting challenging motion scenarios, plus a framework addressing motion-induced appearance instability.

entry.title: Radiology Report Generation for Low-Quality X-Ray Images

author.name: Hongze Zhu, Chen Hu, Jiaxuan Jiang, Hong Liu, Yawen Huang, Ming Hu, Tianyu Wang, Zhijian Wu, Yefeng Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes a robust radiology report generation framework for low-quality X-rays, introducing an automated quality assessment agent and a dual-loop training strategy for handling image degradation.

entry.title: Are Pretrained Image Matchers Good Enough for SAR-Optical Satellite Registration?

author.name: Isaac Corley, Alex Stoken, Gabriele Berton

entry.summary: Evaluates 24 pretrained image matcher families in zero-shot SAR-optical satellite registration, finding that cross-modal training doesn't uniformly help and visual-thermal matchers surprisingly work well.

entry.title: DeepShapeMatchingKit: Accelerated Functional Map Solver and Shape Matching Pipelines Revisited

author.name: Yizheng Xie, Lennart Bastian, Congyue Deng, Thomas W. Mitchel, Maolin Gao, Daniel Cremers

entry.summary: DeepShapeMatchingKit provides a vectorized functional map solver achieving 33x speedup, plus documents an implementation divergence in DiffusionNet that affects shape matching benchmarks.

entry.title: GTASA: Ground Truth Annotations for Spatiotemporal Analysis, Evaluation and Training of Video Models

author.name: Nicolae Cudlenco, Mihai Masala, Marius Leordeanu

entry.summary: GTASA provides a corpus of multi-actor videos with per-frame spatial relation graphs and temporal mappings generated via a game engine, showing advantages over neural generators for evaluation and training.

entry.title: BareBones: Benchmarking Zero-Shot Geometric Comprehension in VLMs

author.name: Aaditya Baranwal, Vishal Yadav, Abhishek Rajora

entry.summary: BareBones is a zero-shot benchmark testing whether VLMs genuinely understand geometric structure or merely exploit RGB textures. Uses pixel-level silhouettes to isolate pure geometric shape comprehension from texture-based shortcuts.

entry.title: Learning 3D Representations for Spatial Intelligence from Unposed Multi-View Images

author.name: Bo Zhou, Qiuxia Lai, Zeren Sun, Xiangbo Shu, Yazhou Yao, Wenguan Wang

entry.summary: UniSplat learns 3D representations from unposed multi-view images through a feed-forward framework with dual-masking strategy, appearance refinement, and geometry-semantic consistency. Targets spatial intelligence foundations for embodied AI.

entry.title: HuiYanEarth-SAR: A Foundation Model for High-Fidelity and Low-Cost Global Remote Sensing Imagery Generation

author.name: Yongxiang Liu, Jie Zhou, Yafei Song, Tianpeng Liu, Li Liu

entry.summary: HuiYanEarth-SAR is the first foundational SAR imagery generation model that integrates geospatial priors with scattering mechanisms for high-fidelity global SAR image generation. Addresses data scarcity in SAR research.

entry.title: GeomPrompt: Geometric Prompt Learning for RGB-D Semantic Segmentation Under Missing and Degraded Depth

author.name: Krishna Jaganathan, Patricio Vela

entry.summary: GeomPrompt synthesizes geometric prompts from RGB alone for frozen RGB-D segmentation models when depth is missing or degraded. Training-free approach using only segmentation supervision, not depth estimation.

entry.title: STS-Mixer: Spatio-Temporal-Spectral Mixer for 4D Point Cloud Video Understanding

author.name: Wenhao Li, Xueying Jiang, Gongjie Zhang, Xiaoqin Zhang, Ling Shao, Shijian Lu

entry.summary: STS-Mixer introduces a spectral perspective for 4D point cloud video understanding by transforming point clouds into graph spectral signals and decomposing them into frequency bands capturing distinct geometric structures.

entry.title: LMMs Meet Object-Centric Vision: Understanding, Segmentation, Editing and Generation

author.name: Yuqian Yuan, Wenqiao Zhang, Juekai Lin, Yu Zhong, Mingjian Gao, Binhe Yu, Yunqi Cao, Wentong Li, Yueting Zhuang, Beng Chin Ooi

entry.summary: Survey of object-centric vision approaches with Large Multimodal Models, covering understanding, segmentation, editing, and generation. Identifies limitations of LMMs in precise object-level grounding and manipulation.

entry.title: OmniShow: Unifying Multimodal Conditions for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation

author.name: Donghao Zhou, Guisheng Liu, Hao Yang, Jiatong Li, Jingyu Lin, Xiaohu Huang, Yichen Liu, Xin Gao, Cunjian Chen, Shilei Wen, Chi-Wing Fu, Pheng-Ann Heng

entry.summary: OmniShow is an end-to-end framework for human-object interaction video generation conditioned on text, reference images, audio, and pose. Introduces unified channel-wise conditioning for harmonizing multimodal inputs.

entry.title: GPU-Accelerated Continuous-Time Successive Convexification for Contact-Implicit Legged Locomotion

author.name: Samuel C. Buckner, Purnanand Elango

entry.summary: GPU-accelerated contact-implicit trajectory optimization using continuous-time successive convexification. Introduces integral cross-complementarity constraints that avoid missing contact events between discretization nodes.

entry.title: ScoRe-Flow: Complete Distributional Control via Score-Based Reinforcement Learning for Flow Matching

author.name: Xiaotian Qiu, Lukai Chen, Jinhao Li, Qi Sun, Cheng Zhuo, Guohao Dai

entry.summary: Proposes ScoRe-Flow, a method for RL fine-tuning of Flow Matching policies that modulates the drift via the score function rather than just injecting noise. Provides complete distributional control for going beyond imitation learning demonstrations.

entry.title: DA-PTQ: Drift-Aware Post-Training Quantization for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Siyuan Xu, Tianshi Wang, Fengling Li, Lei Zhu, Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes DA-PTQ, a drift-aware post-training quantization method for VLA models that addresses temporal error accumulation at the vision-language-to-action interface during sequential control. Formulates quantization as a drift-aware optimization problem.

entry.title: ConfigSpec: Profiling-Based Configuration Selection for Distributed Edge--Cloud Speculative LLM Serving

author.name: Xiangchen Li, Saeid Ghafouri, Jiakun Fan, Babar Ali, Hans Vandierendonck, Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos

entry.summary: Presents ConfigSpec, a framework for selecting optimal configurations in distributed speculative LLM serving across edge-cloud systems, modeling throughput, acceptance rate, and power across the configuration space.

entry.title: A Queueing-Theoretic Framework for Dynamic Attack Surfaces: Data-Integrated Risk Analysis and Adaptive Defense

author.name: Jihyeon Yun, Abdullah Yasin Etcibasi, Ming Shi, C. Emre Koksal

entry.summary: Develops a queueing-theoretic framework for modeling cyber-attack surfaces where vulnerabilities are queue backlogs. Shows that even symmetric AI automation can increase successful exploit rates.

entry.title: Shared Emotion Geometry Across Small Language Models: A Cross-Architecture Study of Representation, Behavior, and Methodological Confounds

author.name: Jihoon Jeong

entry.summary: Finds that small language models (1B-8B) across five architectures share nearly identical 21-emotion geometry in their representations, despite having very different behavioral profiles. Suggests a universal emotional representation layer.

entry.title: CLAY: Conditional Visual Similarity Modulation in Vision-Language Embedding Space

author.name: Sohwi Lim, Lee Hyoseok, Jungjoon Park, Tae-Hyun Oh

entry.summary: Proposes CLAY, a method for adaptive visual similarity computation that reframes VLM embedding spaces as text-conditional similarity spaces without additional training. Enables multi-conditioned image retrieval with fixed visual embeddings.

entry.title: Exact Certification of Neural Networks and Partition Aggregation Ensembles against Label Poisoning

author.name: Ajinkya Mohgaonkar, Lukas Gosch, Mahalakshmi Sabanayagam, Debarghya Ghoshdastidar, Stephan G\"unnemann

entry.summary: Introduces EnsembleCert, the first white-box certification framework for partition-aggregation ensembles against label-flipping attacks, yielding tighter robustness guarantees than black-box approaches.

entry.title: Orthogonal machine learning for conditional odds and risk ratios

author.name: Jiacheng Ge, Iv\'an D\'iaz

entry.summary: Proposes orthogonal machine learning methods for estimating conditional odds ratios and risk ratios, generalizing DR-learner and R-learner approaches. Derives orthogonal risk functions enabling flexible ML estimation of these treatment effect measures.

entry.title: Judge Like Human Examiners: A Weighted Importance Multi-Point Evaluation Framework for Generative Tasks with Long-form Answers

author.name: Guoxin Yu, Chulun Zhou, Lemao Liu, Qi Wang, Mo Yu, Jialong Tang, Baosong Yang, Xiang Ao, Wao Lam, Yue Yu

entry.summary: Proposes WIMPE, an evaluation framework for long-form generative tasks that factorizes reference answers into weighted, context-bound scoring points, inspired by human exam grading. Addresses the challenge of heterogeneous importance across answer aspects.

entry.title: Bridging What the Model Thinks and How It Speaks: Self-Aware Speech Language Models for Expressive Speech Generation

author.name: Kuang Wang, Lai Wei, Qibing Bai, Ping Lin, Wenkai Fang, Feng Jiang, Zhongjie Jiang, Jun Huang, Yannan Wang, Haizhou Li

entry.summary: Proposes SA-SLM (Self-Aware Speech Language Model) that addresses the gap between semantic understanding and acoustic expressiveness in speech LMs by providing utterance-level intent signals and realization-aware training feedback.

entry.title: VLN-NF: Feasibility-Aware Vision-and-Language Navigation with False-Premise Instructions

author.name: Hung-Ting Su, Ting-Jun Wang, Jia-Fong Yeh, Min Sun, Winston H. Hsu

entry.summary: Introduces VLN-NF, a benchmark for vision-and-language navigation with false-premise instructions where targets don't exist in specified locations. Proposes ROAM, a two-stage agent that navigates, explores, and decides NOT-FOUND.

entry.title: Topo-ADV: Generating Topology-Driven Imperceptible Adversarial Point Clouds

author.name: Gayathry Chandramana Krishnan Nampoothiry, Raghuram Venkatapuram, Anirban Ghosh, Ayan Dutta

entry.summary: Topo-ADV introduces the first topology-driven adversarial attack on 3D point clouds, exploiting homological structure as a previously unexplored vulnerability surface for deep learning models.

entry.title: Learnable Motion-Focused Tokenization for Effective and Efficient Video Unsupervised Domain Adaptation

author.name: Tzu Ling Liu, Ian Stavness, Mrigank Rochan

entry.summary: LMFT proposes learnable motion-focused tokenization for video domain adaptation that discards low-motion background tokens to reduce domain shift and computational cost in action recognition.

entry.title: VGGT-HPE: Reframing Head Pose Estimation as Relative Pose Prediction

author.name: Vasiliki Vasileiou, Panagiotis P. Filntisis, Petros Maragos, Kostas Daniilidis

entry.summary: VGGT-HPE reformulates head pose estimation as relative pose prediction between two views using a geometry foundation model, trained only on synthetic data while achieving robust real-world performance.

entry.title: SignReasoner: Compositional Reasoning for Complex Traffic Sign Understanding via Functional Structure Units

author.name: Ruibin Wang, Zhenyu Lin, Xinhai Zhao

entry.summary: SignReasoner transforms VLMs into traffic sign experts through Functional Structure Unit decomposition, breaking complex signs into minimal functional blocks for compositional generalization.

entry.title: Enhancing Fine-Grained Spatial Grounding in 3D CT Report Generation via Discriminative Guidance

author.name: Chenyu Wang, Weicheng Dai, Han Liu, Wenchao Li, Kayhan Batmanghelich

entry.summary: Proposes discriminative cue-prompting with prompt dropout for improving fine-grained spatial grounding in 3D CT report generation, distilling location-specific cues from free-text reports.

entry.title: Structured State-Space Regularization for Compact and Generation-Friendly Image Tokenization

author.name: Jinsung Lee, Jaemin Oh, Namhun Kim, Dongwon Kim, Byung-Jun Yoon, Suha Kwak

entry.summary: Introduces a novel regularizer for image tokenizers based on state-space model dynamics, transferring frequency awareness to latent features for more compact and generation-friendly representations.

entry.title: PACO: Proxy-Task Alignment and Online Calibration for On-the-Fly Category Discovery

author.name: Weidong Tang, Bohan Zhang, Zhixiang Chi, ZiZhang Wu, Yang Wang, Yanan Wu

entry.summary: PACO addresses on-the-fly category discovery with proxy-task alignment and online calibration, treating it as a dynamic process rather than static classification. Moves beyond single-threshold discovery mechanisms.

entry.title: Seeing Through the Tool: A Controlled Benchmark for Occlusion Robustness in Foundation Segmentation Models

author.name: Nhan Ho, Luu Le, Thanh-Huy Nguyen, Thien Nguyen, Xiaofeng Liu, Ulas Bagci

entry.summary: OccSAM-Bench systematically evaluates SAM-family models under controlled surgical occlusion scenarios. Introduces a three-region evaluation protocol that decomposes performance into full, visible, and invisible targets.

entry.title: Device-Conditioned Neural Architecture Search for Efficient Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Yiming Wu, Huan Wang, Zhenghao Chen, Ge Yuan, Dong Xu

entry.summary: DC-QFA proposes a unified framework for device-conditioned neural architecture search for robotic manipulation, using quantization-aware training with hardware constraints for efficient deployment across heterogeneous platforms.

entry.title: At FullTilt: Real-Time Open-Set 3D Macromolecule Detection Directly from Tilted 2D Projections

author.name: Ming-Yang Ho, Alberto Bartesaghi

entry.summary: FullTilt performs open-set 3D macromolecule detection directly from 2D tilt-series in cryo-ET, eliminating redundant volumetric computation and accelerating inference by orders of magnitude compared to sliding-window approaches.

entry.title: Energy-oriented Diffusion Bridge for Image Restoration with Foundational Diffusion Models

author.name: Jinhui Hou, Zhiyu Zhu, Junhui Hou

entry.summary: E-Bridge proposes an energy-oriented diffusion bridge framework for image restoration that approximates low-cost manifold geodesic trajectories, reducing trajectory energy through a novel bridge process over shorter time horizons.

entry.title: Seeing Through Touch: Tactile-Driven Visual Localization of Material Regions

author.name: Seongyu Kim, Seungwoo Lee, Hyeonggon Ryu, Joon Son Chung, Arda Senocak

entry.summary: Proposes tactile-driven visual localization that identifies image regions matching tactile input material properties. Introduces local visuo-tactile alignment via dense cross-modal feature interactions and new datasets with in-the-wild scenes.

entry.title: ReaLiTy and LADS: A Unified Framework and Dataset Suite for LiDAR Adaptation Across Sensors and Adverse Weather Conditions

author.name: Vivek Anand, Bharat Lohani, Rakesh Mishra, Gaurav Pandey

entry.summary: ReaLiTy framework transforms LiDAR data to match different sensor specifications and weather conditions using physics-informed methods. Introduces LADS dataset for systematic domain adaptation analysis.

entry.title: MobiFlow: Real-World Mobile Agent Benchmarking through Trajectory Fusion

author.name: Yunfei Feng, Xi Zhao, Cheng Zhang, Dahu Feng, Daolin Cheng, Jianqi Yu, Yubin Xia, Erhu Feng

entry.summary: MobiFlow is an evaluation framework for mobile agents that works with arbitrary third-party apps using trajectory fusion, addressing the mismatch between emulator-based benchmarks and real-world mobile agent deployment.

entry.title: Hubble: An LLM-Driven Agentic Framework for Safe and Automated Alpha Factor Discovery

author.name: Runze Shi, Shengyu Yan, Yuecheng Cai, Chengxi Lv

entry.summary: Hubble is a closed-loop alpha factor mining framework for quantitative finance that uses LLMs as intelligent search heuristics, constrained by domain-specific operators and an AST-based execution sandbox for safety.

entry.title: Edu-MMBias: A Three-Tier Multimodal Benchmark for Auditing Social Bias in Vision-Language Models under Educational Contexts

author.name: Ruijia Li, Mingzi Zhang, Zengyi Yu, Yuang Wei, Bo Jiang

entry.summary: Edu-MMBias is a systematic framework for auditing social bias in Vision-Language Models in educational contexts, diagnosing bias across cognitive, affective, and behavioral dimensions using a tri-component attitude model from social psychology.

entry.title: TimeSeriesExamAgent: Creating Time Series Reasoning Benchmarks at Scale

author.name: Malgorzata Gwiazda, Yifu Cai, Mononito Goswami, Arjun Choudhry, Artur Dubrawski

entry.summary: TimeSeriesExamAgent creates scalable time series reasoning benchmarks combining templates with LLM agents, covering five core categories. Shows current models have substantial gaps especially in causality and anomaly detection.

entry.title: CWCD: Category-Wise Contrastive Decoding for Structured Medical Report Generation

author.name: Shantam Srivastava, Mahesh Bhosale, David Doermann, Mingchen Gao

entry.summary: CWCD proposes category-wise contrastive decoding for radiology report generation, addressing the problem where current single-pass generation loses attention to visual tokens and introduces spurious pathology co-occurrences.

entry.title: Safety Guarantees in Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning for Cascade Dynamical Systems

author.name: Shima Rabiei, Sandipan Mishra, Santiago Paternain

entry.summary: Proves zero-shot safety guarantees for cascade dynamical systems by training RL policies on reduced-order models and combining with low-level tracking controllers, with formal probability bounds.

entry.title: Principles Do Not Apply Themselves: A Hermeneutic Perspective on AI Alignment

author.name: Behrooz Razeghi

entry.summary: Argues that AI alignment has an inherently interpretive component, analyzed through hermeneutics. Points out that general principles don't self-apply and require context-sensitive judgment, connecting to empirical findings about preference-labeling ambiguity.

entry.title: Back to the Barn with LLAMAs: Evolving Pretrained LLM Backbones in Finetuning Vision Language Models

author.name: Sameera Horawalavithana, Lauren Phillips, Ian Stewart, Sai Munikoti, Karl Pazdernik

entry.summary: Systematically investigates how swapping pretrained LLM backbones affects VLM performance across multimodal reasoning, alignment, and task-specific benchmarks. Studies the impact of evolving LLM capabilities on VLM development.

entry.title: From Answers to Arguments: Toward Trustworthy Clinical Diagnostic Reasoning with Toulmin-Guided Curriculum Goal-Conditioned Learning

author.name: Chen Zhan, Xiaoyu Tan, Gengchen Ma, Yu-Jie Xiong, Xiaoyan Jiang, Xihe Qiu

entry.summary: Proposes a Toulmin-guided curriculum learning framework for trustworthy clinical diagnostic reasoning in LLMs. Addresses the problem of 'correct answers through flawed reasoning' by demanding transparent argumentative structure.

entry.title: Measuring the Authority Stack of AI Systems: Empirical Analysis of 366,120 Forced-Choice Responses Across 8 AI Models

author.name: Seulki Lee

entry.summary: Presents large-scale empirical mapping (366,120 responses across 8 AI models) of AI decision-making across value priorities, evidence preferences, and source trust hierarchies using the PRISM benchmark. Reveals systematic patterns including a 4:4 split between Universalism-first and Security-first models.

entry.title: Select Smarter, Not More: Prompt-Aware Evaluation Scheduling with Submodular Guarantees

author.name: Xiaoyu Ma, Yiwen Li, Haoyue Liu, Zhichao Wang, Ye Chen, Yongxin Guo, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: Proposes POES for efficient prompt evaluation during automatic prompt optimization. Maps APO to online adaptive testing using IRT-based discrimination, achieving principled budget allocation with submodular guarantees.

entry.title: From Agent Loops to Structured Graphs:A Scheduler-Theoretic Framework for LLM Agent Execution

author.name: Hu Wei

entry.summary: Proposes SGH (Structured Graph Harness), framing agent loops as single-ready-unit schedulers and lifting control flow to inspectable directed acyclic graphs. Addresses implicit dependencies, unbounded recovery, and mutable history in agent loops.

entry.title: Context Kubernetes: Declarative Orchestration of Enterprise Knowledge for Agentic AI Systems

author.name: Charafeddine Mouzouni

entry.summary: Proposes Context Kubernetes, an architecture that applies Kubernetes-like declarative orchestration patterns to manage enterprise knowledge for agentic AI systems. Includes YAML-based manifests and a three-tier agent permission model.

entry.title: GenTac: Generative Modeling and Forecasting of Soccer Tactics

author.name: Jiayuan Rao, Tianlin Gui, Haoning Wu, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie

entry.summary: Introduces GenTac, a diffusion-based generative framework for modeling soccer tactics as stochastic processes over continuous multi-player trajectories and discrete events. Samples diverse, plausible long-horizon future trajectories.

entry.title: Para-B&B: Load-Balanced Deterministic Parallelization of Solving MIP

author.name: Jinyu Zhang, Di Huang, Yue Liu, Shuo Wang, Zhenyu Pu, Zhiyuan Liu

entry.summary: Presents the first fully open-source implementation of deterministic parallel branch-and-bound for HiGHS MIP solver, with a novel data-parallel architecture ensuring strict determinism.

entry.title: AEG: A Baremetal Framework for AI Acceleration via Direct Hardware Access in Heterogeneous Accelerators

author.name: Hua Jiang, Sayan Mandal, Brandon Kirincich, Govind Varadarajan

entry.summary: Introduces a baremetal runtime architecture for high-performance ML inference on heterogeneous accelerators without OS overhead, using Runtime Control Blocks to flatten complex control logic.

entry.title: HearthNet: Edge Multi-Agent Orchestration for Smart Homes

author.name: Zhonghao Zhan, Krinos Li, Yefan Zhang, Hamed Haddadi

entry.summary: Presents HearthNet, an edge multi-agent orchestration system for smart homes using persistent, role-specialized LLM agents coordinating through MQTT and Git-backed shared state.

entry.title: WearBCI Dataset: Understanding and Benchmarking Real-World Wearable Brain-Computer Interfaces Signals

author.name: Haoxian Liu, Hengle Jiang, Lanxuan Hong, Xiaomin Ouyang

entry.summary: Introduces WearBCI, the first dataset comprehensively evaluating wearable brain-computer interface signals under different motion dynamics with synchronized multimodal recordings.

entry.title: Training Deep Visual Networks Beyond Loss and Accuracy Through a Dynamical Systems Approach

author.name: Hai La Quang, Hassan Ugail, Newton Howard, Cong Tran Tien, Nam Vu Hoai, Hung Nguyen Viet

entry.summary: Introduces a dynamical systems perspective for studying deep network training, defining integration, metastability, and dynamics scores from layer activations to understand internal representation changes beyond loss/accuracy.

entry.title: Multi-Frequency Local Plasticity for Visual Representation Learning

author.name: Mehdi Fatan Serj, C. Alejandro Parraga, Xavier Otazu

entry.summary: Introduces a modular hierarchical framework for visual representation learning using fixed Gabor decomposition, Hebbian learning, and Hopfield retrieval without end-to-end backpropagation, achieving 57% on CIFAR-100.

entry.title: I Walk the Line: Examining the Role of Gestalt Continuity in Object Binding for Vision Transformers

author.name: Alexa R. Tartaglini, Michael A. Lepori

entry.summary: Investigates whether vision transformers rely on Gestalt continuity principles for object binding, examining how pretrained models associate portions of images containing objects.

entry.title: Like a Hammer, It Can Build, It Can Break: Large Language Model Uses, Perceptions, and Adoption in Cybersecurity Operations on Reddit

author.name: Souradip Nath, Chih-Yi Huang, Aditi Ganapathi, Kashyap Thimmaraju, Jaron Mink, Gail-Joon Ahn

entry.summary: Mixed-methods analysis of 892 Reddit posts examining how cybersecurity practitioners use, perceive, and adopt LLMs for Security Operations Center workflows, providing empirical grounding for practitioner perspectives.

entry.title: LVSum: A Benchmark for Timestamp-Aware Long Video Summarization

author.name: Alkesh Patel, Melis Ozyildirim, Ying-Chang Cheng, Ganesh Nagarajan

entry.summary: Introduces LVSum, a human-annotated benchmark for long video summarization with fine-grained temporal alignment across 13 domains, with new LLM-based evaluation metrics for content relevance and temporal grounding.

entry.title: Degradation-Consistent Paired Training for Robust AI-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Zongyou Yang, Yinghan Hou, Xiaokun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Degradation-Consistent Paired Training (DCPT) for robust AI-generated image detection, explicitly enforcing consistency between clean and degraded views through feature and prediction constraints.

entry.title: FashionMV: Product-Level Composed Image Retrieval with Multi-View Fashion Data

author.name: Peng Yuan, Bingyin Mei, Hui Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces FashionMV, the first large-scale multi-view fashion dataset for product-level composed image retrieval with 127K products and 472K images. Formalizes the Multi-View CIR task bridging single-image retrieval to product-level reasoning.

entry.title: Rethinking the Diffusion Model from a Langevin Perspective

author.name: Candi Zheng, Yuan Lan

entry.summary: Provides a pedagogical reframing of diffusion models from a Langevin dynamics perspective, unifying ODE and SDE approaches. Addresses why flow matching is not fundamentally simpler than denoising.

entry.title: ReFEree: Reference-Free and Fine-Grained Method for Evaluating Factual Consistency in Real-World Code Summarization

author.name: Suyoung Bae, CheolWon Na, Jaehoon Lee, Yumin Lee, YunSeok Choi, Jee-Hyong Lee

entry.summary: Proposes ReFEree, a reference-free method for evaluating factual consistency of LLM-generated code summaries at segment level, addressing the gap in evaluating multi-sentence summaries of real-world code.

entry.title: STORM: End-to-End Referring Multi-Object Tracking in Videos

author.name: Zijia Lu, Jingru Yi, Jue Wang, Yuxiao Chen, Junwen Chen, Xinyu Li, Davide Modolo

entry.summary: Introduces STORM, an end-to-end MLLM for referring multi-object tracking that jointly performs grounding and tracking, with task-composition learning to improve data efficiency.

entry.title: COREY: A Prototype Study of Entropy-Guided Operator Fusion with Hadamard Reparameterization for Selective State Space Models

author.name: Bo Ma, Jinsong Wu, Hongjiang Wei, Weiqi Yan

entry.summary: Proposes COREY, a framework combining memory-aware operator fusion with Hadamard reparameterization for State Space Models, using activation entropy for runtime scheduling of fusion boundaries.

entry.title: Verify Before You Fix: Agentic Execution Grounding for Trustworthy Cross-Language Code Analysis

author.name: Jugal Gajjar

entry.summary: Proposes execution-grounded agentic validation for cross-language vulnerability analysis where no repair action is taken without execution-based confirmation of exploitability.

entry.title: Speaking to No One: Ontological Dissonance and the Double Bind of Conversational AI

author.name: Hugh Brosnahan, Izabela Lipinska

entry.summary: Argues that conversational AI creates 'ontological dissonance' from the appearance of relational presence without any subject, potentially contributing to delusional experiences in vulnerable users.

entry.title: LLMs for Qualitative Data Analysis Fail on Security-specificComments in Human Experiments

author.name: Maria Camporese, Fabio Massacci, Yuanjun Gong

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs can replace human annotators for thematic analysis of security-specific comments in human experiments. Finds LLMs fail at coding security-specific aspects requiring deeper contextual understanding.

entry.title: Task2vec Readiness: Diagnostics for Federated Learning from Pre-Training Embeddings

author.name: Cristiano Mafuz, Rodrigo Silva

entry.summary: Proposes readiness indices from Task2Vec embeddings to predict federated learning performance before training, quantifying federation alignment through cohesion, dispersion, and density metrics.

entry.title: Beyond A Fixed Seal: Adaptive Stealing Watermark in Large Language Models

author.name: Shuhao Zhang, Yuli Chen, Jiale Han, Bo Cheng, Jiabao Ma

entry.summary: Introduces Adaptive Stealing (AS), a new watermark stealing algorithm for LLMs that adapts to the non-uniform distribution of watermark information and dynamic generation processes. Uses position-based construction and adaptive selection modules.

entry.title: A Systematic Analysis of the Impact of Persona Steering on LLM Capabilities

author.name: Jiaqi Chen, Ming Wang, Tingna Xie, Shi Feng, Yongkang Liu

entry.summary: Systematically studies how persona induction via neuron-based personality trait manipulation affects LLM cognitive capabilities across six benchmarks. Finds persona changes produce measurable shifts in task performance beyond surface-level style.

entry.title: Record-Remix-Replay: Hierarchical GPU Kernel Optimization using Evolutionary Search

author.name: Daniel Nichols, Konstantinos Parasyris, Caetano Melone, Tal Ben-Nun, Giorgis Georgakoudis, Harshitha Menon

entry.summary: Presents Record-Remix-Replay (R³), a hierarchical evolutionary search framework for GPU kernel optimization that searches across algorithm design, implementation, compiler settings, and launch parameters simultaneously.

entry.title: BoxTuning: Directly Injecting the Object Box for Multimodal Model Fine-Tuning

author.name: Zekun Qian, Ruize Han, Wei Feng

entry.summary: Proposes BoxTuning, which injects object spatial-temporal information directly as visual overlays (colored bounding boxes, trajectory trails) on video frames rather than encoding coordinates as text tokens, addressing modality mismatch in video QA.

entry.title: Cost-optimal Sequential Testing via Doubly Robust Q-learning

author.name: Doudou Zhou, Yiran Zhang, Dian Jin, Yingye Zheng, Lu Tian, Tianxi Cai

entry.summary: Develops a doubly robust Q-learning framework for learning cost-optimal sequential testing policies from retrospective clinical data with informative missingness. Introduces path-specific inverse probability weights for heterogeneous test trajectories.

entry.title: Minimal Embodiment Enables Efficient Learning of Number Concepts in Robot

author.name: Zhegong Shangguan, Alessandro Di Nuovo, Angelo Cangelosi

entry.summary: Shows that embodied robots achieve 96.8% counting accuracy with only 10% of training data compared to 60.6% for vision-only baselines, demonstrating that embodiment acts as a structural prior for learning numerical concepts.

entry.title: ADD for Multi-Bit Image Watermarking

author.name: An Luo, Jie Ding

entry.summary: Proposes ADD (Add, Dot, Decode), a multi-bit image watermarking method that embeds messages via linear combination with a learned watermark and decodes through inner products. Aims for high capacity, resilience to distortions, and theoretical justification.

entry.title: Not All Forgetting Is Equal: Architecture-Dependent Retention Dynamics in Fine-Tuned Image Classifiers

author.name: Miit Daga, Swarna Priya Ramu

entry.summary: Tracks per-sample forgetting during fine-tuning of ResNet-18 and DeiT-Small, fitting Ebbinghaus-style decay curves. Finds architectures forget fundamentally different samples (Jaccard overlap only 0.3), with implications for curriculum design and ensemble construction.

entry.title: SVD-Prune: Training-Free Token Pruning For Efficient Vision-Language Models

author.name: Yvon Apedo, Martyna Poreba, Michal Szczepanski, Samia Bouchafa

entry.summary: Proposes SVD-Prune, a training-free token pruning method for vision-language models based on singular value decomposition. Addresses positional bias and information dispersion issues in existing attention-based pruning methods.

entry.title: Fairness is Not Flat: Geometric Phase Transitions Against Shortcut Learning

author.name: Nicolas Rodriguez-Alvarez (Instituto de Educacion Secundaria Parquesol, Valladolid, Spain), Fernando Rodriguez-Merino (University of Valladolid, Valladolid, Spain)

entry.summary: Proposes a geometric methodology to mitigate shortcut learning in deep neural networks, using a zero-hidden-layer Topological Auditor to isolate gradient-monopolizing features. Demonstrates a Capacity Phase Transition when linear shortcuts are pruned.

entry.title: Belief-State RWKV for Reinforcement Learning under Partial Observability

author.name: Liu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes interpreting RWKV's recurrent state as an explicit belief state with uncertainty (mean and covariance) for RL under partial observability. Pilot experiments show benefit of uncertainty-aware control.

entry.title: Topology-Aware PAC-Bayesian Generalization Analysis for Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Xinping Yi

entry.summary: Proposes topology-aware PAC-Bayesian generalization bounds for graph neural networks that incorporate graph structure into the analysis, addressing limitations of existing norm-based bounds that ignore topology.

entry.title: Communication-Efficient Gluon in Federated Learning

author.name: Xun Qian, Alexander Gaponov, Grigory Malinovsky, Peter Richt\'arik

entry.summary: Investigates communication-efficient variants of Gluon (extension of Muon optimizer) for federated learning with both unbiased and contraction compressors, using SARAH-style variance reduction to reduce compression error.

entry.title: Online Covariance Estimation in Averaged SGD: Improved Batch-Mean Rates and Minimax Optimality via Trajectory Regression

author.name: Yijin Ni, Xiaoming Huo

entry.summary: Improves online covariance estimation for Polyak-Ruppert averaged SGD, achieving better batch-means convergence rate of O(n^{-1/6}) vs previous O(n^{-1/8}) through re-tuned block-growth parameters. Also proves minimax optimality.

entry.title: Tracking High-order Evolutions via Cascading Low-rank Fitting

author.name: Zhao Song

entry.summary: Proposes cascading low-rank fitting for tracking high-order dynamics in diffusion/flow matching models, avoiding separate neural networks for each derivative order and reducing parameter scaling.

entry.title: Mycelium-Index: A Streaming Approximate Nearest Neighbor Index with Myelial Edge Decay, Traffic-Driven Reinforcement, and Adaptive Living Hierarchy

author.name: Anton Pakhunov

entry.summary: Presents mycelium-index, a bio-inspired streaming ANN index that adapts topology through edge decay/reinforcement and living hierarchy. Achieves competitive recall to FreshDiskANN with 5.7x less RAM and 4.7x higher QPS.

entry.title: Sustainable Transformer Neural Network Acceleration with Stochastic Photonic Computing

author.name: S. Afifi, O. Alo, I. Thakkar, S. Pasricha

entry.summary: Presents ASTRA, the first silicon-photonic accelerator using stochastic computing for transformers, achieving 7.6x speedup and 1.3x lower energy compared to state-of-the-art accelerators.

entry.title: Training-Free Cross-Lingual Dysarthria Severity Assessment via Phonological Subspace Analysis in Self-Supervised Speech Representations

author.name: Bernard Muller, Antonio Armando Ortiz Barra\~n\'on, LaVonne Roberts

entry.summary: Presents a training-free method for cross-lingual dysarthria severity assessment using phonological subspace analysis within frozen HuBERT representations. Estimates feature directions from healthy speech only, requiring no supervised severity model.

entry.title: A Modularized Framework for Piecewise-Stationary Restless Bandits

author.name: Kuan-Ta Li, Chia-Chun Lin, Ping-Chun Hsieh, Yu-Chih Huang

entry.summary: Studies piecewise-stationary restless multi-armed bandits with unknown change points, proposing a modular framework integrating arbitrary RMAB base algorithms with change detection and diminishing exploration. Introduces refined regret notion for exploration and detection.

entry.title: Sense Less, Infer More: Agentic Multimodal Transformers for Edge Medical Intelligence

author.name: Chengwei Zhou, Zhaoyan Jia, Haotian Yu, Xuming Chen, Brandon Lee, Christopher Pulliam, Steve Majerus, Massoud Pedram, Gourav Datta

entry.summary: Introduces AMI, an edge-based framework for multimodal medical monitoring that learns when to sense and how to infer, using differentiable gating for sensor selection and sigma-delta sensing for temporal redundancy reduction.

entry.title: Position-Agnostic Pre-Projection for Transformer Attention: Nonlinear Feature Construction and Content Skip Before Q/K/V

author.name: Chirag Shinde

entry.summary: Proposes pre-projection MLP before Q/K/V projections and content skip connections around attention in transformers. Shows +40.6% LAMBADA accuracy improvement in frozen-probe experiments on Pythia models.

entry.title: Probabilistic Prediction of Neural Dynamics via Autoregressive Flow Matching

author.name: Nicole Rogalla, Yuzhen Qin, Mario Senden, Ahmed El-Gazzar, Marcel van Gerven

entry.summary: Introduces autoregressive flow matching for probabilistic prediction of neural dynamics from multimodal sensory input. Models the conditional distribution of future neural activity given past dynamics and concurrent stimuli.

entry.title: Computation of Least Trimmed Squares: A Branch-and-Bound framework with Hyperplane Arrangement Enhancements

author.name: Xiang Meng, Andr\'es G\'omez, Rahul Mazumder

entry.summary: Proposes a new MIO formulation for penalized least trimmed squares regression that embeds hyperplane arrangement logic into perspective reformulation. Shows polynomial-size branch-and-bound tree when features are fixed.

entry.title: MosaicMRI: A Diverse Dataset and Benchmark for Raw Musculoskeletal MRI

author.name: Paula Arguello, Berk Tinaz, Mohammad Shahab Sepehri, Maryam Soltanolkotabi, Mahdi Soltanolkotabi

entry.summary: Introduces MosaicMRI, the largest open-source raw musculoskeletal MRI dataset (2,671 volumes, 80,156 slices) for training and evaluating ML methods for reconstruction, artifact removal, and segmentation.

entry.title: Knowing What to Stress: A Discourse-Conditioned Text-to-Speech Benchmark

author.name: Arnon Turetzky, Avihu Dekel, Hagai Aronowitz, Ron Hoory, Yossi Adi

entry.summary: Presents CAST, a benchmark for evaluating context-conditioned word-level stress in TTS systems using contrastive context pairs. Finds TTS systems lag behind text-only LMs in inferring contextually appropriate stress from discourse.

entry.title: How Robust Are Large Language Models for Clinical Numeracy? An Empirical Study on Numerical Reasoning Abilities in Clinical Contexts

author.name: Minh-Vuong Nguyen, Fatemeh Shiri, Zhuang Li, Karin Verspoor

entry.summary: Introduces ClinicNumRobBench, a benchmark of 1,624 instances evaluating clinical numeracy across four reasoning types: value retrieval, arithmetic, comparison, and aggregation. Tests robustness across varied clinical note formats.

entry.title: Evaluating Memory Capability in Continuous Lifelog Scenario

author.name: Jianjie Zheng, Zhichen Liu, Zhanyu Shen, Jingxiang Qu, Guanhua Chen, Yile Wang, Yang Xu, Yang Liu, Sijie Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes LifeDialBench for evaluating memory systems in continuous lifelog scenarios using wearable devices. Introduces online evaluation protocol addressing temporal leakage issues in offline settings.

entry.title: PA-SFM: Tracker-free differentiable acoustic radiation for freehand 3D photoacoustic imaging

author.name: Shuang Li, Jian Gao, Chulhong Kim, Seongwook Choi, Qian Chen, Yibing Wang, Shuang Wu, Yu Zhang, Tingting Huang, Yucheng Zhou, Boxin Yao, Yao Yao, Changhui Li

entry.summary: PA-SFM presents a tracker-free framework for 3D photoacoustic imaging that eliminates the need for external positioning sensors by integrating the acoustic wave equation into a differentiable programming pipeline for simultaneous pose recovery and 3D reconstruction.

entry.title: Multi-Granularity Reasoning for Image Quality Assessment via Attribute-Aware Reinforcement Learning to Rank

author.name: Xiangyong Chen, Xiaochuan Lin, Haoran Liu, Xuan Li, Yichen Su, Xiangwei Guo

entry.summary: MG-IQA extends reinforcement learning to rank for image quality assessment to jointly predict overall quality and fine-grained attributes (sharpness, noise, color fidelity) in a single pass using vision-language models.

entry.title: PointSplat: Efficient Geometry-Driven Pruning and Transformer Refinement for 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Anh Thuan Tran, Jana Kosecka

entry.summary: PointSplat introduces a 3D geometry-driven pruning and transformer refinement framework for Gaussian Splatting that reduces model size while maintaining visual quality through geometric importance scoring.

entry.title: Active Diffusion Matching: Score-based Iterative Alignment of Cross-Modal Retinal Images

author.name: Kanggeon Lee, Su Jeong Song, Soochahn Lee, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: Active Diffusion Matching proposes cross-modal retinal image alignment using two interdependent score-based diffusion models to jointly estimate global and local transformations via iterative Langevin MCMC.

entry.title: ABot-Claw: A Foundation for Persistent, Cooperative, and Self-Evolving Robotic Agents

author.name: Dongjie Huo, Haoyun Liu, Guoqing Liu, Dekang Qi, Zhiming Sun, Maoguo Gao, Jianxin He, Yandan Yang, Xinyuan Chang, Feng Xiong, Xing Wei, Zhiheng Ma, Mu Xu

entry.summary: ABot-Claw extends OpenClaw into an embodied multi-robot platform integrating VLA models with System 2 reasoning for persistent, cooperative agents in open-world environments.

entry.title: EditCrafter: Tuning-free High-Resolution Image Editing via Pretrained Diffusion Model

author.name: Kunho Kim, Sumin Seo, Yongjun Cho, Hyungjin Chung

entry.summary: EditCrafter enables tuning-free high-resolution image editing at arbitrary resolutions using pretrained diffusion models, overcoming the limitation of fixed training resolutions.

entry.title: AC-MIL: Weakly Supervised Atrial LGE-MRI Quality Assessment via Adversarial Concept Disentanglement

author.name: K M Arefeen Sultan, Kaysen Hansen, Benjamin Orkild, Alan Morris, Eugene Kholmovski, Erik Bieging, Eugene Kwan, Ravi Ranjan, Ed DiBella, Shireen Elhabian

entry.summary: AC-MIL proposes adversarial concept disentanglement within multiple instance learning for MRI quality assessment, providing actionable feedback on specific failure modes rather than a single quality score.

entry.title: Multi-modal, multi-scale representation learning for satellite imagery analysis just needs a good ALiBi

author.name: Patrick Kage, Pavlos Andreadis

entry.summary: Scale-ALiBi introduces a spatial encoding bias for transformer attention that handles satellite imagery at multiple ground sample distances and modalities, improving performance on GEO-Bench.

entry.title: FreeScale: Scaling 3D Scenes via Certainty-Aware Free-View Generation

author.name: Chenhan Jiang, Yu Chen, Qingwen Zhang, Jifei Song, Songcen Xu, Dit-Yan Yeung, Jiankang Deng

entry.summary: FreeScale transforms limited real-world image sequences into scalable training data for novel view synthesis by using imperfect 3D reconstructions as geometric proxies. Proposes certainty-aware free-view generation to filter out artifacts from the proxy scenes.

entry.title: LiveGesture Streamable Co-Speech Gesture Generation Model

author.name: Muhammad Usama Saleem, Mayur Jagdishbhai Patel, Ekkasit Pinyoanuntapong, Zhongxing Qin, Li Yang, Hongfei Xue, Ahmed Helmy, Chen Chen, Pu Wang

entry.summary: LiveGesture is the first fully streamable, speech-driven full-body gesture generation framework with zero look-ahead, supporting arbitrary sequence lengths via streamable vector quantization and hierarchical autoregressive transformers.

entry.title: EgoFun3D: Modeling Interactive Objects from Egocentric Videos using Function Templates

author.name: Weikun Peng, Denys Iliash, Manolis Savva

entry.summary: EgoFun3D models interactive 3D objects from egocentric videos using function templates that capture cross-part functional mappings (e.g., knob rotation controlling temperature). Provides simulation-ready outputs compilable into executable code.

entry.title: Variational Latent Entropy Estimation Disentanglement: Controlled Attribute Leakage for Face Recognition

author.name: \"Unsal \"Ozt\"urk (Idiap Research Institute, Martigny, Switzerland), Vedrana Krivoku\'ca Hahn (Idiap Research Institute, Martigny, Switzerland), Sushil Bhattacharjee (Idiap Research Institute, Martigny, Switzerland), S\'ebastien Marcel (Idiap Research Institute, Martigny, Switzerland, UNIL, Lausanne, Switzerland)

entry.summary: VLEED proposes a post-hoc method using variational autoencoders to disentangle face recognition embeddings, separating identity from sensitive attributes like gender and ethnicity. Uses mutual information-based objectives for privacy and fairness.

entry.title: GS4City: Hierarchical Semantic Gaussian Splatting via City-Model Priors

author.name: Qilin Zhang, Jinyu Zhu, Olaf Wysocki, Benjamin Busam, Boris Jutzi

entry.summary: GS4City incorporates CityGML city-model priors into semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting for urban scene understanding. Uses hierarchical semantics from LoD3 models via raycasting to provide structured labels for Gaussian primitives.

entry.title: The Impact of Federated Learning on Distributed Remote Sensing Archives

author.name: Anand Umashankar, Karam Tomotaki-Dawoud, Nicolai Schneider

entry.summary: Systematic study of federated learning for distributed remote sensing archives, addressing non-IID data challenges from geographic variation across 5+ petabytes of Earth observation data.

entry.title: Pair2Scene: Learning Local Object Relations for Procedural Scene Generation

author.name: Xingjian Ran, Shujie Zhang, Weipeng Zhong, Li Luo, Bo Dai

entry.summary: Pair2Scene generates 3D indoor scenes using learned local pairwise object relations combined with scene hierarchies and physics-based algorithms. Avoids reliance on LLMs/VLMs for precise spatial reasoning.

entry.title: Search-MIND: Training-Free Multi-Modal Medical Image Registration

author.name: Boya Wang, Ruizhe Li, Chao Chen, Xin Chen

entry.summary: Search-MIND proposes a training-free multi-modal medical image registration framework with novel loss functions (VWMI and S-MIND) for instance-specific registration without learning.

entry.title: Visualising the Attractor Landscape of Neural Cellular Automata

author.name: James Stovold, Mia-Katrin Kvalsund, Harald Michael Ludwig, Varun Sharma, Alexander Mordvintsev

entry.summary: Applies manifold learning (PCA, autoencoders) and topological data analysis (persistent homology) to visualize and interpret the attractor landscape of Neural Cellular Automata, opening the NCA black box.

entry.title: OmniUMI: Towards Physically Grounded Robot Learning via Human-Aligned Multimodal Interaction

author.name: Shaqi Luo, Yuanyuan Li, Youhao Hu, Chenhao Yu, Chaoran Xu, Jiachen Zhang, Guocai Yao, Tiejun Huang, Ran He, Zhongyuan Wang

entry.summary: Presents OmniUMI, a unified handheld data collection framework that synchronously captures RGB, depth, trajectory, tactile sensing, grasping force, and interaction wrench for robot learning. Addresses the limitation of visuomotor-only UMI-style interfaces for contact-rich manipulation.

entry.title: WM-DAgger: Enabling Efficient Data Aggregation for Imitation Learning with World Models

author.name: Anlan Yu, Zaishu Chen, Peili Song, Zhiqing Hong, Haotian Wang, Desheng Zhang, Tian He, Yi Ding, Daqing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes WM-DAgger, which uses World Models to synthesize out-of-distribution recovery data for imitation learning, eliminating the need for continuous human involvement in the DAgger data aggregation loop.

entry.title: AI for epistemics: the good, the bad and the ugly

author.name: owencb

entry.summary: Maps out how AI could reshape epistemics through three dynamics: the good (uplifting truth-tracking), the bad (unintentionally making the world harder to understand), and the ugly (malicious epistemic disruption). Argues feedback loops could amplify outcomes in either direction.

entry.title: Treaties, Regulations, and Research can be Complements

author.name: Davidmanheim

entry.summary: Argues that AI risk can be addressed through complementary tools—treaties, regulations, and research—rather than treating them as substitutes. Different risks live at different levels and require different interventions.

entry.title: Demographic and Linguistic Bias Evaluation in Omnimodal Language Models

author.name: Alaa Elobaid

entry.summary: Evaluates demographic and linguistic biases across text, image, audio, and video modalities in omnimodal language models, finding audio tasks show larger biases than image/video tasks.

entry.title: Think in Sentences: Explicit Sentence Boundaries Enhance Language Model's Capabilities

author.name: Zhichen Liu, Yongyuan Li, Yang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes inserting sentence boundary delimiters in LLM inputs to improve capabilities, finding that explicit sentence structure helps LLMs with sentence-by-sentence processing during reasoning.

entry.title: FishRoPE: Projective Rotary Position Embeddings for Omnidirectional Visual Perception

author.name: Rahul Ahuja, Mudit Jain, Bala Murali Manoghar Sai Sudhakar, Venkatraman Narayanan, Pratik Likhar, Varun Ravi Kumar, Senthil Yogamani

entry.summary: Introduces FishRoPE, adapting frozen vision foundation models to fisheye camera geometry through projective rotary position embeddings and LoRA. Addresses the mismatch between pinhole-camera-trained models and fisheye distortion in autonomous vehicles.

entry.title: From Query to Counsel: Structured Reasoning with a Multi-Agent Framework and Dataset for Legal Consultation

author.name: Mingfei Lu, Yi Zhang, Mengjia Wu, Yue Feng

entry.summary: Constructs JurisCQAD, a 43K Chinese legal consultation dataset with expert annotations, and proposes JurisMA, a multi-agent framework for legal question answering with task decomposition into legal element graphs.

entry.title: Bridging Linguistic Gaps: Cross-Lingual Mapping in Pre-Training and Dataset for Enhanced Multilingual LLM Performance

author.name: Weihua Zheng, Chang Liu, Zhengyuan Liu, Xin Huang, Kui Wu, Muhammad Huzaifah Md Shahrin, Aiti Aw, Roy Ka-Wei Lee

entry.summary: Introduces cross-lingual mapping during pre-training to improve multilingual LLM alignment without compromising monolingual fluency. Proposes Language Alignment Coefficient for measuring cross-lingual representation quality.

entry.title: Federated Single-Agent Robotics: Multi-Robot Coordination Without Intra-Robot Multi-Agent Fragmentation

author.name: Xue Qin, Simin Luan, John See, Cong Yang, Zhijun Li

entry.summary: Proposes Federated Single-Agent Robotics (FSAR), arguing that multi-robot coordination should emerge through federation at the fleet level while each robot remains a single coherent agent, rather than fragmenting each robot into multiple internal agents.

entry.title: Discourse Diversity in Multi-Turn Empathic Dialogue

author.name: Hongli Zhan, Emma S. Gueorguieva, Javier Hernandez, Jina Suh, Desmond C. Ong, Junyi Jessy Li

entry.summary: Analyzes discourse diversity in multi-turn empathic dialogue, examining whether LLMs' known formulaicity extends to discourse moves in empathic conversations. Shows LLMs lack varied strategies as conversations unfold.

entry.title: Training-Free Object-Background Compositional T2I via Dynamic Spatial Guidance and Multi-Path Pruning

author.name: Yang Deng, David Mould, Paul L. Rosin, Yu-Kun Lai

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free framework for text-to-image generation that improves foreground-background composition through dynamic spatial guidance and multi-path latent pruning during diffusion sampling.

entry.title: Differentiable Vector Quantization for Rate-Distortion Optimization of Generative Image Compression

author.name: Shiyin Jiang, Wei Long, Minghao Han, Zhenghao Chen, Ce Zhu, Shuhang Gu

entry.summary: RDVQ introduces differentiable vector quantization for end-to-end rate-distortion optimization in generative image compression, with an autoregressive entropy model supporting test-time rate control. Bridges VQ representation learning and entropy modeling.

entry.title: Rein3D: Reinforced 3D Indoor Scene Generation with Panoramic Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Dehui Wang, Congsheng Xu, Rong Wei, Yue Shi, Shoufa Chen, Dingxiang Luo, Tianshuo Yang, Xiaokang Yang, Yusen Qin, Rui Tang, Yao Mu

entry.summary: Rein3D reconstructs full 360-degree indoor environments from sparse inputs by combining 3D Gaussian Splatting with video diffusion priors. Uses a restore-and-refine paradigm with radial exploration strategy for panoramic rendering.

entry.title: LogitDynamics: Reliable ViT Error Detection from Layerwise Logit Trajectories

author.name: Ido Beigelman, Moti Freiman

entry.summary: LogitDynamics detects Vision Transformer classification errors by modeling how class evidence evolves across layers, inspired by hallucination detection in LLMs. Uses lightweight linear probes on intermediate layer logits.

entry.title: ArtiCAD: Articulated CAD Assembly Design via Multi-Agent Code Generation

author.name: Yuan Shui, Yandong Guan, Zhanwei Zhang, Juncheng Hu, Jing Zhang, Dong Xu, Qian Yu

entry.summary: ArtiCAD is the first training-free multi-agent system for generating editable, articulated CAD assemblies from text or images, using specialized Design, Generation, Assembly, and Review agents.

entry.title: TraversalBench: Challenging Paths to Follow for Vision Language Models

author.name: Clara Petrova, Zhuo Chen, Marin Solja\v{c}i\'c

entry.summary: TraversalBench tests VLMs' ability to follow complex visual paths — a task easy for humans but challenging for models. Benchmarks exact ordered sequence recovery when traversing polylines with controlled structural factors.

entry.title: OmniScript: Towards Audio-Visual Script Generation for Long-Form Cinematic Video

author.name: Junfu Pu, Yuxin Chen, Teng Wang, Ying Shan

entry.summary: OmniScript introduces the video-to-script task for long-form cinematic video understanding, with an 8B-parameter omni-modal language model that generates hierarchical scene-by-scene scripts with audio cues.

entry.title: LoGo-MR: Screening Breast MRI for Cancer Risk Prediction by Efficient Omni-Slice Modeling

author.name: Xin Wang, Yuan Gao, George Yiasemis, Antonio Portaluri, Zahra Aghdam, Muzhen He, Luyi Han, Yaofei Duan, Chunyao Lu, Xinglong Liang, Tianyu Zhang, Vivien van Veldhuizen, Yue Sun, Tao Tan, Ritse Mann, Jonas Teuwen

entry.summary: LoGo-MR proposes a 2.5D local-global framework for five-year breast cancer risk prediction from screening MRI. Balances computational efficiency with volumetric context modeling through neighbor-slice encoding.

entry.title: Learning Robustness at Test-Time from a Non-Robust Teacher

author.name: Stefano Bianchettin, Giulio Rossolini, Giorgio Buttazzo

entry.summary: Studies test-time adversarial robustness adaptation from non-robust pretrained models. Investigates whether adversarial training strategies can improve robustness during unsupervised test-time adaptation.

entry.title: DINO_4D: Semantic-Aware 4D Reconstruction

author.name: Yiru Yang, Zhuojie Wu, Quentin Marguet, Nishant Kumar Singh, Max Schulthess

entry.summary: Presents DINO_4D, using frozen DINOv3 features as structural priors for semantic-aware 4D reconstruction of dynamic scenes, suppressing semantic drift during tracking while maintaining linear time complexity.

entry.title: Wolkowicz-Styan Upper Bound on the Hessian Eigenspectrum for Cross-Entropy Loss in Nonlinear Smooth Neural Networks

author.name: Yuto Omae, Kazuki Sakai, Yohei Kakimoto, Makoto Sasaki, Yusuke Sakai, Hirotaka Takahashi

entry.summary: Derives Wolkowicz-Styan upper bounds on Hessian eigenspectra for neural networks with cross-entropy loss, providing computable bounds related to loss landscape sharpness without computing full eigendecomposition.

entry.title: EviCare: Enhancing Diagnosis Prediction with Deep Model-Guided Evidence for In-Context Reasoning

author.name: Hengyu Zhang, Xuyun Zhang, Pengxiang Zhan, Linhao Luo, Hang Lv, Yanchao Tan, Shirui Pan, Carl Yang

entry.summary: Proposes EviCare, an in-context reasoning framework that integrates deep model guidance into LLM-based diagnosis prediction from EHRs, addressing the problem of overlooking novel conditions not frequently seen in training data.

entry.title: CLSGen: A Dual-Head Fine-Tuning Framework for Joint Probabilistic Classification and Verbalized Explanation

author.name: WonJin Yoon, Kangyu Zhu, Ian Bulovic, Autumn Sehy, Yanjun Gao, Dmitriy Dligach, Majid Afshar, Timothy A. Miller

entry.summary: Proposes CLSGen, a dual-head fine-tuning framework that combines a discriminative classification head with generative explanation capability, avoiding catastrophic forgetting and linguistic collapse.

entry.title: What and Where to Adapt: Structure-Semantics Co-Tuning for Machine Vision Compression via Synergistic Adapters

author.name: Shaobo Liu, Haobo Xiong, Kai Liu, Yuna Lin

entry.summary: Introduces Structure-Semantics Co-Tuning for image compression, coordinating adapter placement across encoder-decoder and entropy model components for efficient fine-tuning of pre-trained codecs.

entry.title: Particle Diffusion Matching: Random Walk Correspondence Search for the Alignment of Standard and Ultra-Widefield Fundus Images

author.name: Kanggeon Lee, Soochahn Lee, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: Particle Diffusion Matching performs alignment of standard and ultra-widefield fundus images through random walk correspondence search guided by a diffusion model, achieving SOTA in retinal alignment.

entry.title: SMFormer: Empowering Self-supervised Stereo Matching via Foundation Models and Data Augmentation

author.name: Yun Wang, Zhengjie Yang, Jiahao Zheng, Zhanjie Zhang, Dapeng Oliver Wu, Yulan Guo

entry.summary: SMFormer combines vision foundation model features with self-supervised stereo matching, introducing VFM-guided supervision and data augmentation to close the gap with supervised methods.

entry.title: SIMPLER: H&E-Informed Representation Learning for Structured Illumination Microscopy

author.name: Abu Zahid Bin Aziz, Syed Fahim Ahmed, Gnanesh Rasineni, Mei Wang, Olcaytu Hatipoglu, Marisa Ricci, Malaiyah Shaw, Guang Li, J. Quincy Brown, Valerio Pascucci, Shireen Elhabian

entry.summary: SIMPLER enables transfer of digital pathology foundation models to structured illumination microscopy by learning cross-modal alignment between SIM and H&E representations.

entry.title: HiddenObjects: Scalable Diffusion-Distilled Spatial Priors for Object Placement

author.name: Marco Schouten, Ioannis Siglidis, Serge Belongie, Dim P. Papadopoulos

entry.summary: HiddenObjects learns class-conditioned spatial priors for object placement by distilling implicit placement knowledge from text-conditioned diffusion models. Creates a 27M annotation dataset across 27k scenes without manual labeling.

entry.title: LumiMotion: Improving Gaussian Relighting with Scene Dynamics

author.name: Joanna Kaleta, Piotr W\'ojcik, Kacper Marzol, Tomasz Trzci\'nski, Kacper Kania, Marek Kowalski

entry.summary: LumiMotion leverages dynamic elements in scenes (motion) as supervisory signals for inverse rendering with Gaussian Splatting, enabling better disentanglement of material properties and illumination in real-world conditions.

entry.title: Improving Layout Representation Learning Across Inconsistently Annotated Datasets via Agentic Harmonization

author.name: Renyu Li, Vladimir Kirilenko, Yao You, Crag Wolfe

entry.summary: Proposes agentic label harmonization using VLMs to reconcile annotation inconsistencies across heterogeneous document layout datasets before training object detection models. Shows naive mixing degrades performance.

entry.title: Observe Less, Understand More: Cost-aware Cross-scale Observation for Remote Sensing Understanding

author.name: Zhenghao Xie, Jing Xiao, Zhenqi Wang, Kexin Ma, Liang Liao, Gui-Song Xia, Mi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a cost-aware cross-scale observation strategy for remote sensing that selectively acquires high-resolution imagery based on low-resolution global perception. Addresses the practical cost-performance tradeoff in multi-resolution observation.

entry.title: Unfolding 3D Gaussian Splatting via Iterative Gaussian Synopsis

author.name: Yuqin Lu, Yang Zhou, Yihua Dai, Guiqing Li, Shengfeng He

entry.summary: Proposes Iterative Gaussian Synopsis, a top-down unfolding scheme for compact and progressive 3DGS rendering. Derives coarser LODs through adaptive mask-based pruning for streaming and resource-constrained deployment.

entry.title: Brain-Grasp: Graph-based Saliency Priors for Improved fMRI-based Visual Brain Decoding

author.name: Mohammad Moradi, Morteza Moradi, Marco Grassia, Giuseppe Mangioni

entry.summary: Brain-Grasp uses graph-informed saliency priors from fMRI brain signals to guide diffusion-based image reconstruction, preserving object structure and semantic fidelity in brain decoding.

entry.title: LLMs for Text-Based Exploration and Navigation Under Partial Observability

author.name: Stephan Sandfuchs, Maximilian Melchert, J\"org Frochte

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs can function as text-only controllers for navigation and exploration in gridworlds under partial observability, without code execution or tools. Evaluates 9 LLMs across difficulty levels.

entry.title: VeriTrans: Fine-Tuned LLM-Assisted NL-to-PL Translation via a Deterministic Neuro-Symbolic Pipeline

author.name: Xuan Liu, Dheeraj Kodakandla, Kushagra Srivastva, Mahfuza Farooque

entry.summary: VeriTrans compiles natural-language requirements into solver-ready logic with validator-gated reliability, using round-trip NL-PL-NL reconstruction as an acceptance gate. Achieves 94.46% SAT/UNSAT correctness on SatBench.

entry.title: Mobile GUI Agent Privacy Personalization with Trajectory Induced Preference Optimization

author.name: Zhixin Lin, Jungang Li, Dongliang Xu, Shidong Pan, Yibo Shi, Yuchi Liu, Yuecong Min, Yue Yao

entry.summary: Studies privacy personalization in mobile GUI agents, observing that different privacy preferences induce structurally different execution trajectories. Proposes trajectory-induced preference optimization to handle variable-length heterogeneous trajectories.

entry.title: The Missing Knowledge Layer in Cognitive Architectures for AI Agents

author.name: Micha\"el Roynard (LAAS-OASIS)

entry.summary: Identifies a missing Knowledge layer in major cognitive architectures (CoALA, JEPA) and proposes a four-layer decomposition (Knowledge, Memory, Wisdom, Intelligence) with fundamentally different persistence semantics for each layer.

entry.title: DreamKG: A KG-Augmented Conversational System for People Experiencing Homelessness

author.name: Javad M Alizadeh, Genhui Zheng, Chiu C Tan, Yuzhou Chen, Omar Martinez, Philip McCallion, Ying Ding, Chenguang Yang, AnneMarie Tomosky, Huanmei Wu

entry.summary: Presents DreamKG, a knowledge graph-augmented conversational system for people experiencing homelessness, grounding responses in verified data about Philadelphia services. Shows 59% superiority over Google Search AI and 84% over standard LLMs.

entry.title: MCERF: Advancing Multimodal LLM Evaluation of Engineering Documentation with Enhanced Retrieval

author.name: Kiarash Naghavi Khanghah, Hoang Anh Nguyen, Anna C. Doris, Amir Mohammad Vahedi, Daniele Grandi, Faez Ahmed, Hongyi Xu

entry.summary: Presents MCERF, a multimodal retrieval and reasoning framework for engineering documentation QA that couples ColPali multimodal retrieval with LLM reasoning for tables, illustrations, and dense text.

entry.title: LETGAMES: An LLM-Powered Gamified Approach to Cognitive Training for Patients with Cognitive Impairment

author.name: Jingwei Shi, Shengyu Tao, Xinxiang Yin, Chen Huang, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes LETGAMES, an LLM-powered method for automated personalized therapeutic game design for cognitive training, inspired by Dungeons & Dragons. Includes a psychology-grounded evaluation protocol.

entry.title: NeuroPath: Practically Adopting Motor Imagery Decoding through EEG Signals

author.name: Jiani Cao, Kun Wang, Yang Liu, Zhenjiang Li

entry.summary: Introduces NeuroPath, a unified foundation model architecture for motor imagery BCI decoding that handles diverse EEG sensor configurations and tasks.

entry.title: NetAgentBench: A State-Centric Benchmark for Evaluating Agentic Network Configuration

author.name: Ahmed Twabi, Yepeng Ding, Tohru Kondo

entry.summary: Introduces NetAgentBench, a dynamic benchmark using Finite State Machines to evaluate LLM agents on multi-turn network configuration tasks. Finds that while agents handle basic tasks, they suffer 'exploration meltdowns' and 'coherence collapse' on expert-level configurations.

entry.title: Orthogonal Quadratic Complements for Vision Transformer Feed-Forward Networks

author.name: Wang Zixian

entry.summary: Proposes Orthogonal Quadratic Complements (OQC) for vision transformer feed-forward networks, constructing a low-rank quadratic auxiliary branch projected onto the orthogonal complement of the main branch.

entry.title: A-IO: Adaptive Inference Orchestration for Memory-Bound NPUs

author.name: Chen Zhang, Yan Ding, Haotian Wang, Chubo Liu, Keqin Li, Kenli Li

entry.summary: Proposes A-IO, an adaptive inference orchestration framework for memory-bound NPU platforms that addresses the 'Model Scaling Paradox' in LLM deployment on heterogeneous hardware like Ascend 910B.

entry.title: Rebooting Microreboot: Architectural Support for Safe, Parallel Recovery in Microservice Systems

author.name: Laurent Bindschaedler

entry.summary: Proposes a three-agent architecture for safe microservice recovery, separating diagnosis/planning/verification with a typed seven-action ISA and transactional microkernel, where agents are explicitly untrusted.

entry.title: FREE-Switch: Frequency-based Dynamic LoRA Switch for Style Transfer

author.name: Shenghe Zheng, Minyu Zhang, Tianhao Liu, Hongzhi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FREE-Switch, a training-free method for combining multiple LoRA adapters for style transfer using frequency-based dynamic switching to handle inter-adapter differences and reduce content drift.

entry.title: MR-Coupler: Automated Metamorphic Test Generation via Functional Coupling Analysis

author.name: Congying Xu, Hengcheng Zhu, Songqiang Chen, Jiarong Wu, Valerio Terragni, Shing-Chi Cheung

entry.summary: Proposes MR-Coupler, which leverages functional coupling between methods in source code to automatically construct metamorphic relations for testing, using LLMs for test case generation validated through mutation analysis.

entry.title: VGA-Bench: A Unified Benchmark and Multi-Model Framework for Video Aesthetics and Generation Quality Evaluation

author.name: Longteng Jiang, DanDan Zheng, Qianqian Qiao, Heng Huang, Huaye Wang, Yihang Bo, Bao Peng, Jingdong Chen, Jun Zhou, Xin Jin

entry.summary: Introduces VGA-Bench, a unified benchmark for joint evaluation of video generation quality and aesthetic quality with a three-tier taxonomy spanning aesthetic quality, tagging, and generation quality.

entry.title: Exploring the impact of fairness-aware criteria in AutoML

author.name: Joana Sim\~oes, Jo\~ao Correia

entry.summary: Studies integrating fairness criteria directly into AutoML optimization pipelines beyond just model selection. Shows that fairness-aware search across all ML pipeline stages can reduce bias without major performance trade-offs.

entry.title: Towards Green Wearable Computing: A Physics-Aware Spiking Neural Network for Energy-Efficient IMU-based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Naichuan Zheng, Hailun Xia, Zepeng Sun, Weiyi Li, Yinze Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes PAS-Net, a multiplier-free spiking neural network for wearable human activity recognition that incorporates physics-aware biomechanical topology constraints for energy-efficient edge deployment.

entry.title: MoEITS: A Green AI approach for simplifying MoE-LLMs

author.name: Luis Balderas, Miguel Lastra, Jos\'e M. Ben\'itez

entry.summary: Introduces MoEITS for simplifying MoE-LLMs using information-theoretic framework. Aims to reduce computational and memory burden while maintaining model quality.
