entry.title: Turning Generators into Retrievers: Unlocking MLLMs for Natural Language-Guided Geo-Localization

author.name: Yuqi Chen, Xiaohan Zhang, Ahmad Arrabi, Waqas Sultani, Chen Chen, Safwan Wshah

entry.summary: Adapts MLLMs for natural-language guided cross-view geo-localization by parameter-efficient finetuning, turning generative models into effective retrievers for satellite image matching from text descriptions.

entry.title: ReXSonoVQA: A Video QA Benchmark for Procedure-Centric Ultrasound Understanding

author.name: Xucheng Wang, Xiaoman Zhang, Sung Eun Kim, Ankit Pal, Pranav Rajpurkar

entry.summary: Introduces ReXSonoVQA, a video QA benchmark for ultrasound procedure understanding with 514 clips testing action-goal reasoning, artifact resolution, and procedure planning. Shows current VLMs struggle with troubleshooting questions in this domain.

entry.title: Continuous-time Online Learning via Mean-Field Neural Networks: Regret Analysis in Diffusion Environments

author.name: Erhan Bayraktar, Bingyan Han, Ziqing Zhang

entry.summary: Studies continuous-time online learning with diffusion-process-generated data using mean-field neural networks. Establishes regret bounds using tools from optimal transport, Malliavin calculus, and propagation of chaos theory.

entry.title: Efficient Training for Cross-lingual Speech Language Models

author.name: Yan Zhou, Qingkai Fang, Yun Hong, Yang Feng

entry.summary: Introduces CSLM, an efficient cross-lingual speech language model training method using discrete speech tokens with a novel alignment strategy for cross-modal and cross-lingual alignment through continual pre-training.

entry.title: Governance by Design: A Parsonian Institutional Architecture for Internet-Wide Agent Societies

author.name: Anbang Ruan

entry.summary: Proposes a Parsonian institutional architecture for governing internet-wide agent societies, applying Talcott Parsons' AGIL framework to derive a 16-cell governance structure. Applied to an analysis of the OpenClaw ecosystem.

entry.title: Think Before you Write: QA-Guided Reasoning for Character Descriptions in Books

author.name: Argyrios Papoudakis, Mirella Lapata, Frank Keller

entry.summary: Proposes a QA-guided reasoning framework for generating character descriptions from long-form narratives like novels. Counterintuitively finds that disabling built-in reasoning in LLMs improves character description, motivating a decoupled reasoning-generation approach.

entry.title: SCNO: Spiking Compositional Neural Operator -- Towards a Neuromorphic Foundation Model for Nuclear PDE Solving

author.name: Samrendra Roy, Souvik Chakraborty, Rizwan-uddin, Syed Bahauddin Alam

entry.summary: Introduces Spiking Compositional Neural Operator (SCNO), a modular architecture combining spiking and conventional components for PDE solving. Maintains a library of small spiking blocks for elementary operators and composes them for coupled PDEs.

entry.title: Evaluating Cooperation in LLM Social Groups through Elected Leadership

author.name: Ryan Faulkner, Anushka Deshpande, David Guzman Piedrahita, Joel Z. Leibo, Zhijing Jin

entry.summary: Studies whether leadership and election mechanisms improve cooperation in LLM multi-agent simulations of common-pool resource governance. Presents an open-source framework for simulating leadership dynamics.

entry.title: SLM Finetuning for Natural Language to Domain Specific Code Generation in Production

author.name: Renjini R. Nair (Microsoft), Damian K. Kowalczyk (Microsoft), Marco Gaudesi (Microsoft), Chhaya Methani (Microsoft)

entry.summary: Studies fine-tuning small language models for domain-specific code generation in production, comparing against RAG+LLM baselines. Shows fine-tuned SLMs can meet production latency requirements while maintaining accuracy.

entry.title: LoDAdaC: a unified local training-based decentralized framework with adaptive gradients and compressed communication

author.name: Wei Liu, Anweshit Panda, Ujwal Pandey, Haven Cook, George M. Slota, Naigang Wang, Jie Chen, Yangyang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes LoDAdaC, a unified framework combining multiple local training steps, Adam-type adaptive gradient updates, and compressed communication for decentralized distributed learning.

entry.title: Preventing Latent Rehearsal Decay in Online Continual SSL with SOLAR

author.name: Giacomo Cignoni, Simone Magistri, Andrew D. Bagdanov, Antonio Carta

entry.summary: Identifies 'Latent Rehearsal Decay' in online continual self-supervised learning where excessive replay stability degrades the latent space. Proposes SOLAR with diagnostic metrics and demonstrates improved performance on OCSSL benchmarks.

entry.title: Slithering Through Gaps: Capturing Discrete Isolated Modes via Logistic Bridging

author.name: Pinaki Mohanty, Ruqi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes HiSS, a sampling algorithm for multimodal discrete distributions that uses logistic convolution kernels within a Metropolis-within-Gibbs framework to bridge isolated modes in discrete energy landscapes.

entry.title: Hypergraph Neural Diffusion: A PDE-Inspired Framework for Hypergraph Message Passing

author.name: Zhiheng Zhou, Mengyao Zhou, Xixun Lin, Xingqin Qi, Guiying Yan

entry.summary: Proposes Hypergraph Neural Diffusion (HND), a PDE-inspired framework for message passing on hypergraphs using continuous-time diffusion equations with learnable structure-aware coefficients. Addresses oversmoothing and shallow propagation.

entry.title: Distributionally Robust K-Means Clustering

author.name: Vikrant Malik, Taylan Kargin, Babak Hassibi

entry.summary: Proposes distributionally robust K-means clustering using Wasserstein-2 ambiguity sets, yielding a tractable dual that produces soft clustering with smooth weighted assignments. Includes efficient block coordinate descent algorithm.

entry.title: CAGenMol: Condition-Aware Diffusion Language Model for Goal-Directed Molecular Generation

author.name: Yanting Li, Zhuoyang Jiang, Enyan Dai, Lei Wang, Wen-Cai Ye, Li Liu

entry.summary: Proposes CAGenMol, a condition-aware discrete diffusion framework for goal-directed molecular generation that combines discrete diffusion with RL to handle heterogeneous structural and property constraints.

entry.title: Improving understanding and trust in AI: How users benefit from interval-based counterfactual explanations

author.name: Tabea E. R\"ober, Paul Festor, Rob Goedhart, S. \.Ilker Birbil, Aldo Faisal

entry.summary: Conducts a user study comparing interval-based counterfactual explanations against point counterfactuals, feature importance, and no explanation. Finds clear superiority of interval explanations for model understanding and trust.

entry.title: Reproduction Beyond Benchmarks: ConstBERT and ColBERT-v2 Across Backends and Query Distributions

author.name: Utshab Kumar Ghosh, Ashish David, Shubham Chatterjee

entry.summary: Evaluates reproducibility of ColBERT-v2 and ConstBERT across five dimensions, finding catastrophic 86-97% performance drops on long narrative queries. Identifies architectural limitations of MaxSim operator's uniform token weighting as the root cause.

entry.title: Neural Stochastic Processes for Satellite Precipitation Refinement

author.name: Shunya Nagashima, Takumi Bannai, Shuitsu Koyama, Tomoya Mitsui, Shuntaro Suzuki

entry.summary: Presents Neural Stochastic Process (NSP) for satellite precipitation refinement, combining a Neural Process encoder with a latent Neural SDE on 2D spatial representation. Fuses sparse gauge observations with satellite products while preserving temporal structure.

entry.title: Toward Generalized Cross-Lingual Hateful Language Detection with Web-Scale Data and Ensemble LLM Annotations

author.name: Dang H. Dang, Jelena Mitrovi, Michael Granitzer

entry.summary: Studies multilingual hate speech detection using large-scale web data and LLM-based synthetic annotations. Shows continued pretraining yields ~3% macro-F1 gains and LLM ensemble annotations produce competitive synthetic training data.

entry.title: SEPTQ: A Simple and Effective Post-Training Quantization Paradigm for Large Language Models

author.name: Han Liu, Haotian Gao, Xiaotong Zhang, Changya Li, Feng Zhang, Wei Wang, Fenglong Ma, Hong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes SEPTQ, a simple post-training quantization method for LLMs that avoids complex computation procedures while maintaining performance under low-bit quantization. Aims for practical PTQ without the cost of QAT.

entry.title: ODUTQA-MDC: A Task for Open-Domain Underspecified Tabular QA with Multi-turn Dialogue-based Clarification

author.name: Zhensheng Wang, ZhanTeng Lin, Wenmian Yang, Kun Zhou, Yiquan Zhang, Weijia Jia

entry.summary: Introduces ODUTQA-MDC, a benchmark for open-domain tabular QA with underspecified queries, including 209 tables and 25K QA pairs. Proposes MAIC-TQA, a multi-agent framework for detecting and clarifying ambiguities through dialogue.

entry.title: NOSE: Neural Olfactory-Semantic Embedding with Tri-Modal Orthogonal Contrastive Learning

author.name: Yanyi Su, Hongshuai Wang, Zhifeng Gao, Jun Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes NOSE, a tri-modal representation learning framework aligning molecular structure, receptor sequence, and natural language descriptions for olfaction. Uses orthogonal contrastive learning to decouple modality contributions.

entry.title: SHARE: Social-Humanities AI for Research and Education

author.name: Jo\~ao Gon\c{c}alves, Sonia de Jager, Petr Knoth, David Pride, Nick Jelicic

entry.summary: Introduces SHARE, the first causal language models pretrained specifically for social sciences and humanities, with performance close to Phi-4 despite using 100x fewer tokens. Also presents MIRROR, a non-generative AI interface.

entry.title: HistLens: Mapping Idea Change across Concepts and Corpora

author.name: Yi Jing, Weiyun Qiu, Yihang Peng, Zhifang Sui

entry.summary: Proposes HistLens, an SAE-based framework for multi-concept, multi-corpus conceptual-history analysis that decomposes concept representations into interpretable features for tracking semantic evolution across time.

entry.title: Head-wise Modality Specialization within MLLMs for Robust Fake News Detection under Missing Modality

author.name: Kai Qian, Weijie Shi, Jiaqi Wang, Mengze Li, Hao Chen, Yue Cui, Hanghui Guo, Ziyi Liu, Jia Zhu, Jiajie Xu

entry.summary: Proposes head-wise modality specialization within MLLMs for fake news detection under missing modality conditions, studying attention head relationships with modality-specific learning.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Localized Watermarking for Copyright Protection in Embedding-as-a-Service

author.name: Zhimin Chen, Xiaojie Liang, Wenbo Xu, Yuxuan Liu, Wei Lu

entry.summary: Proposes GeoMark, a geometry-aware watermarking framework for Embedding-as-a-Service copyright protection that uses natural in-manifold embeddings and geometry-separated anchor zones for robust verification.

entry.title: DuET: Dual Execution for Test Output Prediction with Generated Code and Pseudocode

author.name: Hojae Han, Jaejin Kim, Seung-won Hwang, Yu Jin Kim, Moontae Lee

entry.summary: Introduces DuET, combining direct code execution with LLM-based pseudocode execution via functional majority voting for test output prediction. Shows the two approaches are complementary.

entry.title: Are We Recognizing the Jaguar or Its Background? A Diagnostic Framework for Jaguar Re-Identification

author.name: Antonio Rueda-Toicen, Abigail Allen Martin, Daniil Morozov, Matin Mahmood, Alexandra Schild, Shahabeddin Dayani, Davide Panza, Gerard de Melo

entry.summary: Introduces a diagnostic framework for wildlife re-identification that detects when models rely on background context rather than actual identity features (coat patterns), using inpainted images and cross-flank retrieval on a jaguar benchmark.

entry.title: MuPPet: Multi-person 2D-to-3D Pose Lifting

author.name: Thomas Markhorst, Zhi-Yi Lin, Jouh Yeong Chew, Jan van Gemert, Xucong Zhang

entry.summary: MuPPet proposes a multi-person 2D-to-3D pose lifting framework that explicitly models inter-person correlations and handles varying group sizes for understanding social interactions.

entry.title: GIF: A Conditional Multimodal Generative Framework for IR Drop Imaging in Chip Layouts

author.name: Kiran Thorat, Nicole Meng, Mostafa Karami, Caiwen Ding, Yingjie Lao, Zhijie Jerry Shi

entry.summary: GIF proposes a generative framework for IR drop prediction in chip design that fuses geometric image features and topological graph features, addressing limitations of existing ML approaches that miss long-range dependencies.

entry.title: Warm-Started Reinforcement Learning for Iterative 3D/2D Liver Registration

author.name: Hanyuan Zhang, Lucas He, Zijie Cheng, Abdolrahim Kadkhodamohammadi, Danail Stoyanov, Brian R. Davidson, Evangeles B. Mazomenos, Matthew. J Clarkson

entry.summary: Presents a reinforcement learning framework for CT-to-laparoscopic video registration that uses warm-starting from supervised pose estimation for faster convergence and coarse-to-fine iterative refinement.

entry.title: A Comparison of Multi-View Stereo Methods for Photogrammetric 3D Reconstruction: From Traditional to Learning-Based Approaches

author.name: Yawen Li, George Vosselman, Francesco Nex

entry.summary: Comprehensive comparison of traditional (COLMAP) vs. learning-based multi-view stereo methods for aerial photogrammetry, evaluating both geometry-guided and end-to-end approaches on aerial datasets.

entry.title: Dual-Exposure Imaging with Events

author.name: Mingyuan Lin, Hongyi Liu, Chu He, Wen Yang, Gui-Song Xia, Lei Yu

entry.summary: Proposes event-camera-based dual-exposure imaging that uses events' high temporal resolution to provide accurate motion information for combining short and long exposure images in low-light scenarios.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Single Image Reflection Removal in the Wild: Datasets, Results, and Methods

author.name: Jie Cai, Kangning Yang, Zhiyuan Li, Florin-Alexandru Vasluianu, Radu Timofte, Jinlong Li, Jinglin Shen, Zibo Meng, Junyan Cao, Lu Zhao, Pengwei Liu, Yuyi Zhang, Fengjun Guo, Jiagao Hu, Zepeng Wang, Fei Wang, Daiguo Zhou, Yi'ang Chen, Honghui Zhu, Mengru Yang, Yan Luo, Kui Jiang, Jin Guo, Jonghyuk Park, Jae-Young Sim, Wei Zhou, Hongyu Huang, Linfeng Li, Lindong Kong, Saiprasad Meesiyawar, Misbha Falak Khanpagadi, Nikhil Akalwadi, Ramesh Ashok Tabib, Uma Mudenagudi, Bilel Benjdira, Anas M. Ali, Wadii Boulila, Kosuke Shigematsu, Hiroto Shirono, Asuka Shin, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi, Jiachen Tu, Shreeniketh Joshi, Jin-Hui Jiang, Yu-Fan Lin, Yu-Jou Hsiao, Chia-Ming Lee, Fu-En Yang, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Chih-Chung Hsu

entry.summary: Reviews the NTIRE 2026 challenge on single-image reflection removal, providing the OpenRR-5k dataset and evaluation of 11 methods on real-world reflection scenarios.

entry.title: DiningBench: A Hierarchical Multi-view Benchmark for Perception and Reasoning in the Dietary Domain

author.name: Song Jin, Juntian Zhang, Xun Zhang, Zeying Tian, Fei Jiang, Guojun Yin, Wei Lin, Yong Liu, Rui Yan

entry.summary: DiningBench is a hierarchical multi-view food benchmark evaluating VLMs across classification, nutrition estimation, and VQA with 3K dishes, multiple views, and verified nutritional data.

entry.title: Investigating Bias and Fairness in Appearance-based Gaze Estimation

author.name: Burak Akg\"ul, Erol \c{S}ahin, Sinan Kalkan

entry.summary: First comprehensive evaluation of fairness in appearance-based gaze estimation across ethnicity and gender attributes. Establishes a fairness baseline and evaluates existing bias mitigation strategies for the gaze domain.

entry.title: ReplicateAnyScene: Zero-Shot Video-to-3D Composition via Textual-Visual-Spatial Alignment

author.name: Mingyu Dong, Chong Xia, Mingyuan Jia, Weichen Lyu, Long Xu, Zheng Zhu, Yueqi Duan

entry.summary: ReplicateAnyScene enables fully automated, zero-shot compositional 3D reconstruction from casually captured videos, integrating textual-visual-spatial alignment for spatial intelligence.

entry.title: AmodalSVG: Amodal Image Vectorization via Semantic Layer Peeling

author.name: Juncheng Hu, Ziteng Xue, Guotao Liang, Anran Qi, Buyu Li, Sheng Wang, Dong Xu, Qian Yu

entry.summary: AmodalSVG introduces amodal image vectorization that produces semantically organized SVG layers with complete object geometries including occluded regions, enabling structural editability beyond existing modal vectorization.

entry.title: Bootstrapping Video Semantic Segmentation Model via Distillation-assisted Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Jihun Kim, Hoyong Kwon, Hyeokjun Kweon, Kuk-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: DiTTA converts image segmentation models into video segmentation models through test-time adaptation, distilling SAM2's temporal knowledge without requiring annotated video data.

entry.title: Do Instance Priors Help Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation?

author.name: Anurag Das, Anna Kukleva, Xinting Hu, Yuki M. Asano, Bernt Schiele

entry.summary: SeSAM adapts Segment Anything Model for weakly supervised semantic segmentation using weak labels (coarse masks, scribbles, points), identifying and addressing specific challenges in converting SAM from instance to semantic segmentation.

entry.title: Precision Synthesis of Multi-Tracer PET via VLM-Modulated Rectified Flow for Stratifying Mild Cognitive Impairment

author.name: Tuo Liu, Shuijin Lin, Shaozhen Yan, Haifeng Wang, Jie Lu, Jianhua Ma, Chunfeng Lian

entry.summary: DIReCT++ synthesizes multi-tracer PET from MRI using domain-informed rectified flow with vision-language model modulation for Alzheimer's disease screening, achieving subject-specific precision.

entry.title: Seg2Change: Adapting Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation Model for Remote Sensing Change Detection

author.name: You Su, Yonghong Song, Jingqi Chen, Zehan Wen

entry.summary: Seg2Change adapts open-vocabulary semantic segmentation models for remote sensing change detection, enabling detection across arbitrary categories. Constructs a category-agnostic change detection dataset and proposes a framework bridging segmentation and change detection.

entry.title: Scene Change Detection with Vision-Language Representation Learning

author.name: Diwei Sheng, Vijayraj Gohil, Satyam Gaba, Zihan Liu, Giles Hamilton-Fletcher, John-Ross Rizzo, Yongqing Liang, Chen Feng

entry.summary: LangSCD introduces a vision-language framework for scene change detection that incorporates semantic reasoning through language. Uses VLMs to generate textual descriptions fused with visual features for robust change detection.

entry.title: Progressively Texture-Aware Diffusion for Contrast-Enhanced Sparse-View CT

author.name: Tianqi Wang, Wenchao Du, Hongyu Yang

entry.summary: PTD proposes a coarse-to-fine diffusion framework for sparse-view CT reconstruction, combining a reconstructive module for low-frequency content with a conditional diffusion module for texture refinement.

entry.title: MorphoFlow: Sparse-Supervised Generative Shape Modeling with Adaptive Latent Relevance

author.name: Mokshagna Sai Teja Karanam, Tushar Kataria, Shireen Elhabian

entry.summary: MorphoFlow learns probabilistic shape representations from sparse surface annotations using neural implicit representations and normalizing flows. Eliminates the need for dense segmentations in statistical shape modeling.

entry.title: Who Handles Orientation? Investigating Invariance in Feature Matching

author.name: David Nordstr\"om, Johan Edstedt, Fredrik Kahl, Georg B\"okman

entry.summary: Studies where rotation invariance should be incorporated in sparse feature matching pipelines. Finds that invariance in descriptors performs similarly to handling it in the matcher, with implications for pipeline design.

entry.title: EagleVision: A Multi-Task Benchmark for Cross-Domain Perception in High-Speed Autonomous Racing

author.name: Zakhar Yagudin, Murad Mebrahtu, Ren Jin, Jiaqi Huang, Yujia Yue, Dzmitry Tsetserukou, Jorge Dias, Majid Khonji

entry.summary: EagleVision introduces a LiDAR-based multi-task benchmark for 3D detection and trajectory prediction in high-speed autonomous racing, with cross-domain evaluation across racing and urban driving.

entry.title: Perception Is All You Need: A Neuroscience Framework for Low Cost Sensorless Gaze in HRI

author.name: Mason Kadem

entry.summary: Proposes a sensorless gaze-following framework for child-robot interaction that exploits the human visual system's assumption of convexity. Enables sub-dollar cardboard robots with no sensors or power.

entry.title: MoRI: Mixture of RL and IL Experts for Long-Horizon Manipulation Tasks

author.name: Yaohang Xu, Lianjie Ma, Gewei Zuo, Wentao Zhang, Han Ding, Lijun Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces MoRI, a system that dynamically switches between imitation learning and reinforcement learning experts based on action variance, using offline pre-training with online fine-tuning. Aims to combine IL's efficiency with RL's exploration for long-horizon manipulation tasks.

entry.title: WARPED: Wrist-Aligned Rendering for Robot Policy Learning from Egocentric Human Demonstrations

author.name: Harry Freeman, Chung Hee Kim, George Kantor

entry.summary: Presents WARPED, a framework that synthesizes realistic wrist-view observations from egocentric human demonstration videos using vision foundation models, enabling training of visuomotor policies from monocular RGB data without specialized hardware.

entry.title: Simulator Adaptation for Sim-to-Real Learning of Legged Locomotion via Proprioceptive Distribution Matching

author.name: Jeremy Dao, Alan Fern

entry.summary: Introduces a sim-to-real adaptation method for legged locomotion based on proprioceptive distribution matching, comparing hardware and simulation rollouts as distributions rather than time-aligned trajectories. Eliminates need for motion capture or external sensing.

entry.title: AI Safety's Biggest Talent Gap Isn't Researchers. It's Generalists.

author.name: Topaz

entry.summary: Argues that AI safety's biggest talent gap is in generalist roles (program managers, operators, org leaders) rather than researchers, and that current incentives push people toward technical research even when generalist work would be higher impact. Announces the Generator Residency program.

entry.title: Uncertainty-quantified Pulse Signal Recovery from Facial Video using Regularized Stochastic Interpolants

author.name: Vineet R. Shenoy, Cheng Peng, Rama Chellappa, Yu Sun

entry.summary: RIS-iPPG introduces uncertainty quantification for imaging photoplethysmography using regularized stochastic interpolants, enabling test-time sampling for clinical uncertainty analysis of blood volume pulse recovery from facial video.

entry.title: Beyond Theory of Mind in Robotics

author.name: Malte F. Jung

entry.summary: Argues that Theory of Mind is insufficient for social robotics, drawing on ethnomethodology and conversation analysis to propose that social meaning is produced through moment-to-moment coordination rather than inferred from hidden mental states.

entry.title: Belief-Aware VLM Model for Human-like Reasoning

author.name: Anshul Nayak, Shahil Shaik, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a belief-aware VLM framework integrating retrieval-based memory and reinforcement learning for intent inference, approximating belief through retrieval rather than explicit belief models.

entry.title: Learning Hierarchical and Geometry-Aware Graph Representations for Text-to-CAD

author.name: Shengjie Gong, Wenjie Peng, Hongyuan Chen, Gangyu Zhang, Yunqing Hu, Huiyuan Zhang, Shuangping Huang, Tianshui Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical graph representation for text-to-CAD code generation that models assembly structure and geometric constraints as intermediate representations between text and executable code.

entry.title: CARO: Chain-of-Analogy Reasoning Optimization for Robust Content Moderation

author.name: Bingzhe Wu, Haotian Lu, Yuchen Mou

entry.summary: Introduces CARO, a two-stage training framework combining RAG-bootstrapped analogical reasoning chains with DPO to make LLMs more robust at content moderation, especially for ambiguous cases with misleading shortcuts.

entry.title: Agent Mentor: Framing Agent Knowledge through Semantic Trajectory Analysis

author.name: Roi Ben-Gigi, Yuval David, Fabiana Fournier, Lior Limonad, Dany Moshkovich, Hadar Mulian, Segev Shlomov

entry.summary: Introduces Agent Mentor, an open-source analytics pipeline that monitors AI agent execution logs and incrementally adapts system prompts to improve agent performance. Uses semantic trajectory analysis to identify and fix prompt-related issues.

entry.title: Delving Aleatoric Uncertainty in Medical Image Segmentation via Vision Foundation Models

author.name: Ruiyang Li, Fang Liu, Licheng Jiao, Xinglin Xie, Jiayao Hao, Shuo Li, Xu Liu, Jingyi Yang, Lingling Li, Puhua Chen, Wenping Ma

entry.summary: Proposes leveraging visual foundation models to estimate aleatoric (data) uncertainty in medical image segmentation by analyzing feature diversity of decoded representations. Shifts focus from model uncertainty to inherent data uncertainty.

entry.title: Inspectable AI for Science: A Research Object Approach to Generative AI Governance

author.name: Ruta Binkyte, Sharif Abuaddba, Chamikara Mahawaga, Ming Ding, Natasha Fernandes, Mario Fritz

entry.summary: Proposes AI as a Research Object (AI-RO), treating AI interactions as structured, inspectable components of scientific research. Based on Research Object theory and FAIR principles, proposes logging model configuration, prompts, and outputs.

entry.title: Agentic Driving Coach: Robustness and Determinism of Agentic AI-Powered Human-in-the-Loop Cyber-Physical Systems

author.name: Deeksha Prahlad, Daniel Fan, Hokeun Kim

entry.summary: Proposes using reactor model of computation (via Lingua Franca framework) to address nondeterminism in agentic AI-powered human-in-the-loop cyber-physical systems. Case study on an agentic driving coach.

entry.title: SemaCDR: LLM-Powered Transferable Semantics for Cross-Domain Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Chunxu Zhang, Shanqiang Huang, Zijian Zhang, Jiahong Liu, Linsong Yu, Ruiqi Wan, Bo Yang, Irwin King

entry.summary: Proposes SemaCDR, a semantics-driven framework for cross-domain sequential recommendation using LLMs to create unified semantic spaces and domain-agnostic item features.

entry.title: ACE-Bench: A Lightweight Benchmark for Evaluating Azure SDK Usage Correctness

author.name: Wenxing Zhu, Simeng Qi, Junkui Chen, Yan Xie, Min Huang, Jingkan He, Xiao Wang, Cheng Chen, Sijing Meng, Tianqi Zhang

entry.summary: Presents ACE-Bench, an execution-free benchmark for evaluating LLM coding agents' Azure SDK usage correctness without provisioning cloud resources. Uses atomic criteria combining regex checks and LLM-judge checks.

entry.title: Assessing the Pedagogical Readiness of Large Language Models as AI Tutors in Low-Resource Contexts: A Case Study of Nepal's K-10 Curriculum

author.name: Pratyush Acharya, Prasansha Bharati, Yokibha Chapagain, Isha Sharma Gauli, Kiran Parajuli

entry.summary: Evaluates GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4, Qwen3-235B, and Kimi K2 as AI tutors for Nepal's K-10 curriculum, introducing a curriculum-aligned benchmark with seven pedagogical metrics.

entry.title: Diffusion-Based Generative Priors for Efficient Beam Alignment in Directional Networks

author.name: Esraa Fahmy Othman, Lina Bariah, Merouane Debbah

entry.summary: Proposes a conditional diffusion model for beam alignment in mmWave/THz systems that learns probabilistic beam priors from geometric and multipath features, achieving strong ranking performance.

entry.title: CAGE: Bridging the Accuracy-Aesthetics Gap in Educational Diagrams via Code-Anchored Generative Enhancement

author.name: Dikshant Kukreja, Kshitij Sah, Karan Goyal, Mukesh Mohania, Vikram Goyal

entry.summary: Proposes CAGE, a hybrid pipeline bridging the accuracy-aesthetics gap in educational diagram generation by combining code-based label correctness with visual enhancement from generative models.

entry.title: Attention-Guided Flow-Matching for Sparse 3D Geological Generation

author.name: Zhixiang Lu, Mengqi Han, Peixin Guo, Tianming Bai, Jionglong Su, Fei Fang, Sifan Song

entry.summary: Proposes 3D-GeoFlow, the first attention-guided continuous flow matching framework for generating 3D geological models from sparse borehole and surface data, addressing the ill-posed inverse problem of geological modeling.

entry.title: STaR-DRO: Stateful Tsallis Reweighting for Group-Robust Structured Prediction

author.name: Samah Fodeh, Ganesh Puthiaraju, Elyas Irankhah, Linhai Ma, Srivani Talakokkul, Afshan Khan, Sreeraj Ramachandran, Jordan Alpert, Sarah Schellhorn

entry.summary: Presents STaR-DRO, a framework combining XML-based prompting strategies for structured prediction with Tsallis mirror descent for group-robust optimization under label skew and heterogeneous difficulty.

entry.title: ACCIDENT: A Benchmark Dataset for Vehicle Accident Detection from Traffic Surveillance Videos

author.name: Lukas Picek, Michal \v{C}erm\'ak, Marek Hanzl, Vojt\v{e}ch \v{C}erm\'ak

entry.summary: Introduces ACCIDENT, a benchmark dataset of 4,238 clips for traffic accident detection from CCTV footage, with tasks for temporal localization, spatial localization, and collision type classification with custom uncertainty-aware metrics.

entry.title: Efficient Personalization of Generative User Interfaces

author.name: Yi-Hao Peng, Samarth Das, Jeffrey P. Bigham, Jason Wu

entry.summary: Studies efficient personalization of generative UIs, finding substantial disagreement among designers (kappa=0.25) and developing preference-efficient adaptation methods using sparse pairwise feedback.

entry.title: MatRes: Zero-Shot Test-Time Model Adaptation for Simultaneous Matching and Restoration

author.name: Kanggeon Lee, Soochahn Lee, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: Proposes MatRes, a zero-shot test-time adaptation framework for jointly improving image restoration and geometric matching using a single image pair, enforcing conditional similarity at corresponding locations.

entry.title: A Diffusion-Contrastive Graph Neural Network with Virtual Nodes for Wind Nowcasting in Unobserved Regions

author.name: Jie Shi, Siamak Mehrkanoon

entry.summary: Presents a graph neural network with virtual nodes for wind nowcasting in regions without observation stations. Uses diffusion and contrastive learning to extend predictions to unobserved areas without new sensors.

entry.title: LLMs Should Incorporate Explicit Mechanisms for Human Empathy

author.name: Xiaoxing You, Qiang Huang, Jun Yu

entry.summary: Argues that LLMs should incorporate explicit empathy mechanisms, formalizing empathy as a behavioral property and identifying four failure modes: affect attenuation, contextual misrepresentation, stance rigidification, and perspective distortion.

entry.title: Prosociality by Coupling, Not Mere Observation: Homeostatic Sharing in an Inspectable Recurrent Artificial Life Agent

author.name: Aishik Sanyal

entry.summary: Studies prosocial behavior in artificial life agents through homeostatic coupling mechanisms rather than explicit social rewards, showing sharing emerges from internal state coupling without partner-welfare reward terms.

entry.title: MMR-AD: A Large-Scale Multimodal Dataset for Benchmarking General Anomaly Detection with Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Xincheng Yao, Zefeng Qian, Chao Shi, Jiayang Song, Chongyang Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MMR-AD, a large-scale multimodal dataset for benchmarking general anomaly detection with MLLMs. Addresses the gap between web pretraining data and industrial anomaly detection scenarios.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Web-Conditioned Scientific Fact-Checking

author.name: Ashwin Vinod, Katrin Erk

entry.summary: Presents an uncertainty-aware scientific fact-checking pipeline using atomic predicate decomposition and calibrated uncertainty-gated web search. Only triggers expensive web searches when local evidence is uncertain.

entry.title: Semantic-Geometric Dual Compression: Training-Free Visual Token Reduction for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing Understanding

author.name: Yueying Li, Fengxiang Wang, Yan Li, Mingshuo Chen, Mengying Zhao, Long Lan

entry.summary: Proposes DualComp, a training-free visual token compression method for ultra-high-resolution remote sensing images that adapts compression strategy based on whether the task requires semantic or geometric understanding.

entry.title: Taking a Pulse on How Generative AI is Reshaping the Software Engineering Research Landscape

author.name: Bianca Trinkenreich, Fabio Calefato, Kelly Blincoe, Viggo Tellefsen Wivestad, Antonio Pedro Santos Alves, J\'ulia Cond\'e Ara\'ujo, Marina Cond\'e Ara\'ujo, Paolo Tell, Marcos Kalinowski, Thomas Zimmermann, Margaret-Anne Storey

entry.summary: Large-scale survey of 457 SE researchers on GenAI adoption in research practices (2023-2025). Finds widespread use, pressure to adopt, and significant concerns about governance, with many reporting it reshapes their research landscape.

entry.title: Evolving Many Worlds: Towards Open-Ended Discovery in Petri Dish NCA via Population-Based Training

author.name: Uljad Berdica, Jakob Foerster, Frank Hutter, Arber Zela

entry.summary: Introduces PBT-NCA, a meta-evolutionary algorithm for Petri Dish Neural Cellular Automata that evolves populations rewarding behavioral novelty and visual diversity. Aims to generate sustained open-ended complexity from local interactions.

entry.title: METRO: Towards Strategy Induction from Expert Dialogue Transcripts for Non-collaborative Dialogues

author.name: Haofu Yang, Jiaji Liu, Chen Huang, Faguo Wu, Wenqiang Lei, See-Kiong Ng

entry.summary: Proposes METRO for inducing dialogue strategies from expert transcripts, formalizing knowledge into a Strategy Forest that captures both short-term responses and long-term planning. Outperforms baselines by 9-10% on non-collaborative dialogue.

entry.title: SLALOM: Simulation Lifecycle Analysis via Longitudinal Observation Metrics for Social Simulation

author.name: Juhoon Lee, Joseph Seering

entry.summary: Introduces SLALOM, a framework for validating LLM-based social simulations that shifts focus from outcome verification to process fidelity, using Pattern-Oriented Modeling. Addresses the 'stopped clock' problem where simulations reach correct outcomes via implausible trajectories.

entry.title: EdgeCIM: A Hardware-Software Co-Design for CIM-Based Acceleration of Small Language Models

author.name: Jinane Bazzi, Mariam Rakka, Fadi Kurdahi, Mohammed E. Fouda, Ahmed Eltawil

entry.summary: Presents EdgeCIM, a hardware-software co-design framework using compute-in-memory (CIM) for accelerating small language model inference at the edge, implemented in 65nm. Addresses the memory-bound nature of autoregressive decoding.

entry.title: SemEnrich: Self-Supervised Semantic Enrichment of Radiology Reports for Vision-Language Learning

author.name: Halil Ibrahim Gulluk, Olivier Gevaert

entry.summary: Proposes a self-supervised method for enriching radiology reports by leveraging semantic clustering to add positive/neutral findings, addressing bias toward negative findings in medical datasets.

entry.title: Mild Over-Parameterization Benefits Asymmetric Tensor PCA

author.name: Shihong Ding, Weicheng Lin, Cong Fang

entry.summary: Shows that mild over-parameterization (d² memory) benefits asymmetric tensor PCA, proposing a three-phase alternating-update algorithm that achieves better sample complexity than existing methods with higher memory budgets.

entry.title: Membership Inference Attacks Expose Participation Privacy in ECG Foundation Encoders

author.name: Ziyu Wang, Elahe Khatibi, Ankita Sharma, Krishnendu Chakrabarty, Sanaz Rahimi Moosavi, Farshad Firouzi, Amir Rahmani

entry.summary: Audits membership inference attacks against foundation-style ECG encoders pretrained with self-supervised learning, showing that participation in pretraining can be inferred even when raw data and labels are never disclosed. Raises concerns about participation privacy in health AI.

entry.title: UniPROT: Uniform Prototype Selection via Partial Optimal Transport with Submodular Guarantees

author.name: Prateek Chanda, Prayas Agrawal, Karthik S. Gurumoorthy, Ganesh Ramakrishnan, Bamdev Mishra, Pratik Jawanpuria

entry.summary: Introduces UniPROT, a prototype selection framework using partial optimal transport to ensure uniform representation across classes. Reformulates the intractable super-additive optimization into tractable submodular problems.

entry.title: A Faster Path to Continual Learning

author.name: Wei Li, Hangjie Yuan, Zixiang Zhao, Borui Kang, Ziwei Liu, Tao Feng

entry.summary: Proposes C-Flat Turbo, an optimized version of the C-Flat continual learning optimizer that reduces training cost by skipping redundant gradient computations while achieving stronger performance through direction-invariant component analysis.

entry.title: Sheaf Diffusion with Adaptive Local Structure for Spatio-Temporal Forecasting

author.name: Abeer Mostafa, Raneen Younis, Zahra Ahmadi

entry.summary: Proposes ST-Sheaf GNN for spatio-temporal forecasting using sheaf theory to learn dynamic restriction maps that adapt per-edge transformations based on graph topology and temporal context.

entry.title: Generative Path-Finding Method for Wasserstein Gradient Flow

author.name: Chengyu Liu, Xiang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes GenWGP, a generative path-finding framework for Wasserstein gradient flows that learns generative flows from initial to equilibrium distributions by minimizing a path loss encoding the full trajectory.

entry.title: Inter-Layer Hessian Analysis of Neural Networks with DAG Architectures

author.name: Maxim Bolshim (ITMO University, Saint Petersburg, Russia), Alexander Kugaevskikh (ITMO University, Saint Petersburg, Russia)

entry.summary: Presents analytical decomposition of the full Hessian of neural networks with DAG architectures into inter-layer blocks, separating Gauss-Newton from tensor components. Shows tensor component vanishes for ReLU activations.

entry.title: Robust Fair Disease Diagnosis in CT Images

author.name: Justin Li, Daniel Ding, Asmita Yuki Pritha, Aryana Hou, Xin Wang, Shu Hu

entry.summary: Introduces a two-level fairness objective for chest CT diagnosis combining logit-adjusted cross-entropy (sample-level) with CVaR aggregation (group-level) to handle compound failures from class imbalance and demographic underrepresentation.

entry.title: RF-LEGO: Modularized Signal Processing-Deep Learning Co-Design for RF Sensing via Deep Unrolling

author.name: Luca Jiang-Tao Yu, Chenshu Wu

entry.summary: Proposes RF-LEGO, a modular framework that transforms signal processing algorithms into trainable deep learning modules through deep unrolling for wireless sensing. Preserves interpretability while enabling learning.

entry.title: Adaptive Multi-Expert Reasoning via Difficulty-Aware Routing and Uncertainty-Guided Aggregation

author.name: Mohamed Ehab, Ali Hamdi

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Multi-Expert Reasoning (AMR), a framework that routes math problems to specialized experts based on difficulty prediction, with neural verification and clustering-based aggregation of responses.

entry.title: bioLeak: Leakage-Aware Modeling and Diagnostics for Machine Learning in R

author.name: Sel\c{c}uk Korkmaz

entry.summary: Introduces bioLeak, an R package for constructing leakage-aware resampling workflows and auditing ML models for data leakage in biomedical studies. Supports various task types and provides HTML reporting.

entry.title: The Price of Ignorance: Information-Free Quotation for Data Retention in Machine Unlearning

author.name: Bin Han, Di Feng, Zexin Fang, Jie Wang, Hans D. Schotten

entry.summary: Designs an information-free ascending quotation mechanism for data retention pricing in machine unlearning contexts. Analyzes welfare cost of operating without private user information under GDPR-type regulations.

entry.title: GPU Acceleration of Sparse Fully Homomorphic Encrypted DNNs

author.name: Lara D'Agata, Carlos Agull\'o-Domingo, \'Oscar Vera-L\'opez, Kaustubh Shivdikar, Ardhi W. B. Yudha, Ferhat Yaman, David Kaeli, Jos\'e L. Abell\'an, Ian Colbert, Jos\'e Cano

entry.summary: Optimizes sparse matrix multiplication for fully homomorphic encryption on AMD GPUs using FIDESlib. Exploits sparsity in both operands for improved runtime of encrypted DNN inference.

entry.title: Claim2Vec: Embedding Fact-Check Claims for Multilingual Similarity and Clustering

author.name: Rrubaa Panchendrarajan, Arkaitz Zubiaga

entry.summary: Introduces Claim2Vec, the first multilingual embedding model for fact-check claims, fine-tuned with contrastive learning on similar multilingual claim pairs. Addresses the underexplored problem of claim clustering for fact-checking.

entry.title: BLUEmed: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Debate for Clinical Error Detection

author.name: Saukun Thika You, Nguyen Anh Khoa Tran, Wesley K. Marizane, Hanshu Rao, Qiunan Zhang, Xiaolei Huang

entry.summary: Introduces BLUEmed, a multi-agent debate framework with hybrid RAG for detecting terminology substitution errors in clinical notes. Uses domain expert agents with distinct knowledge bases and structured counter-argumentation.

entry.title: ProUIE: A Macro-to-Micro Progressive Learning Method for LLM-based Universal Information Extraction

author.name: Wenda Liu, Zhigang Song, Shuai Nie, Guangyao Liu, Lisung Chen, Binyu Yang, Yaran Chen, Peng Zhou, Hongzhen Wang, Yuchen Liu, Wenyue Hu, Jiaming Xu, Runyu Shi, Ying Huang

entry.summary: Proposes ProUIE, a macro-to-micro progressive learning approach for LLM-based universal information extraction that improves performance without external information through curriculum-style training stages.

entry.title: HeceTokenizer: A Syllable-Based Tokenization Approach for Turkish Retrieval

author.name: Senol Gulgonul

entry.summary: HeceTokenizer is a syllable-based tokenizer for Turkish that exploits phonological structure to create an OOV-free vocabulary. A tiny BERT model trained with it outperforms a 200x larger morphology-driven baseline on retrieval.

entry.title: RCBSF: A Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Contract Revision via Stackelberg Game

author.name: Shijia Xu, Yu Wang, Xiaolong Jia, Zhou Wu, Kai Liu, April Xiaowen Dong

entry.summary: Proposes RCBSF, a multi-agent framework formulating contract revision as a Stackelberg game with risk constraints. Establishes a leader-follower structure between global prescription, constrained revision, and local verification agents.

entry.title: Phonological distances for linguistic typology and the origin of Indo-European languages

author.name: Marius Mavridis, Juan De Gregorio, Raul Toral, David Sanchez

entry.summary: Uses information-theoretic framework with second-order Markov chains on phoneme sequences to quantify distances among 67 languages, recovering language family structures and showing correlation with genetic distances.

entry.title: Psychological Concept Neurons: Can Neural Control Bias Probing and Shift Generation in LLMs?

author.name: Yuto Harada, Hiro Taiyo Hamada

entry.summary: Analyzes Big Five personality representations in LLMs, using probing to locate where personality information emerges across layers and identifying neurons that selectively respond to each trait, then using interventions to study behavioral effects.

entry.title: Does Your VFM Speak Plant? The Botanical Grammar of Vision Foundation Models for Object Detection

author.name: Lars Lundqvist, Earl Ranario, Hamid Kamangir, Heesup Yun, Christine Diepenbrock, Brian N. Bailey, J. Mason Earles

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates how text prompt construction affects zero-shot object detection performance across four VFM detectors in agricultural scenes, revealing that optimal prompts are model-specific.

entry.title: Unmixing-Guided Spatial-Spectral Mamba with Clustering Tokens for Hyperspectral Image Classification

author.name: Yimin Zhu, Lincoln Linlin Xu

entry.summary: Proposes unmixing-guided spatial-spectral Mamba with clustering tokens for hyperspectral image classification, combining spectral unmixing with state-space models.

entry.title: Revisiting the Scale Loss Function and Gaussian-Shape Convolution for Infrared Small Target Detection

author.name: Hao Li, Man Fung Zhuo

entry.summary: Revisits scale loss functions and proposes Gaussian-shaped convolution for infrared small target detection, introducing a monotonic diff-based scale loss and learnable kernels matching the physical imaging characteristics of small targets.

entry.title: DocRevive: A Unified Pipeline for Document Text Restoration

author.name: Kunal Purkayastha, Ayan Banerjee, Josep Llados, Umapada Pal

entry.summary: DocRevive presents a unified pipeline for restoring damaged/occluded document text combining OCR, masked language modeling, and diffusion models, with a synthetic dataset of 30K degraded document images.

entry.title: A Benchmark and Multi-Agent System for Instruction-driven Cinematic Video Compilation

author.name: Peixuan Zhang, Chang Zhou, Ziyuan Zhang, Hualuo Liu, Chunjie Zhang, Jingqi Liu, Xiaohui Zhou, Xi Chen, Shuchen Weng, Si Li, Boxin Shi

entry.summary: CineBench is the first benchmark for instruction-driven cinematic video compilation, accompanied by CineAgents, a multi-agent system that reformulates video compilation into a design-and-compose paradigm. Addresses contextual collapse and temporal fragmentation in long-form video editing.

entry.title: Self-supervised Pretraining of Cell Segmentation Models

author.name: Kaden Stillwagon, Alexandra Dunnum VandeLoo, Benjamin Magondu, Craig R. Forest

entry.summary: DINOCell is a self-supervised framework for cell instance segmentation that leverages DINOv2 representations instead of SAM-based natural image pretraining, better aligning with microscopy data characteristics.

entry.title: Defending against Patch-Based and Texture-Based Adversarial Attacks with Spectral Decomposition

author.name: Wei Zhang, Xinyu Chang, Xiao Li, Yiming Zhu, Xiaolin Hu

entry.summary: Adversarial Spectrum Defense (ASD) uses discrete wavelet transform for spectral decomposition to defend against patch-based and texture-based adversarial attacks, specifically addressing physical-world threats to person detection.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: AI Flash Portrait (Track 3)

author.name: Ya-nan Guan, Shaonan Zhang, Hang Guo, Yawen Wang, Xinying Fan, Tianqu Zhuang, Jie Liang, Hui Zeng, Guanyi Qin, Lishen Qu, Tao Dai, Shu-Tao Xia, Lei Zhang, Radu Timofte, Bin Chen, Yuanbo Zhou, Hongwei Wang, Qinquan Gao, Tong Tong, Yanxin Qian, Lizhao You, Jingru Cong, Lei Xiong, Shuyuan Zhu, Zhi-Qiang Zhong, Kan Lv, Yang Yang, Kailing Tang, Minjian Zhang, Zhipei Lei, Zhe Xu, Liwen Zhang, Dingyong Gou, Yanlin Wu, Cong Li, Xiaohui Cui, Jiajia Liu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Yaokun Shi, Jiachen Tu, Liqing Wang, Shihang Li, Bo Zhang, Biao Wang, Haiming Xu, Xiang Long, Xurui Liao, Yanqiao Zhai, Haozhe Li, Shijun Shi, Jiangning Zhang, Yong Liu, Kai Hu, Jing Xu, Xianfang Zeng, Yuyang Liu, Minchen Wei

entry.summary: Overview of the NTIRE 2026 RAIM Challenge Track 3 focusing on AI flash portrait restoration in low-light conditions. Establishes a benchmark for real-world low-light portrait restoration with hybrid evaluation metrics combining objective and subjective measures.

entry.title: Empowering Video Translation using Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Bingzheng QU, Kehai Chen, Xuefeng Bai, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Survey/overview of MLLM-powered video translation systems that jointly model speech recognition, translation, text-to-speech, and lip synchronization. Shows MLLMs can overcome limitations of traditional cascaded pipelines.

entry.title: Beyond Reconstruction: Reconstruction-to-Vector Diffusion for Hyperspectral Anomaly Detection

author.name: Jijun Xiang, Jiayi Wang, Pengxiang Wang, Cheng Chen, Nian Wang, Tao Wang

entry.summary: R2VD redefines hyperspectral anomaly detection by treating reconstruction as a starting point for diffusion-based generative dynamics rather than an endpoint. Introduces a four-stage pipeline to address sub-pixel anomaly vanishing and confirmation bias.

entry.title: Degradation-Aware and Structure-Preserving Diffusion for Real-World Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Yang Ji, Zonghao Chen, Zhihao Xue, Junqin Hu

entry.summary: Proposes degradation-aware and structure-preserving modules for diffusion-based real-world image super-resolution. Introduces degradation token injection and spatially asymmetric noise injection as lightweight add-ons.

entry.title: The Devil is in the Details -- From OCR for Old Church Slavonic to Purely Visual Stemma Reconstruction

author.name: Armin Hoenen

entry.summary: Investigates OCR systems for 18th-century Church Slavonic manuscripts, comparing classical, ML, and LLM-based approaches (including GPT-5 and Gemini-3-Flash). Assesses agentic OCR architectures for post-processing.

entry.title: Compact single-shot ranging and near-far imaging using metasurfaces

author.name: Junjie Luo, Yuxuan Liu, Wei Ting Chen, Qing Wang, Qi Guo

entry.summary: Presents a metasurface imaging system for simultaneous near-far imaging with passive ranging capability. Achieves ±1mm accuracy in a 15mm total track length system.

entry.title: AnySlot: Goal-Conditioned Vision-Language-Action Policies for Zero-Shot Slot-Level Placement

author.name: Zhaofeng Hu, Sifan Zhou, Qinbo Zhang, Rongtao Xu, Qi Su, Ci-Jyun Liang

entry.summary: Proposes AnySlot, a hierarchical VLA framework that converts language instructions into explicit visual goals (scene markers) before executing with a goal-conditioned policy. Decouples language grounding from precise control for slot-level object placement tasks.

entry.title: Ro-SLM: Onboard Small Language Models for Robot Task Planning and Operation Code Generation

author.name: Wenhao Wang, Yanyan Li, Long Jiao, Jiawei Yuan

entry.summary: Introduces Ro-SLM, a framework for deploying small language models onboard robots for task planning and code generation, using knowledge distillation from larger LLMs. Targets robots with constrained compute or unreliable internet connectivity.

entry.title: We need Git for AI Timelines

author.name: fluxxrider

entry.summary: Argues that AI timeline tracking needs version-controlled, continuously-updated collaborative infrastructure (like Git) because quarterly updates can't keep pace with the speed of AI development, citing Mythos as an example of rapid invalidation.

entry.title: When the "Black Box Problem" Becomes the Default Message

author.name: Alison Avery

entry.summary: Discusses Alondra Nelson's concept of 'algorithmic agnotology'—the deliberate blurring of what AI companies truly don't know vs. what they choose to withhold—arguing for better policy definitions of transparency and explainability.

entry.title: Data-Efficient Semantic Segmentation of 3D Point Clouds via Open-Vocabulary Image Segmentation-based Pseudo-Labeling

author.name: Takahiko Furuya

entry.summary: PLOVIS addresses three simultaneous forms of data insufficiency in 3D point cloud segmentation (scarce scenes, scarce annotations, no 2D images) using open-vocabulary image segmentation for pseudo-labeling.

entry.title: MapATM: Enhancing HD Map Construction through Actor Trajectory Modeling

author.name: Mingyang Li, Brian Lee, Rui Zuo, Brent Bacchus, Priyantha Mudalige, Qinru Qiu

entry.summary: MapATM leverages historical actor (vehicle) trajectory information as structural priors for road geometry to improve HD map lane detection accuracy, particularly for occluded and distant lanes.

entry.title: CDPR: Cross-modal Diffusion with Polarization for Reliable Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Rongjia Yu, Tong Jia, Hao Wang, Xiaofang Li, Xiao Yang, Zinuo Zhang, Cuiwei Liu

entry.summary: CDPR integrates polarization priors (AoLP/DoLP) into a diffusion-based monocular depth estimation framework, addressing failures on textureless surfaces, transparent objects, and specular reflections.

entry.title: Persistent Identity in AI Agents: A Multi-Anchor Architecture for Resilient Memory and Continuity

author.name: Prahlad G. Menon

entry.summary: Presents soul.py, an architecture for persistent AI agent identity through distributed memory systems (episodic, procedural, emotional), inspired by how human identity survives neurological damage. Addresses catastrophic forgetting of agent 'self'.

entry.title: Unifying Ontology Construction and Semantic Alignment for Deterministic Enterprise Reasoning at Scale

author.name: Hongyin Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes the Large Ontology Model (LOM), a unified framework integrating ontology construction, semantic alignment, and logical reasoning into one end-to-end architecture for enterprise reasoning at scale.

entry.title: AdaQE-CG: Adaptive Query Expansion for Web-Scale Generative AI Model and Data Card Generation

author.name: Haoxuan Zhang, Ruochi Li, Zhenni Liang, Mehri Sattari, Phat Vo, Collin Qu, Ting Xiao, Junhua Ding, Yang Zhang, Haihua Chen

entry.summary: AdaQE-CG proposes adaptive query expansion for automatically generating AI model and data cards at web scale, addressing static templates, information scarcity, and lack of benchmarks in documentation generation.

entry.title: GLEaN: A Text-to-image Bias Detection Approach for Public Comprehension

author.name: Bochu Ding, Brinnae Bent, Augustus Wendell

entry.summary: GLEaN is a pipeline for making text-to-image model biases visually understandable to the general public through portrait-based compositions that distill a model's central tendency into representative images.

entry.title: Inductive Reasoning for Temporal Knowledge Graphs with Emerging Entities

author.name: Ze Zhao, Yuhui He, Lyuwen Wu, Gu Tang, Bin Lu, Xiaoying Gan, Luoyi Fu, Xinbing Wang, Chenghu Zhou

entry.summary: Addresses inductive reasoning on temporal knowledge graphs for emerging entities (lacking historical interactions, ~25% of all entities) by using semantic similarity to transfer knowledge from established entities.

entry.title: MAVEN-T: Multi-Agent enVironment-aware Enhanced Neural Trajectory predictor with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Wenchang Duan

entry.summary: MAVEN-T is a teacher-student framework for trajectory prediction in autonomous driving that achieves SOTA through architectural co-design and progressive distillation, balancing representational capacity with deployment efficiency.

entry.title: Governed Reasoning for Institutional AI

author.name: Mamadou Seck

entry.summary: Proposes Cognitive Core, a governed decision architecture for institutional AI with nine typed cognitive primitives, a four-tier governance model requiring human review as execution condition, and a tamper-evident audit ledger. Targets regulatory, clinical, and institutional decision-making.

entry.title: Beyond Statistical Co-occurrence: Unlocking Intrinsic Semantics for Tabular Data Clustering

author.name: Mingjie Zhao, Yunfan Zhang, Yiqun Zhang, Yiu-ming Cheung

entry.summary: Proposes TagCC, a tabular data clustering framework that bridges statistical co-occurrence patterns with intrinsic semantic knowledge from feature names and values using LLM-derived open-world textual concepts.

entry.title: CFMS: A Coarse-to-Fine Multimodal Synthesis Framework for Enhanced Tabular Reasoning

author.name: Qixian Huang, Hongqiang Lin, Tong Fu, Yingsen Wang, Zhenghui Fu, Qirui Wang, Yiding Sun, Dongxu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CFMS, a coarse-to-fine multimodal framework for tabular reasoning that first uses MLLMs for high-level visual perception then applies granular symbolic reasoning, combining visual and textual modalities hierarchically.

entry.title: AI Integrity: A New Paradigm for Verifiable AI Governance

author.name: Seulki Lee

entry.summary: Introduces AI Integrity as a governance paradigm focused on verifying the reasoning process itself (not just outcomes). Defines the Authority Stack as a 4-layer cascade of values, epistemology, sources, and data, requiring protection from corruption.

entry.title: Dynamic Summary Generation for Interpretable Multimodal Depression Detection

author.name: Shiyu Teng, Jiaqing Liu, Hao Sun, Yu Li, Shurong Chai, Ruibo Hou, Tomoko Tateyama, Lanfen Lin, Yen-Wei Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-stage framework using LLMs for depression detection, generating progressively richer clinical summaries that guide multimodal fusion of text, audio, and video features. Produces human-readable assessment reports.

entry.title: Beyond RAG for Cyber Threat Intelligence: A Systematic Evaluation of Graph-Based and Agentic Retrieval

author.name: Dzenan Hamzic, Florian Skopik, Max Landauer, Markus Wurzenberger, Andreas Rauber

entry.summary: Evaluates graph-based and agentic retrieval approaches for cyber threat intelligence (CTI) beyond traditional RAG. Compares multiple paradigms for answering complex questions over security reports.

entry.title: Collaborative Multi-Agent Scripts Generation for Enhancing Imperfect-Information Reasoning in Murder Mystery Games

author.name: Keyang Zhong, Junlin Xie, Hefeng Wu, Haofeng Li, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: Proposes a collaborative multi-agent framework for generating and evaluating Murder Mystery Game scripts to improve VLM reasoning under imperfect information with deception.

entry.title: Evaluating Visual Prompts with Eye-Tracking Data for MLLM-Based Human Activity Recognition

author.name: Jae Young Choi, Seon Gyeom Kim, Hyungjun Yoon, Taeckyung Lee, Donggun Lee, Jaeryung Chung, Jihyung Kil, Ryan Rossi, Sung-Ju Lee, Tak Yeon Lee

entry.summary: Evaluates visual prompting strategies that transform eye-tracking sensor data into visualization images as input to multimodal LLMs for human activity recognition, comparing timeline, heatmap, and scanpath visualizations.

entry.title: Hardware Utilization and Inference Performance of Edge Object Detection Under Fault Injection

author.name: Faezeh Pasandideh, Mehdi Azarafza, Achim Rettberg

entry.summary: Characterizes hardware utilization and inference performance of edge object detection models (including YOLO2026n) under fault injection on NVIDIA Jetson Nano, using LLM and diffusion model-synthesized faults.

entry.title: TaFall: Balance-Informed Fall Detection via Passive Thermal Sensing

author.name: Chengxiao Li, Xie Zhang, Wei Zhu, Yan Jiang, Chenshu Wu

entry.summary: Introduces TaFall, a privacy-preserving fall detection system using low-cost thermal array sensing that models falls as balance degradation processes using pose-driven biomechanical dynamics.

entry.title: PAS: Estimating the target accuracy before domain adaptation

author.name: Raphaella Diniz, Jackson de Faria, Martin Ester

entry.summary: Proposes PAS, a score for estimating domain adaptation transferability before performing adaptation, helping select source domains and pre-trained models without labeled target validation data.

entry.title: Exploring Structural Complexity in Normative RAG with Graph-based approaches: A case study on the ETSI Standards

author.name: Aiman Al Masoud, Marco Arazzi, Simone Germani, Antonino Nocera

entry.summary: Investigates Graph RAG architectures for processing normative/standards documents (ETSI standards), comparing them against vanilla vector-based RAG for capturing hierarchical structures and cross-references.

entry.title: From UAV Imagery to Agronomic Reasoning: A Multimodal LLM Benchmark for Plant Phenotyping

author.name: Yu Wu, Guangzeng Han, Ibra Niang Niang, Francia Ravelombola, Maiara Oliveira, Jason Davis, Dong Chen, Feng Lin, Xiaolei Huang

entry.summary: Introduces PlantXpert, an evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning benchmark for soybean and cotton phenotyping from UAV imagery, evaluating VLMs on domain-specific agronomic reasoning tasks.

entry.title: Graph-RHO: Critical-path-aware Heterogeneous Graph Network for Long-Horizon Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling

author.name: Yujie Li, Jiuniu Wang, Mugen Peng, Guangzuo Li, Wenjia Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Graph-RHO, a critical-path-aware heterogeneous graph network for long-horizon flexible job-shop scheduling using rolling horizon optimization with asymmetric cost-sensitive prediction.

entry.title: Class-Adaptive Cooperative Perception for Multi-Class LiDAR-based 3D Object Detection in V2X Systems

author.name: Blessing Agyei Kyem, Joshua Kofi Asamoah, Armstrong Aboah

entry.summary: Proposes class-adaptive cooperative perception for multi-class 3D object detection in vehicle-to-everything systems. Uses different fusion strategies for different object classes to handle varying geometric structures.

entry.title: Rethinking Video Human-Object Interaction: Set Prediction over Time for Unified Detection and Anticipation

author.name: Yuanhao Luo, Di Wen, Kunyu Peng, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Jiale Wei, Rainer Stiefelhage

entry.summary: Introduces DETAnt-HOI benchmark and HOI-DA framework for joint human-object interaction detection and anticipation in video, addressing temporal misalignment in existing benchmarks.

entry.title: UDAPose: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Low-Light Human Pose Estimation

author.name: Haopeng Chen, Yihao Ai, Kabeen Kim, Robby T. Tan, Yixin Chen, Bo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes UDAPose for unsupervised domain adaptation in low-light human pose estimation, addressing the gap between well-lit training data and real low-light scenes through more realistic augmentation and robust cross-attention.

entry.title: Architecture-Agnostic Modality-Isolated Gated Fusion for Robust Multi-Modal Prostate MRI Segmentation

author.name: Yongbo Shu, Wenzhao Xie, Shanhu Yao, Zirui Xin, Luo Lei, Kewen Chen, Aijing Luo

entry.summary: Proposes MIGF, an architecture-agnostic gated fusion module for multi-modal prostate MRI segmentation that handles missing or degraded modalities through separate encoding streams and modality dropout.

entry.title: Do BERT Embeddings Encode Narrative Dimensions? A Token-Level Probing Analysis of Time, Space, Causality, and Character in Fiction

author.name: Beicheng Bei, Hannah Hyesun Chun, Chen Guo, Arwa Saghiri

entry.summary: Probes whether BERT embeddings encode narrative dimensions (time, space, causality, character) using token-level labeled fiction data. Linear probe achieves 94% accuracy confirming BERT encodes narrative information.

entry.title: Resilient Write: A Six-Layer Durable Write Surface for LLM Coding Agents

author.name: Justice Owusu Agyemang, Jerry John Kponyo, Elliot Amponsah, Godfred Manu Addo Boakye, Kwame Opuni-Boachie Obour Agyekum

entry.summary: Presents Resilient Write, a six-layer durable write surface for LLM coding agents over MCP, handling write failures through pre-flight scoring, atomic writes, resume-safe chunking, and task handoff.

entry.title: When Valid Signals Fail: Regime Boundaries Between LLM Features and RL Trading Policies

author.name: Zhengzhe Yang

entry.summary: Explores using frozen LLMs as feature extractors for RL trading agents, finding that while LLM-extracted features have high predictive information coefficients, the RL agent fails to exploit them due to regime boundary effects between feature quality and policy learning.

entry.title: Network Effects and Agreement Drift in LLM Debates

author.name: Erica Cau, Andrea Failla, Giulio Rossetti

entry.summary: Studies how LLM agents behave in multi-round network debates, finding 'agreement drift' where agents systematically shift toward specific positions. Uses controlled homophily and class size in network generation.

entry.title: From Redaction to Restoration: Deep Learning for Medical Image Anonymization and Reconstruction

author.name: Adrienne Kline, Abhijit Gaonkar, Daniel Pittman, Chris Kuehn, Nils Forkert

entry.summary: Presents an end-to-end deep learning framework for medical image de-identification that detects and redacts PHI regions, then uses generative inpainting to restore useful information without compromising privacy.

entry.title: Regularized Entropy Information Adaptation with Temporal-Awareness Networks for Simultaneous Speech Translation

author.name: Joseph Liu, Nameer Hirschkind, Xiao Yu, Mahesh Kumar Nandwana

entry.summary: Improves REINA for simultaneous speech translation with two temporal-awareness strategies (alignment network and timestep augmentation) to address the bias toward reading most audio before writing.

entry.title: Vestibular reservoir computing

author.name: Smita Deb, Shirin Panahi, Mulugeta Haile, Ying-Cheng Lai

entry.summary: Proposes a physical reservoir computing scheme inspired by the biological vestibular system, with an uncoupled topology that achieves performance comparable to fully coupled networks. Derives memory capacity formula for linear reservoirs.

entry.title: Towards Multi-Source Domain Generalization for Sleep Staging with Noisy Labels

author.name: Kening Wang, Di Wen, Yufan Chen, Ruiping Liu, Junwei Zheng, Jiale Wei, Kailun Yang, Rainer Stiefelhagen, Kunyu Peng

entry.summary: Presents the first benchmark for noisy labels in multi-source domain-generalized sleep staging and proposes FF-TRUST with joint time-frequency early learning regularization.

entry.title: Consensus-based Recursive Multi-Output Gaussian Process

author.name: Yogesh Prasanna Kumar Rao, Tamas Keviczky, Raj Thilak Rajan

entry.summary: Proposes CRMGP, combining recursive multi-output Gaussian process inference with consensus-based distributed updates for scalable uncertainty-aware learning of vector-valued fields.

entry.title: WOODELF-HD: Efficient Background SHAP for High-Depth Decision Trees

author.name: Ron Wettenstein, Alexander Nadel, Udi Boker

entry.summary: Proposes WOODELF-HD, an extension of the Woodelf algorithm for computing Background SHAP values in decision tree ensembles, reducing the exponential preprocessing factor from 3^D to 2^D for tree depth D using a Strassen-like multiplication scheme.

entry.title: Unified Graph Prompt Learning via Low-Rank Graph Message Prompting

author.name: Beibei Wang, Bo Jiang, Ziyan Zhang, Jin Tang

entry.summary: Proposes Low-Rank Graph Message Prompting (LR-GMP), a unified graph prompt learning approach that simultaneously targets all graph components (node features, edge features, edge weights) via a single low-rank framework.

entry.title: Representation-Aligned Multi-Scale Personalization for Federated Learning

author.name: Wenfei Liang, Wee Peng Tay

entry.summary: Proposes FRAMP, a framework for personalized federated learning that generates client-specific models from compact client descriptors, enabling both data and resource adaptation without relying on a fixed global backbone.

entry.title: Learning How Much to Think: Difficulty-Aware Dynamic MoEs for Graph Node Classification

author.name: Jiajun Zhou, Yadong Li, Xuanze Chen, Chen Ma, Chuang Zhao, Shanqing Yu, Qi Xuan

entry.summary: Proposes D2MoE for graph node classification, using predictive entropy as difficulty proxy to allocate expert resources adaptively via top-p routing, concentrating computation on hard nodes.

entry.title: SHANG++: Robust Stochastic Acceleration under Multiplicative Noise

author.name: Yaxin Yu, Long Chen, Minfu Feng

entry.summary: Proposes SHANG++, an accelerated SGD method derived from Hessian-driven Nesterov flow discretization with damping correction, achieving faster convergence under multiplicative noise scaling conditions.

entry.title: Sharpness-Aware Surrogate Training for On-Sensor Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Maximilian Nicholson

entry.summary: Studies Sharpness-Aware Surrogate Training (SAST) applying SAM to surrogate-gradient SNN training to reduce the accuracy gap between smooth surrogate training and hard-threshold deployment for on-sensor vision.

entry.title: Engineering Resource-constrained Software Systems with DNN Components: a Concept-based Pruning Approach

author.name: Federico Formica, Andrea Rota, Aurora Francesca Zanenga, Andrea Bombarda, Mark Lawford, Lionel C. Briand, Claudio Menghi

entry.summary: Presents a concept-based pruning technique for DNNs that uses human-interpretable concepts (features, colors, classes) to guide pruning decisions according to system requirements. Particularly relevant for resource-constrained software systems.

entry.title: CapBench: A Multi-PDK Dataset for Machine-Learning-Based Post-Layout Capacitance Extraction

author.name: Hector R. Rodriguez, Jiechen Huang, Wenjian Yu

entry.summary: Presents CapBench, a fully reproducible multi-PDK dataset for ML-based post-layout capacitance extraction in chip design. Covers 3 technology nodes with 61,855 3D windows and validated high-fidelity labels.

entry.title: 3DTV: A Feedforward Interpolation Network for Real-Time View Synthesis

author.name: Stefan Schulz, Fernando Edelstein, Hannah Dr\"oge, Matthias B. Hullin, Markus Plack

entry.summary: Proposes 3DTV, a feedforward network for real-time sparse-view interpolation using Delaunay-based triplet selection and pose-aware depth estimation. Runs without scene-specific optimization, enabling practical AR/VR applications.

entry.title: Simulating Organized Group Behavior: New Framework, Benchmark, and Analysis

author.name: Xinkai Zou, Yiming Huang, Zhuohang Wu, Jian Sha, Nan Huang, Longfei Yun, Jingbo Shang, Letian Peng

entry.summary: Formalizes organized group behavior simulation as a research platform, providing task definition, benchmark, and structured analytical framework. Models how organized groups like corporations respond to situations.

entry.title: Who Wrote This Line? Evaluating the Detection of LLM-Generated Classical Chinese Poetry

author.name: Jiang Li, Tian Lan, Shanshan Wang, Dongxing Zhang, Dianqing Lin, Guanglai Gao, Derek F. Wong, Xiangdong Su

entry.summary: Introduces ChangAn, a benchmark for detecting LLM-generated classical Chinese poetry. Addresses unique challenges of classical Chinese poetry including strict metrical regularity, shared imagery systems, and flexible syntax.

entry.title: Relational Probing: LM-to-Graph Adaptation for Financial Prediction

author.name: Yingjie Niu, Changhong Jin, Rian Dolphin, Ruihai Dong

entry.summary: Proposes Relational Probing, replacing the standard LM head with a relation head that induces relational graphs directly from hidden states for stock-trend prediction. Joint training with downstream tasks enables structured graph outputs from LM representations.

entry.title: Expect the Unexpected? Testing the Surprisal of Salient Entities

author.name: Jessica Lin, Amir Zeldes

entry.summary: Studies how entity salience in discourse relates to surprisal in language models, finding that globally salient entities exhibit significantly higher surprisal than non-salient ones, challenging uniform information density assumptions.

entry.title: TRACE: An Experiential Framework for Coherent Multi-hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering

author.name: Yingxu Wang, Jiaxin Huang, Mengzhu Wang, Nan Yin

entry.summary: Proposes TRACE for multi-hop KGQA that translates reasoning paths into natural language narratives for semantic continuity and uses exploration priors to reduce redundant search.

entry.title: EvoDiagram: Agentic Editable Diagram Creation via Design Expertise Evolution

author.name: Tianfu Wang, Leilei Ding, Ziyang Tao, Yi Zhan, Zhiyuan Ma, Wei Wu, Yuxuan Lei, Yuan Feng, Junyang Wang, Yin Wu, Yizhao Xu, Hongyuan Zhu, Qi Liu, Nicholas Jing Yuan, Yanyong Zhang, Hui Xiong

entry.summary: Presents EvoDiagram, an agentic framework for generating editable diagrams via intermediate canvas schemas with a multi-agent system and design knowledge evolution mechanism.

entry.title: Hierarchical Textual Knowledge for Enhanced Image Clustering

author.name: Yijie Zhong, Yunfan Gao, Weipeng Jiang, Haofen Wang

entry.summary: Proposes KEC, a knowledge-enhanced image clustering method that constructs hierarchical concept-attribute structured knowledge using LLMs to guide clustering of visually similar but semantically different images.

entry.title: 3D Multi-View Stylization with Pose-Free Correspondences Matching for Robust 3D Geometry Preservation

author.name: Shirsha Bose

entry.summary: This thesis introduces a feed-forward stylization network for multi-view 3D scenes that preserves geometry without requiring camera poses, using test-time optimization with appearance transfer and geometry preservation objectives. It addresses the problem of texture drift and warped edges in per-view stylization.

entry.title: Vector Field Synthesis with Sparse Streamlines Using Diffusion Model

author.name: Nguyen K. Phan, Ricardo Morales, Sebastian D. Espriella, Guoning Chen

entry.summary: Presents a diffusion-based framework for synthesizing 2D vector fields from sparse streamline inputs while maintaining physical plausibility using classifier-free guidance.

entry.title: Intra-finger Variability of Diffusion-based Latent Fingerprint Generation

author.name: Noor Hussein, Anil K. Jain, Karthik Nandakumar

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates intra-finger variability of synthetic fingerprints from diffusion models, constructing a latent style bank with 40+ distinct styles and analyzing ridge/minutiae integrity.

entry.title: A3-FPN: Asymptotic Content-Aware Pyramid Attention Network for Dense Visual Prediction

author.name: Meng'en Qin, Yu Song, Quanling Zhao, Xiaodong Yang, Yingtao Che, Xiaohui Yang

entry.summary: A3-FPN proposes an asymptotic content-aware pyramid attention network that enables global feature interaction through a horizontally-spread column architecture for improved multi-scale dense prediction.

entry.title: FastSHADE: Fast Self-augmented Hierarchical Asymmetric Denoising for Efficient inference on mobile devices

author.name: Nikolay Falaleev

entry.summary: FastSHADE is a lightweight denoising network for mobile GPUs featuring asymmetric frequency blocks and spatially gated upsampling, achieving real-time performance on edge devices.

entry.title: Context Matters: Vision-Based Depression Detection Comparing Classical and Deep Approaches

author.name: Maneesh Bilalpur, Saurabh Hinduja, Sonish Sivarajkumar, Nicholas Allen, Yanshan Wang, Itir Onal Ertugrul, Jeffrey F. Cohn

entry.summary: Compares classical (interpretable features + SVM) and deep learning approaches for vision-based depression detection across different contexts, examining accuracy, fairness, and generalizability.

entry.title: AIM-Bench: Benchmarking and Improving Affective Image Manipulation via Fine-Grained Hierarchical Control

author.name: Shi Chen, Xuecheng Wu, Heli Sun, Yunyun Shi, Xinyi Yin, Fengjian Xue, Jinheng Xie, Dingkang Yang, Hao Wang, Junxiao Xue, Liang He

entry.summary: AIM-Bench introduces the first benchmark for Affective Image Manipulation, combining emotion taxonomy with Valence-Arousal-Dominance framework for fine-grained emotional image editing. Curates 800 high-quality samples covering 8 emotional categories through a hierarchical human-in-the-loop workflow.

entry.title: Spatio-Temporal Difference Guided Motion Deblurring with the Complementary Vision Sensor

author.name: Yapeng Meng, Lin Yang, Yuguo Chen, Xiangru Chen, Taoyi Wang, Lijian Wang, Zheyu Yang, Yihan Lin, Rong Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes using the Tianmouc complementary vision sensor (CVS) for motion deblurring, leveraging synchronized RGB frames with high-frame-rate spatial difference data. Addresses limitations of event cameras under rapid motion.

entry.title: FineEdit: Fine-Grained Image Edit with Bounding Box Guidance

author.name: Haohang Xu, Lin Liu, Zhibo Zhang, Rong Cong, Xiaopeng Zhang, Qi Tian

entry.summary: FineEdit uses bounding boxes as guidance for precise diffusion-based image editing, injecting spatial constraints at multiple levels to maintain background consistency while accurately localizing edit targets.

entry.title: Boxes2Pixels: Learning Defect Segmentation from Noisy SAM Masks

author.name: Camile Lendering, Erkut Akdag, Egor Bondarev

entry.summary: Boxes2Pixels treats SAM as a noisy teacher for industrial defect segmentation, training a compact student with noise-robust distillation from SAM-generated pseudo-masks derived from bounding box annotations.

entry.title: Development and evaluation of CADe systems in low-prevalence setting: The RARE25 challenge for early detection of Barrett's neoplasia

author.name: Tim J. M. Jaspers, Francisco Caetano, Cris H. B. Claessens, Carolus H. J. Kusters, Rixta A. H. van Eijck van Heslinga, Floor Slooter, Jacques J. Bergman, Peter H. N. De With, Martijn R. Jong, Albert J. de Groof, Fons van der Sommen

entry.summary: RARE25 challenge introduces a prevalence-aware benchmark for computer-aided detection of early Barrett's neoplasia, reflecting real-world low-prevalence conditions that standard enriched datasets miss.

entry.title: Bridging the RGB-IR Gap: Consensus and Discrepancy Modeling for Text-Guided Multispectral Detection

author.name: Jiaqi Wu, Zhen Wang, Enhao Huang, Kangqing Shen, Yulin Wang, Yang Yue, Yifan Pu, Gao Huang

entry.summary: Proposes a semantic bridge fusion framework for text-guided multispectral (RGB-IR) object detection that models both consensus and discrepancy between modalities. Text serves as a shared bridge to align RGB and IR representations.

entry.title: LEADER: Learning Reliable Local-to-Global Correspondences for LiDAR Relocalization

author.name: Jianshi Wu, Minghang Zhu, Dunqiang Liu, Wen Li, Sheng Ao, Siqi Shen, Chenglu Wen, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: LEADER proposes a robust LiDAR relocalization framework with a geometric encoder that captures multi-scale features for reliable 6-DoF pose estimation. Addresses vulnerability to noise and outliers in learning-based regression methods.

entry.title: TAG-Head: Time-Aligned Graph Head for Plug-and-Play Fine-grained Action Recognition

author.name: Imtiaz Ul Hassan, Nik Bessis, Ardhendu Behera

entry.summary: TAG-Head is a lightweight graph-based head that upgrades standard 3D backbones for fine-grained action recognition using RGB only. Combines temporal graph modeling with transformer encoders for subtle spatio-temporal cue capture.

entry.title: BEM: Training-Free Background Embedding Memory for False-Positive Suppression in Real-Time Fixed-Background Camera

author.name: Junwoo Park, Jangho Lee, Sunho Lim

entry.summary: BEM is a training-free, weight-frozen module that suppresses false positive detections in fixed-camera environments by learning and exploiting quasi-static background priors at inference time.

entry.title: R2E-VID: Two-Stage Robust Routing via Temporal Gating for Elastic Edge-Cloud Video Inference

author.name: Zheming Yang, Lulu Zuo, Shun Lu, Yangyu Zhang, Zhicheng Li, Xiangyang Li, Yang You

entry.summary: R2E-VID proposes a two-stage robust routing framework for edge-cloud video inference with temporal gating that adapts to video content dynamics and resource conditions.

entry.title: Simple but Stable, Fast and Safe: Achieve End-to-end Control by High-Fidelity Differentiable Simulation

author.name: Fanxing Li, Shengyang Wang, Yuxiang Huang, Fangyu Sun, Yufei Yan, Danping Zou, Wenxian Yu
