entry.title: OpenKedge: Governing Agentic Mutation with Execution-Bound Safety and Evidence Chains

author.name: Jun He, Deying Yu

entry.summary: Introduces OpenKedge, a protocol for governing autonomous AI agent mutations through declarative intent proposals, deterministic state evaluation, and execution contracts with bounded permissions. Shifts safety from reactive filtering to preventative enforcement.

entry.title: InsEdit: Towards Instruction-based Visual Editing via Data-Efficient Video Diffusion Models Adaptation

author.name: Zhefan Rao, Bin Zou, Haoxuan Che, Xuanhua He, Chong Hou Choi, Yanheng Li, Rui Liu, Qifeng Chen

entry.summary: Presents InsEdit, an instruction-based video editing model built on HunyuanVideo-1.5 that achieves SOTA open-source performance with only ~100K video editing data. Uses Mutual Context Attention for creating aligned video pairs.

entry.title: Generative Simulation for Policy Learning in Physical Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Junxiang Wang, Xinwen Xu, Tiancheng Wu, Julian Millan, Nir Pechuk, Zackory Erickson

entry.summary: Introduces a zero-shot text2sim2real framework using LLMs and VLMs to procedurally generate diverse physical human-robot interaction scenarios from natural language prompts, then trains imitation learning policies from synthetic demonstrations.

entry.title: Every Response Counts: Quantifying Uncertainty of LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems through Tensor Decomposition

author.name: Tiejin Chen, Huaiyuan Yao, Jia Chen, Evangelos E. Papalexakis, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Introduces MATU, a framework for quantifying uncertainty in LLM-based multi-agent systems using tensor decomposition. Addresses cascading uncertainty, inter-agent communication variability, and diverse topologies.

entry.title: Adam-HNAG: A Convergent Reformulation of Adam with Accelerated Rate

author.name: Yaxin Yu, Long Chen, Zeyi Xu

entry.summary: Develops a convergent reformulation of Adam optimizer using variable/operator splitting with curvature-aware gradient correction. Establishes convergence guarantees including accelerated rates in the convex smooth setting.

entry.title: Toward Hardware-Agnostic Quadrupedal World Models via Morphology Conditioning

author.name: Mohamad H. Danesh, Chenhao Li, Amin Abyaneh, Anas Houssaini, Kirsty Ellis, Glen Berseth, Marco Hutter, Hsiu-Chin Lin

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for training a generalizable Quadrupedal World Model (QWM) that disentangles environmental dynamics from robot morphology via morphology conditioning, enabling transfer across different quadruped robots.

entry.title: PSIRNet: Deep Learning-based Free-breathing Rapid Acquisition Late Enhancement Imaging

author.name: Arda Atalik, Hui Xue, Rhodri H. Davies, Thomas A. Treibel, Daniel K. Sodickson, Michael S. Hansen, Peter Kellman

entry.summary: Develops PSIRNet, an 845M parameter physics-guided deep learning network for free-breathing cardiac MRI that produces diagnostic quality from a single two-heartbeat acquisition, eliminating need for 8-24 motion-corrected averages. Trained on 800K+ slices from 55K+ patients.

entry.title: MedConceal: A Benchmark for Clinical Hidden-Concern Reasoning Under Partial Observability

author.name: Yikun Han, Joey Chan, Jingyuan Chen, Mengting Ai, Simo Du, Yue Guo

entry.summary: Presents MedConceal, a benchmark with interactive patient simulator for evaluating hidden-concern reasoning in medical dialogue. Contains 300 curated cases and 600 clinical dialogues testing LLMs' ability to elicit concealed patient concerns.

entry.title: Adaptive Candidate Point Thompson Sampling for High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization

author.name: Donney Fan, Geoff Pleiss

entry.summary: Introduces Adaptive Candidate Thompson Sampling (ACTS) for high-dimensional Bayesian optimization that adaptively reduces the search space during sampling using gradient guidance, addressing the curse of dimensionality for candidate points.

entry.title: GeoMMBench and GeoMMAgent: Toward Expert-Level Multimodal Intelligence in Geoscience and Remote Sensing

author.name: Aoran Xiao, Shihao Cheng, Yonghao Xu, Yexian Ren, Hongruixuan Chen, Naoto Yokoya

entry.summary: Introduces GeoMMBench, a comprehensive multimodal benchmark for geoscience and remote sensing evaluating 36 LLMs, plus GeoMMAgent integrating tool use and dynamic retrieval for expert-level geospatial interpretation.

entry.title: M-IDoL: Information Decomposition for Modality-Specific and Diverse Representation Learning in Medical Foundation Model

author.name: Yihang Liu and Ying Wen and Jiaxiong Yang and Longzhen Yang and Lianghua He and Heng Tao Shen

entry.summary: Proposes M-IDoL, a medical foundation model using information decomposition to learn modality-specific representations via Mixture-of-Experts subspaces, maximizing inter-modality entropy while minimizing intra-modality uncertainty.

entry.title: Litmus (Re)Agent: A Benchmark and Agentic System for Predictive Evaluation of Multilingual Models

author.name: Avni Mittal, Shanu Kumar, Sandipan Dandapat and Monojit Choudhury

entry.summary: Introduces Litmus (Re)Agent for predictive multilingual evaluation - estimating model performance on missing language-task combinations through a DAG-orchestrated agentic system with feature-aware evidence aggregation.

entry.title: Testing the Assumptions of Active Learning for Translation Tasks with Few Samples

author.name: Lorenzo Jaime Yu Flores, Cesare Spinoso di-Piano, Ori Ernst, David Ifeoluwa Adelani, Jackie Chi Kit Cheung

entry.summary: Tests core assumptions of active learning for translation tasks with few samples, finding that neither informativeness nor diversity of training data correlate with test set performance. Suggests fundamental limitations of AL strategies in low-sample regimes.

entry.title: PinpointQA: A Dataset and Benchmark for Small Object-Centric Spatial Understanding in Indoor Videos

author.name: Zhiyu Zhou, Peilin Liu, Ruoxuan Zhang, Luyang Zhang, Cheng Zhang, Hongxia Xie, Wen-Huang Cheng

entry.summary: PinpointQA is the first benchmark for small object-centric spatial understanding in indoor videos, with 10K QA pairs across four progressively challenging tasks from presence verification to precise localization.

entry.title: StreamMeCo: Long-Term Agent Memory Compression for Efficient Streaming Video Understanding

author.name: Junxi Wang, Te Sun, Jiayi Zhu, Junxian Li, Haowen Xu, Zichen Wen, Xuming Hu, Zhiyu Li, Linfeng Zhang

entry.summary: StreamMeCo compresses vision agent memory for streaming video understanding through graph-based sampling and pruning, reducing memory overhead while maintaining accuracy. Introduces time-decay retrieval to mitigate compression-induced performance loss.

entry.title: Hypergraph Neural Networks Accelerate MUS Enumeration

author.name: Hiroya Ijima, Koichiro Yawata

entry.summary: Proposes using hypergraph neural networks to accelerate MUS (Minimal Unsatisfiable Subsets) enumeration in constraint satisfaction problems. Uses RL-trained HGNN agents to minimize satisfiability checks in a domain-agnostic way.

entry.title: BlendFusion -- Scalable Synthetic Data Generation for Diffusion Model Training

author.name: Thejas Venkatesh, Suguna Varshini Velury

entry.summary: BlendFusion generates synthetic training data from 3D scenes using path tracing to avoid model collapse (MAD) that occurs when training on purely diffusion-generated images. Curates FineBLEND dataset with automatic captioning.

entry.title: Nested Radially Monotone Polar Occupancy Estimation: Clinically-Grounded Optic Disc and Cup Segmentation for Glaucoma Screening

author.name: Rimsa Goperma, Rojan Basnet, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: NPS-Net formulates optic disc/cup segmentation as nested radially monotone polar occupancy estimation, guaranteeing clinical validity (star-convexity and nesting) while achieving strong zero-shot generalization across 7 datasets.

entry.title: Off-the-shelf Vision Models Benefit Image Manipulation Localization

author.name: Zhengxuan Zhang, Keji Song, Junmin Hu, Ao Luo, Yuezun Li

entry.summary: ReVi adapter repurposes off-the-shelf general vision models for image manipulation localization, showing that semantic priors from generation and segmentation networks contain useful manipulation-detection signals.

entry.title: "Take Me Home, Wi-Fi Drone": A Drone-based Wireless System for Wilderness Search and Rescue

author.name: Weiying Hou, Luca Jiang-Tao Yu, Chenshu Wu

entry.summary: Wi2SAR uses drones with Wi-Fi hotspots that mimic known networks to trigger automatic reconnection of victims' mobile devices for wilderness search and rescue, enabling localization without existing infrastructure.

entry.title: MixFlow: Mixed Source Distributions Improve Rectified Flows

author.name: Nazir Nayal, Christopher Wewer, Jan Eric Lenssen

entry.summary: Proposes MixFlow, a training strategy for rectified flows that reduces generative path curvature by conditioning the source distribution on an arbitrary signal aligned with the data distribution. Achieves faster sampling through straighter generative paths.

entry.title: Mosaic: Multimodal Jailbreak against Closed-Source VLMs via Multi-View Ensemble Optimization

author.name: Yuqin Lan, Gen Li, Yuanze Hu, Weihao Shen, Zhaoxin Fan, Faguo Wu, Xiao Zhang, Laurence T. Yang, Zhiming Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes Mosaic, a multi-view ensemble optimization framework for multimodal jailbreak attacks against closed-source VLMs. Identifies and addresses 'surrogate dependency' gap between homogeneous and heterogeneous attack settings.

entry.title: SkillMOO: Multi-Objective Optimization of Agent Skills for Software Engineering

author.name: Jingzhi Gong, Ruizhen Gu, Zhiwei Fei, Yazhuo Cao, Lukas Twist, Alina Geiger, Shuo Han, Dominik Sobania, Federica Sarro, Jie M. Zhang

entry.summary: Presents SkillMOO, a multi-objective optimization framework that automatically evolves skill bundles for LLM-based coding agents using NSGA-II. Improves pass rate by up to 131% while reducing cost by 32% on software engineering tasks.

entry.title: Constraint-Aware Corrective Memory for Language-Based Drug Discovery Agents

author.name: Maochen Sun, Youzhi Zhang, Gaofeng Meng

entry.summary: Presents CACM, a language-based drug discovery framework with constraint-aware corrective memory that tracks protocol-level requirements (set size, diversity, binding quality) across an agent's multi-step planning process.

entry.title: Physics-guided surrogate learning enables zero-shot control of turbulent wings

author.name: Yuning Wang, Pol Suarez, Mathis Bode and Ricardo Vinuesa

entry.summary: Shows that RL policies trained in turbulent channel flows can transfer zero-shot to a realistic NACA4412 wing, achieving 28.7% skin-friction drag reduction by exploiting local structures of wall-bounded turbulence.

entry.title: Case-Grounded Evidence Verification: A Framework for Constructing Evidence-Sensitive Supervision

author.name: Soroosh Tayebi Arasteh, Mehdi Joodaki, Mahshad Lotfinia, Sven Nebelung, Daniel Truhn

entry.summary: Introduces case-grounded evidence verification, a framework where models must determine whether provided evidence supports a claim for a specific case. The key contribution is a supervision construction procedure generating support examples alongside semantically controlled non-support examples including counterfactuals.

entry.title: ANTIC: Adaptive Neural Temporal In-situ Compressor

author.name: Sandeep S. Cranganore, Andrei Bodnar, Gianluca Galleti, Fabian Paischer, Johannes Brandstetter

entry.summary: Introduces ANTIC, an in-situ neural compression pipeline for massive PDE simulation data. It combines adaptive temporal snapshot selection with spatial neural compression to handle petabyte-to-exabyte scale data from physics simulations like Navier-Stokes and magnetohydrodynamics.

entry.title: VerifAI: A Verifiable Open-Source Search Engine for Biomedical Question Answering

author.name: Milo\v{s} Ko\v{s}prdi\'c, Adela Ljaji\'c, Bojana Ba\v{s}aragin, Darija Medvecki, Lorenzo Cassano, Nikola Milo\v{s}evi\'c

entry.summary: Introduces VerifAI, an open-source biomedical QA system combining RAG with post-hoc claim verification that decomposes answers into atomic claims and validates against evidence using fine-tuned NLI. Outperforms GPT-4 on HealthVer hallucination detection.

entry.title: Adjoint Matching through the Lens of the Stochastic Maximum Principle in Optimal Control

author.name: Carles Domingo-Enrich, Jiequn Han

entry.summary: Rigorously derives Adjoint Matching from the Stochastic Maximum Principle for stochastic optimal control problems. Generalizes to control-dependent drift/diffusion and convex running costs, showing critical points satisfy HJB conditions.

entry.title: CSAttention: Centroid-Scoring Attention for Accelerating LLM Inference

author.name: Chuxu Song, Zhencan Peng, Jiuqi Wei, Chuanhui Yang

entry.summary: Proposes CSAttention, a training-free sparse attention method for LLM inference that front-loads computation into offline prefill and uses centroid-scoring for efficient online decoding. Optimized for reusable context scenarios.

entry.title: Act or Escalate? Evaluating Escalation Behavior in Automation with Language Models

author.name: Matthew DosSantos DiSorbo, Harang Ju

entry.summary: Models the act-or-escalate decision in LLM automation across five domains (forecasting, recommendation, moderation, lending, driving). Finds marked differences in implicit cost thresholds across model families with miscalibrated self-estimates.

entry.title: Evidential Transformation Network: Turning Pretrained Models into Evidential Models for Post-hoc Uncertainty Estimation

author.name: Yongchan Chun, Chanhee Park, Jeongho Yoon, Jaehyung Seo, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Proposes the Evidential Transformation Network (ETN), a lightweight post-hoc module that converts pretrained models into evidential models for uncertainty estimation. Operates in logit space with sample-dependent affine transformations.

entry.title: Creator Incentives in Recommender Systems: A Cooperative Game-Theoretic Approach for Stable and Fair Collaboration in Multi-Agent Bandits

author.name: Ramakrishnan Krishnamurthy, Arpit Agarwal, Lakshminarayanan Subramanian, Maximilian Nickel

entry.summary: Models content creator incentives in recommendation platforms as a cooperative game-theoretic multi-agent bandit problem. Proves that for homogeneous agents the game is convex with non-empty core containing the Shapley value, ensuring stability and fairness.

entry.title: Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference

author.name: Dengjia Zhang, Alexander Martin, William Jurayj, Kenton Murray, Benjamin Van Durme, Reno Kriz

entry.summary: Introduces Unified Multimodal Uncertain Inference (UMUI), a task requiring calibrated probability estimates across text, audio, and video modalities. Proposes CLUE method combining self-consistent teacher distillation for calibrated uncertainty estimation.

entry.title: Demystifying the Silence of Correctness Bugs in PyTorch Compiler

author.name: Meiziniu Li, Dongze Li, Jianmeng Liu, Shing-Chi Cheung

entry.summary: Systematically characterizes correctness bugs in PyTorch's torch.compile, which cause incorrect outputs without crashes/warnings. Provides the first empirical study of these silent bugs that threaten LLM application reliability.

entry.title: Artifacts as Memory Beyond the Agent Boundary

author.name: John D. Martin, Fraser Mince, Esra'a Saleh, Amy Pajak

entry.summary: Formalizes how environment artifacts can functionally serve as agent memory in RL, proving that certain observations reduce the information needed to represent history. Experiments show spatial paths reduce memory requirements for learning.

entry.title: State Space Models are Effective Sign Language Learners: Exploiting Phonological Compositionality for Vocabulary-Scale Recognition

author.name: Bryan Cheng, Austin Jin, Jasper Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PHONSSM, using state space models with phonological decomposition for sign language recognition at vocabulary scale (5,565 signs). Achieves 72.1% on WLASL2000, improving over skeleton-based methods by 18.4pp.

entry.title: MT-OSC: Path for LLMs that Get Lost in Multi-Turn Conversation

author.name: Jyotika Singh, Fang Tu, Miguel Ballesteros, Weiyi Sun, Sandip Ghoshal, Michelle Yuan, Yassine Benajiba, Sujith Ravi, Dan Roth

entry.summary: Introduces MT-OSC, a framework for condensing multi-turn chat history for LLMs using a Condenser Agent with few-shot inference and a lightweight Decider. Reduces token counts by up to 72% in 10-turn conversations while maintaining performance.

entry.title: HiFloat4 Format for Language Model Pre-training on Ascend NPUs

author.name: Mehran Taghian, Yunke Peng, Xing Huang, Yao Wang, Yaoyuan Wang, Wei Guo, Yuanyong Luo, Tianchi Hu, Junsong Wang, Xin Wang, Hu Liu, Yu Cheng, Ziwei Yu, Hongliang Li, Mehdi Rahimifar, Lei Yan, Xuefei Wang, Zhuang Ma, Lei Liu, Hui Yu, Anandharaju Durai Raju, Hoang Le, Hei Yi Mak, Tanzila Rahman, Shadan Golestan

entry.summary: Investigates Huawei's HiFloat4 FP4 format for LLM pre-training on Ascend NPUs, systematically comparing it with MXFP4 for large-scale training. Targets 4x compute throughput and memory efficiency improvements.

entry.title: HM-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models in Hyperspectral Remote Sensing

author.name: Xinyu Zhang, Zurong Mai, Qingmei Li, Zjin Liao, Yibin Wen, Yuhang Chen, Xiaoya Fan, Chan Tsz Ho, Bi Tianyuan, Haoyuan Liang, Ruifeng Su, Zihao Qian, Juepeng Zheng, Jianxi Huang, Yutong Lu, and Haohuan Fu

entry.summary: Introduces HM-Bench, the first benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on hyperspectral remote sensing imagery, with 19,337 QA pairs across 13 task categories and a dual-modal spectral encoding strategy.

entry.title: Ge$^\text{2}$mS-T: Multi-Dimensional Grouping for Ultra-High Energy Efficiency in Spiking Transformer

author.name: Zecheng Hao, Shenghao Xie, Kang Chen, Wenxuan Liu, Zhaofei Yu, Tiejun Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Ge²mS-T, a spiking vision transformer with grouped computation across temporal, spatial, and network dimensions, achieving ultra-high energy efficiency through a novel ExpG-IF neuron model enabling lossless ANN-SNN conversion.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Decision-Focused Learning via Value-Aware Sequential Communication

author.name: Benjamin Amoh, Geoffrey Parker, Wesley Marrero

entry.summary: Introduces SeqComm-DFL, unifying sequential communication with decision-focused learning for multi-agent coordination. Messages maximize receiver decision quality with Stackelberg conditioning and prosocial ordering.

entry.title: WOMBET: World Model-based Experience Transfer for Robust and Sample-efficient Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Mintae Kim, Koushil Sreenath

entry.summary: Proposes WOMBET, a framework that learns source-task world models and generates filtered offline data for target-task online fine-tuning with uncertainty-penalized planning and adaptive sampling.

entry.title: How Should Video LLMs Output Time? An Analysis of Efficient Temporal Grounding Paradigms

author.name: Shengji Jin, Yuanhao Zou, Victor Zhu, Zhengping Ji, Chen Chen

entry.summary: Presents controlled empirical study comparing three temporal grounding output paradigms for Video LLMs (text numeral, temporal token, continuous temporal) across compact VLMs, finding temporal token generation achieves best accuracy-efficiency tradeoff.

entry.title: PerMix-RLVR: Preserving Persona Expressivity under Verifiable-Reward Alignment

author.name: Jihwan Oh, Soowon Oh, Murad Aghazada, Minchan Jeong, Sungnyun Kim, Se-Young Yun

entry.summary: Addresses the trade-off between persona expressivity and task performance when applying RLVR to LLMs. Proposes PerMix-RLVR which preserves persona sensitivity during training-time alignment without inference-time prompt search.

entry.title: ASTRA: Adaptive Semantic Tree Reasoning Architecture for Complex Table Question Answering

author.name: Xiaoke Guo, Songze Li, Zhiqiang Liu, Zhaoyan Gong, Yuanxiang Liu, Huajun Chen, and Wen Zhang

entry.summary: ASTRA proposes adaptive semantic tree reasoning for complex table QA, reconstructing tables into logical semantic trees that model hierarchical dependencies. Combines tree construction with dual-phase reasoning for improved table understanding.

entry.title: Regime-Conditional Retrieval: Theory and a Transferable Router for Two-Hop QA

author.name: Andre Bacellar

entry.summary: Formalizes the two-regime structure of two-hop QA retrieval (Q-dominant vs B-dominant) with three theorems and proposes RegimeRouter, a lightweight binary router that selects retrieval strategies per query.

entry.title: Skill-Conditioned Visual Geolocation for Vision-Language

author.name: Chenjie Yang, Yutian Jiang and Chenyu Wu

entry.summary: GeoSkill is a training-free framework for visual geolocation using an evolving Skill-Graph of atomic geographic reasoning skills. Enables self-evolution of geolocation capabilities through feedback loops.

entry.title: Overhang Tower: Resource-Rational Adaptation in Sequential Physical Planning

author.name: Ruihong Shen, Shiqian Li, Yixin Zhu

entry.summary: Studies how humans adapt physical prediction mechanisms and planning strategies under resource constraints in a block-stacking task. Shows a dual transition from simulation to heuristics and from deliberative to myopic planning under pressure.

entry.title: Memory-Efficient Transfer Learning with Fading Side Networks via Masked Dual Path Distillation

author.name: Yutong Zhang, Jiaxin Chen, Honglin Chen, Kaiqi Zheng, Shengcai Liao, Hanwen Zhong, Weixin Li, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: MDPD enables memory-efficient transfer learning with fading side networks that are distilled away during inference, eliminating the inference overhead of typical side-network approaches.

entry.title: FIRE-CIR: Fine-grained Reasoning for Composed Fashion Image Retrieval

author.name: Fran\c{c}ois Gard\`eres, Camille-Sovanneary Gauthier, Jean Ponce, Shizhe Chen

entry.summary: FIRE-CIR introduces compositional reasoning to fashion composed image retrieval through question-driven visual reasoning that explicitly determines what to preserve and change rather than relying on embedding similarity.

entry.title: Interactive ASR: Towards Human-Like Interaction and Semantic Coherence Evaluation for Agentic Speech Recognition

author.name: Peng Wang (1), Yanqiao Zhu (1), Zixuan Jiang (1), Qinyuan Chen (2), Xingjian Zhao (2), Xipeng Qiu (2), Wupeng Wang (3), Zhifu Gao (3), Xiangang Li (3), Kai Yu (1), Xie Chen (1) ((1) X-LANCE Lab, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (2) School of Computer Science, Fudan University, (3) Tongyi Fun Team, Alibaba Group)

entry.summary: Proposes Interactive ASR with LLM-as-a-Judge for semantic-aware evaluation beyond WER, plus an LLM-driven interactive correction framework that mimics human communication patterns.

entry.title: MATCHA: Efficient Deployment of Deep Neural Networks on Multi-Accelerator Heterogeneous Edge SoCs

author.name: Enrico Russo, Mohamed Amine Hamdi, Alessandro Ottaviano, Francesco Conti, Angelo Garofalo, Daniele Jahier Pagliari, Maurizio Palesi, Luca Benini, Alessio Burrello

entry.summary: MATCHA is a DNN deployment framework for heterogeneous multi-accelerator SoCs that uses constraint programming for optimized memory allocation and scheduling, achieving up to 35% latency reduction.

entry.title: CT-1: Vision-Language-Camera Models Transfer Spatial Reasoning Knowledge to Camera-Controllable Video Generation

author.name: Haoyu Zhao, Zihao Zhang, Jiaxi Gu, Haoran Chen, Qingping Zheng, Pin Tang, Yeyin Jin, Yuang Zhang, Junqi Cheng, Zenghui Lu, Peng Shu, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes CT-1 (Camera Transformer 1), a Vision-Language-Camera model that transfers spatial reasoning to camera-controllable video generation. Uses Wavelet-based Regularization Loss for learning complex camera trajectory distributions.

entry.title: GRM: Utility-Aware Jailbreak Attacks on Audio LLMs via Gradient-Ratio Masking

author.name: Yunqiang Wang, Hengyuan Na, Di Wu, Miao Hu, Guocong Quan

entry.summary: Proposes Gradient-Ratio Masking (GRM) for jailbreak attacks on audio LLMs that balances attack success with utility preservation. Finds that concentrating perturbation on select frequency bands yields better attack-utility tradeoffs.

entry.title: The AI Codebase Maturity Model: From Assisted Coding to Self-Sustaining Systems

author.name: Andy Anderson

entry.summary: Presents the AI Codebase Maturity Model (ACMM), a 5-level framework for how codebases evolve from basic AI-assisted coding to self-sustaining systems, validated through a 4-month experience report maintaining a Kubernetes dashboard with Claude Code and Copilot.

entry.title: E3-TIR: Enhanced Experience Exploitation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning

author.name: Weiyang Guo, Zesheng Shi, Liye Zhao, Jiayuan Ma, Zeen Zhu, Junxian He, Min Zhang, Jing Li

entry.summary: Proposes E3-TIR, a training paradigm for tool-integrated reasoning that dynamically integrates expert prefixes, expert-guided exploration, and self-exploration to address inefficient exploration in Zero-RL and capability plateaus in SFT-then-RL.

entry.title: XFED: Non-Collusive Model Poisoning Attack Against Byzantine-Robust Federated Classifiers

author.name: Israt Jahan Mouri, Muhammad Ridowan, Muhammad Abdullah Adnan

entry.summary: Introduces XFED, a non-collusive model poisoning attack against Byzantine-robust federated learning where compromised clients share adversarial objectives but never communicate with each other, challenging assumptions of existing defenses.

entry.title: EgoTL: Egocentric Think-Aloud Chains for Long-Horizon Tasks

author.name: Lulin Liu, Dayou Li, Yiqing Liang, Sicong Jiang, Hitesh Vijay, Hezhen Hu, Xuhai Xu, Zirui Liu, Srinivas Shakkottai, Manling Li, and Zhiwen Fan

entry.summary: Introduces EgoTL, a think-aloud capture pipeline for egocentric data that addresses noisy VLM auto-labeling in long-horizon household tasks. It combines human verbal annotations with spatial grounding to provide more accurate training data for embodied AI.

entry.title: Tango: Taming Visual Signals for Efficient Video Large Language Models

author.name: Shukang Yin, Sirui Zhao, Hanchao Wang, Baozhi Jia, Xianquan Wang, Chaoyou Fu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Tango, a framework for efficient Video LLMs that improves token pruning through diversity-driven attention selection and improved similarity-based clustering. Identifies and addresses limitations in existing top-k selection and clustering approaches for video token reduction.

entry.title: 3D-VCD: Hallucination Mitigation in 3D-LLM Embodied Agents through Visual Contrastive Decoding

author.name: Makanjuola Ogunleye, Eman Abdelrahman and Ismini Lourentzou

entry.summary: Introduces 3D-VCD, the first inference-time visual contrastive decoding framework for mitigating hallucinations in 3D embodied agents. Constructs distorted 3D scene graphs to generate contrastive distributions that penalize hallucinated content.

entry.title: Yes, But Not Always. Generative AI Needs Nuanced Opt-in

author.name: Wiebke Hutiri, Morgan Scheuerman, Shruti Nagpal, Austin Hoag, Alice Xiang

entry.summary: Argues that binary opt-in/opt-out consent for generative AI training data is insufficient, proposing nuanced inference-time consent verification through an agent-based architecture that checks conditional consent granted by rights holders.

entry.title: DenseLoRA: Dense Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models

author.name: Lin Mu, Xiaoyu Wang, Li Ni, Yang Li, Zhize Wu, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces DenseLoRA, an improvement over LoRA for LLM fine-tuning that uses a single Encoder-Decoder to refine and compress hidden representations across adaptation layers instead of redundant low-rank matrix pairs. Claims superior parameter efficiency and performance.

entry.title: SparseCoop: Cooperative Perception with Kinematic-Grounded Queries

author.name: Jiahao Wang, Zhongwei Jiang, Wenchao Sun, Jiaru Zhong, Haibao Yu, Yuner Zhang, Chenyang Lu, Chuang Zhang, Lei He, Shaobing Xu, Jianqiang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SparseCoop, a fully sparse cooperative perception framework for autonomous driving 3D detection and tracking that discards intermediate BEV representations, using kinematic-grounded sparse queries for efficient multi-vehicle communication.

entry.title: Controllable Egocentric Video Generation via Occlusion-Aware Sparse 3D Hand Joints

author.name: Chenyangguang Zhang, Botao Ye, Boqi Chen, Alexandros Delitzas, Fangjinhua Wang, Marc Pollefeys, Xi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for controllable egocentric video generation using sparse 3D hand joints as embodiment-agnostic control signals. Handles severe egocentric occlusions and enables cross-embodiment generalization to robotic hands.

entry.title: EMA Is Not All You Need: Mapping the Boundary Between Structure and Content in Recurrent Context

author.name: Arth Singh

entry.summary: Uses EMA (exponential moving average) traces as controlled probes to map the boundary between temporal structure and token content in sequence models. Finds EMA captures structural information well (96% of supervised BiGRU) but destroys token identity, with 8x worse perplexity than GPT-2.

entry.title: Attention-Based Sampler for Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Yuyan Zhou, Kai Syun Hou, Weiyu Chen, James Kwok

entry.summary: Studies decoding order selection for diffusion language models from a log-likelihood maximization perspective. Proposes an attention-based sampler that accounts for global sequence structure rather than just token-level information.

entry.title: FluidFlow: a flow-matching generative model for fluid dynamics surrogates on unstructured meshes

author.name: David Ramos, Lucas Lacasa, Ferm\'in Guti\'errez, Eusebio Valero and Gonzalo Rubio

entry.summary: Introduces FluidFlow, a generative model based on conditional flow-matching for CFD surrogates that operates directly on unstructured meshes without mesh interpolation. Provides scalable surrogate models for fluid dynamics.

entry.title: From Dispersion to Attraction: Spectral Dynamics of Hallucination Across Whisper Model Scales

author.name: Ivan Viakhirev, Kirill Borodin, Grach Mkrtchian

entry.summary: Proposes the Spectral Sensitivity Theorem predicting phase transitions in deep ASR networks from dispersive to attractor regimes. Validates on Whisper models, finding intermediate models show structural disintegration while large models enter compression-seeking states.

entry.title: LEGO: Latent-space Exploration for Geometry-aware Optimization of Humanoid Kinematic Design

author.name: Jihwan Yoon, Taemoon Jeong, Jeongeun Park, Chanwoo Kim, Jaewoon Kwon, Yonghyeon Lee, Kyungjae Lee, and Sungjoon Choi

entry.summary: Proposes LEGO, a framework for optimizing humanoid robot kinematic design by learning a latent design space from existing mechanical designs using screw-theory representations and isometric manifold learning, then optimizing via motion retargeting.

entry.title: RAMP: Hybrid DRL for Online Learning of Numeric Action Models

author.name: Yarin Benyamin, Argaman Mordoch, Shahaf S. Shperberg, Roni Stern

entry.summary: Proposes RAMP, combining deep RL, action model learning, and automated planning for learning numeric planning action models online through environment interaction. Creates a positive feedback loop between RL exploration and model-based planning.

entry.title: Accelerating Transformer-Based Monocular SLAM via Geometric Utility Scoring

author.name: Xinmiao Xiong, Bangya Liu, Hao Wang, Dayou Li, Nuo Chen, Andrew Feng, Mingyu Ding, Suman Banerjee, Yang Zhou, and Zhiwen Fan

entry.summary: Proposes LeanGate, a lightweight feed-forward gating network that predicts geometric utility scores for frames before expensive geometric decoding in monocular SLAM. Bypasses over 90% of frames while maintaining mapping quality.

entry.title: LLMs Underperform Graph-Based Parsers on Supervised Relation Extraction for Complex Graphs

author.name: Paolo Gajo, Domenic Rosati, Hassan Sajjad, Alberto Barr\'on-Cede\~no

entry.summary: Shows that LLMs underperform much smaller graph-based parsers for relation extraction when sentence graphs are complex (many relations). The performance gap widens as graph complexity increases.

entry.title: InstrAct: Towards Action-Centric Understanding in Instructional Videos

author.name: Zhuoyi Yang, Jiapeng Yu, Reuben Tan, Boyang Li, and Huijuan Xu

entry.summary: Proposes InstrAction, a pretraining framework for action-centric video understanding that addresses static bias in video models. Uses action-centric hard negatives and an Action Perceiver module to disentangle actions from objects.

entry.title: Revisiting Anisotropy in Language Transformers: The Geometry of Learning Dynamics

author.name: Raphael Bernas, Fanny Jourdan, Antonin Poch\'e, C\'eline Hudelot

entry.summary: Revisits anisotropy in language Transformers from a geometric learning dynamics perspective. Derives arguments for how frequency-biased sampling affects curvature and why training amplifies tangent directions.

entry.title: R2G: A Multi-View Circuit Graph Benchmark Suite from RTL to GDSII

author.name: Zewei Zhou, Jiajun Zou, Jiajia Zhang, Ao Yang, Ruichao He, Haozheng Zhou, Ao Liu, Jiawei Liu, Leilei Jin, Shan Shen, Daying Sun

entry.summary: Presents R2G, a multi-view circuit graph benchmark suite spanning RTL-to-GDSII physical design stages with 30 open-source IP cores, standardized representations, and reproducible baselines for GNN-based EDA tasks.

entry.title: TAIHRI: Task-Aware 3D Human Keypoints Localization for Close-Range Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Ao Li, Yonggen Ling, Yiyang Lin, Yuji Wang, Yong Deng, Yansong Tang

entry.summary: Proposes TAIHRI, the first VLM tailored for close-range human-robot interaction perception, understanding motion commands and localizing task-relevant 3D keypoints in egocentric camera coordinates.

entry.title: Low-Data Supervised Adaptation Outperforms Prompting for Cloud Segmentation Under Domain Shift

author.name: Harshith Kethavath and Weiming Hu

entry.summary: Shows that low-data supervised adaptation consistently outperforms all 60 prompt variants for cloud segmentation with CLIPSeg, where even engineered prompts underperform the zero-shot baseline.

entry.title: Efficient Hierarchical Implicit Flow Q-learning for Offline Goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zhiqiang Dong, Teng Pang, Rongjian Xu, Guoqiang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes goal-conditioned mean flow policy for offline GCRL, introducing average velocity fields into hierarchical policy modeling to address limited expressiveness of Gaussian policies for long-horizon control.

entry.title: Quantisation Reshapes the Metacognitive Geometry of Language Models

author.name: Jon-Paul Cacioli

entry.summary: Shows that model quantization restructures rather than uniformly degrades metacognitive efficiency in LLMs, with domain-level M-ratio profiles becoming uncorrelated between quantized and full-precision formats. However, underlying discrimination (Type-2 AUROC) remains perfectly stable.

entry.title: ActFER: Agentic Facial Expression Recognition via Active Tool-Augmented Visual Reasoning

author.name: Shifeng Liu, Zhengye Zhang, Sirui Zhao, Xinglong Mao, Zhehan Kan, Zhixiang Wei, Shiwei Wu, Chaoyou Fu, Tong Xu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: ActFER reformulates facial expression recognition as active visual evidence acquisition followed by multimodal reasoning, dynamically invoking tools for face detection, alignment, and AU analysis rather than passive single-pass prediction.

entry.title: Noise-Aware In-Context Learning for Hallucination Mitigation in ALLMs

author.name: Qixuan Huang, Khalid Zaman, Masashi Unoki

entry.summary: Proposes Noise-Aware In-Context Learning for mitigating hallucinations in auditory large language models, using a noise prior library and retrieved examples as contextual priors without fine-tuning.

entry.title: CAD 100K: A Comprehensive Multi-Task Dataset for Car Related Visual Anomaly Detection

author.name: Jiahua Pang, Ying Li, Dongpu Cao, Jingcai Luo, Yanuo Zheng, Bao Yunfan, Yujie Lei, Rui Yuan, Yuxi Tian, Guojin Yuan, Hongchang Chen, Zhi Zheng, Yongchun Liu

entry.summary: CAD 100K is a large-scale benchmark for car-related multi-task visual anomaly detection spanning 7 vehicle domains and 3 tasks with over 100K images. First car-related anomaly dataset specialized for multi-task learning.

entry.title: Plasticity-Enhanced Multi-Agent Mixture of Experts for Dynamic Objective Adaptation in UAVs-Assisted Emergency Communication Networks

author.name: Wen Qiu, Zhiqiang He, Wei Zhao, and Hiroshi Masui

entry.summary: PE-MAMoE addresses plasticity loss in multi-agent RL for UAV emergency communications through a mixture-of-experts architecture with stochastic perturbations for maintaining adaptation capability under non-stationarity.

entry.title: Towards Lifelong Aerial Autonomy: Geometric Memory Management for Continual Visual Place Recognition in Dynamic Environments

author.name: Xingyu Shao, Zhiqiang Yan, Liangzheng Sun, Mengfan He, Chao Chen, Jinhui Zhang, Chunyu Li, Ziyang Meng

entry.summary: Proposes a heterogeneous memory framework for aerial visual place recognition that handles catastrophic forgetting across sequential drone missions. Uses a Learn-and-Dispose pipeline with static satellite anchors and dynamic experience replay.

entry.title: Temporal Patch Shuffle (TPS): Leveraging Patch-Level Shuffling to Boost Generalization and Robustness in Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Jafar Bakhshaliyev, Johannes Burchert, Niels Landwehr, Lars Schmidt-Thieme

entry.summary: Temporal Patch Shuffle is a simple data augmentation method for time series forecasting that shuffles overlapping temporal patches using variance-based ordering to increase diversity while preserving local temporal structure.

entry.title: SPASM: Stable Persona-driven Agent Simulation for Multi-turn Dialogue Generation

author.name: Han Luo, Guy Laban

entry.summary: Introduces SPASM, a modular framework for stable multi-turn dialogue generation that addresses persona drift, role confusion, and echoing in LLM-LLM conversations. Decomposes simulation into persona creation, dialogue generation, and stability monitoring.

entry.title: ScheMatiQ: From Research Question to Structured Data through Interactive Schema Discovery

author.name: Shahar Levy, Eliya Habba, Reshef Mintz, Barak Raveh, Renana Keydar, Gabriel Stanovsky

entry.summary: Introduces ScheMatiQ, a tool that uses LLMs to automatically convert natural-language research questions over document collections into structured annotation schemas and grounded databases. Includes a web interface for expert steering.

entry.title: EthicMind: A Risk-Aware Framework for Ethical-Emotional Alignment in Multi-Turn Dialogue

author.name: Jiawen Deng, Wei Li, Wentao Zhang, Ziyun Jiao, Fuji Ren

entry.summary: Proposes EthicMind, a risk-aware framework for ethical-emotional alignment in multi-turn dialogue that jointly analyzes ethical risk and user emotion at each turn. Plans response strategies balancing empathy with ethical safety.

entry.title: Distributed Online Convex Optimization with Compressed Communication: Optimal Regret and Applications

author.name: Sifan Yang, Dan-Yue Li, Lijun Zhang

entry.summary: Establishes optimal regret bounds for distributed online convex optimization with compressed communication, proving matching lower and upper bounds that cleanly quantify the compression ratio's impact on regret.

entry.title: SAGE: A Service Agent Graph-guided Evaluation Benchmark

author.name: Ling Shi, Yuqin Dai, Ziyin Wang, Ning Gao, Wei Zhang, Chaozheng Wang, Yujie Wang, Wei He, Jinpeng Wang, Deiyi Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes SAGE, a multi-agent benchmark for evaluating LLM-based customer service agents using Dynamic Dialogue Graphs derived from SOPs. Includes adversarial intent taxonomy and extension mechanisms for diverse evaluation scenarios.

entry.title: GeRM: A Generative Rendering Model From Physically Realistic to Photorealistic

author.name: Jiayuan Lu, Rengan Xie, Xuancheng Jin, Zhizhen Wu, Qi Ye, Tian Xie, Hujun Bao, Rui Wang. Yuchi Huo

entry.summary: Presents GeRM, a generative rendering model that bridges the gap between Physically-Based Rendering and Photorealistic Rendering. Addresses the dilemma between explicit simulation requiring unreachable digital models and implicit generation sacrificing controllability.

entry.title: Iterative Identification Closure: Amplifying Causal Identifiability in Linear SEMs

author.name: Ziyi Ding and Xiao-Ping Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Iterative Identification Closure (IIC), a framework that decouples causal identification in linear SEMs into seed identification and reduced HTC propagation. Closes 15-23% of previously inconclusive causal effects.

entry.title: From Frames to Events: Rethinking Evaluation in Human-Centric Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Narges Rashvand, Shanle Yao, Armin Danesh Pazho, Babak Rahimi Ardabili, Hamed Tabkhi

entry.summary: Proposes shifting from frame-level to event-level evaluation for pose-based video anomaly detection, arguing that frame-level metrics systematically overestimate performance for real surveillance deployments that require actionable event alerts.

entry.title: Task-Aware LLM Routing with Multi-Level Task-Profile-Guided Data Synthesis for Cold-Start Scenarios

author.name: Hui Liu, Bin Zou, Kecheng Chen, Jie Liu, Wenya Wang, Haoliang Li

entry.summary: Proposes TRouter, a task-type-aware LLM routing system for cold-start scenarios, using multi-level task-profile-guided synthetic data generation to construct training data when in-domain examples are unavailable.

entry.title: Beyond Augmented-Action Surrogates for Multi-Expert Learning-to-Defer

author.name: Yannis Montreuil, Axel Carlier, Lai Xing Ng, Wei Tsang Ooi

entry.summary: Studies 'Learning-to-Defer with advice' where routing decisions also include what additional information experts receive. Shows natural separated surrogates are inconsistent and introduces an augmented surrogate with consistency guarantees.

entry.title: ECHO: Efficient Chest X-ray Report Generation with One-step Block Diffusion

author.name: Lifeng Chen, Tianqi You, Hao Liu, Zhimin Bao, Jile Jiao, Xiao Han, Zhicai Ou, Tao Sun, Xiaofeng Mou, Xiaojie Jin, Yi Xu

entry.summary: Proposes ECHO, an efficient diffusion-based VLM for chest X-ray report generation enabling single-step inference via Direct Conditional Distillation, addressing textual coherence issues from token-factorized denoisers through block-level diffusion.

entry.title: Online3R: Online Learning for Consistent Sequential Reconstruction Based on Geometry Foundation Model

author.name: Shunkai Zhou, Zike Yan, Fei Xue, Dong Wu, Yuchen Deng, Hongbin Zha

entry.summary: Presents Online3R, a sequential 3D reconstruction framework using learnable visual prompts injected into frozen geometry foundation models, with local-global self-supervised online learning for scene adaptation at test time.

entry.title: RIRF: Reasoning Image Restoration Framework

author.name: Wending Yan, Rongkai Zhang, Kaihua Tang, Yu Cheng, Qiankun Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Reason and Restore (R&R), integrating Chain-of-Thought reasoning into image restoration by using fine-tuned Qwen3-VL as an explicit reasoner to diagnose degradation types, severity, and scene semantics before restoration.

entry.title: Semantic Rate-Distortion for Bounded Multi-Agent Communication: Capacity-Derived Semantic Spaces and the Communication Cost of Alignment

author.name: Anthony T. Nixon

entry.summary: Shows that bounded agents with different computational capacities induce fundamentally different semantic alphabets (not just different compressions), with a sharp phase transition below a critical rate where intent-preserving communication becomes structurally impossible.

entry.title: High-dimensional Adaptive MCMC with Reduced Computational Complexity

author.name: Max Hird, Samuel Livingstone

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive MCMC method that learns a dense linear preconditioner with sparse parametrization, achieving O(m²d) per-iteration complexity compared to O(d²) for existing correlation-capturing methods. Uses online PCA on the MCMC chain to construct the preconditioner.

entry.title: EGLOCE: Training-Free Energy-Guided Latent Optimization for Concept Erasure

author.name: Junyeong Ahn, Seojin Yoon, Sungyong Baik

entry.summary: Proposes EGLOCE, a training-free concept erasure method for diffusion models that redirects noisy latents during inference using energy-guided sampling with dual objectives: repulsive energy for unwanted concepts and attractive energy for preserving related concepts.

entry.title: Many Ways to Be Fake: Benchmarking Fake News Detection Under Strategy-Driven AI Generation

author.name: Xinyu Wang, Sai Koneru, Wenbo Zhang, Wenliang Zheng, Saksham Ranjan, Sarah Rajtmajer

entry.summary: Introduces MANYFAKE, a benchmark of 6,798 fake news articles generated through multiple strategy-driven prompting pipelines capturing diverse fake news construction methods, including mixed-truth cases that are underrepresented in existing benchmarks.

entry.title: GNN-as-Judge: Unleashing the Power of LLMs for Graph Learning with GNN Feedback

author.name: Ruiyao Xu, Kaize Ding

entry.summary: Proposes GNN-as-Judge, a framework that uses GNN feedback to generate and select reliable pseudo labels for fine-tuning LLMs on text-attributed graphs in low-resource settings. Addresses label noise mitigation when using pseudo labels.

entry.title: Can We Still Hear the Accent? Investigating the Resilience of Native Language Signals in the LLM Era

author.name: Nabelanita Utami, Sasano Ryohei

entry.summary: Investigates whether LLM writing assistance is homogenizing academic writing by tracking native language identification (NLI) performance across pre-NN, pre-LLM, and post-LLM eras in ACL Anthology papers. Finds consistent NLI decline with interesting language-specific anomalies.

entry.title: QuanBench+: A Unified Multi-Framework Benchmark for LLM-Based Quantum Code Generation

author.name: Ali Slim, Haydar Hamieh, Jawad Kotaich, Yehya Ghosn, Mahdi Chehimi, Ammar Mohanna, Hasan Abed Al Kader Hammoud, Bernard Ghanem

entry.summary: Introduces QuanBench+, a unified benchmark spanning Qiskit, PennyLane, and Cirq with 42 aligned tasks for evaluating LLM quantum code generation. Reports Pass@1 up to 59.5% in Qiskit with feedback-based repair improving results.

entry.title: Distilling Genomic Models for Efficient mRNA Representation Learning via Embedding Matching

author.name: Rasched Haidari, Sam Martin, Maxime Allard

entry.summary: Presents a distillation framework for transferring mRNA representations from a large genomic foundation model to a 200x smaller model using embedding-level distillation. Achieves state-of-the-art among comparable-size models on mRNA-bench.

entry.title: Extrapolating Volition with Recursive Information Markets

author.name: Abhimanyu Pallavi Sudhir and Long Tran-Thanh

entry.summary: Analyzes LLM-buyer mechanisms for information markets through a value-of-information framework, where LLMs can inspect information and 'forget' it to overcome the buyer's inspection paradox. Studies recursive version and incentive compatibility.

entry.title: SkillForge: Forging Domain-Specific, Self-Evolving Agent Skills in Cloud Technical Support

author.name: Xingyan Liu, Xiyue Luo, Linyu Li, Ganghong Huang, Jianfeng Liu, Honglin Qiao

entry.summary: Introduces SkillForge, a self-evolving framework for LLM-powered agents in cloud technical support that closes an end-to-end creation-evaluation-refinement loop for domain-specific skills. Uses historical tickets and knowledge bases for grounding.

entry.title: VOLTA: The Surprising Ineffectiveness of Auxiliary Losses for Calibrated Deep Learning

author.name: Rahul D Ray, Utkarsh Srivastava

entry.summary: Benchmarks ten UQ methods against a simplified VOLTA variant using only a deep encoder, learnable prototypes, cross-entropy loss, and post-hoc temperature scaling. Finds the simplified approach competitive or superior across multiple distribution shifts.

entry.title: Geometry-Induced Long-Range Correlations in Recurrent Neural Network Quantum States

author.name: Asif Bin Ayub, Amine Mohamed Aboussalah, Mohamed Hibat-Allah

entry.summary: Introduces dilated RNN wave functions for neural quantum states that inject long-range inductive bias while retaining O(N log N) scaling. Shows analytically that dilation can induce power-law correlation scaling.

entry.title: Model Space Reasoning as Search in Feedback Space for Planning Domain Generation

author.name: James Oswald, Daniel Oblinsky, Volodymyr Varha, Vasilije Dragovic, Harsha Kokel, Kavitha Srinivas, Michael Katz, Shirin Sohrabi

entry.summary: Investigates using agentic LLM feedback frameworks with symbolic feedback (landmarks, VAL validator) for generating planning domains from natural language descriptions. Uses heuristic search over model space.

entry.title: Adaptive Simulation Experiment for LLM Policy Optimization

author.name: Mingjie Hu, Siyang Gao, Jian-qiang Hu, Enlu Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes treating LLMs as stochastic simulators for adaptive simulation experiments to identify optimal policies from finite candidates. Derives data requirements for policy identification in both structured and unstructured settings.

entry.title: Lessons Without Borders? Evaluating Cultural Alignment of LLMs Using Multilingual Story Moral Generation

author.name: Sophie Wu, Andrew Piper

entry.summary: Studies multilingual story moral generation as a culturally grounded evaluation task. Shows frontier LLMs like GPT-4o generate morals with less cross-linguistic variation than humans, concentrating on widely shared values.

entry.title: Structural Evaluation Metrics for SVG Generation via Leave-One-Out Analysis

author.name: Haonan Zhu, Adrienne Deganutti, Elad Hirsch, Purvanshi Mehta

entry.summary: Introduces leave-one-out analysis as structural evaluation metrics for SVG generation, assessing individual element contributions to visual quality rather than just overall similarity scores. Addresses a gap in evaluating the editability that makes SVGs valuable.

entry.title: DeFakeQ: Enabling Real-Time Deepfake Detection on Edge Devices via Adaptive Bidirectional Quantization

author.name: Xiangyu Li, Yujing Sun, Yuhang Zheng, Yuexin Ma, Kwok-Yan Lam

entry.summary: Proposes DeFakeQ, an adaptive bidirectional quantization method specifically designed for deepfake detection on edge devices, addressing the challenge that standard quantization degrades detection of subtle forgery artifacts.

entry.title: MV3DIS: Multi-View Mask Matching via 3D Guides for Zero-Shot 3D Instance Segmentation

author.name: Yibo Zhao, Yigong Zhang, and Jin Xie

entry.summary: Proposes MV3DIS for zero-shot 3D instance segmentation using multi-view 2D masks with explicit 3D geometric priors in a coarse-to-fine framework, addressing fragmented segmentation from independent frame processing.

entry.title: Enhancing LLM Problem Solving via Tutor-Student Multi-Agent Interaction

author.name: Nurullah Eymen \"Ozdemir and Erhan Oztop

entry.summary: Proposes PETITE, a tutor-student multi-agent system where two LLM instances with asymmetric roles collaborate on coding problems, with the tutor providing structured feedback without ground-truth access.

entry.title: A novel hybrid approach for positive-valued DAG learning

author.name: Yao Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes H-MRS algorithm for learning DAGs from positive-valued data using moment-based scoring with log-scale regression, targeting domains like gene expression and asset prices where multiplicative dynamics dominate.

entry.title: MAB-DQA: Addressing Query Aspect Importance in Document Question Answering with Multi-Armed Bandits

author.name: Yixin Xiang, Yunshan Ma, Xiaoyu Du, Yibing Chen, Yanxin Zhang, Jinhui Tang

entry.summary: Proposes MAB-DQA using multi-armed bandits to model varying importance of query aspects in document question answering, addressing the limitation of multimodal RAG systems that retain too few candidate pages.

entry.title: Online Quantile Regression for Nonparametric Additive Models

author.name: Haoran Zhan

entry.summary: Introduces projected functional gradient descent for online nonparametric additive quantile regression, achieving minimax optimal rates with O(J_t ln J_t) computational complexity per step without storing historical data.

entry.title: Domain-generalizable Face Anti-Spoofing with Patch-based Multi-tasking and Artifact Pattern Conversion

author.name: Seungjin Jung, Yonghyun Jeong, Minha Kim, Jimin Min, Youngjoon Yoo, Jongwon Choi

entry.summary: PCGAN disentangles spoof artifacts from facial features using a GAN to improve domain generalization in face anti-spoofing. Incorporates patch-based and multi-task learning to handle partial attacks.

entry.title: Social Reality Construction via Active Inference: Modeling the Dialectic of Conformity and Creativity

author.name: Kentaro Nomura, Takato Horii

entry.summary: Multi-agent simulation using active inference to model how social agents both internalize collective norms and reshape them through creative action. Demonstrates emergent social group formation and bidirectional norm-creativity dynamics.

entry.title: Frequency-Enhanced Diffusion Models: Curriculum-Guided Semantic Alignment for Zero-Shot Skeleton Action Recognition

author.name: Yuxi Zhou, Zhengbo Zhang, Jingyu Pan, Zhiyu Lin, Zhigang Tu

entry.summary: FDSM addresses spectral bias in diffusion models for zero-shot skeleton action recognition, integrating frequency-aware modules and curriculum-based semantic abstraction to recover fine-grained motion details.

entry.title: Beyond Isolated Clients: Integrating Graph-Based Embeddings into Event Sequence Models

author.name: Harry Proshian, Nikita Severin, Sergey Nikolenko, Kireev Ivan, Andrey Savchenko, Ivan Sergeev, Maria Postnova, Ilya Makarov

entry.summary: Proposes three strategies for integrating graph-based structural information into contrastive self-supervised learning for event sequence models, showing consistent improvements across financial and e-commerce datasets.

entry.title: Synthesizing real-world distributions from high-dimensional Gaussian Noise with Fully Connected Neural Network

author.name: Joanna Komorniczak

entry.summary: Proposes a fast synthetic tabular data generation method using a fully connected neural network with randomized loss function that transforms Gaussian noise to approximate target distributions, achieving reference MMD scores orders of magnitude faster.

entry.title: Few-Shot Contrastive Adaptation for Audio Abuse Detection in Low-Resource Indic Languages

author.name: Aditya Narayan Sankaran, Reza Farahbakhsh, Noel Crespi

entry.summary: Investigates CLAP for few-shot audio abuse detection in low-resource Indic languages, showing strong cross-lingual transfer from audio representations without relying on error-prone ASR transcription.

entry.title: Detecting Diffusion-generated Images via Dynamic Assembly ForestsDetecting Diffusion-generated Images via Dynamic Assembly Forests

author.name: Mengxin Fu, Yuezun Li

entry.summary: Dynamic Assembly Forest (DAF) uses a deep forest approach instead of DNNs to detect diffusion-generated images, achieving competitive performance with significantly fewer parameters and no GPU requirement.

entry.title: Prototype-Regularized Federated Learning for Cross-Domain Aspect Sentiment Triplet Extraction

author.name: Zongming Cai, Jianhang Tang, Zhenyong Zhang, Jinghui Qin, Kebing Jin and Hankz Hankui Zhuo

entry.summary: PCD-SpanProto uses prototype-regularized federated learning for cross-domain aspect sentiment triplet extraction, enabling distributed clients to exchange class-level prototypes instead of full model parameters.

entry.title: Persona-E$^2$: A Human-Grounded Dataset for Personality-Shaped Emotional Responses to Textual Events

author.name: Yuqin Yang, Haowu Zhou, Haoran Tu, Zhiwen Hui, Shiqi Yan, HaoYang Li, Dong She, Xianrong Yao, Yang Gao, Zhanpeng Jin

entry.summary: Introduces Persona-E², a large-scale dataset linking MBTI and Big Five personality traits to reader-based emotional variations across news, social media, and literary texts. Addresses the 'personality illusion' problem in role-playing LLMs.

entry.title: The Fast Lane Hypothesis: Von Economo Neurons Implement a Biological Speed-Accuracy Tradeoff

author.name: Esila Keskin

entry.summary: Proposes the Fast Lane Hypothesis: Von Economo neurons implement a biological speed-accuracy tradeoff via sparse, fast projection pathways for rapid social decisions. Introduces the first computational model of VEN function using leaky integrate-and-fire neurons.

entry.title: 2D or 3D: Who Governs Salience in VLA Models? -- Tri-Stage Token Pruning Framework with Modality Salience Awareness

author.name: Zihao Zheng, Sicheng Tian, Zhihao Mao, Lingyue Zhang, Chenyue Li, Ziyun Zhang, Hong Gao, Yuchen Huang, Yutong Xu, Guojie Luo, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: Develops a tri-stage analysis of 2D/3D modality salience in Vision-Language-Action models for embodied AI, proposing a modality-aware token pruning framework that accounts for different salience dynamics between 2D and 3D inputs.

entry.title: Through Their Eyes: Fixation-aligned Tuning for Personalized User Emulation

author.name: Lingfeng Huang, Huizhong Guo, Tianjun Wei, Yingpeng Du, Zhu Sun

entry.summary: Proposes FixATe, aligning a VLM's visual attention with user-specific gaze patterns from eye-tracking data to improve personalized user simulation for recommender system evaluation. Shows users have stable individual gaze patterns predictive of clicks.

entry.title: Efficient Unlearning through Maximizing Relearning Convergence Delay

author.name: Khoa Tran, Simon S. Woo

entry.summary: Introduces a new metric called 'relearning convergence delay' for machine unlearning evaluation that captures changes in both weight space and prediction space, plus an Influence Eliminating Unlearning framework based on this metric.

entry.title: SynFlow: Scaling Up LiDAR Scene Flow Estimation with Synthetic Data

author.name: Qingwen Zhang, Xiaomeng Zhu, Chenhan Jiang, Patric Jensfelt

entry.summary: Proposes SynFlow, a synthetic data generation pipeline for LiDAR scene flow estimation that prioritizes motion diversity over sensor realism. Training entirely on synthetic data with 4,000 sequences shows strong transfer to real-world benchmarks.

entry.title: Agentic Jackal: Live Execution and Semantic Value Grounding for Text-to-JQL

author.name: Vishnu Murali, Anmol Gulati, Elias Lumer, Kevin Frank, Sindy Campagna, Vamse Kumar Subbiah

entry.summary: Introduces Jackal, the first large-scale execution-based text-to-JQL benchmark with 100K validated pairs, and Agentic Jackal, a tool-augmented agent that uses live Jira instance access to resolve ambiguous field references and verify queries.

entry.title: You Can't Fight in Here! This is BBS!

author.name: Richard Futrell, Kyle Mahowald

entry.summary: A playful multi-character discussion between linguists and computational scientists debating whether LLMs can inform language science, identifying the 'String Statistics Strawman' and 'As Good As it Gets Assumption' as common misconceptions.

entry.title: VISOR: Agentic Visual Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Iterative Search and Over-horizon Reasoning

author.name: Yucheng Shen, Jiulong Wu, Jizhou Huang, Dawei Yin, Lingyong Yan, Min Cao

entry.summary: Proposes VISOR, an agentic visual RAG system addressing visual evidence sparsity and search drift in multi-step reasoning over visually rich documents, using iterative search with over-horizon reasoning.

entry.title: Toward World Models for Epidemiology

author.name: Zeeshan Memon, Yiqi Su, Christo Kurisummoottil Thomas, Walid Saad, Liang Zhao, Naren Ramakrishnan

entry.summary: Proposes a conceptual framework for epidemiological world models, formulating epidemics as controlled, partially observed dynamical systems where the true state is latent, observations are policy-dependent, and interventions propagate through human behavior.

entry.title: Event-Driven Temporal Graph Networks for Asynchronous Multi-Agent Cyber Defense in NetForge_RL

author.name: Igor Jankowski

entry.summary: Introduces NetForge_RL, a high-fidelity cyber operations simulator that models network defense as an asynchronous, continuous-time partially observable process. It addresses the sim-to-real gap in multi-agent reinforcement learning for cybersecurity by using event-driven temporal graph networks and zero-trust constraints.

entry.title: RELiQ: Scalable Entanglement Routing via Reinforcement Learning in Quantum Networks

author.name: Tobias Meuser, Jannis Weil, Aninda Lahiri, Marius Paraschiv

entry.summary: Proposes RELiQ, a reinforcement learning approach using graph neural networks for entanglement routing in quantum networks that relies only on local information and iterative message exchange, without requiring global topology knowledge.

entry.title: Dual Model Deep Learning for Alzheimer Prognostication

author.name: Alireza Moayedikia, Sara Fin and Uffe Kock Wiil

entry.summary: Develops PROGRESS, a dual-model deep learning framework that transforms a single baseline cerebrospinal fluid biomarker assessment into Alzheimer's prognostic estimates with calibrated uncertainty bounds, without requiring longitudinal observations.

entry.title: Silhouette Loss: Differentiable Global Structure Learning for Deep Representations

author.name: Matheus Vin\'icius Todescato and Joel Lu\'is Carbonera

entry.summary: Introduces Soft Silhouette Loss, a differentiable objective inspired by the silhouette coefficient that enforces intra-class compactness and inter-class separation without pairwise comparisons. Claims reduced computational cost compared to contrastive methods.

entry.title: On the Spectral Geometry of Cross-Modal Representations: A Functional Map Diagnostic for Multimodal Alignment

author.name: Krisanu Sarkar

entry.summary: Studies cross-modal alignment between DINOv2 and MiniLM using functional maps from computational geometry. Finds similar eigenvalue spectra (0.043 distance) but near-zero diagonal in functional maps, indicating semantic rather than structural misalignment.

entry.title: ViSAGE @ NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Video Saliency Prediction

author.name: Kun Wang, Yupeng Hu, Zhiran Li, Hao Liu, Qianlong Xiang, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: Presents ViSAGE, the champion solution for the NTIRE 2026 Video Saliency Prediction Challenge at CVPR 2026. Uses a multi-expert ensemble with adaptive gating to fuse complementary spatio-temporal saliency predictions.

entry.title: From Selection to Scheduling: Federated Geometry-Aware Correction Makes Exemplar Replay Work Better under Continual Dynamic Heterogeneity

author.name: Zhuang Qi and Ying-Peng Tang and Lei Meng and Guoqing Chao and Lei Wu and Han Yu and Xiangxu Meng

entry.summary: Proposes FEAT, a federated geometry-aware correction method for continual learning that addresses representation collapse from class imbalance across federated clients. Uses geometric structure alignment and scheduling to improve exemplar replay.

entry.title: RS-OVC: Open-Vocabulary Counting for Remote-Sensing Data

author.name: Tamir Shor, George Leifman, Genady Beryozkin

entry.summary: Proposes RS-OVC, the first open vocabulary counting model for remote sensing imagery, enabling counting of novel object classes unseen during training. Demonstrates accurate counting across diverse aerial imagery scenarios.

entry.title: Task-Aware Bimanual Affordance Prediction via VLM-Guided Semantic-Geometric Reasoning

author.name: Fabian Hahne, Vignesh Prasad, Georgia Chalvatzaki, Jan Peters, Alap Kshirsagar

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical framework for task-aware bimanual manipulation that jointly reasons about affordance localization and arm allocation using VLMs. Generalizes across object categories without category-specific training.

entry.title: HTNav: A Hybrid Navigation Framework with Tiered Structure for Urban Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Chengjie Fan, Cong Pan, Zijian Liu, Ningzhong Liu, Jie Qin

entry.summary: Proposes HTNav for aerial vision-and-language navigation combining imitation learning and RL in a staged training framework, with distance-aware reward shaping and VLM-enhanced reasoning for urban drone navigation.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Transformers: Conformal Prediction for Language Models

author.name: Abhiram Vellore, Niraj K. Jha

entry.summary: Applies conformal prediction to transformer language model embeddings (BERT, RoBERTa) for uncertainty quantification, providing calibrated prediction sets with coverage guarantees.

entry.title: Customized Fusion: A Closed-Loop Dynamic Network for Adaptive Multi-Task-Aware Infrared-Visible Image Fusion

author.name: Zengyi Yang, Yu Liu, Juan Cheng, Zhiqin Zhu, Yafei Zhang, Huafeng Li

entry.summary: Proposes CLDyN, a closed-loop dynamic network for infrared-visible image fusion that adaptively responds to semantic requirements of diverse downstream tasks through requirement-driven semantic compensation.

entry.title: MASS: Mesh-inellipse Aligned Deformable Surfel Splatting for Hand Reconstruction and Rendering from Egocentric Monocular Video

author.name: Haoyu Zhu and Yi Zhang and Lei Yao and Lap-pui Chau and Yi Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MASS for hand reconstruction from egocentric video using mesh-aligned deformable 2D Gaussian surfels, with Steiner Inellipse initialization and fractal densification for high-fidelity rendering.

entry.title: NTIRE 2026 The 3rd Restore Any Image Model (RAIM) Challenge: Multi-Exposure Image Fusion in Dynamic Scenes (Track 2)

author.name: Lishen Qu, Yao Liu, Jie Liang, Hui Zeng, Wen Dai, Guanyi Qin, Ya-nan Guan, Shihao Zhou, Jufeng Yang, Lei Zhang, Radu Timofte, Xiyuan Yuan, Wanjie Sun, Shihang Li, Bo Zhang, Bin Chen, Jiannan Lin, Yuxu Chen, Qinquan Gao, Tong Tong, Song Gao, Jiacong Tang, Tao Hu, Xiaowen Ma, Qingsen Yan, Sunhan Xu, Juan Wang, Xinyu Sun, Lei Qi, He Xu, Jiachen Tu, Guoyi Xu, Yaoxin Jiang, Jiajia Liu, Yaokun Shi

entry.summary: NTIRE 2026 challenge paper on multi-exposure image fusion in dynamic scenes for HDR imaging, with 114 participating teams and 987 submissions. Benchmarks real-world HDR fusion under motion, illumination variation, and camera jitter.

entry.title: Feature-Label Modal Alignment for Robust Partial Multi-Label Learning

author.name: Yu Chen, Weijun Lv, Yue Huang, Xiaozhao Fang, Jie Wen, Yong Xu, Guanbin Li

entry.summary: PML-MA treats features and labels as two modalities in partial multi-label learning, using low-rank orthogonal decomposition for pseudo-label generation and alignment to handle noisy labels.

entry.title: NyayaMind- A Framework for Transparent Legal Reasoning and Judgment Prediction in the Indian Legal System

author.name: Parjanya Aditya Shukla, Shubham Kumar Nigam, Debtanu Datta, Balaramamahanthi Deepak Patnaik, Noel Shallum, Pradeep Reddy Vanga, Saptarshi Ghosh, Arnab Bhattacharya

entry.summary: NyayaMind is an open-source framework for transparent legal reasoning and judgment prediction in the Indian judiciary, integrating retrieval, reasoning, and verification mechanisms.

entry.title: GeoPAS: Geometric Probing for Algorithm Selection in Continuous Black-Box Optimisation

author.name: Jiabao Brad Wang, Xiang Shi, Yiliang Yuan, Mustafa Misir

entry.summary: GeoPAS represents black-box optimization problem instances as multiple coarse 2D slices for algorithm selection, using a validity-aware CNN encoder with risk-aware solver selection.

entry.title: PS-TTS: Phonetic Synchronization in Text-to-Speech for Achieving Natural Automated Dubbing

author.name: Changi Hong, Yoonah Song, Hwayoung Park, Chaewoon Bang, Dayeon Gu, Do Hyun Lee, and Hong Kook Kim

entry.summary: PS-TTS achieves natural automated dubbing through isochrony (duration matching) and phonetic synchronization using DTW-based viseme alignment with paraphrased translated text.

entry.title: Long-SCOPE: Fully Sparse Long-Range Cooperative 3D Perception

author.name: Jiahao Wang, Zikun Xu, Yuner Zhang, Zhongwei Jiang, Chenyang Lu, Shuocheng Yang, Yuxuan Wang, Jiaru Zhong, Chuang Zhang, Shaobing Xu, Jianqiang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Long-SCOPE, a fully sparse framework for long-distance cooperative 3D perception in autonomous driving via V2X communication. Features Geometry-guided Query Generation and Context-Aware Association for robust detection at long range.

entry.title: A Predictive View on Streaming Hidden Markov Models

author.name: Gerardo Duran-Martin

entry.summary: Develops a predictive-first optimization framework for streaming hidden Markov models that prioritizes accurate step-ahead predictions over full posterior recovery. Formulates inference as a constrained projection problem in predictive-distribution space.

entry.title: A Benchmark of Dexterity for Anthropomorphic Robotic Hands

author.name: Davide Liconti, Yuning Zhou, Yasunori Toshimitsu, Ronan Hinchet and Robert K. Katzschmann

entry.summary: Introduces POMDAR, a comprehensive dexterity benchmark for anthropomorphic robotic hands derived from human motor control taxonomies. Implemented in both real-world and simulation with structured manipulation and grasping tasks.

entry.title: Structure-Aware Fine-Grained Gaussian Splatting for Expressive Avatar Reconstruction

author.name: Yuze Su, Hongsong Wang, Jie Gui, Liang Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Structure-aware Fine-grained Gaussian Splatting (SFGS) for expressive full-body avatar reconstruction from monocular video, capturing hand movements and facial expressions using spatial triplane and temporal hexplane representations.

entry.title: LLM-Rosetta: A Hub-and-Spoke Intermediate Representation for Cross-Provider LLM API Translation

author.name: Peng Ding

entry.summary: Presents LLM-Rosetta, an open-source hub-and-spoke translation framework for cross-provider LLM API compatibility, reducing O(N²) bilateral adapters to O(N) through a shared intermediate representation capturing the common semantic core of LLM APIs.

entry.title: Biologically-Grounded Multi-Encoder Architectures as Developability Oracles for Antibody Design

author.name: Simon J. Crouzet

entry.summary: Presents CrossAbSense, property-specific neural oracles combining frozen protein language model encoders with attention decoders for antibody developability prediction. Achieves 12-20% improvement over baselines on therapeutic IgG benchmarks.

entry.title: Musculoskeletal Motion Imitation for Learning Personalized Exoskeleton Control Policy in Impaired Gait

author.name: Itak Choi, Ilseung Park, Eni Halilaj, Inseung Kang

entry.summary: Introduces a framework combining musculoskeletal simulation with RL for personalized exoskeleton control that captures both healthy and pathological gait patterns without task-specific tuning.

entry.title: SCoRe: Clean Image Generation from Diffusion Models Trained on Noisy Images

author.name: Yuta Matsuzaki, Seiichi Uchida, Shumpei Takezaki

entry.summary: Proposes SCoRe (Spectral Cutoff Regeneration), a training-free method for generating clean images from diffusion models trained on noisy datasets by suppressing corrupted high-frequency components and regenerating them via SDEdit.

entry.title: UIPress: Bringing Optical Token Compression to UI-to-Code Generation

author.name: Dasen Dai, Shuoqi Li, Ronghao Chen, Huacan Wang, Biao Wu, Qizhen Lan

entry.summary: Proposes UIPress, a learned visual token compression module for UI-to-Code generation that reduces prefill latency while maintaining code generation quality, adapted from document OCR compression to UI screenshots.

entry.title: Across the Levels of Analysis: Explaining Predictive Processing in Humans Requires More Than Machine-Estimated Probabilities

author.name: Sathvik Nair and Colin Phillips

entry.summary: Critiques and extends claims about language models and psycholinguistics through Marr's levels of analysis, arguing that machine-estimated probabilities alone are insufficient for explaining predictive processing in human language comprehension.

entry.title: SafeMind: A Risk-Aware Differentiable Control Framework for Adaptive and Safe Quadruped Locomotion

author.name: Zukun Zhang, Kai Shu, Mingqiao Mo

entry.summary: Introduces SafeMind, a differentiable safety-control framework for quadruped robots that unifies probabilistic Control Barrier Functions with semantic context understanding and meta-adaptive risk calibration for end-to-end training.

entry.title: Seeing is Believing: Robust Vision-Guided Cross-Modal Prompt Learning under Label Noise

author.name: Zibin Geng, Xuefeng Jiang, Jia Li, Zheng Li, Tian Wen, Lvhua Wu, Sheng Sun, Yuwei Wang, Min Liu

entry.summary: Proposes VisPrompt, a vision-guided prompt learning framework robust to label noise. It uses cross-modal attention to inject visual semantics into prompt representations, anchoring learning to stable visual evidence rather than noisy labels.

entry.title: Automated Standardization of Legacy Biomedical Metadata Using an Ontology-Constrained LLM Agent

author.name: Josef Hardi, Martin J. O'Connor, Marcos Martinez-Romero, Jean G. Rosario, Stephen A. Fisher and Mark A. Musen

entry.summary: Presents an LLM-based system for standardizing legacy biomedical metadata that queries real-time terminology services rather than relying on static prompts. Achieves high-quality FAIR-compliant metadata standardization by combining LLM reasoning with authoritative vocabulary retrieval.

entry.title: WAND: Windowed Attention and Knowledge Distillation for Efficient Autoregressive Text-to-Speech Models

author.name: Hanna Lee, Tan Dat Nguyen, Jaehoon Kang, Kyuhong Shim

entry.summary: Proposes WAND, a framework that adapts pretrained autoregressive TTS models to use windowed attention with constant complexity, combining persistent global attention over conditioning tokens with local sliding-window attention and knowledge distillation.

entry.title: Temperature-Dependent Performance of Prompting Strategies in Extended Reasoning Large Language Models

author.name: Mousa Salah and Amgad Muneer

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates chain-of-thought and zero-shot prompting across temperature settings on Grok-4.1 with extended reasoning, using 39 IMO-level math problems. Finds counterintuitive results: zero-shot peaks at moderate temperatures while CoT works best at extremes.

entry.title: Ranked Activation Shift for Post-Hoc Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Gianluca Guglielmo, Marc Masana

entry.summary: Proposes Ranked Activation Shift, a hyperparameter-free post-hoc OOD detection method that replaces sorted activation magnitudes with a fixed in-distribution reference profile. Shows consistent performance across datasets and architectures.

entry.title: MolPaQ: Modular Quantum-Classical Patch Learning for Interpretable Molecular Generation

author.name: Syed Rameez Naqvi and Lu Peng

entry.summary: Introduces MolPaQ, a modular quantum-classical molecular generator that assembles molecules from quantum-generated patches. Achieves 100% RDKit validity, 99.75% novelty, and 0.905 diversity with adversarial fine-tuning.

entry.title: Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection via Dual-Branch Reconstruction and Autoregressive Flow-based Residual Density Estimation

author.name: Jun Liu, Ying Chen, Ziqian Lu, Qinyue Tong and Jun Tang

entry.summary: Proposes DBR-AF for multivariate time series anomaly detection, combining dual-branch reconstruction (separating cross-variable and intra-variable modeling) with autoregressive flow for residual density estimation to better distinguish hard-to-reconstruct samples from true anomalies.

entry.title: Sustained Impact of Agentic Personalisation in Marketing: A Longitudinal Case Study

author.name: Olivier Jeunen, Eleanor Hanna, Schaun Wheeler

entry.summary: Longitudinal 11-month case study of agentic marketing personalization comparing active human-curated vs. passive autonomous operation. Finds that agents maintained or improved performance even after human oversight was removed.

entry.title: An Algorithm for Fast Assembling Large-Scale Defect-Free Atom Arrays

author.name: Tao Zhang, Xiaodi Li, Hui Zhai, Linghui Chen

entry.summary: Presents an algorithm for fast assembly of large-scale defect-free atom arrays (~10^4 qubits) using a supervised learning-based path planner and smooth trajectory generation for optical tweezers.

entry.title: Wireless Communication Enhanced Value Decomposition for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Diyi Hu and Bhaskar Krishnamachari

entry.summary: Proposes CLOVER, a cooperative MARL framework where value decomposition is conditioned on the realized wireless communication graph, introducing relational inductive bias via GNN-based mixing with permutation-equivariant hypernetworks.

entry.title: Cards Against LLMs: Benchmarking Humor Alignment in Large Language Models

author.name: Yousra Fettach, Guillaume Bied, Hannu Toivonen, Tijl De Bie

entry.summary: Benchmarks five frontier LLMs playing Cards Against Humanity against human players. Models exceed random baseline but show modest alignment with human humor preferences, and agree with each other far more than with humans.

entry.title: Building Better Environments for Autonomous Cyber Defence

author.name: Chris Hicks, Elizabeth Bates, Shae McFadden, Isaac Symes Thompson, Myles Foley, Ed Chapman, Nickolas Espinosa Dice, Ankita Samaddar, Joshua Sylvester, Himanshu Neema, Nicholas Butts, Nate Foster, Ahmad Ridley, Zoe M, Paul Jones

entry.summary: Workshop report from November 2025 on building RL environments for autonomous cyber defence, aggregating practitioner knowledge from academia, industry, and government on environment design, common pitfalls, and best practices.

entry.title: BIAS: A Biologically Inspired Algorithm for Video Saliency Detection

author.name: Zhao-ji Zhang, Ya-tang Li

entry.summary: Presents BIAS, a biologically inspired video saliency model building on the Itti-Koch framework with retina-inspired motion detection, achieving millisecond latency and outperforming some deep learning models on DHF1K dataset.

entry.title: Harnessing Weak Pair Uncertainty for Text-based Person Search

author.name: Jintao Sun, Zhedong Zheng, Gangyi Ding

entry.summary: Introduces uncertainty-aware method for text-based person search that estimates image-text pair uncertainty to leverage weak positive pairs from different camera views, incorporating uncertainty into contrastive learning optimization.

entry.title: GRASP: Grounded CoT Reasoning with Dual-Stage Optimization for Multimodal Sarcasm Target Identification

author.name: Faxian Wan, Xiaocui Yang, Yifan Cao, Shi Feng, Daling Wang, Yifei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes GRASP for multimodal sarcasm target identification, integrating visual grounding with chain-of-thought reasoning. Curates MSTI-MAX dataset and uses dual-stage optimization combining RL and SFT.

entry.title: Degradation-Robust Fusion: An Efficient Degradation-Aware Diffusion Framework for Multimodal Image Fusion in Arbitrary Degradation Scenarios
