author.name: Yu Shi, Yu Liu, Zhong-Cheng Wu, Juan Cheng, Huafeng Li, Xun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a degradation-aware diffusion framework for multimodal image fusion that handles noise, blur, and low resolution simultaneously, combining efficiency of neural networks with generative priors of diffusion models.

entry.title: TaxPraBen: A Scalable Benchmark for Structured Evaluation of LLMs in Chinese Real-World Tax Practice

author.name: Gang Hu, Yating Chen, Haiyan Ding, Wang Gao, Jiajia Huang, Min Peng, Qianqian Xie, Kun Yu

entry.summary: Introduces TaxPraBen, the first benchmark for Chinese taxation practice, with 10 traditional NLP tasks and 3 real-world scenarios across 14 datasets, featuring structured evaluation paradigm.

entry.title: Fine-Grained Action Segmentation for Renorrhaphy in Robot-Assisted Partial Nephrectomy

author.name: Jiaheng Dai, Huanrong Liu, Tailai Zhou, Tongyu Jia, Qin Liu, Yutong Ban, Zeju Li, Yu Gao, Xin Ma, Qingbiao Li

entry.summary: Establishes the SIA-RAPN benchmark for fine-grained action segmentation during renorrhaphy in robot-assisted partial nephrectomy, comparing four temporal models on 50 clinical videos with 12 frame-level labels.

entry.title: Anchored Sliding Window: Toward Robust and Imperceptible Linguistic Steganography

author.name: Ruiyi Yan, Shiao Meng and Yugo Murawaki

entry.summary: Proposes the Anchored Sliding Window framework for linguistic steganography that improves both imperceptibility and robustness by anchoring prompt and bridge context within the generation window.

entry.title: Few-Shot Personalized Age Estimation

author.name: Jakub Paplh\'am, Vojt\v{e}ch Franc, Artem Moroz

entry.summary: OpenPAE introduces the first open benchmark for N-shot personalized age estimation, establishing baselines from arithmetic offset through Bayesian methods. Addresses identity-dependent aging rates.

entry.title: FaceLiVTv2: An Improved Hybrid Architecture for Efficient Mobile Face Recognition

author.name: Novendra Setyawan, Chi-Chia Sun, Mao-Hsiu Hsu, Wen-Kai Kuo, Jun-Wei Hsieh

entry.summary: FaceLiVTv2 improves hybrid CNN-Transformer face recognition for mobile devices with Lite MHLA, replacing multi-layer attention with lightweight linear projections for efficient global-local feature interaction.

entry.title: Structuring versus Problematizing: How LLM-based Agents Scaffold Learning in Diagnostic Reasoning

author.name: Fatma Bet\"ul G\"ure\c{s}, Tanya Nazaretsky, Seyed Parsa Neshaei, Tanja K\"aser

entry.summary: Introduces PharmaSim Switch, a scenario-based learning environment for pharmacy training enhanced with LLM-powered agents implementing two scaffolding approaches: structuring (guiding step-by-step) and problematizing (challenging assumptions). Studies how different approaches shape diagnostic reasoning.

entry.title: Camera Artist: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cinematic Language Storytelling Video Generation

author.name: Haobo Hu, Qi Mao, Yuanhang Li, and Libiao Jin

entry.summary: Proposes Camera Artist, a multi-agent framework modeling filmmaking workflows for narrative video generation with explicit cinematic language. Introduces a Cinematography Shot Agent for recursive storyboard generation and cinematic language injection.

entry.title: Training-free, Perceptually Consistent Low-Resolution Previews with High-Resolution Image for Efficient Workflows of Diffusion Models

author.name: Wongi Jeong, Hoigi Seo, Se Young Chun

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free method for generating low-resolution preview images that are perceptually consistent with their high-resolution counterparts in diffusion model workflows. Enables efficient candidate selection before committing to full-resolution generation.

entry.title: Hitem3D 2.0: Multi-View Guided Native 3D Texture Generation

author.name: Huiang He, Shengchu Zhao, Jianwen Huang, Jie Li, Jiaqi Wu, Hu Zhang, Pei Tang, Heliang Zheng, Yukun Li, Rongfei Jia

entry.summary: Proposes Hitem3D 2.0 for multi-view guided native 3D texture generation, combining 2D multi-view priors with native 3D texture representations. Addresses texture coverage, cross-view consistency, and geometry-texture alignment.

entry.title: Neural Distribution Prior for LiDAR Out-of-Distribution Detection

author.name: Zizhao Li, Zhengkang Xiang, Jiayang Ao, Feng Liu, Joseph West, Kourosh Khoshelham

entry.summary: Proposes Neural Distribution Prior (NDP) for LiDAR out-of-distribution detection that models distributional structure of network predictions and adaptively reweights OOD scores based on class imbalance in LiDAR data.

entry.title: Meta-Learned Basis Adaptation for Parametric Linear PDEs

author.name: Vikas Dwivedi, Monica Sigovan, Bruno Sixou

entry.summary: Proposes KAPI, a meta-learned physics-informed framework for solving parametric linear PDEs combining a kernel-adaptive predictor with a least-squares corrector. The meta-network learns how the approximation space should adapt across parametric families.

entry.title: SatQNet: Satellite-assisted Quantum Network Entanglement Routing Using Directed Line Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Tobias Meuser, Jannis Weil, Aninda Lahiri, Marius Paraschiv

entry.summary: Proposes SatQNet, a reinforcement learning approach using directed line graph neural networks for entanglement routing in satellite-assisted quantum networks. Addresses the challenge of dynamic quantum topology from satellite motion.

entry.title: Transferable FB-GNN-MBE Framework for Potential Energy Surfaces: Data-Adaptive Transfer Learning in Deep Learned Many-Body Expansion Theory

author.name: Siqi Chen, Zhiqiang Wang, Yili Shen, Xianqi Deng, Xi Cheng, Cheng-Wei Ju, Jun Yi, Guo Ling, Dieaa Alhmoud, Hui Guan, Zhou Lin

entry.summary: Develops FB-GNN-MBE integrating fragment-based graph neural networks into many-body expansion theory for predicting potential energy surfaces of large molecular systems. Includes transfer learning for data-adaptive training.

entry.title: Stability Enhanced Gaussian Process Variational Autoencoders

author.name: Carl R. Richardson, Jichen Zhang, Ethan King, J\'an Drgo\v{n}a

entry.summary: Proposes Stability Enhanced Gaussian Process VAE (SEGP-VAE) for learning low-dimensional linear time-invariant systems from high-dimensional video data. Uses a complete parametrization restricted to semi-contracting systems for stability guarantees.

entry.title: Robust 4D Visual Geometry Transformer with Uncertainty-Aware Priors

author.name: Ying Zang, Yidong Han, Chaotao Ding, Yuanqi Hu, Deyi Ji, Qi Zhu, Xuanfu Li, Jin Ma, Lingyun Sun, Tianrun Chen, Lanyun Zhu

entry.summary: Presents a framework for robust 4D dynamic scene reconstruction that extends 3D foundation models (like VGGT) by modeling uncertainty to disentangle dynamic and static components, using entropy-guided attention and local-consistency geometry purification.

entry.title: Is More Data Worth the Cost? Dataset Scaling Laws in a Tiny Attention-Only Decoder

author.name: G\"otz-Henrik Wiegand, Lorena Raichle, Rico St\"adeli, Tomas Hrycej, Bernhard Bermeitinger, Siegfried Handschuh

entry.summary: Studies dataset-size scaling laws in a tiny attention-only decoder, finding that ~30% of training data reaches ~90% of full-data accuracy, demonstrating clear diminishing returns consistent with scaling law behavior even at small scale.

entry.title: Offline Local Search for Online Stochastic Bandits

author.name: Gerdus Benad\`e, Rathish Das, Thomas Lavastida

entry.summary: Investigates local search methods for combinatorial multi-armed bandits, a class of algorithms widely used in practice but under-explored in online settings. Provides theoretical guarantees for deploying local search online.

entry.title: AdaCubic: An Adaptive Cubic Regularization Optimizer for Deep Learning

author.name: Ioannis Tsingalis, Constantine Kotropoulos, and Corentin Briat

entry.summary: Proposes AdaCubic, a cubic regularization optimizer for deep learning that adaptively adjusts the cubic term weight using an auxiliary optimization problem and Hutchinson's Hessian approximation.

entry.title: Sim-to-Real Transfer for Muscle-Actuated Robots via Generalized Actuator Networks

author.name: Jan Schneider, Mridul Mahajan, Le Chen, Simon Guist, Bernhard Sch\"olkopf, Ingmar Posner, Dieter B\"uchler

entry.summary: Proposes Generalized Actuator Networks (GeAN) for sim-to-real transfer of muscle-actuated robots, learning neural network models of complex actuation from joint position trajectories rather than torque sensors.

entry.title: Region-Constrained Group Relative Policy Optimization for Flow-Based Image Editing

author.name: Zhuohan Ouyang, Zhe Qian, Wenhuo Cui, Chaoqun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes RC-GRPO-Editing, a region-constrained GRPO framework for flow-based image editing that restricts exploration to target regions, reducing noisy credit assignment from global perturbations and improving instruction-guided editing quality.

entry.title: AsymLoc: Towards Asymmetric Feature Matching for Efficient Visual Localization

author.name: Mohammad Omama, Gabriele Berton, Eric Foxlin, Yelin Kim

entry.summary: Proposes AsymLoc, an asymmetric visual localization framework where a large teacher model processes database images offline while a lightweight student handles online queries, using a novel distillation framework for cross-model feature matching.

entry.title: C-SHAP for time series: An approach to high-level temporal explanations

author.name: Annemarie Jutte, Faizan Ahmed, Jeroen Linssen, Maurice van Keulen

entry.summary: Proposes C-SHAP for time series, extending concept-based SHAP explanations to capture high-level temporal patterns rather than just point-level attributions. Provides a general definition and example implementation for time series explainability.

entry.title: MultiFinRAG: An Optimized Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) Framework for Financial Question Answering

author.name: Chinmay Gondhalekar, Urjitkumar Patel, Fang-Chun Yeh

entry.summary: Introduces MultiFinRAG, a retrieval-augmented generation framework for financial QA over complex multi-modal documents (10-Ks, 10-Qs) that handles text, tables, and figures jointly. Uses batched multimodal extraction with a quantized open-source LLM for structured outputs.

entry.title: AVATAAR: Agentic Video Answering via Temporal Adaptive Alignment and Reasoning

author.name: Urjitkumar Patel, Fang-Chun Yeh, Chinmay Gondhalekar

entry.summary: Introduces AVATAAR, a modular framework for video question answering that combines global/local video context with a Pre-Retrieval Thinking Agent and Rethink Module for iterative retrieval refinement over long-form video content.

entry.title: SQuARE: Structured Query & Adaptive Retrieval Engine For Tabular Formats

author.name: Chinmay Gondhalekar, Urjitkumar Patel, Fang-Chun Yeh

entry.summary: Presents SQuARE, a hybrid retrieval framework for question answering over real spreadsheets that handles multirow headers, merged cells, and inconsistent schemas. Routes queries through either chunk retrieval or SQL based on structural complexity scoring.

entry.title: Biconvex Biclustering

author.name: Sam Rosen, Eric C. Chi, Jason Xu

entry.summary: Proposes biconvex biclustering that jointly learns informative features while discovering biclusters, with theoretical guarantees (finite-sample bounds) and efficient proximal alternating minimization. Improves over convex biclustering in high-dimensional settings.

entry.title: Unbiased Rectification for Sequential Recommender Systems Under Fake Orders

author.name: Qiyu Qin, Yichen Li, Haozhao Wang, Cheng Wang, Rui Zhang, Ruixuan Li

entry.summary: Proposes methods to rectify sequential recommender systems compromised by fake orders (click farming, substitutions, sequential perturbations) embedded within genuine user sequences, without full retraining.

entry.title: A Representation-Level Assessment of Bias Mitigation in Foundation Models

author.name: Svetoslav Nizhnichenkov, Rahul Nair, Elizabeth Daly, Brian Mac Namee

entry.summary: Investigates how bias mitigation reshapes embedding spaces in BERT and Llama2 by analyzing geometric shifts in gender-occupation associations. Finds consistent representational shifts across encoder and decoder models, positioning embedding analysis as a diagnostic tool.

entry.title: Structured Exploration and Exploitation of Label Functions for Automated Data Annotation

author.name: Phong Lam, Ha-Linh Nguyen, Thu-Trang Nguyen, Son Nguyen, and Hieu Dinh Vo

entry.summary: Introduces EXPONA, an automated framework for programmatic labeling that formulates label function generation as a structured exploration-exploitation process balancing diversity and reliability.

entry.title: QCFuse: Query-Centric Cache Fusion for Efficient RAG Inference

author.name: Jianxin Yan, Zeheng Qian, Wangze Ni, Zhitao Shen, Zhiping Wang, Haoyang Li, Jia Zhu, Lei Chen and Kui Ren

entry.summary: Introduces QCFuse, a KV cache fusion system for RAG that uses semantic summary anchors to enhance query representations and selectively recomputes query-related tokens based on attention analysis.

entry.title: Pretrain-then-Adapt: Uncertainty-Aware Test-Time Adaptation for Text-based Person Search

author.name: Jiahao Zhang and Shaofei Huang and Yaxiong Wang and Zhedong Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes a Pretrain-then-Adapt paradigm for text-based person search using uncertainty-aware offline test-time adaptation, eliminating need for target-domain supervision. Adapts using only unlabeled test data.

entry.title: From Business Events to Auditable Decisions: Ontology-Governed Graph Simulation for Enterprise AI

author.name: Hongyin Zhu, Jinming Liang, Mengjun Hou, Ruifan Tang, Xianbin Zhu, Jingyuan Yang, Yuanman Mao, Feng Wu

entry.summary: Presents LOM-action, an enterprise AI framework using event-driven ontology simulation where business events trigger graph mutations in isolated sandboxes, ensuring decisions are derived from scenario-valid simulation graphs with full audit trails.

entry.title: MARINER: A 3E-Driven Benchmark for Fine-Grained Perception and Complex Reasoning in Open-Water Environments

author.name: Xingming Liao, Ning Chen, Muying Shu, Yunpeng Yin, Peijian Zeng, Zhuowei Wang, Nankai Lin, Lianglun Cheng

entry.summary: Introduces MARINER, a benchmark for fine-grained perception and reasoning in open-water/maritime environments with 16,629 images across 63 vessel categories. Evaluations show even advanced MLLMs struggle with fine-grained maritime discrimination.

entry.title: On Semiotic-Grounded Interpretive Evaluation of Generative Art

author.name: Ruixiang Jiang, Changwen Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SemJudge for evaluating generative art through a Peircean computational semiotic framework, modeling Human-GenArt Interaction as cascaded semiosis. Addresses the gap that existing evaluators only assess surface-level image quality.

entry.title: High-dimensional inference for the $\gamma$-ray sky with differentiable programming

author.name: Siddharth Mishra-Sharma, Tracy R. Slatyer, Yitian Sun, Yuqing Wu

entry.summary: Applies differentiable probabilistic programming to high-dimensional gamma-ray astrophysics, specifically the Galactic Center gamma-ray Excess puzzle. Uses GPU-accelerated variational inference over a large model space of spatial morphologies.

entry.title: SIC3D: Style Image Conditioned Text-to-3D Gaussian Splatting Generation

author.name: Ming He, Zhixiang Chen, Steve Maddock

entry.summary: Presents SIC3D, a pipeline for style-conditioned text-to-3D generation using 3D Gaussian Splatting with a novel Variational Stylized Score Distillation loss for transferring style from reference images.

entry.title: Memory Wall is not gone: A Critical Outlook on Memory Architecture in Digital Neuromorphic Computing

author.name: Amirreza Yousefzadeh, Sameed Sohail, Ana Lucia Varbanescu

entry.summary: Critically examines digital neuromorphic processors' memory architectures, arguing that on-chip memory (SRAM, STT-MRAM) has become a new memory wall consuming significant area and energy, potentially limiting competitiveness.

entry.title: MeshOn: Intersection-Free Mesh-to-Mesh Composition

author.name: Hyunwoo Kim, Itai Lang, Hadar Averbuch-Elor, Silvia Sell\'an, and Rana Hanocka

entry.summary: Proposes MeshOn for intersection-free mesh-to-mesh composition using VLMs for initialization, geometric losses, and physics-inspired barrier losses to prevent intersections, with diffusion prior for final deformation.

entry.title: Alleviating Community Fear in Disasters via Multi-Agent Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yashodhan D. Hakke, Almuatazbellah M. Boker, Lamine Mili, Michael von Spakovsky, Hoda Eldardiry

entry.summary: Applies multi-agent actor-critic RL to model disaster response across power, communication, and emergency management systems, reducing community fear. Tested on Hurricane Harvey/Irma data showing 70% and 50% fear reduction respectively.

entry.title: CatalogStitch: Dimension-Aware and Occlusion-Preserving Object Compositing for Catalog Image Generation

author.name: Sanyam Jain, Pragya Kandari, Manit Singhal, He Zhang, Soo Ye Kim

entry.summary: Presents CatalogStitch, model-agnostic techniques for automated object compositing in catalog image generation, with dimension-aware mask computation and occlusion-aware restoration that eliminate manual intervention.

entry.title: MedFormer-UR: Uncertainty-Routed Transformer for Medical Image Classification

author.name: Mohammed Maaz Sibhai, Abedalrhman Alkhateeb, Saad B. Ahmed

entry.summary: Enhances MedFormer with prototype-based learning and uncertainty-guided routing using Dirichlet distributions for per-token evidential uncertainty in medical image classification.

entry.title: Simulation of Adaptive Running with Flexible Sports Prosthesis using Reinforcement Learning of Hybrid-link System

author.name: Yuta Shimane, Ko Yamamoto

entry.summary: Proposes RL-based simulation for adaptive running with prosthetic legs using a hybrid-link system that models flexible deformation of leaf-spring prostheses, enabling whole-body dynamics analysis for prosthesis design.

entry.title: Dynamic Class-Aware Active Learning for Unbiased Satellite Image Segmentation

author.name: Gadi Hemanth Kumar, Athira Nambiar, and Pankaj Bodani

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic class-aware active learning for satellite image segmentation that addresses class imbalance by adapting selection criteria based on per-class performance.

entry.title: Towards Linguistically-informed Representations for English as a Second or Foreign Language: Review, Construction and Application

author.name: Wenxi Li, Xihao Wang, Weiwei Sun

entry.summary: Surveys existing resources for English as a Second/Foreign Language (ESFL), proposes construction-based representations that model syntax-semantics interface for both ESFL and standard English. Treats ESFL as a distinct linguistic system.

entry.title: Text-Conditioned Multi-Expert Regression Framework for Fully Automated Multi-Abutment Design

author.name: Mianjie Zheng, Xinquan Yang, Xuefen Liu, Xuguang Li, Kun Tang, He Meng, Linlin Shen

entry.summary: TEMAD automates multi-abutment dental implant design using a text-conditioned multi-expert architecture that integrates implant site localization and parameter regression into a unified pipeline.

entry.title: {\sf TriDeliver}: Cooperative Air-Ground Instant Delivery with UAVs, Couriers, and Crowdsourced Ground Vehicles

author.name: Junhui Gao, Yan Pan, Qianru Wang, Wenzhe Hou, Yiqin Deng, Liangliang Jiang, and Yuguang Fang

entry.summary: TriDeliver proposes the first hierarchical cooperative framework integrating human couriers, UAVs, and crowdsourced ground vehicles for instant delivery using transfer learning.

entry.title: Geometry Reinforced Efficient Attention Tuning Equipped with Normals for Robust Stereo Matching

author.name: Jiahao Li, Xinhong Chen, Zhengmin Jiang, Cheng Huang, Yung-Hui Li, Jianping Wang

entry.summary: GREATEN proposes using surface normals as domain-invariant geometric cues for stereo matching to improve synthetic-to-real zero-shot generalization. The framework includes gated contextual-geometric fusion and attention tuning modules to handle challenging regions like textureless and specular surfaces.

entry.title: Efficient Spatial-Temporal Focal Adapter with SSM for Temporal Action Detection

author.name: Yicheng Qiu, Keiji Yanai

entry.summary: Proposes an Efficient Spatial-Temporal Focal Adapter using State Space Models (SSMs) for temporal action detection in videos. Addresses feature redundancy and degraded global dependency modeling in long video sequences.

entry.title: Globally Optimal Pose from Orthographic Silhouettes

author.name: Agniva Sengupta, Dilara Ku\c{s}, Jianning Li, Stefan Zachow

entry.summary: Solves pose estimation from orthographic silhouettes using the continuity of area-of-silhouette in rotation space. Proposes the first method achieving globally optimal pose from a single unoccluded silhouette of a known shape.

entry.title: On the Role of DAG topology in Energy-Aware Cloud Scheduling : A GNN-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach

author.name: Anas Hattay, Fred Ngole Mboula, Eric Gascard, and Zakaria Yahoun

entry.summary: Studies GNN-based deep reinforcement learning for energy-aware cloud scheduling of workflow DAGs. Identifies specific out-of-distribution conditions where GNN-based schedulers fail due to structural mismatches in message passing.

entry.title: DiffHLS: Differential Learning for High-Level Synthesis QoR Prediction with GNNs and LLM Code Embeddings

author.name: Zedong Peng, Zeju Li, Qiang Xu, Jieru Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes DiffHLS, a differential learning framework for predicting High-Level Synthesis quality-of-result by learning from kernel-design pairs. Combines GNN branches with code LLM embeddings to predict design-induced deltas.

entry.title: FashionStylist: An Expert Knowledge-enhanced Multimodal Dataset for Fashion Understanding

author.name: Kaidong Feng, Zhuoxuan Huang, Huizhong Guo, Yuting Jin, Xinyu Chen, Yue Liang, Yifei Gai, Li Zhou, Yunshan Ma, Zhu Sun

entry.summary: Introduces FashionStylist, an expert-annotated benchmark for holistic fashion understanding supporting outfit-to-item grounding, outfit completion, and outfit evaluation tasks. Provides professionally grounded annotations at item and outfit levels.

entry.title: Are Independently Estimated View Uncertainties Comparable? Unified Routing for Trusted Multi-View Classification

author.name: Yilin Zhang, Cai Xu, Haishun Chen, Ziyu Guan, Wei Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a unified routing mechanism for trusted multi-view classification that addresses the problem of independently estimated view uncertainties being incomparable due to branch-specific scale bias rather than true sample reliability.

entry.title: Bringing Clustering to MLL: Weakly-Supervised Clustering for Partial Multi-Label Learning

author.name: Yu Chen, Weijun Lv, Yue Huang, Xuhuan Zhu, Fang Li

entry.summary: Introduces WSC-PML, a weakly-supervised clustering approach for partial multi-label learning that bridges clustering and multi-label assignment through membership matrix decomposition, addressing the fundamental incompatibility between clustering memberships and multi-label assignments.

entry.title: Do We Really Need to Approach the Entire Pareto Front in Many-Objective Bayesian Optimisation?

author.name: Chao Jiang, Jingyu Huang, Miqing Li

entry.summary: Questions whether approaching the entire Pareto front is necessary in many-objective Bayesian optimization, arguing that since decision-makers ultimately select one solution, focused search strategies may be more sample-efficient.

entry.title: Automated Instruction Revision (AIR): A Structured Comparison of Task Adaptation Strategies for LLM

author.name: Solomiia Bilyk, Volodymyr Getmanskyi, Taras Firman

entry.summary: Studies Automated Instruction Revision (AIR) for adapting LLMs to downstream tasks, comparing it against prompt optimization, retrieval, and fine-tuning across diverse benchmarks. Finds no single adaptation method dominates across all settings.

entry.title: [Hot take] Problems with AI prose

author.name: sudo

entry.summary: Analyzes a NYT quiz comparing Claude Opus 4.5 prose with famous human writers, where readers were surprisingly close to 50/50. The author identifies specific failure modes in AI writing including homogenized rhythm, excessive 'showing,' and the loss of authorial voice.

entry.title: EpiAgent: An Agent-Centric System for Ancient Inscription Restoration

author.name: Shipeng Zhu, Ang Chen, Na Nie, Pengfei Fang, Min-Ling Zhang, Hui Xue

entry.summary: Proposes EpiAgent, an LLM-based agent system for ancient inscription restoration that follows an Observe-Conceive-Execute-Reevaluate paradigm, coordinating multimodal analysis, historical experience, and specialized restoration tools.

entry.title: NOMAD: Generating Embeddings for Massive Distributed Graphs

author.name: Aishwarya Sarkar, Sayan Ghosh, Nathan R. Tallent, Ali Jannesari

entry.summary: Presents NOMAD, a distributed-memory graph embedding framework using MPI for massive graphs with millions-to-billions of edges, implementing proximity-based models like LINE and Node2Vec across distributed systems.

entry.title: Adaptive Rigor in AI System Evaluation using Temperature-Controlled Verdict Aggregation via Generalized Power Mean

author.name: Aleksandr Meshkov

entry.summary: Proposes Temperature-Controlled Verdict Aggregation (TCVA), using generalized power-mean with a temperature parameter to control evaluation rigor from pessimistic (safety-critical) to lenient (conversational). Achieves correlation with human judgments comparable to state-of-the-art.

entry.title: STIndex: A Context-Aware Multi-Dimensional Spatiotemporal Information Extraction System

author.name: Wenxiao Zhang, Yu Liu, Qiang sun, Yihao Ding, Sirui Li, Yanbing Liu, Jin B. Hong, Wei Liu

entry.summary: Introduces STIndex, a system for structuring unstructured content into a spatiotemporal data warehouse using LLMs for context-aware extraction. Users define domain-specific dimensions while the system handles extraction and grounding.

entry.title: What Matters in Virtual Try-Off? Dual-UNet Diffusion Model For Garment Reconstruction

author.name: Loc-Phat Truong, Meysam Madadi, Sergio Escalera

entry.summary: Studies architectural design choices for Virtual Try-Off (reconstructing canonical garments from draped images) using Dual-UNet diffusion models. Ablates backbone, conditioning, and fusion strategies.

entry.title: Active Learning for Generalizable Detonation Performance Prediction of Energetic Materials

author.name: R. Seaton Ullberg, Megan C. Davis, Jeremy N. Schroeder, Andrew H. Salij, M. J. Cawkwell, Christopher J. Snyder, Wilton J. M. Kort-Kamp, Ivana Matanovic

entry.summary: Uses active learning combining DFT, thermochemical modeling, message-passing neural networks, and Bayesian optimization for high-throughput prediction of detonation performance of energetic materials.

entry.title: Accurate and Reliable Uncertainty Estimates for Deterministic Predictions Extensions to Under and Overpredictions

author.name: Rileigh Bandy, Enrico Camporeale, Andong Hu, Thomas Berger, Rebecca Morrison

entry.summary: Extends the ACCRUE framework for uncertainty quantification to handle asymmetric, non-Gaussian uncertainty distributions including under/overpredictions. Learns input-dependent uncertainty without restrictive distributional assumptions.

entry.title: Cross-Lingual Attention Distillation with Personality-Informed Generative Augmentation for Multilingual Personality Recognition

author.name: Jing Jie Tan, Ban-Hoe Kwan, Danny Wee-Kiat Ng, Yan-Chai Hum, Noriyuki Kawarazaki, Kosuke Takano

entry.summary: Proposes ADAM for multilingual personality recognition, using LLM-based translation augmentation with personality-informed generation and cross-lingual attention distillation across English, Japanese, Chinese, Malay, and French.

entry.title: Fast Model-guided Instance-wise Adaptation Framework for Real-world Pansharpening with Fidelity Constraints

author.name: Zhiqi Yang, Jin-Liang Xiao, Shan Yin, Liang-Jian Deng and Gemine Vivone

entry.summary: Proposes FMG-Pan, a fast model-guided instance-wise adaptation framework for real-world pansharpening that balances generalization with fusion quality while reducing computational overhead compared to zero-shot methods.

entry.title: Identification and Anonymization of Named Entities in Unstructured Information Sources for Use in Social Engineering Detection

author.name: Carlos Jimeno Miguel, Raul Orduna, Francesco Zola

entry.summary: Develops a GDPR-compliant system for collecting and anonymizing data from Telegram for cybercrime analysis, combining speech-to-text transcription with named entity recognition for anonymization.

entry.title: UniSemAlign: Text-Prototype Alignment with a Foundation Encoder for Semi-Supervised Histopathology Segmentation

author.name: Le-Van Thai, Tien Dat Nguyen, Hoai Nhan Pham, Lan Anh Dinh Thi, Duy-Dong Nguyen, and Ngoc Lam Quang Bui

entry.summary: Proposes UniSemAlign for semi-supervised histopathology segmentation using dual-modal semantic alignment with prototype-level and text-level branches built on a pathology-pretrained Transformer encoder.

entry.title: Natural Riemannian gradient for learning functional tensor networks

author.name: Nikolas Klug, Michael Ulbrich, Marius Willner, Andr\'e Uschmajew

entry.summary: Proposes a natural Riemannian gradient descent for learning functional tensor networks, applicable to arbitrary losses. The approach is basis-independent and handles both factorized and manifold-based tensor representations.

entry.title: Online Intention Prediction via Control-Informed Learning

author.name: Tianyu Zhou, Zihao Liang, Zehui Lu, Shaoshuai Mou

entry.summary: Proposes an online intention prediction framework for estimating goal states of autonomous systems using inverse optimal control/IRL with a shifting horizon strategy. Demonstrates adaptive prediction on a quadrotor drone.

entry.title: Compositional-Degradation UAV Image Restoration: Conditional Decoupled MoE Network and A Benchmark

author.name: Jinquan Yan, Zhicheng Zhao, Zhengzheng Tu, Chenglong Li, Jin Tang, and Bin Luo

entry.summary: Proposes DAME-Net for compositional UAV image restoration that decouples degradation perception from reconstruction using a Mixture-of-Experts approach. Handles multiple simultaneous degradations (rain, haze, noise).

entry.title: UHD Low-Light Image Enhancement via Real-Time Enhancement Methods with Clifford Information Fusion

author.name: Xiaohan Wang, Chen Wu, Dawei Zhao, Guangwei Gao, Dianjie Lu, Guijuan Zhang, Linwei Fan, Xu Lu, Shuai Wu, Hang Wei, and Zhuoran Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes a real-time UHD low-light image enhancement network using Clifford algebra-based geometric feature fusion in 2D Euclidean space, achieving millisecond-level inference on edge devices.

entry.title: Multimodal Anomaly Detection for Human-Robot Interaction

author.name: Guilherme Ribeiro, Iordanis Antypas, Leonardo Bizzaro, Jo\~ao Bimbo, Nuno Cruz Garcia

entry.summary: Proposes MADRI, a multimodal anomaly detection framework for human-robot interaction that transforms video into semantic feature vectors and augments with robot sensor data and scene graphs.

entry.title: Data-Efficient Non-Gaussian Semi-Nonparametric Density Estimation for Nonlinear Dynamical Systems

author.name: Aaron R. Liao, Kenshiro Oguri, Michele D. Carpenter

entry.summary: Presents a method for estimating non-Gaussian probability densities of states in nonlinear dynamical systems using seminonparametric (Gallant-Nychka) densities with Hermite polynomial bases. Introduces a convex relaxation for initial estimates and demonstrates data efficiency.

entry.title: LPC-SM: Local Predictive Coding and Sparse Memory for Long-Context Language Modeling

author.name: Keqin Xie

entry.summary: Proposes LPC-SM, a hybrid autoregressive architecture separating local attention, persistent memory, predictive correction, and run-time control within the same block, using Orthogonal Novelty Transport for memory writes. Evaluated at 158M parameters across three stages, showing ablation evidence for component contributions. An interesting alternative architecture but at very small scale.

entry.title: Exploring a Behavioral Model of "Positive Friction" in Human-AI Interaction

author.name: Zeya Chen, Ruth Schmidt

entry.summary: Explores 'positive friction' in human-AI interaction — the idea that deliberate delays and obstacles can be beneficial for reflection and preventing biased behaviors. Proposes a behavioral model framework for when friction helps versus hinders AI users and practitioners.

entry.title: FetalSleepNet: A Transfer Learning Framework with Spectral Equalisation Domain Adaptation for Fetal Sleep Stage Classification

author.name: Weitao Tang, Johann Vargas-Calixto, Nasim Katebi, Nhi Tran, Sharmony B. Kelly, Gari D. Clifford, Robert Galinsky, Faezeh Marzbanrad

entry.summary: Presents FetalSleepNet, the first deep learning approach for classifying fetal sleep states from ovine EEG. Uses transfer learning from adult human EEG with a spectral equalization domain adaptation strategy across 24 fetal sheep.

entry.title: A Method for Characterizing Disease Progression from Acute Kidney Injury to Chronic Kidney Disease

author.name: Yilu Fang, Jordan G. Nestor, Casey N. Ta, Jerard Z. Kneifati-Hayek, Chunhua Weng

entry.summary: Uses EHR data to dynamically track AKI patients' clinical evolution toward CKD using clustering of patient vectors, multi-state modeling, and survival analysis. Identifies 15 distinct post-AKI states among 20,699 patients.

entry.title: The Mask of Civility: Benchmarking Chinese Mock Politeness Comprehension in Large Language Models

author.name: Yitong Zhang, Yuhan Xiang, Mingxuan Liu

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates LLMs' ability to recognize mock politeness in Chinese across six models (including GPT-5.1 and DeepSeek) under four prompting conditions. Constructs a three-category dataset of politeness, impoliteness, and mock politeness.

entry.title: SynDocDis: A Metadata-Driven Framework for Generating Synthetic Physician Discussions Using Large Language Models

author.name: Beny Rubinstein and Sergio Matos

entry.summary: Presents SynDocDis, a framework for generating synthetic physician-to-physician clinical discussions using structured prompting and de-identified metadata. Evaluated by five practicing physicians for clinical accuracy.

entry.title: Uncertainty Estimation for the Open-Set Text Classification systems

author.name: Leonid Erlygin and Alexey Zaytsev

entry.summary: Adapts Holistic Uncertainty Estimation (HolUE) for open-set text classification, addressing both text uncertainty (ill-formulated queries) and gallery uncertainty (ambiguous data distribution) to predict recognition errors.

entry.title: Neural networks for Text-to-Speech evaluation

author.name: Ilya Trofimenko, David Kocharyan, Aleksandr Zaitsev, Pavel Repnikov, Mark Levin, Nikita Shevtsov

entry.summary: Proposes neural models for automated TTS evaluation: NeuralSBS (73.7% accuracy on SOMOS for relative comparisons) and WhisperBert (multimodal fusion approach), as alternatives to expensive human MOS and SBS evaluations.

entry.title: Memory-Guided Trust-Region Bayesian Optimization (MG-TuRBO) for High Dimensions

author.name: Abhilasha Saroj, Shaked Regev, Guanhao Xu, Jinghui Yuan, Roy Luo, and Ross Wang

entry.summary: Proposes Memory-Guided TuRBO (MG-TuRBO) for Bayesian optimization in high dimensions, applied to traffic simulation calibration with 14 and 84 decision variables. Compares against genetic algorithms and classical BO methods.

entry.title: Joint Interference Detection and Identification via Adversarial Multi-task Learning

author.name: H. Xu, B. He, S. Wang

entry.summary: Establishes a theoretically grounded multi-task learning framework for joint interference detection, modulation identification, and interference identification in wireless communications, deriving upper bounds connecting MTL performance to task similarity via Wasserstein distance.

entry.title: Practical Bayesian Inference for Speech SNNs: Uncertainty and Loss-Landscape Smoothing

author.name: Yesmine Abdennadher and Philip N. Garner

entry.summary: Explores Bayesian learning approaches for spiking neural networks in speech processing, using the IVON variational method. Shows Bayesian approach smooths the irregular predictive landscape caused by spike-based threshold generation.

entry.title: Retrieval Augmented Classification for Confidential Documents

author.name: Yeseul E. Chang, Rahul Kailasa, Simon Shim, Byunghoon Oh, Jaewoo Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Retrieval Augmented Classification (RAC) for classifying confidential documents, comparing it with supervised fine-tuning on the WikiLeaks corpus. RAC shows more stable performance on unbalanced data while matching fine-tuning on balanced data.

entry.title: Parameterized Complexity Of Representing Models Of MSO Formulas

author.name: Petr Ku\v{c}era and Petr Martinek

entry.summary: Extends Courcelle's theorem to show that models of MSO2 formulas with free variables can be represented with decision diagrams of parameterized linear size in treewidth and formula size.

entry.title: Adversarial Sensor Errors for Safe and Robust Wind Turbine Fleet Control

author.name: Julian Quick and Marcus Binder Nilsen and Andreas Bechmann and Tran Nguyen Le and Pierre-Elouan Mikael Rethore

entry.summary: Proposes an adversarial training framework for wind turbine fleet controllers, where an adversary agent learns to confound the controller through sensor errors. Finds an Arms Race co-training approach yields the best robust policies.

entry.title: Weak Adversarial Neural Pushforward Method for the Wigner Transport Equation

author.name: Andrew Qing He, Wei Cai, Sihong Shao

entry.summary: Extends the Weak Adversarial Neural Pushforward Method to the Wigner transport equation for quantum phase-space dynamics. Key insight reduces the nonlocal pseudo-differential operator to pointwise finite differences.

entry.title: CERBERUS: A Three-Headed Decoder for Vertical Cloud Profiles

author.name: Emily K. deJong, Nipun Gunawardena, Kevin Smalley, Hassan Beydoun, and Peter Caldwell

entry.summary: Introduces CERBERUS, a probabilistic framework for inferring vertical radar reflectivity profiles of clouds from geostationary satellite data using a three-headed encoder-decoder architecture with zero-inflated predictions.

entry.title: Tracing the Chain: Deep Learning for Stepping-Stone Intrusion Detection

author.name: Nate Mathews and Nicholas Hopper and Matthew Wright

entry.summary: Applies ESPRESSO, a deep learning flow correlation model with transformers and triplet metric learning, to stepping-stone intrusion detection. Develops synthetic data generation tool for realistic SSI traffic.

entry.title: Using Synthetic Data for Machine Learning-based Childhood Vaccination Prediction in Narok, Kenya

author.name: Jimmy Bach, Yang Li, Yaqi Liu, John Sankok, Rose Kimani, Carrie B. Dolan, Julius N. Odhiambo, Haipeng Chen

entry.summary: Uses synthetic data generation to predict childhood vaccination risk in Narok County, Kenya's Maasai population, addressing data scarcity and privacy concerns in low-resource settings.

entry.title: Deep Light Pollution Removal in Night Cityscape Photographs

author.name: Hao Wang, Xiaolin Wu, Xi Zhang, and Baoqing Sun

entry.summary: Introduces a physically-based degradation model for light pollution in nighttime photography that accounts for anisotropic spread and spatial diffusion of artificial lighting. Proposes methods to restore pristine night appearance by neutralizing radiative footprints.

entry.title: A fast and Generic Energy-Shifting Transformer for Hybrid Monte Carlo Radiotherapy Calculation

author.name: Chi-Hieu Pham, Didier Benoit, Vincent Bourbonne, Ulrike Schick and Julien Bert

entry.summary: Introduces Energy-Shifting, a deep learning framework for accelerated Monte Carlo dose calculation in radiotherapy that synthesizes LINAC dose distributions from monoenergetic inputs. Proposes TransUNetSE3D architecture combining Transformers with Squeeze-and-Excitation modules.

entry.title: Vision Transformers for Preoperative CT-Based Prediction of Histopathologic Chemotherapy Response Score in High-Grade Serous Ovarian Carcinoma

author.name: Francesca Fati, Felipe Coutinho, Marika Reinius, Marina Rosanu, Gabriel Funingana, Luigi De Vitis, Gabriella Schivardi, Hannah Clayton, Alice Traversa, Zeyu Gao, Guilherme Penteado, Shangqi Gao, Francesco Pastori, Ramona Woitek, Maria Cristina Ghioni, Giovanni Damiano Aletti, Mercedes Jimenez-Linan, Sarah Burge, Nicoletta Colombo, Evis Sala, Maria Francesca Spadea, Timothy L. Kline, James D. Brenton, Jaime Cardoso, Francesco Multinu, Elena De Momi, Mireia Crispin-Ortuzar, Ines P. Machado

entry.summary: Investigates Vision Transformers for predicting chemotherapy response scores in ovarian cancer from pre-treatment CT scans. Proposes a 2.5D multimodal deep learning framework combining imaging and clinical data.

entry.title: TinyNeRV: Compact Neural Video Representations via Capacity Scaling, Distillation, and Low-Precision Inference

author.name: Muhammad Hannan Akhtar, Ihab Amer and Tamer Shanableh

entry.summary: Systematically studies tiny NeRV architectures for efficient neural video representation deployment in constrained environments. Introduces lightweight configurations and evaluates capacity scaling, distillation, and low-precision inference.

entry.title: Statistical Properties of the King Wen Sequence: An Anti-Habituation Structure That Does Not Improve Neural Network Training

author.name: Augustin Chan

entry.summary: Performs rigorous statistical analysis of the ancient I-Ching King Wen sequence, finding significant properties resembling curriculum learning principles. Tests whether these properties benefit neural network training (they don't).

entry.title: The causal relation between off-street parking and electric vehicle adoption in Scotland

author.name: Bernardino D'Amico, Achille Fonzone, Emma Hart

entry.summary: Uses causal inference on Scottish household data to determine that private off-street parking is a genuine infrastructure constraint (not just socioeconomic proxy) for EV adoption, increasing ownership probability from 3% to a higher level.

entry.title: A 0.5-V Linear Neuromorphic Voltage-to-Spike Encoder Using a Bulk-Driven Transconductor

author.name: Meysam Akbari, Erika Covi, Kea-Tiong Tang

entry.summary: Introduces an ultralow-power voltage-to-spike encoder using a bulk-driven transconductor for neuromorphic computing, achieving <5.6% linearity deviation at 22-180nW power consumption in 0.18μm CMOS.

entry.title: Robust Adaptive Backstepping Impedance Control of Robots in Unknown Environments

author.name: Reza Nazmara, Alap Kshirsagar, Jan Peters, A. Pedro Aguiar

entry.summary: Presents Robust Adaptive Backstepping Impedance Control (RABIC) for robots in uncertain contact-rich environments. Uses Taylor series-based estimators for dynamics and adaptive bounds for external forces with finite-time stability guarantees.

entry.title: LuMon: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Development Suite with Novel Datasets for Lunar Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Ayta\c{c} Sekmen, Fatih Emre Gunes, Furkan Horoz, H\"useyin Umut I\c{s}{\i}k, Mehmet Alp Ozaydin, Onur Altay Topaloglu, \c{S}ahin Umutcan \"Ust\"unda\c{s}, Yurdasen Alp Yeni, Halil Ersin Soken, Erol Sahin, Ramazan Gokberk Cinbis, Sinan Kalkan

entry.summary: Presents LuMon, a benchmark for monocular depth estimation on lunar surfaces, featuring real Chang'e-3 mission data with stereo ground truth. Evaluates state-of-the-art MDE methods in zero-shot lunar settings, revealing severe domain gaps.

entry.title: Adaptor: Advancing Assistive Teleoperation with Few-Shot Learning and Cross-Operator Generalization

author.name: Yu Liu, Yihang Yin, Tianlv Huang, Fei Yan, Yuan Xu, Weinan Hong, Wei Han, Yue Cao, Xiangyu Chen, Zipei Fan, and Xuan Song

entry.summary: Presents Adaptor, a few-shot framework for cross-operator intent recognition in assistive teleoperation, using trajectory perturbation synthesis and vision-language model context to handle inter-operator variability.

entry.title: Realizing Immersive Volumetric Video: A Multimodal Framework for 6-DoF VR Engagement

author.name: Zhengxian Yang, Shengqi Wang, Shi Pan, Hongshuai Li, Haoxiang Wang, Lin Li, Guanjun Li, Zhengqi Wen, Borong Lin, Jianhua Tao and Tao Yu

entry.summary: Introduces Immersive Volumetric Videos (IVV), a new media format for 6-DoF VR with audiovisual feedback, along with ImViD, a multi-view multi-modal dataset built with synchronized video-audio capture.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Reinforcement Learning of Spatial Density Velocity Potentials for Map-Free Racing

author.name: Shathushan Sivashangaran, Apoorva Khairnar, Sepideh Gohari, Vihaan Dutta and Azim Eskandarian

entry.summary: Proposes physics-informed RL using spatial density velocity potentials for autonomous racing without prebuilt maps, combining behavioral cloning and deep RL strengths for end-to-end control at the limits of tire friction.

entry.title: You can’t trust violence

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: David Krueger addresses the topic of violence against AI companies in response to existential risk concerns, arguing that AI risk awareness should not be blamed for violent actions and that violence is counterproductive to AI safety goals.

entry.title: MobileMold: A Smartphone-Based Microscopy Dataset for Food Mold Detection

author.name: Dinh Nam Pham, Leonard Prokisch, Bennet Meyer, Jonas Thumbs

entry.summary: Introduces MobileMold, an open dataset of 4,941 smartphone microscopy images for food mold detection across 11 food types, 4 smartphones, and 3 microscopes. Establishes baselines with near-ceiling performance on mold detection.

entry.title: QoS-QoE Translation with Large Language Model

author.name: Yingjie Yu, Mingyuan Wu, Ahmadreza Eslaminia, Lingzhi Zhao, Kaizhuo Yan, Klara Nahrstedt

entry.summary: Proposes using LLMs for QoS-QoE translation in multimedia systems by creating a structured dataset of QoS-QoE relationships from literature. Shows LLMs can generalize these relationships across scenarios.

entry.title: RansomTrack: A Hybrid Behavioral Analysis Framework for Ransomware Detection

author.name: Busra Caliskan, Ibrahim Gulatas, H. Hakan Kilinc and A. Halim Zaim

entry.summary: Presents RansomTrack, a hybrid behavioral analysis framework combining static (Radare2) and dynamic (Frida) features for ransomware detection. Releases a dataset of 165 ransomware and benign families.

entry.title: eBandit: Kernel-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Video Streaming

author.name: Mahdi Alizadeh

entry.summary: Presents eBandit, an eBPF-based framework that relocates ABR algorithm selection into the Linux kernel using an epsilon-greedy multi-armed bandit, achieving 7.2% QoE improvement over the best static heuristic.

entry.title: Temporal Dropout Risk in Learning Analytics: A Harmonized Survival Benchmark Across Dynamic and Early-Window Representations

author.name: Rafael da Silva, Jeff Eicher, Gregory Longo

entry.summary: Introduces a survival-oriented benchmark for student dropout risk prediction using OULAD, comparing dynamic weekly and continuous-time approaches across tree-based, parametric, and neural survival models with four evaluation layers.

entry.title: MuTSE: A Human-in-the-Loop Multi-use Text Simplification Evaluator

author.name: Rares-Alexandru Roscan and Gabriel Petre1 and Adrian-Marius Dumitran and Angela-Liliana Dumitran

entry.summary: Introduces MuTSE, a human-in-the-loop tool for evaluating LLM text simplification across different prompting strategies and architectures, providing visual comparative analysis.

entry.title: Adding Another Dimension to Image-based Animal Detection

author.name: Vandita Shukla, Fabio Remondino and Benjamin Risse

entry.summary: Presents a pipeline using Skinned Multi-Animal Linear models to estimate 3D bounding boxes for animals from monocular images, projecting them into 2D space with camera pose refinement. Computes cuboid face visibility metrics.

entry.title: Soft Electroadhesive Feet for Micro Aerial Robots Perching on Smooth and Curved Surfaces

author.name: Chen Liu, Sonu Feroz, Ketao Zhang

entry.summary: Presents soft stretchable electroadhesive pads for micro aerial robot perching on smooth and curved surfaces. Demonstrates perching with a Crazyflie quadrotor achieving ~3N shear adhesion forces.

entry.title: AMO-ENE: Attention-based Multi-Omics Fusion Model for Outcome Prediction in Extra Nodal Extension and HPV-associated Oropharyngeal Cancer

author.name: Gautier H\'enique, William Le, Gabriel Dayan, Coralie Brodeur, Kristoff Nelson, Apostolos Christopoulos, Edith Filion, Phuc-Felix Nguyen-Tan, Laurent Letourneau-Guillon, Houda Bahig and Samuel Kadoury

entry.summary: Proposes AMO-ENE, a multi-omics fusion model combining CT imaging with clinical data for predicting extranodal extension and treatment outcomes in HPV-associated oropharyngeal cancer. Uses hierarchical 3D semi-supervised segmentation.

entry.title: Cluster-First Labelling: An Automated Pipeline for Segmentation and Morphological Clustering in Histology Whole Slide Images

author.name: Muhammad Haseeb Ahmad, Sharmila Rajendran, Damion Young, Jon Mason

entry.summary: Presents a cloud-native pipeline for automated histology whole slide image labeling using a cluster-first paradigm: segmentation via Cellpose-SAM, neural embeddings, UMAP dimensionality reduction, and DBSCAN clustering, reducing manual annotation effort.

entry.title: Three Modalities, Two Design Probes, One Prototype, and No Vision: Experience-Based Co-Design of a Multi-modal 3D Data Visualization Tool

author.name: Sanchita S. Kamath, Aziz N Zeidieh, Venkatesh Potluri, Sile O'Modhrain, Kenneth Perry, JooYoung Seo

entry.summary: Co-designs a multi-modal 3D data visualization tool with blind and low-vision researchers, using tactile, audio, and configurable aggregation modalities for accessible STEM data exploration.

entry.title: TME-PSR: Time-aware, Multi-interest, and Explanation Personalization for Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Qingzhuo Wang, Leilei Wen, Juntao Chen, Kunyu Peng, Ruiyang Qin, Zhihua Wei, Wen Shen

entry.summary: Proposes TME-PSR, a sequential recommendation model integrating time-aware personalization, multi-interest modeling, and personalized explanation alignment using lightweight Linear Recurrent Units and mutual information weighting.

entry.title: Incremental Semantics-Aided Meshing from LiDAR-Inertial Odometry and RGB Direct Label Transfer

author.name: Muhammad Affan, Ville Lehtola and George Vosselman

entry.summary: Proposes a modular incremental pipeline for semantics-aided mesh reconstruction from LiDAR-inertial scans using vision foundation models for labeling, incremental label fusion, and semantics-aware TSDF fusion.

entry.title: Embedding Non-Distortive Cancelable Face Template Generation

author.name: Dmytro Zakharov, Oleksandr Kuznetsov, Emanuele Frontoni, Natalia Kryvinska

entry.summary: Introduces an image distortion technique for cancelable biometric templates that makes facial images unrecognizable visually but preservable for embedding-based recognition. Tests on MNIST and LFW datasets to find maximum distortion preserving identity. Addresses privacy in biometric systems.

entry.title: Deep Spatio-Temporal Neural Network for Air Quality Reanalysis

author.name: Ammar Kheder, Benjamin Foreback, Lili Wang, Zhi-Song Liu and Michael Boy

entry.summary: Proposes AQ-Net, a spatiotemporal reanalysis model for air quality prediction combining LSTM, multi-head attention, cyclic encoding, and neural kNN for spatial interpolation at unobserved stations. Validated on 2013-2017 northern China data.

entry.title: Joint UAV-UGV Positioning and Trajectory Planning via Meta A3C for Reliable Emergency Communications

author.name: Ndagijimana Cyprien, Mehdi Sookhak, Hosein Zarini, Chandra N Sekharan, and Mohammed Atiquzzaman

entry.summary: Proposes a joint UAV-UGV positioning and trajectory planning framework using Meta A3C reinforcement learning for emergency communications, incorporating road graph constraints for UGV mobility.

entry.title: GAN-Enhanced Deep Reinforcement Learning for Semantic-Aware Resource Allocation in 6G Network Slicing

author.name: Daniel Benniah John

entry.summary: Proposes GAN-DDPG for semantic-aware resource allocation in 6G network slicing, integrating conditional GANs for traffic synthesis with continuous action DDPG and semantic-aware reward optimization.

entry.title: Fully Autonomous Z-Score-Based TinyML Anomaly Detection on Resource-Constrained MCUs Using Power Side-Channel Data

author.name: Abdulrahman Albaiz, Fathi Amsaad

entry.summary: Presents a fully autonomous TinyML anomaly detection system using Z-Score analysis on a microcontroller for power side-channel monitoring. Performs both training and inference on-device without cloud connectivity.

entry.title: EngageTriBoost: Predictive Modeling of User Engagement in Digital Mental Health Intervention Using Explainable Machine Learning

author.name: Ha Na Cho, Daniel Eisenberg, Cheryl King, Kai Zheng

entry.summary: Applies machine learning to predict user engagement in eBridge digital mental health intervention using EngageTriBoost ensemble model (84% accuracy) with SHAP analysis for interpretability among at-risk college students.

entry.title: Reservoir observer enhanced with residual calibration and attention mechanism

author.name: Yichen Liu, Wei Xiao, Tianguang Chu

entry.summary: Integrates residual calibration and attention mechanisms into reservoir observer design for inferring unmeasured variables in nonlinear dynamical systems. Demonstrates substantial improvement on chaotic systems.

entry.title: TiAb Review Plugin: A Browser-Based Tool for AI-Assisted Title and Abstract Screening

author.name: Yuki Kataoka, Masahiro Banno, Michihito Kyo, Shuri Nakao, Tomoo Sato, Shunsuke Taito, Tomohiro Takayama, Takahiro Tsuge, Yasushi Tsujimoto, Ryuhei So, and Toshi A. Furukawa

entry.summary: Develops TiAb Review Plugin, an open-source Chrome extension for AI-assisted systematic review screening using Google Sheets as database, supporting manual, LLM batch, and ML active learning screening modes.

entry.title: Detection of Hate and Threat in Digital Forensics: A Case-Driven Multimodal Approach

author.name: Ponkoj Chandra Shill

entry.summary: Proposes a case-driven multimodal framework for detecting hate and threat content in digital forensic investigations, handling embedded text, contextual text, and image-only evidence. The framework selectively applies different analysis modes based on evidence type.

entry.title: IKKA: Inversion Classification via Critical Anomalies for Robust Visual Servoing

author.name: Darya Pavlenko

entry.summary: Introduces IKKA, a topologically motivated weighting framework for robust visual servoing under distribution shift, treating outlier points as structurally informative. Runs on Raspberry Pi 4 CPU-only.

entry.title: Scrapyard AI

author.name: Marc B\"ohlen, Sai Krishna

entry.summary: Proposes the concept of an 'AI scrapyard' - repurposing obsolete but still powerful AI models for resource-constrained experimentation, demonstrated through Project Nudge-x which uses legacy models to analyze mining site impacts.

entry.title: A Mathematical Framework for Temporal Modeling and Counterfactual Policy Simulation of Student Dropout

author.name: Rafael da Silva, Jeff Eicher, Gregory Longo

entry.summary: Proposes a temporal modeling framework with counterfactual policy simulation for student dropout prediction using LMS engagement data, combining penalized logistic regression with scenario-indexed policy layers.

entry.title: The nextAI Solution to the NeurIPS 2023 LLM Efficiency Challenge

author.name: Gyuwon Park, DongIl Shin, SolGil Oh, SangGi Ryu, and Byung-Hak Kim

entry.summary: Describes a solution to the NeurIPS 2023 LLM Efficiency Challenge using QLoRA fine-tuning of LLaMa2-70B on a single A100 40GB GPU within 24 hours.

entry.title: Score-Driven Rating System for Sports

author.name: Vladim\'ir Hol\'y and Michal \v{C}ern\'y

entry.summary: Introduces a score-driven rating system that generalizes the Elo system by using the gradient of the log-likelihood as the updating mechanism, accommodating diverse game outcomes beyond win/loss. Theoretical properties including zero expected value and reversion to true skills are derived.

entry.title: Automated Batch Distillation Process Simulation for a Large Hybrid Dataset for Deep Anomaly Detection

author.name: Jennifer Werner, Justus Arweiler, Indra Jungjohann, Jochen Schmid, Fabian Jirasek, Hans Hasse, Michael Bortz

entry.summary: Creates a hybrid experimental-simulation dataset for anomaly detection in batch distillation processes using an automated Python-based process simulator. Evaluates deep learning anomaly detection on the combined dataset.

entry.title: Beyond Segmentation: Structurally Informed Facade Parsing from Imperfect Images

author.name: Maciej Janicki, Aleksander Plocharski, Przemyslaw Musialski

entry.summary: Augments YOLOv8 with a lightweight alignment loss for facade parsing that encourages grid-consistent bounding box arrangements, injecting geometric priors without altering inference. Shows improved structural regularity.

entry.title: VAGNet: Vision-based accident anticipation with global features

author.name: Vipooshan Vipulananthan, Charith D. Chitraranjan

entry.summary: Proposes VAGNet, a vision-based accident anticipation model using global features for real-time dashcam processing, avoiding per-object feature extraction for computational efficiency.

entry.title: Hierarchical Flow Decomposition for Turning Movement Prediction at Signalized Intersections

author.name: Md Atiqur Rahman Mallick, Kamrul Hasan, Pulock Das, Liang Hong, and S M Shazzad Rassel

entry.summary: Proposes HFD-TM, a hierarchical deep learning framework for predicting intersection turning movements by first forecasting corridor through-movements and then expanding to individual turning streams. Uses physics-informed loss for flow conservation. A domain-specific application of deep learning to traffic engineering.

entry.title: Stochastic-Dimension Frozen Sampled Neural Network for High-Dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii Equations on Unbounded Domains

author.name: Zhangyong Liang

entry.summary: Proposes SD-FSNN for solving high-dimensional Gross-Pitaevskii equations on unbounded domains, with dimension-independent computational cost via stochastic dimension sampling and random hidden weights.

entry.title: Variational Quantum Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Hydrological PDE-Constrained Learning with Inherent Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Prasad Nimantha Madusanka Ukwatta Hewage, Midhun Chakkravarthy, Ruvan Kumara Abeysekara

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid quantum-classical physics-informed neural network for hydrological PDE-constrained learning, using variational quantum circuits with Saint-Venant equations as physics constraints, leveraging quantum measurement stochasticity for uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Multi-task Just Recognizable Difference for Video Coding for Machines: Database, Model, and Coding Application

author.name: Junqi Liu, Yun Zhang, Xiaoxia Huang, Long Xu, Weisi Lin

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Task JRD for video coding for machines, creating a dataset of 27,264 JRD annotations supporting object detection, segmentation, and keypoint detection, with a model integrating generalized and specialized feature extraction.

entry.title: Deep Learning Models for Robust Facial Liveness Detection

author.name: Oleksandr Kuznetsov, Emanuele Frontoni, Luca Romeo, Riccardo Rosati, Andrea Maranesi, Alessandro Muscatello

entry.summary: Presents deep learning models for facial liveness detection that integrate texture analysis and other features to counter advanced spoofing attacks including deepfakes. Addresses gaps in current anti-spoofing methods.

entry.title: Sentiment Classification of Gaza War Headlines: A Comparative Analysis of Large Language Models and Arabic Fine-Tuned BERT Models

author.name: Amr Eleraqi, Hager H. Mustafa, and Abdul Hadi N. Ahmed

entry.summary: Comparative analysis of sentiment classification on 10,990 Arabic Gaza War news headlines across LLMs and Arabic BERT models. Uses information-theoretic metrics to quantify differences, treating sentiment as an interpretive act rather than seeking ground truth.

entry.title: One Interface, Many Robots: Unified Real-Time Low-Level Motion Planning for Collaborative Arms

author.name: Yue Feng, Weicheng Huang, and I-Ming Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a common interface for real-time low-level motion planning of collaborative robotic arms using polynomial interpolation and quadratic programming for smooth trajectory generation across heterogeneous platforms.

entry.title: Adaptive Dual Residual U-Net with Attention Gate and Multiscale Spatial Attention Mechanisms (ADRUwAMS)

author.name: Mohsen Yaghoubi Suraki

entry.summary: Proposes ADRUwAMS, combining adaptive dual residual U-Net with attention gates and multiscale spatial attention for brain glioma segmentation.

entry.title: DDSP-QbE++: Improving Speech Quality for Speech Anonymisation for Atypical Speech

author.name: Suhita Ghosh, Yamini Sinha, Sebastian Stober

entry.summary: Improves DDSP-based voice conversion for speech anonymization by incorporating voicing detection and bandwidth-limited excitation to reduce aliasing artifacts, particularly for atypical speech.

entry.title: Characterizing Lidar Range-Measurement Ambiguity due to Multiple Returns

author.name: Jason H. Rife and Yifan Li

entry.summary: Analyzes lidar measurement ambiguity from multiple returns along a single beam path, characterizing cases where probabilistic returns occur due to multiple scattering surfaces within the beam cone.

entry.title: Decentralized Opinion-Integrated Decision making at Unsignalized Intersections via Signed Networks

author.name: Bhaskar Varma, Ying Shuai Quan, Karl D. von Ellenrieder, Paolo Falcone

entry.summary: Proposes a decentralized decision-making framework for autonomous vehicles at unsignalized intersections using dual signed networks for intent exchange and cooperation without centralized coordination.

entry.title: Drift-Aware Online Dynamic Learning for Nonstationary Multivariate Time Series: Application to Sintering Quality Prediction

author.name: Yumeng Zhao, Shengxiang Yang and Xianpeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DA-MSDL, a framework for handling concept drift in nonstationary multivariate time series prediction for industrial sintering quality. Uses multi-scale spatiotemporal feature extraction with online adaptive mechanisms.

entry.title: Continuous Orthogonal Mode Decomposition: Haptic Signal Prediction in Tactile Internet

author.name: Mohammad Ali Vahedifar, Mojtaba Nazari, Qi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Mode-Domain Architecture for haptic signal prediction in Tactile Internet, using Continuous-Orthogonal Mode Decomposition to overcome mode overlapping issues in signal decomposition, achieving 98.6% prediction accuracy.

entry.title: DSVTLA: Deep Swin Vision Transformer-Based Transfer Learning Architecture for Multi-Type Cancer Histopathological Cancer Image Classification

author.name: Muazzem Hussain Khan and Tasdid Hasnain and Md. Jamil khan and Ruhul Amin and Md. Shamim Reza and Md. Al Mehedi Hasan and Md Ashad Alam

entry.summary: Proposes a Swin Vision Transformer-based transfer learning architecture combining hierarchical Swin Transformer with ResNet50 features for multi-cancer histopathological image classification across five cancer types.

entry.title: The Blast Radius Principle

author.name: Martin Sustrik

entry.summary: Uses Ukraine's infrastructure resilience under attack to argue for a 'Blast Radius Principle' - that decentralized systems are more resilient to catastrophic failures. Draws lessons for infrastructure design, including digital systems.

entry.title: The Ethics of AI-Assisted Creative Work

author.name: Roger E. Avedon

entry.summary: A philosophical essay on the ethics of AI-assisted creative work, focusing on what humans owe audiences when using AI tools. Develops a framework based on accountability rather than ontological claims about AI minds.

entry.title: A Semi-Automated Framework for 3D Reconstruction of Medieval Manuscript Miniatures

author.name: Riccardo Pallotto, Pierluigi Feliciati, Tiberio Uricchio

entry.summary: Presents a semi-automated pipeline for converting 2D medieval manuscript miniatures into 3D digital models, evaluating seven image-to-3D methods on 69 manuscript figures. Hi3DGen was found to best balance topological quality with surface detail.

entry.title: EfficientSign: An Attention-Enhanced Lightweight Architecture for Indian Sign Language Recognition

author.name: Rishabh Gupta, Shravya R. Nalla

entry.summary: Presents EfficientSign, a lightweight sign language recognition model using EfficientNet-B0 with attention modules, achieving 99.94% accuracy on Indian Sign Language with 62% fewer parameters than ResNet18.

entry.title: Smartwatch-Based Sitting Time Estimation in Real-World Office Settings

author.name: Olivia Zhang, Zhilin Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes using rotation vector sequences derived from Euler angles as a novel representation for estimating sitting time from smartwatch IMU signals in office settings. Tested on a 34-hour dataset.

entry.title: NCL-BU at SemEval-2026 Task 3: Fine-tuning XLM-RoBERTa for Multilingual Dimensional Sentiment Regression

author.name: Tong Wu, Nicolay Rusnachenko, Huizhi Liang

entry.summary: Describes a system for SemEval-2026 Task 3 using fine-tuned XLM-RoBERTa for multilingual dimensional aspect-based sentiment analysis, predicting valence-arousal scores.

entry.title: Benchmarking CNN- and Transformer-Based Models for Surgical Instrument Segmentation in Robotic-Assisted Surgery

author.name: Sara Ameli

entry.summary: Benchmarks five deep learning architectures (UNet variants, DeepLabV3, SegFormer) for surgical instrument segmentation in robotic surgery using the SAR-RARP50 dataset. Finds that DeepLabV3 achieves results comparable to SegFormer.

entry.title: On the Representational Limits of Quantum-Inspired 1024-D Document Embeddings: An Experimental Evaluation Framework

author.name: Dario Maio

entry.summary: Presents an experimental framework for constructing quantum-inspired 1024-dimensional document embeddings using overlapping windows, multi-scale aggregation, and circuit-inspired feature mappings.

entry.title: An Open-Source, Open Data Approach to Activity Classification from Triaxial Accelerometry in an Ambulatory Setting

author.name: Sepideh Nikookar, Edward Tian, Harrison Hoffman, Matthew Parks, J. Lucas McKay, Yashar Kiarashi, Tommy T. Thomas, Alex Hall, David W. Wright, and Gari D. Clifford

entry.summary: Develops an open-source, open-data pipeline for classifying physical activities from 50Hz triaxial accelerometer data, collecting data from 23 subjects performing five activities with associated ECG.

entry.title: Deep Learning-Based Tracking and Lineage Reconstruction of Ligament Breakup

author.name: Vrushank Ahire, Vivek Kurumanghat, Mudasir Ganaie, Lipika Kabiraj

entry.summary: Presents a deep learning framework for tracking ligament breakup in liquid sheet disintegration, using Faster R-CNN for detection and custom temporal modeling for fragmentation lineage reconstruction.

entry.title: LPLCv2: An Expanded Dataset for Fine-Grained License Plate Legibility Classification

author.name: Lucas Wojcik and Eduardo A. F. Machoski and Eduil Nascimento Jr. and Rayson Laroca and David Menotti

entry.summary: Expands a license plate legibility classification benchmark to 3x size with revised annotations and novel labels including vehicle attributes. Provides comprehensive annotation at LP, vehicle, and image levels.

entry.title: On not being scared of math

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.summary: Practical advice for junior ML researchers on not being intimidated by mathematical notation in papers. Explains that most ML math is either shorthand or precision-adding, and provides strategies for reading papers without getting stuck.

entry.title: Spectra of LSRDRs of the Okubo algebra

author.name: Joseph Van Name

entry.summary: Analyzes the spectral properties of the author's custom machine learning algorithm (LSRDRs) applied to the Okubo algebra, showing that eigenvalues tend to be algebraic numbers of low degree, suggesting mathematical regularity.

entry.title: AI Driven Soccer Analysis Using Computer Vision

author.name: Adrian Manchado, Tanner Cellio, Jonathan Keane, Yiyang Wang

entry.summary: Applies YOLO and Faster R-CNN for soccer player tracking with field keypoint detection for distance estimation. Standard application of existing CV models to sports analysis.

entry.title: On the Terminology and Geometric Aspects of Redundant Parallel Manipulators

author.name: Andreas Mueller

entry.summary: Proposes consistent terminology for redundant parallel kinematic machines, distinguishing kinematic and actuation redundancy. Introduces a configuration-space-based geometric model to clarify singularity avoidance through redundant actuation.

entry.title: Eggs, rooms, puzzles, and talking about AI

author.name: KatjaGrace

entry.summary: An essay using easter egg hiding and room allocation as examples of how engaging with fine-grained detail reveals complexity hidden by abstraction. Draws loose connections to how we discuss AI capabilities and risks.

entry.title: Searchable explorer of EA Forum & LessWrong posts with explicit cruxes or "change my mind" content

author.name: david reinstein

entry.summary: Presents a searchable database of ~39 EA Forum and LessWrong posts containing explicit cruxes, 'change my mind' statements, and research-blocking questions, tagged and filterable for The Unjournal's Pivotal Questions project.

entry.title: Your Mom is a Chimera

author.name: michaelwaves

entry.summary: Explains feto-maternal microchimerism - the bidirectional transfer of cells between mother and fetus during pregnancy, where cells differentiate into various tissue types and persist for decades. Discusses potential implications for immune function and disease.

entry.title: Talk English, Think Something Else

author.name: J Bostock

entry.summary: A philosophical blog post drawing an analogy between programming in one language while thinking in another, and having productive conversations about abstract topics. Argues people should be more aware of the gap between natural language and the structures they're trying to communicate.

entry.title: Counterintuitive Coin Toss. Part II

author.name: PaulTheHuman

entry.summary: A mathematical exploration of biased coin toss games, analyzing what happens when a player can slightly predict outcomes. Translated from Russian, it's part II of a series on counterintuitive probability results.

entry.title: TAPs or it didn't happen

author.name: Raemon

entry.summary: A personal blog post about Trigger Action Plans (TAPs) - the idea that insights need to be translated into concrete trigger-action patterns to actually change behavior. Advocates for making explicit plans when having conversations that generate insights.

entry.title: Morale

author.name: J Bostock

entry.summary: A blog post theorizing about morale as 'the belief that if you work hard, your conditions will improve,' arguing that standard rationalist life-optimization can accidentally lower morale by removing the connection between effort and reward.

entry.title: An Ode to Humility and Curiosity in the New Machine Era

author.name: Nathan Heath

entry.summary: A personal reflection on entering the AI alignment community, advocating for humility and curiosity as essential virtues in the AI era. Discusses the tension between excitement about AI capabilities and concern about risks.

entry.title: Book Review: Existential Kink

author.name: Dentosal

entry.summary: A book review of 'Existential Kink' by Carolyn Elliott, written from a rationalist perspective. The reviewer is largely critical of the book's mystical framing but finds some psychological techniques potentially useful.

entry.title: How to make good tea

author.name: RobertM

entry.summary: A detailed guide to making good tea, covering equipment, brewing techniques, water temperature, and tea sourcing for western-style brewing.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 12, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Discourse is dominated by analysis of Claude Mythos Preview (GA: 2026-04-07). Ryan Greenblatt argues that if Anthropic's 4x productivity claim is literal, timelines should shorten radically. Empirical pushback shows small open-weight models (down to 3.6B active parameters) can reproduce much of Mythos's vulnerability-finding capability, questioning whether it represents a qualitative leap.

  • A novel Persona-Emotion-Behavior space framework unifies Constitutional AI, RLHF, and Deliberative Alignment using recent interpretability findings
  • Generation profiles succeed at detecting covert AI agent attacks where token-level statistics fail—a practical safety contribution
  • An apple-picking model for AI R&D formalizes diminishing returns as easy tasks are exhausted, tempering acceleration forecasts
  • Domain experts report that an AlphaFold moment for materials science remains distant due to lack of standardized structural representations

Governance-focused work addresses detecting distributed training to enforce an AI pause, while David Krueger explores whether a single rogue superintelligence could pose existential risk. Analysis of Dario Amodei's public statements suggests he may not endorse strong superintelligence claims.

entry.title: If Mythos actually made Anthropic employees 4x more productive, I would radically shorten my timelines

author.name: ryan_greenblatt

entry.summary: Following ongoing Research analysis of Claude Mythos, Ryan Greenblatt analyzes Anthropic's claim that Mythos Preview yields 4x productivity for their employees. He argues that if this is literally true (4x serial labor acceleration), it would radically shorten AI timelines, but expresses skepticism that the claim should be interpreted this strongly.

entry.title: Small models also found the vulnerabilities that Mythos found

author.name: dominicq

entry.summary: As first argued in Social two days ago, Claims that small, cheap, open-weight models (including one with 3.6B active parameters) can reproduce much of the vulnerability analysis that Anthropic's Claude Mythos Preview showcased in its announcement, including its flagship FreeBSD exploit detection. Argues Mythos's cybersecurity results, while impressive, don't represent a qualitative leap.

entry.title: Quick Thoughts About Mythos

author.name: Against Moloch

entry.summary: Following yesterday's News on Mythos's cybersecurity implications, Analysis of Claude Mythos Preview's cybersecurity capabilities, arguing it represents a 'gradually then suddenly' moment where AI capability at vulnerability discovery and exploit creation has made a qualitative jump. Discusses implications for AI safety and the risk of future capability jumps in other domains.

entry.title: Constitutional AI vs. RLHF vs. Deliberative Alignment

author.name: laudiacay

entry.summary: A technical comparison of RLHF, Constitutional AI, and Deliberative Alignment, introducing a 'Persona-Emotion-Behavior space' framework from recent interpretability papers to analyze personality stability under each approach. The post examines why Constitutional AI produces more stable personalities and why Deliberative Alignment shows paranoid reasoning traces.

entry.title: Token Statistics Fail at AI Attack Detection But Generation Profiles Succeed

author.name: Yatharth Maheshwari

entry.summary: Presents a new approach to detecting covert AI agent attacks: while token-level statistics fail to distinguish normal from adversarial behavior, 'generation profiles' (patterns of how models generate text) succeed. Tested at the Apart Research AI Control Hackathon across multiple model scales.

entry.title: An apple picking model for AI R&D

author.name: Noosphere89

entry.summary: Analyzes AI R&D acceleration using an 'apple picking' model where easy tasks are completed first, arguing that AI agents may exhibit diminishing returns in research even as they become more capable. Discusses implications of agent time horizons from METR benchmarks for forecasting AI-driven research acceleration.

entry.title: The AlphaFold moment for materials is not any time soon

author.name: Connor Blake

entry.summary: Reports from an AI + materials science conference that an 'AlphaFold moment' for materials science is unlikely in the near term, because materials lack the nice properties of proteins (composition doesn't determine structure, manufacturing matters enormously, etc.).

entry.title: Dario probably doesn't believe in superintelligence

author.name: RobertM

entry.summary: Argues that Dario Amodei likely does not believe in superintelligence in the strong sense (that returns to intelligence past human level are large), citing a 2013 conversation transcript with Eliezer Yudkowsky and other evidence. Claims this undermines assumptions many have about Anthropic's motivations.

entry.title: Catching illicit distributed training operations during an AI pause

author.name: Robi Rahman

entry.summary: Analyzes a threat model for MIRI's proposed international AI development moratorium: adversaries could use distributed training across many small, registered-but-innocent-looking chip clusters to circumvent compute monitoring. Proposes detection methods including network traffic analysis and statistical monitoring.

entry.title: Could a single rogue AI destroy humanity?

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: Explores whether a single rogue superintelligent AI could destroy humanity, drawing on a 2025 scenario exercise in Washington D.C. Pushes back against the trend of focusing only on 'coordinated failures' and argues single-agent risk remains plausible given sufficient capability advantages.

entry.title: Proof Explained: Touchette-Lloyd Theorem

author.name: Alfred Harwood

entry.summary: A detailed walkthrough of the proof of the Touchette-Lloyd theorem, which concerns information-theoretic bounds on how well a system can track an environment given constraints on internal complexity. Includes worked examples.

entry.title: Pausing AI Is the Best Answer to Post-Alignment Problems

author.name: MichaelDickens

entry.summary: Argues that even if technical AI alignment is solved, numerous 'post-alignment' problems (misuse, S-risks, concentration of power, moral error, etc.) remain, and a global moratorium on superintelligence development is the best strategy to address them all simultaneously.

entry.title: Announcing ILIAD 2026

author.name: Eddie Jean
