entry.summary: Presents ResearchEVO, an end-to-end framework for automated scientific discovery that uses LLM-guided bi-dimensional co-evolution to search code implementations by fitness, then autonomously generates research papers explaining the findings.

entry.title: When Do We Need LLMs? A Diagnostic for Language-Driven Bandits

author.name: Uljad Berdica, Fernando Acero, Anton Ipsen, Parisa Zehtabi, Michael Cashmore, Manuela Veloso

entry.summary: Introduces LLMP-UCB, a bandit algorithm deriving uncertainty estimates from LLMs via repeated inference, but finds that lightweight numerical bandits on text embeddings match or exceed LLM performance for language-driven contextual bandits.

entry.title: MG$^2$-RAG: Multi-Granularity Graph for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Sijun Dai, Qiang Huang, Xiaoxing You, Jun Yu

entry.summary: Proposes MG²-RAG, a multi-granularity graph RAG framework that constructs hierarchical multimodal knowledge graphs combining textual parsing with entity-driven visual grounding, improving cross-modal reasoning in retrieval-augmented generation.

entry.title: Comparative Characterization of KV Cache Management Strategies for LLM Inference

author.name: Oteo Mamo, Olga Kogiou, Hyunjin Yi, Weikuan Yu

entry.summary: Provides comparative analysis of KV cache management strategies for LLM inference, benchmarking memory consumption and performance trade-offs across varying request sizes and context lengths.

entry.title: StarVLA: A Lego-like Codebase for Vision-Language-Action Model Developing

author.name: StarVLA Community

entry.summary: Presents StarVLA, an open-source modular codebase for Vision-Language-Action model research, supporting multiple VLM backbones and action heads with standardized evaluation protocols for embodied agent development.

entry.title: Edit, But Verify: An Empirical Audit of Instructed Code-Editing Benchmarks

author.name: Amir M. Ebrahimi, Gopi Krishnan Rajbahadur

entry.summary: Audits instructed code-editing benchmarks, finding only two (CanItEdit and EDIT-Bench) properly evaluate this capability. Analysis reveals both concentrate >90% evaluation on Python and have limited test coverage, with specific recommendations for improvement.

entry.title: Compiled AI: Deterministic Code Generation for LLM-Based Workflow Automation

author.name: Geert Trooskens (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), Aaron Karlsberg (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), Anmol Sharma (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), Lamara De Brouwer (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), Max Van Puyvelde (Stanford University School of Medicine, Stanford, CA), Matthew Young (XY.AI Labs, Palo Alto, CA), John Thickstun (Cornell University, Ithaca, NY), Gil Alterovitz (Brigham and Women's Hospital / Harvard Medical School, Boston, MA), Walter A. De Brouwer (Stanford University School of Medicine, Stanford, CA)

entry.summary: Studies 'compiled AI,' where LLMs generate executable code during a compilation phase, after which workflows run deterministically without further model invocation. Focuses on healthcare settings where reliability and auditability are critical.

entry.title: LSRM: High-Fidelity Object-Centric Reconstruction via Scaled Context Windows

author.name: Zhengqin Li, Cheng Zhang, Jakob Engel, Zhao Dong

entry.summary: Introduces Large Sparse Reconstruction Model (LSRM) studying how scaling transformer context windows impacts feed-forward 3D reconstruction, using native sparse attention to substantially increase active tokens for high-fidelity object reconstruction.

entry.title: XMark: Reliable Multi-Bit Watermarking for LLM-Generated Texts

author.name: Jiahao Xu, Rui Hu, Olivera Kotevska, Zikai Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes XMark, a multi-bit watermarking method for LLM-generated text that improves encoding/decoding of binary messages with better trade-offs between text quality and decoding accuracy, especially for limited token counts.

entry.title: ALTO: Adaptive LoRA Tuning and Orchestration for Heterogeneous LoRA Training Workloads

author.name: Jingwei Zuo, Xinze Feng, Zien Liu, Kaijian Wang, Fanjiang Ye, Ye Cao, Zhuang Wang, Yuke Wang

entry.summary: ALTO is a system that co-optimizes LoRA hyperparameter tuning and GPU cluster sharing across heterogeneous tasks, enabling early termination of weak candidates and efficient multi-tenant resource utilization.

entry.title: FastDiSS: Few-step Match Many-step Diffusion Language Model on Sequence-to-Sequence Generation--Full Version

author.name: Dat Nguyen-Cong, Tung Kieu, Hoang Thanh-Tung

entry.summary: FastDiSS addresses the problem of degraded self-conditioning in few-step diffusion language models by perturbing self-conditioning signals during training to match inference noise, plus introducing a new distillation approach for sequence-to-sequence generation.

entry.title: Generating Synthetic Doctor-Patient Conversations for Long-form Audio Summarization

author.name: Yanis Labrak, David Gr\"unert, S\'everin Baroudi, Jiyun Chun, Pawel Cyrta, Sergio Burdisso, Ahmed Hassoon, David Liu, Adam Rothschild, Reed Van Deusen, Petr Motlicek, Andrew Perrault, Ricard Marxer, Thomas Schaaf

entry.summary: Proposes a fully open-weight pipeline for generating synthetic doctor-patient conversations with SOAP notes, including persona-driven dialogue, multi-speaker audio synthesis with realistic artifacts, and LLM-based reference generation.

entry.title: ODE-free Neural Flow Matching for One-Step Generative Modeling

author.name: Xiao Shou

entry.summary: Proposes OT-NFM, an ODE-free generative framework enabling true one-step generation by directly learning the transport map using optimal transport pairings. Proves that consistent coupling is necessary to avoid mean collapse.

entry.title: Optimal Rates for Pure {\varepsilon}-Differentially Private Stochastic Convex Optimization with Heavy Tails

author.name: Andrew Lowy

entry.summary: Characterizes the minimax optimal excess-risk rate for pure ε-differential privacy stochastic convex optimization with heavy-tailed gradients, resolving an open question. Achieves the rate in polynomial time.

entry.title: MedRoute: RL-Based Dynamic Specialist Routing in Multi-Agent Medical Diagnosis

author.name: Ashmal Vayani, Parth Parag Kulkarni, Joseph Fioresi, Song Wang, Mubarak Shah

entry.summary: Proposes MedRoute, an RL-based dynamic routing framework for multi-agent medical diagnosis where specialized LMM agents are dynamically selected based on the medical condition, mimicking real clinical specialist referral.

entry.title: Distributional Open-Ended Evaluation of LLM Cultural Value Alignment Based on Value Codebook

author.name: Jaehyeok Lee, Xiaoyuan Yi, Jing Yao, Hyunjin Hwang, Roy Ka-Wei Lee, Xing Xie, JinYeong Bak

entry.summary: Introduces DOVE, a distributional evaluation framework for assessing LLM cultural value alignment by comparing human-written and LLM-generated text distributions using a value codebook constructed via rate-distortion optimization.

entry.title: Stochastic Auto-conditioned Fast Gradient Methods with Optimal Rates

author.name: Yao Ji, Guanghui Lan

entry.summary: Achieves optimal convergence rates for stochastic composite convex optimization without prior knowledge of problem parameters, extending auto-conditioned fast gradient methods to the stochastic setting.

entry.title: Steering the Verifiability of Multimodal AI Hallucinations

author.name: Jianhong Pang, Ruoxi Cheng, Ziyi Ye, Xingjun Ma, Zuxuan Wu, Xuanjing Huang, Yu-Gang Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces a framework for steering the verifiability of multimodal AI hallucinations, distinguishing between obvious and elusive hallucinations and controlling this property for different security/usability demands.

entry.title: FedDetox: Robust Federated SLM Alignment via On-Device Data Sanitization

author.name: Shunan Zhu, Jiawei Chen, Yonghao Yu, Hideya Ochiai

entry.summary: Proposes FedDetox for robust federated alignment of small language models, using knowledge distillation from safety-aligned teachers to create lightweight on-device classifiers that sanitize toxic client data.

entry.title: The Theory and Practice of Highly Scalable Gaussian Process Regression with Nearest Neighbours

author.name: Robert Allison, Tomasz Maciazek, Anthony Stephenson

entry.summary: Develops theoretical framework for Nearest Neighbour Gaussian Process regression, deriving pointwise convergence results for MSE, calibration, and coverage under mild assumptions, filling a gap in large-n theory for this practical scalable GP method.

entry.title: Fast Spatial Memory with Elastic Test-Time Training

author.name: Ziqiao Ma, Xueyang Yu, Haoyu Zhen, Yuncong Yang, Joyce Chai, Chuang Gan

entry.summary: Proposes Elastic Test-Time Training that stabilizes fast-weight updates in large chunk test-time training using Fisher-weighted elastic priors, addressing catastrophic forgetting and enabling processing of arbitrarily long 3D sequences.

entry.title: Depression Detection at the Point of Care: Automated Analysis of Linguistic Signals from Routine Primary Care Encounters

author.name: Feng Chen, Manas Bedmutha, Janice Sabin, Andrea Hartzler, Nadir Weibel, Trevor Cohen

entry.summary: Investigates automated depression detection from 1,108 recorded primary care encounters, finding that zero-shot GPT-OSS outperformed supervised methods (AUPRC=0.510), with combined dyadic features showing promise.

entry.title: Invisible Influences: Investigating Implicit Intersectional Biases through Persona Engineering in Large Language Models

author.name: Nandini Arimanda, Achyuth Mukund, Sakthi Balan Muthiah, Rajesh Sharma

entry.summary: Introduces BADx metric for measuring persona-induced bias amplification in LLMs, showing that existing static embedding tests fail to capture dynamic intersectional biases that emerge when models adopt social roles.

entry.title: When to Call an Apple Red: Humans Follow Introspective Rules, VLMs Don't

author.name: Jonathan Nemitz, Carsten Eickhoff, Junyi Jessy Li, Kyle Mahowald, Michal Golovanevsky, William Rudman

entry.summary: GCA dataset evaluates whether VLMs follow their own introspective rules for color attribution, finding humans are faithful to their stated thresholds while VLMs systematically deviate from their self-reported decision rules.

entry.title: Scientific Knowledge-driven Decoding Constraints Improving the Reliability of LLMs

author.name: Maotian Ma, Zheni Zeng, Zhenghao Liu, Yukun Yan

entry.summary: SciDC integrates scientific knowledge as strong constraints during LLM generation by converting domain knowledge into multi-layered standardized rules, reducing hallucination on domain tasks.

entry.title: DiffuMask: Diffusion Language Model for Token-level Prompt Pruning

author.name: Caleb Zheng, Jyotika Singh, Fang Tu, Weiyi Sun, Sujeeth Bharadwaj, Yassine Benajiba, Sujith Ravi, Eli Shlizerman, Dan Roth

entry.summary: DiffuMask uses a diffusion-based framework for prompt compression that enables parallel token pruning via iterative mask prediction, substantially accelerating compression while preserving reasoning quality.

entry.title: To Adapt or not to Adapt, Rethinking the Value of Medical Knowledge-Aware Large Language Models

author.name: Ane G. Domingo-Aldama, Iker De La Iglesia, Maitane Urruela, Aitziber Atutxa, Ander Barrena

entry.summary: Systematically compares general vs clinical LLMs on medical QA in English and Spanish, introducing perturbation-based evaluation. Finds domain-adapted models don't consistently outperform general-purpose ones.

entry.title: Are Non-English Papers Reviewed Fairly? Language-of-Study Bias in NLP Peer Reviews

author.name: Ehsan Barkhordar, Abdulfattah Safa, Verena Blaschke, Erika Lombart, Marie-Catherine de Marneffe, G\"ozde G\"ul \c{S}ahin

entry.summary: Systematically characterizes language-of-study bias in NLP peer reviews, distinguishing positive and negative forms, and introduces the LOBSTER dataset for detecting such bias.

entry.title: Robustness Risk of Conversational Retrieval: Identifying and Mitigating Noise Sensitivity in Qwen3-Embedding Model

author.name: Weishu Chen, Zhouhui Hou, Mingjie Zhan, Zhicheng Zhao, Fei Su

entry.summary: Identifies a robustness vulnerability in Qwen3-embedding models where structured conversational noise becomes disproportionately retrievable under realistic dialogue-like queries without query prompting.

entry.title: From Perception to Autonomous Computational Modeling: A Multi-Agent Approach

author.name: Daniel N. Wilke

entry.summary: Presents a solver-agnostic framework where LLM agents autonomously execute the complete computational mechanics workflow from visual perception to engineering report generation with uncertainty quantification.

entry.title: Mem3R: Streaming 3D Reconstruction with Hybrid Memory via Test-Time Training

author.name: Changkun Liu, Jiezhi Yang, Zeman Li, Yuan Deng, Jiancong Guo, Luca Ballan

entry.summary: Proposes Mem3R for streaming 3D reconstruction with a hybrid memory that decouples camera tracking (using test-time trained MLP) from geometric mapping (using explicit point memory) for improved temporal consistency.

entry.title: From Blobs to Spokes: High-Fidelity Surface Reconstruction via Oriented Gaussians

author.name: Diego Gomez, Antoine Gu\'edon, Nissim Maruani, Bingchen Gong, Maks Ovsjanikov

entry.summary: Derives a principled occupancy field for 3D Gaussian Splatting by introducing learnable oriented normals and adapted attenuation, enabling extraction of highly accurate watertight meshes from complex scenes.

entry.title: RoSHI: A Versatile Robot-oriented Suit for Human Data In-the-Wild

author.name: Wenjing Margaret Mao, Jefferson Ng, Luyang Hu, Daniel Gehrig, Antonio Loquercio

entry.summary: Introduces RoSHI, a wearable system fusing sparse IMUs with Project Aria glasses for estimating full 3D pose and body shape in global coordinates from egocentric perception, designed for collecting human demonstration data for robot learning.

entry.title: From Governance Norms to Enforceable Controls: A Layered Translation Method for Runtime Guardrails in Agentic AI

author.name: Christopher Koch

entry.summary: Proposes a layered translation method connecting governance standards (ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF) to four implementable control layers for agentic AI: governance objectives, design-time constraints, runtime mechanisms, and audit hooks.

entry.title: Breakthrough the Suboptimal Stable Point in Value-Factorization-Based Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Lesong Tao, Yifei Wang, Haodong Jing, Jingwen Fu, Miao Kang, Shitao Chen, Nanning Zheng

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of why value factorization methods in MARL converge to suboptimal solutions by introducing the concept of 'stable points', and proposes an iterative filtering method to eliminate non-optimal stable points.

entry.title: Towards Effective In-context Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer via Domain-invariant-neurons-based Retrieval

author.name: Jianzhi Yan, Zhiming Li, Le Liu, Zike Yuan, Shiwei Chen, Youcheng Pan, Buzhou Tang, Yang Xiang, Danny Dongning Sun

entry.summary: Proposes Domain-Invariant-Neurons-based Retrieval for cross-domain in-context learning, demonstrating that domain-invariant neurons in LLMs can be used to retrieve useful cross-domain demonstrations that boost reasoning performance.

entry.title: COSMO-Agent: Tool-Augmented Agent for Closed-loop Optimization,Simulation,and Modeling Orchestration

author.name: Liyuan Deng, Shujian Deng, Yongkang Chen, Yongkang Dai, Zhihang Zhong, Linyang Li, Xiao Sun, Yilei Shi, Huaxi Huang

entry.summary: Proposes COSMO-Agent, a tool-augmented RL framework that teaches LLMs to perform closed-loop CAD-CAE optimization, casting geometry generation, simulation, and revision as an interactive RL environment with multi-constraint rewards.

entry.title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning with Augmented Step-Level Transitions for LLM Agents

author.name: Shuai Zhen, Yanhua Yu, Ruopei Guo, Nan Cheng, Yang Deng

entry.summary: Proposes STEP-HRL, a hierarchical RL framework for LLM agents that enables step-level learning from single-step transitions rather than full interaction histories, using subtask completion for global progress tracking.

entry.title: Vision-Guided Iterative Refinement for Frontend Code Generation

author.name: Hannah Sansford, Derek H. C. Law, Wei Liu, Abhishek Tripathi, Niresh Agarwal, Gerrit J. J. van den Burg

entry.summary: Presents a vision-guided iterative refinement framework for frontend code generation where a vision-language model serves as visual critic providing structured feedback on rendered webpages, achieving 17.8% improvement over three refinement cycles.

entry.title: Context-Value-Action Architecture for Value-Driven Large Language Model Agents

author.name: TianZe Zhang, Sirui Sun, Yuhang Xie, Xin Zhang, Zhiqiang Wu, Guojie Song

entry.summary: Proposes Context-Value-Action (CVA) architecture for LLM agents grounded in Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values, revealing that increasing prompt-driven reasoning intensity causes value polarization and collapses population diversity.

entry.title: CURE:Circuit-Aware Unlearning for LLM-based Recommendation

author.name: Ziheng Chen, Jiali Cheng, Zezhong Fan, Hadi Amiri, Yunzhi Yao, Xiangguo Sun, Yang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CURE, a circuit-aware unlearning method for LLM-based recommendation systems that identifies and targets specific model circuits for forgetting, avoiding gradient conflicts between forgetting and retaining objectives.

entry.title: Learning Stable Predictors from Weak Supervision under Distribution Shift

author.name: Mehrdad Shoeibi, Elias Hossain, Ivan Garibay, Niloofar Yousefi

entry.summary: Formalizes 'supervision drift' — changes in the relationship between weak labels and ground truth across contexts — and studies it using CRISPR-Cas13d experiments, proposing methods for learning stable predictors under distribution shift with weak supervision.

entry.title: Dynamic Linear Coregionalization for Realistic Synthetic Multivariate Time Series

author.name: Annita Vapsi, Penghang Liu, Saheed Obitayo, Aakriti, Manoj Cherukumalli, Prathamesh Patil, Amit Varshney, Nicolas Marchesotti, Elizabeth Fons, Vamsi K. Potluru, Manuela Veloso

entry.summary: Introduces DynLMC, a Dynamic Linear Model of Coregionalization for generating synthetic multivariate time series with time-varying correlations. Fine-tuning foundation models on DynLMC data yields zero-shot forecasting improvements across nine benchmarks.

entry.title: OrthoFuse: Training-free Riemannian Fusion of Orthogonal Style-Concept Adapters for Diffusion Models

author.name: Ali Aliev, Kamil Garifullin, Nikolay Yudin, Vera Soboleva, Alexander Molozhavenko, Ivan Oseledets, Aibek Alanov, Maxim Rakhuba

entry.summary: Derives training-free adapter merging formulas for Orthogonal Fine-Tuning (OFT) adapters by exploiting the geometric properties of the orthogonal manifold, enabling combination of style and concept adapters without retraining.

entry.title: RoboPlayground: Democratizing Robotic Evaluation through Structured Physical Domains

author.name: Yi Ru Wang, Carter Ung, Evan Gubarev, Christopher Tan, Siddhartha Srinivasa, Dieter Fox

entry.summary: Introduces RoboPlayground, a framework enabling users to author executable robotic manipulation tasks using natural language within structured physical domains, reframing evaluation as a language-driven process.

entry.title: Region-R1: Reinforcing Query-Side Region Cropping for Multi-Modal Re-Ranking

author.name: Chan-Wei Hu, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Proposes Region-R1, a query-side region cropping framework for multimodal re-ranking that learns to dynamically crop discriminative image regions using region-aware GRPO, reducing the impact of visual distractors.

entry.title: VideoStir: Understanding Long Videos via Spatio-Temporally Structured and Intent-Aware RAG

author.name: Honghao Fu, Miao Xu, Yiwei Wang, Dailing Zhang, Liu Jun, Yujun Cai

entry.summary: VideoStir proposes a RAG framework for long video understanding that structures videos as spatio-temporal graphs and performs multi-hop retrieval to capture both explicit and implicit query-relevant evidence across distant video segments.

entry.title: Context-Agent: Dynamic Discourse Trees for Non-Linear Dialogue

author.name: Junan Hu, Shudan Guo, Wenqi Liu, Jianhua Yin, Yinwei Wei

entry.summary: Context-Agent models multi-turn dialogue as a dynamic tree structure rather than a flat linear sequence, enabling better handling of topic shifts, instruction refinements, and non-linear conversation flows in LLMs.

entry.title: MMEmb-R1: Reasoning-Enhanced Multimodal Embedding with Pair-Aware Selection and Adaptive Control

author.name: Yuchi Wang, Haiyang Yu, Weikang Bian, Jiefeng Long, Xiao Liang, Chao Feng, Hongsheng Li

entry.summary: MMEmb-R1 introduces adaptive reasoning for multimodal embeddings, using pair-aware selection to determine when chain-of-thought reasoning helps embedding quality and adaptive control to avoid it when counterproductive.

entry.title: Probabilistic Language Tries: A Unified Framework for Compression, Decision Policies, and Execution Reuse

author.name: Gregory Magarshak

entry.summary: Introduces Probabilistic Language Tries (PLTs), a unified data structure making explicit the prefix structure of generative models, serving as compressor, policy representation, and memoization index simultaneously.

entry.title: Inference-Time Code Selection via Symbolic Equivalence Partitioning

author.name: David Cho, Yifan Wang, Fanping Sui, Ananth Grama

entry.summary: Proposes Symbolic Equivalence Partitioning for LLM code generation, using symbolic execution to group candidate programs by semantic behavior and select from the dominant partition. Uses SMT constraints to reduce path explosion.

entry.title: Geometric Properties of the Voronoi Tessellation in Latent Semantic Manifolds of Large Language Models

author.name: Marshall Brett

entry.summary: Studies Voronoi tessellation in LLM representation spaces on Qwen3.5-4B, validating a linear scaling law of the expressibility gap (R²=0.9997) and identifying a 'geometric ambiguity regime' in middle layers before crystallization at the final layer.

entry.title: Graph Neural ODE Digital Twins for Control-Oriented Reactor Thermal-Hydraulic Forecasting Under Partial Observability

author.name: Akzhol Almukhametov, Doyeong Lim, Rui Hu, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed Graph Neural Network coupled with Neural ODEs for real-time thermal-hydraulic forecasting in nuclear reactors under partial observability. Achieves millisecond-scale inference for control applications.

entry.title: Visual prompting reimagined: The power of the Activation Prompts

author.name: Yihua Zhang, Hongkang Li, Yuguang Yao, Aochuan Chen, Shuai Zhang, Pin-Yu Chen, Meng Wang, Sijia Liu

entry.summary: Introduces activation prompts (AP) that extend visual prompting from input-level to intermediate activation-level perturbations, narrowing the performance gap between visual prompting and conventional fine-tuning.

entry.title: Anticipating tipping in spatiotemporal systems with machine learning

author.name: Smita Deb, Zheng-Meng Zhai, Mulugeta Haile, Ying-Cheng Lai

entry.summary: Applies machine learning with non-negative matrix factorization and reservoir computing to predict tipping points in spatiotemporal dynamical systems, including forecasting the precise timing of critical transitions.

entry.title: Controller Design for Structured State-space Models via Contraction Theory

author.name: Muhammad Zakwan, Vaibhav Gupta, Alireza Karimi, Efe C. Balta, Giancarlo Ferrari-Trecate

entry.summary: Provides first analysis of controllability and observability for Structured State-space Models (SSMs), enabling scalable controller design via LMIs with contraction theory and a separation principle.

entry.title: Non-identifiability of Explanations from Model Behavior in Deep Networks of Image Authenticity Judgments

author.name: Icaro Re Depaolini, Uri Hasson

entry.summary: Demonstrates that deep neural networks predicting human image authenticity judgments produce inconsistent explanations (attribution maps) within and across architectures, despite achieving similar prediction accuracy, highlighting non-identifiability of explanations from model behavior.

entry.title: Making Room for AI: Multi-GPU Molecular Dynamics with Deep Potentials in GROMACS

author.name: Luca Pennati, Andong Hu, Ivy Peng, Lukas M\"ullender, Stefano Markidis

entry.summary: Integrates DeePMD-kit (ML interatomic potentials) into GROMACS for multi-GPU molecular dynamics simulations, enabling domain-decomposed GPU-accelerated neural network inference across multi-node systems.

entry.title: Beyond Facts: Benchmarking Distributional Reading Comprehension in Large Language Models

author.name: Pei-Fu Guo, Ya-An Tsai, Chun-Chia Hsu, Kai-Xin Chen, Yun-Da Tsai, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng, Mi-Yen Yeh, Shou-De Lin

entry.summary: Text2DistBench benchmarks LLMs' ability to infer distributional information (population-level trends, proportions) from collections of text rather than extracting factual answers, using YouTube comments about entertainment entities.

entry.title: SensorPersona: An LLM-Empowered System for Continual Persona Extraction from Longitudinal Mobile Sensor Streams

author.name: Bufang Yang, Lilin Xu, Yixuan Li, Kaiwei Liu, Xiaofan Jiang, Zhenyu Yan

entry.summary: SensorPersona continuously infers user personas from multimodal mobile sensor streams (not just chat histories) using LLMs, performing person-oriented context encoding on sensor data to enable richer personalization.

entry.title: ValueGround: Evaluating Culture-Conditioned Visual Value Grounding in MLLMs

author.name: Zhipin Wang, Christoph Leiter, Christian Frey, Mohamed Hesham Ibrahim Abdalla, Josif Grabocka, Steffen Eger

entry.summary: ValueGround benchmarks culture-conditioned visual value grounding in MLLMs using World Values Survey questions with contrastive image pairs, testing whether models can match images to country-specific cultural values.

entry.title: MedConclusion: A Benchmark for Biomedical Conclusion Generation from Structured Abstracts

author.name: Weiyue Li, Ruizhi Qian, Yi Li, Yongce Li, Yunfan Long, Jiahui Cai, Yan Luo, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: MedConclusion provides a 5.7M structured abstract dataset for evaluating LLMs' ability to generate biomedical conclusions from evidence, with journal-level metadata enabling subgroup analysis.

entry.title: A Parameter-Efficient Transfer Learning Approach through Multitask Prompt Distillation and Decomposition for Clinical NLP

author.name: Cheng Peng, Mengxian Lyu, Ziyi Chen, Yonghui Wu

entry.summary: Multitask prompt distillation framework that learns a shared metaprompt from 21 clinical source tasks and adapts to unseen tasks with <0.05% trainable parameters, evaluated across 5 clinical NLP task types.

entry.title: SemEval-2026 Task 9: Detecting Multilingual, Multicultural and Multievent Online Polarization

author.name: Usman Naseem, Robert Geislinger, Juan Ren, Sarah Kohail, Rudy Garrido Veliz, P Sam Sahil, Yiran Zhang, Marco Antonio Stranisci, Idris Abdulmumin, \"Ozge Ala\c{c}am, Cengiz Acart\"urk, Aisha Jabr, Saba Anwar, Abinew Ali Ayele, Elena Tutubalina, Aung Kyaw Htet, Xintong Wang, Surendrabikram Thapa, Tanmoy Chakraborty, Dheeraj Kodati, Sahar Moradizeyveh, Firoj Alam, Ye Kyaw Thu, Shantipriya Parida, Ihsan Ayyub Qazi, Lilian Wanzare, Nelson Odhiambo Onyango, Clemencia Siro, Ibrahim Said Ahmad, Adem Chanie Ali, Martin Semmann, Chris Biemann, Shamsuddeen Hassan Muhammad, Seid Muhie Yimam

entry.summary: Presents SemEval-2026 Task 9 on multilingual online polarization detection covering 22 languages with 110K annotated instances, attracting 67 teams. Reports baseline results and best system analyses.

entry.title: iTAG: Inverse Design for Natural Text Generation with Accurate Causal Graph Annotations

author.name: Wenshuo Wang, Boyu Cao, Nan Zhuang, Wei Li

entry.summary: Proposes iTAG, which generates natural text with accurate causal graph annotations by framing concept-to-node assignment as an inverse problem, addressing the lack of causally annotated text data.

entry.title: The Impact of Steering Large Language Models with Persona Vectors in Educational Applications

author.name: Yongchao Wu, Aron Henriksson

entry.summary: Studies persona vectors for activation-based steering of LLMs in educational applications, finding that persona steering generally lowers answer quality, with interpretive tasks being up to 11x more sensitive than factual ones.

entry.title: MorphDistill: Distilling Unified Morphological Knowledge from Pathology Foundation Models for Colorectal Cancer Survival Prediction

author.name: Hikmat Khan, Usama Sajjad, Metin N. Gurcan, Anil Parwani, Wendy L. Frankel, Wei Chen, Muhammad Khalid Khan Niazi

entry.summary: Proposes MorphDistill, a framework distilling knowledge from ten pathology foundation models into a compact CRC-specific encoder using dimension-agnostic multi-teacher relational distillation.

entry.title: Exploring 6D Object Pose Estimation with Deformation

author.name: Zhiqiang Liu, Rui Song, Duanmu Chuangqi, Jiaojiao Li, David Ferstl, Yinlin Hu

entry.summary: Introduces DeSOPE, a large-scale dataset for 6DoF pose estimation of deformed objects, featuring 3D scans of 26 object categories in canonical and deformed states with 133K RGB-D frames and 665K pose annotations.

entry.title: KITE: Keyframe-Indexed Tokenized Evidence for VLM-Based Robot Failure Analysis

author.name: Mehdi Hosseinzadeh, King Hang Wong, Feras Dayoub

entry.summary: Presents KITE, a training-free front-end that converts long robot execution videos into compact tokenized evidence for VLMs, using keyframe selection with bird's-eye-view representations for robot failure analysis including detection, identification, and correction.

entry.title: Generalization error bounds for two-layer neural networks with Lipschitz loss function

author.name: Jiang Yu Nguwi, Nicolas Privault

entry.summary: Derives generalization error bounds for two-layer neural networks with Lipschitz loss functions without assuming bounded loss, achieving dimension-free O(n^{-1/2}) rate for independent test data using Wasserstein distance estimates.

entry.title: How Well Do Vision-Language Models Understand Sequential Driving Scenes? A Sensitivity Study

author.name: Roberto Brusnicki, Mattia Piccinini, Johannes Betz

entry.summary: Introduces VENUSS, a framework for systematic sensitivity analysis of VLM performance on sequential driving scenes. Reveals that even top VLMs achieve only 57% accuracy on temporal driving scene understanding, far below human performance.

entry.title: MAR-GRPO: Stabilized GRPO for AR-diffusion Hybrid Image Generation

author.name: Xiaoxiao Ma, Jiachen Lei, Tianfei Ren, Jie Huang, Siming Fu, Aiming Hao, Jiahong Wu, Xiangxiang Chu, Feng Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes MAR-GRPO, a stabilized RL framework for masked autoregressive image generation models (MAR) that addresses noisy gradients from diffusion heads through multi-trajectory expectation and conservative optimization.

entry.title: AnchorSplat: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian SplattingWith 3D Geometric Priors

author.name: Xiaoxue Zhang, Xiaoxu Zheng, Yixuan Yin, Tiao Zhao, Kaihua Tang, Michael Bi Mi, Zhan Xu, Dave Zhenyu Chen

entry.summary: Proposes AnchorSplat, a feed-forward 3DGS framework that represents scenes directly in 3D space using anchor-aligned Gaussians guided by geometric priors, reducing required Gaussians and improving efficiency.

entry.title: LiveStre4m: Feed-Forward Live Streaming of Novel Views from Unposed Multi-View Video

author.name: Pedro Quesado, Erkut Akdag, Yasaman Kashefbahrami, Willem Menu, Egor Bondarev

entry.summary: Introduces LiveStre4m, a feed-forward model for real-time novel view synthesis from unposed multi-view video. Combines a multi-view vision transformer with a diffusion-transformer interpolation module and camera pose prediction.

entry.title: ReVEL: Multi-Turn Reflective LLM-Guided Heuristic Evolution via Structured Performance Feedback

author.name: Cuong Van Duc, Minh Nguyen Dinh Tuan, Tam Vu Duc, Tung Vu Duy, Son Nguyen Van, Hanh Nguyen Thi, Binh Huynh Thi Thanh

entry.summary: Proposes ReVEL, a framework that embeds LLMs as multi-turn reasoners within an evolutionary algorithm for designing heuristics for NP-hard combinatorial optimization. Uses performance-profile grouping and structured feedback to guide iterative heuristic improvement.

entry.title: MMORF: A Multi-agent Framework for Designing Multi-objective Retrosynthesis Planning Systems

author.name: Frazier N. Baker, Trieu Nguyen, Reza Averly, Botao Yu, Daniel Adu-Ampratwum, Huan Sun, Xia Ning

entry.summary: Presents MMORF, a modular multi-agent framework for multi-objective retrosynthesis planning in chemistry, balancing quality, safety, and cost objectives. Includes a new benchmark of 218 multi-objective retrosynthesis problems.

entry.title: PECKER: A Precisely Efficient Critical Knowledge Erasure Recipe For Machine Unlearning in Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhiyong Ma, Zhitao Deng, Huan Tang, Jialin Chen, Zhijun Zheng, Zhengping Li, Qingyuan Chuai

entry.summary: Proposes PECKER, an efficient machine unlearning approach for diffusion models that uses saliency masks to prioritize updates to parameters most responsible for targeted data, reducing training time while maintaining unlearning efficacy.

entry.title: Deep Researcher Agent: An Autonomous Framework for 24/7 Deep Learning Experimentation with Zero-Cost Monitoring

author.name: Xiangyue Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces Deep Researcher Agent, an open-source framework for autonomous deep learning experimentation with zero-cost monitoring (no LLM API calls during training), two-tier constant-size memory, and full experiment lifecycle management.

entry.title: ACE-Bench: Agent Configurable Evaluation with Scalable Horizons and Controllable Difficulty under Lightweight Environments

author.name: Wang Yang, Chaoda Song, Xinpeng Li, Debargha Ganguly, Chuang Ma, Shouren Wang, Zhihao Dou, Yuli Zhou, Vipin Chaudhary, Xiaotian Han

entry.summary: Proposes ACE-Bench, an agent evaluation benchmark with fine-grained control over task difficulty and horizon length through a unified grid-based planning task. Addresses limitations of existing benchmarks including high environment overhead and imbalanced difficulty distributions.

entry.title: Architecture Without Architects: How AI Coding Agents Shape Software Architecture

author.name: Phongsakon Mark Konrad, Tim Lukas Adam, Riccardo Terrenzi, Serkan Ayvaz

entry.summary: Identifies five mechanisms by which AI coding agents make implicit architectural decisions and proposes six 'prompt-architecture coupling patterns.' Coins the term 'vibe architecture' for the phenomenon of prompt wording producing structurally different systems.

entry.title: Nidus: Externalized Reasoning for AI-Assisted Engineering

author.name: Danil Gorinevski (cybiont GmbH, Sch\"ubelbach, Switzerland)

entry.summary: Presents Nidus, a governance runtime that mechanizes the V-model for AI-assisted software delivery, where three LLM families delivered a 100,000-line system under proof obligations verified on every commit. The system governed its own construction.

entry.title: CritBench: A Framework for Evaluating Cybersecurity Capabilities of Large Language Models in IEC 61850 Digital Substation Environments

author.name: Gustav Keppler, Moritz Gst\"ur, Veit Hagenmeyer

entry.summary: CritBench evaluates LLM cybersecurity capabilities in IEC 61850 digital substation (OT) environments across 81 tasks including configuration analysis, network reconnaissance, and live VM interaction, testing GPT-5 and open-weight models.

entry.title: A Multi-Stage Validation Framework for Trustworthy Large-scale Clinical Information Extraction using Large Language Models

author.name: Maria Mahbub, Gregory M. Dams, Josh Arnold, Caitlin Rizy, Sudarshan Srinivasan, Elliot M. Fielstein, Minu A. Aghevli, Kamonica L. Craig, Elizabeth M. Oliva, Joseph Erdos, Jodie Trafton, Ioana Danciu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-stage validation framework for LLM-based clinical information extraction that enables assessment under weak supervision through prompt calibration, plausibility filtering, semantic grounding, and LLM-as-judge confirmatory evaluation.

entry.title: Scientific Graphics Program Synthesis via Dual Self-Consistency Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Juekai Lin, Yun Zhu, Honglin Lin, Sijing Li, Tianwei Lin, Zheng Liu, Xiaoyang Wang, Wenqiao Zhang, Lijun Wu

entry.summary: Presents a framework for scientific graphics program synthesis (image-to-TikZ) including SciTikZ-230K dataset and dual self-consistency reinforcement learning for structural and visual fidelity.

entry.title: LAG-XAI: A Lie-Inspired Affine Geometric Framework for Interpretable Paraphrasing in Transformer Latent Spaces

author.name: Olexander Mazurets, Olexander Barmak, Leonid Bedratyuk, Iurii Krak

entry.summary: LAG-XAI models paraphrasing as affine transformations in embedding space using Lie group theory, decomposing paraphrase transitions into rotation, deformation, and translation components for interpretability.

entry.title: AgentOpt v0.1 Technical Report: Client-Side Optimization for LLM-Based Agent

author.name: Wenyue Hua, Sripad Karne, Qian Xie, Armaan Agrawal, Nikos Pagonas, Kostis Kaffes, Tianyi Peng

entry.summary: Introduces AgentOpt, a framework for client-side optimization of LLM-based agents, addressing how developers should allocate resources (model choice, tools, API budget) across pipeline stages subject to quality, cost, and latency constraints.

entry.title: Discrete Flow Matching Policy Optimization

author.name: Maojiang Su, Po-Chung Hsieh, Weimin Wu, Mingcheng Lu, Jiunhau Chen, Jerry Yao-Chieh Hu, Han Liu

entry.summary: Introduces DoMinO, a framework for RL fine-tuning of Discrete Flow Matching models by viewing the DFM sampling procedure as a multi-step MDP. Includes total-variation regularizers to prevent policy collapse.

entry.title: MoBiE: Efficient Inference of Mixture of Binary Experts under Post-Training Quantization

author.name: Zhixiong Zhao, Zukang Xu, Zhixuan Chen, Dawei Yang

entry.summary: Proposes MoBiE, the first binarization framework specifically designed for MoE-based LLMs, using joint SVD decomposition, global loss-aware importance estimation, and routing-aware error constraints.

entry.title: MoE Routing Testbed: Studying Expert Specialization and Routing Behavior at Small Scale

author.name: Tobias Falke, Nicolas Anastassacos, Samson Tan, Chankrisna Richy Meas, Chandana Satya Prakash, Nitesh Sekhar, M Saiful Bari, Krishna Kompella, Gamaleldin F. Elsayed

entry.summary: Proposes an MoE Routing Testbed that gives clearer visibility into routing dynamics at small scale while using realistic data, pairing distinguishable domain data with established metrics for expert specialization assessment.

entry.title: Improving Semantic Uncertainty Quantification in Language Model Question-Answering via Token-Level Temperature Scaling

author.name: Tom A. Lamb, Desi R. Ivanova, Philip H. S. Torr, Tim G. J. Rudner

entry.summary: Shows that optimizing a single scalar temperature dramatically improves semantic uncertainty calibration in LLM question-answering, outperforming complex fixed-temperature heuristics. Provides systematic evaluation of both calibration and discrimination.

entry.title: Tracking Adaptation Time: Metrics for Temporal Distribution Shift

author.name: Lorenzo Iovine, Giacomo Ziffer, Emanuele Della Valle

entry.summary: Proposes three new metrics for evaluating model behavior under temporal distribution shift that distinguish between a model's failure to adapt versus inherently harder data. Reveals adaptation patterns hidden by existing metrics.

entry.title: Incentive-Aware Multi-Fidelity Optimization for Generative Advertising in Large Language Models

author.name: Jiayuan Liu, Barry Wang, Jiarui Gan, Tonghan Wang, Leon Xie, Mingyu Guo, Vincent Conitzer

entry.summary: Proposes IAMFM, a framework for generative advertising in LLM responses that combines VCG auction mechanisms with multi-fidelity optimization to handle advertiser strategic behavior and costly stochastic generations.

entry.title: ProofSketcher: Hybrid LLM + Lightweight Proof Checker for Reliable Math/Logic Reasoning

author.name: Kranthi Kommuru, Kunal Khanvilkar, Gaurav Parekh

entry.summary: Proposes ProofSketcher, a hybrid system combining LLM proof generation with a lightweight formal proof checker to catch subtle errors in mathematical and logical reasoning that LLMs typically miss.

entry.title: Attention Flows: Tracing LLM Conceptual Engagement via Story Summaries

author.name: Rebecca M. M. Hicke, Sil Hamilton, David Mimno, Ross Deans Kristensen-McLachlan

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM novel summarization by comparing human and LLM-authored summaries, measuring conceptual engagement through chapter-level alignment. Finds LLMs diverge from human patterns of narrative importance.

entry.title: Learning Debt and Cost-Sensitive Bayesian Retraining: A Forecasting Operations Framework

author.name: Harrison Katz

entry.summary: Defines 'learning debt' as divergence between deployed and updated posteriors, and derives a Bayes-optimal retraining rule that outperforms fixed calendar-based retraining schedules across multiple shift scenarios.

entry.title: Towards Robust Content Watermarking Against Removal and Forgery Attacks

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Yihan Wang, Xiao-Shan Gao

entry.summary: Introduces ISTS, a watermarking paradigm for text-to-image diffusion models that resists both removal and forgery attacks through instance-specific dynamic watermark injection and two-sided detection.

entry.title: A solver-in-the-loop framework for end-to-end differentiable coastal hydrodynamics

author.name: Elsa Cardoso-Bihlo, Alex Bihlo

entry.summary: AegirJAX is a fully differentiable hydrodynamic solver for coastal simulation built within a reverse-mode automatic differentiation framework, enabling gradient-based inverse problems like bathymetry estimation and structural optimization. This bridges physics simulation with modern ML differentiable programming paradigms.

entry.title: Amortized Filtering and Smoothing with Conditional Normalizing Flows

author.name: Tiangang Cui, Xiaodong Feng, Chenlong Pei, Xiaoliang Wan, Tao Zhou

entry.summary: AFSF proposes a unified amortized framework for Bayesian filtering and smoothing using conditional normalizing flows, with a recurrent encoder mapping observation histories to fixed-dimensional summary statistics regardless of time series length.

entry.title: Beyond Loss Values: Robust Dynamic Pruning via Loss Trajectory Alignment

author.name: Huaiyuan Qin, Muli Yang, Gabriel James Goenawan, Kai Wang, Zheng Wang, Peng Hu, Xi Peng, Hongyuan Zhu

entry.summary: AlignPrune proposes a noise-robust dynamic data pruning method using Dynamic Alignment Score based on loss trajectories rather than raw loss values, better identifying noisy samples for pruning under label noise.

entry.title: Gaussian Approximation for Asynchronous Q-learning

author.name: Artemy Rubtsov, Sergey Samsonov, Vladimir Ulyanov, Alexey Naumov

entry.summary: Derives convergence rates for the central limit theorem applied to Polyak-Ruppert averaged iterates of asynchronous Q-learning, establishing rates up to n^{-1/6} over hyper-rectangles.

entry.title: Closing the Speech-Text Gap with Limited Audio for Effective Domain Adaptation in LLM-Based ASR

author.name: Thibault Ba\~neras-Roux, Sergio Burdisso, Esa\'u Villatoro-Tello, Dairazalia S\'anchez-Cort\'es, Shiran Liu, Severin Baroudi, Shashi Kumar, Hasindri Watawana, Manjunath K E, Kadri Hacioglu, Petr Motlicek, Andreas Stolcke

entry.summary: Investigates domain adaptation for LLM-based ASR with limited audio, showing that mixed batching of text-only and paired speech-text data with just 10% speech consistently improves performance, closing the modality gap.

entry.title: GCoT-Decoding: Unlocking Deep Reasoning Paths for Universal Question Answering

author.name: Guanran Luo, Wentao Qiu, Zhongquan Jian, Meihong Wang, Qingqiang Wu

entry.summary: Proposes GCoT-decoding, extending CoT-decoding to open-ended QA tasks using Fibonacci sampling, heuristic error backtracking, and path confidence aggregation without requiring manual prompts.

entry.title: Continuous Interpretive Steering for Scalar Diversity

author.name: Ye-eun Cho

entry.summary: Introduces Continuous Interpretive Steering (CIS), a method that probes graded pragmatic inference in LLMs by treating activation steering strength as a continuous variable, along with a new scalar diversity dataset.

entry.title: Multilingual Embedding Probes Fail to Generalize Across Learner Corpora

author.name: Laurits Lyngbaek, Ross Deans Kristensen-McLachlan

entry.summary: Trains probes on Qwen3-Embedding activations to predict CEFR proficiency levels across nine corpora and seven languages. Finds strong in-distribution performance but complete collapse in cross-corpus evaluation.

entry.title: Evaluating In-Context Translation with Synchronous Context-Free Grammar Transduction

author.name: Jackson Petty, Jaulie Goe, Tal Linzen

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs' ability to perform in-context translation using formal synchronous context-free grammars as a controlled analogue, isolating the skill of inferring language rules from descriptions.

entry.title: WebExpert: domain-aware web agents with critic-guided expert experience for high-precision search

author.name: Yuelin Hu, Zhengxue Cheng, Ronghua Wu, Qunshan Gu, Hongwei Hu, Wei Liu, Qiao Liang, Li Song

entry.summary: Presents WebExpert, a domain-aware web agent for specialized search in finance/biomedicine with sentence-level experience retrieval, facet induction, and preference-optimized planning.

entry.title: Automating Database-Native Function Code Synthesis with LLMs

author.name: Wei Zhou, Xuanhe Zhou, Qikang He, Guoliang Li, Bingsheng He, Quanqing Xu, Fan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DBCooker, an LLM-based system for automatically synthesizing database-native functions, handling complexities like multi-unit registration, internal reference linking, and logic implementation.

entry.title: Evidence-Based Actor-Verifier Reasoning for Echocardiographic Agents

author.name: Peng Huang, Yiming Wang, Yineng Chen, Liangqiao Gui, Hui Guo, Bo Peng, Shu Hu, Xi Wu, Tsao Connie, Hongtu Zhu, Balakrishnan Prabhakaran, Xin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes EchoTrust, an evidence-driven Actor-Verifier framework for trustworthy echocardiographic reasoning in VLM-based agents, avoiding template shortcuts and spurious explanations.

entry.title: Continual Visual Anomaly Detection on the Edge: Benchmark and Efficient Solutions

author.name: Manuel Barusco, Francesco Borsatti, David Petrovic, Davide Dalle Pezze, Gian Antonio Susto

entry.summary: Benchmarks visual anomaly detection methods under joint edge deployment and continual learning constraints, characterizing tradeoffs between memory, inference cost, and detection performance.

entry.title: Controllable Generative Video Compression

author.name: Ding Ding, Daowen Li, Ying Chen, Yixin Gao, Ruixiao Dong, Kai Li, Li Li

entry.summary: Proposes Controllable Generative Video Compression (CGVC) that uses generative modeling to reconstruct non-keyframes guided by coded keyframes and per-frame control priors. Addresses the perception-fidelity trade-off in video compression.

entry.title: VGGT-SLAM++

author.name: Avilasha Mandal, Rajesh Kumar, Sudarshan Sunil Harithas, Chetan Arora

entry.summary: Presents VGGT-SLAM++, a visual SLAM system leveraging the VGGT transformer with local bundle adjustment, DEM-based graph construction, and Sim(3) optimization for large-scale mapping with bounded memory.

entry.title: Q-Zoom: Query-Aware Adaptive Perception for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Yuheng Shi, Xiaohuan Pei, Linfeng Wen, Minjing Dong, Chang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes Q-Zoom, a query-aware adaptive perception framework for MLLMs that dynamically bypasses high-resolution processing when unnecessary and precisely identifies regions requiring fine-grained attention.

entry.title: Distilling Photon-Counting CT into Routine Chest CT through Clinically Validated Degradation Modeling

author.name: Junqi Liu, Xinze Zhou, Wenxuan Li, Scott Ye, Arkadiusz Sitek, Xiaofeng Yang, Yucheng Tang, Daguang Xu, Kai Ding, Kang Wang, Yang Yang, Alan L. Yuille, Zongwei Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes SUMI, a method to bridge the gap between limited photon-counting CT availability and conventional CT by learning to enhance EICT images using PCCT as reference, with clinically validated degradation modeling.

entry.title: TC-AE: Unlocking Token Capacity for Deep Compression Autoencoders

author.name: Teng Li, Ziyuan Huang, Cong Chen, Yangfu Li, Yuanhuiyi Lyu, Dandan Zheng, Chunhua Shen, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TC-AE, a ViT-based deep compression autoencoder that addresses latent representation collapse at high compression ratios by scaling token numbers and introducing token-to-latent compression innovations.

entry.title: Towards foundation-style models for energy-frontier heterogeneous neutrino detectors via self-supervised pre-training

author.name: Sa\'ul Alonso-Monsalve, Fabio Cufino, Umut Kose, Anna Mascellani, Andr\'e Rubbia

entry.summary: Presents a sparse Vision Transformer framework for neutrino detector data, using self-supervised pre-training (masked autoencoder + relational objectives) to learn reusable representations from heterogeneous detector signatures at TeV-scale energies.

entry.title: Conformal Prediction with Time-Series Data via Sequential Conformalized Density Regions

author.name: M. Sampson, K. S. Chan

entry.summary: Proposes Sequential Conformalized Density Regions (SCDR) for conformal prediction on time series data, providing asymptotic conditional coverage guarantees while supporting disconnected prediction sets to capture bifurcations.

entry.title: Elementary Condensation

author.name: Jan

entry.summary: A technical exploration of the 'Condensation' paper (Eisenstat 2025), which formalizes when two agents analyzing the same data must converge on the same concepts. The author attempts to implement the theoretical framework computationally, connecting it to Wentworth's natural abstractions hypothesis and infra-Bayesianism.

entry.title: Enhancing MLLM Spatial Understanding via Active 3D Scene Exploration for Multi-Perspective Reasoning

author.name: Jiahua Chen, Qihong Tang, Weinong Wang, Qi Fan

entry.summary: Proposes a training-free framework enhancing MLLM spatial understanding through Visual Chain-of-Thought grounded in explicit 3D reconstruction. Reconstructs 3D mesh from single images using MLLM-guided processing for multi-perspective reasoning.

entry.title: DOC-GS: Dual-Domain Observation and Calibration for Reliable Sparse-View Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Hantang Li, Qiang Zhu, Xiandong Meng, Debin Zhao, Xiaopeng Fan

entry.summary: Proposes DOC-GS for sparse-view 3D Gaussian Splatting that identifies the core challenge as unobservability of Gaussian primitive reliability. Uses dual-domain observation (image and frequency) and calibration to detect and correct unreliable Gaussians.

entry.title: RefineAnything: Multimodal Region-Specific Refinement for Perfect Local Details

author.name: Dewei Zhou, You Li, Zongxin Yang, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Introduces RefineAnything for region-specific image refinement that restores fine-grained details (text, logos, thin structures) in user-specified regions while keeping non-edited pixels unchanged.

entry.title: Energy-based Tissue Manifolds for Longitudinal Multiparametric MRI Analysis

author.name: Kartikay Tehlan, Lukas F\"orner, Nico Schmutzenhofer, Michael Fr\"uhwald, Matthias Wagner, Nassir Navab, Thomas Wendler

entry.summary: Proposes a geometric framework for longitudinal MRI analysis using patient-specific energy modeling in multi-parametric sequence space, with energy landscapes providing differential-geometric tissue characterization without segmentation labels.

entry.title: PhyEdit: Towards Real-World Object Manipulation via Physically-Grounded Image Editing

author.name: Ruihang Xu, Dewei Zhou, Xiaolong Shen, Fan Ma, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Presents PhyEdit, an image editing framework that uses explicit geometric simulation as 3D-aware visual guidance for physically accurate object manipulation, combined with joint 2D-3D supervision.

entry.title: BRIDGE: Multimodal-to-Text Retrieval via Reinforcement-Learned Query Alignment

author.name: Mohamed Darwish Mounis, Mohamed Mahmoud, Shaimaa Sedek, Mahmoud Abdalla, Mahmoud SalahEldin Kasem, Abdelrahman Abdallah, Hyun-Soo Kang

entry.summary: Proposes BRIDGE, a two-component system for multimodal-to-text retrieval using reinforcement learning to distill noisy multimodal queries into retrieval-optimized text, eliminating the need for multimodal encoders during retrieval.

entry.title: Vision-Language Model-Guided Deep Unrolling Enables Personalized, Fast MRI

author.name: Fangmao Ju, Yuzhu He, Zhiwen Xue, Chunfeng Lian, Jianhua Ma

entry.summary: Introduces PASS, an MRI framework that uses a Vision-Language Model to guide deep unrolling for personalized, task-oriented accelerated MRI with patient-specific k-space trajectory optimization.

entry.title: Grounded Forcing: Bridging Time-Independent Semantics and Proximal Dynamics in Autoregressive Video Synthesis

author.name: Jintao Chen, Chengyu Bai, Junjun hu, Xinda Xue, Mu Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Grounded Forcing for autoregressive video synthesis that bridges time-independent semantics and proximal dynamics through a Dual Memory KV Cache, addressing semantic forgetting, visual drift, and controllability loss.

entry.title: Learning to Search: A Decision-Based Agent for Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

author.name: Zhuohong Chen, Zhenxian Wu, Yunyao Yu, Hangrui Xu, Zirui Liao, Zhifang Liu, Xiangwen Deng, Pen Jiao, Haoqian Wang

entry.summary: Reformulates knowledge-based VQA as a search-agent problem where the model decides when to search, how to refine queries, and when to stop, rather than using a fixed retrieval-then-answer pipeline.

entry.title: Region-Graph Optimal Transport Routing for Mixture-of-Experts Whole-Slide Image Classification

author.name: Xin Tian, Jiuliu Lu, Ephraim Tsalik, Bart Wanders, Colleen Knoth, Julian Knight

entry.summary: Proposes ROAM, a Mixture-of-Experts approach for whole-slide image classification using region-graph optimal transport routing to ensure balanced expert utilization and spatial awareness in computational pathology.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Guided Latent Diagnostic Trajectory Learning for Sequential Clinical Diagnosis

author.name: Xuyang Shen, Haoran Liu, Dongjin Song, Martin Renqiang Min

entry.summary: Proposes LDTL, a framework for sequential clinical diagnosis that models evidence acquisition as a latent trajectory learning problem using a planning LLM agent. Addresses the challenge that clinical datasets rarely provide supervision for optimal diagnostic paths.

entry.title: HYVE: Hybrid Views for LLM Context Engineering over Machine Data

author.name: Jian Tan, Fan Bu, Yuqing Gao, Dev Khanolkar, Jason Mackay, Boris Sobolev, Lei Jin, Li Zhang

entry.summary: Presents HYVE, a framework for LLM context engineering with machine data payloads, using database management principles to handle long, nested, repetitive structured data like JSON and logs more effectively.

entry.title: Market-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Economic and Trade Competition

author.name: Yushuo Zheng (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2), Huiyu Duan (Affiliation 1), Zicheng Zhang (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2), Yucheng Zhu (Affiliation 1), Xiongkuo Min (Affiliation 1), Guangtao Zhai (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2)

entry.summary: Introduces Market-Bench, a benchmark evaluating LLMs as economic agents in a configurable multi-agent supply chain model with procurement auctions and retail pricing, logging complete transaction histories for analysis.

entry.title: Beyond Behavior: Why AI Evaluation Needs a Cognitive Revolution

author.name: Amir Konigsberg

entry.summary: Argues that AI evaluation needs to move beyond behavioral testing (Turing test paradigm) to consider internal processes, mechanisms, and organization, drawing parallels with cognitive psychology's revolution against behaviorism.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy Report Generation: A Deep Research Agent with Progressive Confidence Estimation and Calibration

author.name: Yi Yuan, Xuhong Wang, Shanzhe Lei

entry.summary: Proposes a deep research agent with progressive confidence estimation and calibration for trustworthy report generation, addressing the gap between subjective quality evaluation and epistemic confidence in generated content.

entry.title: Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) for Efficient and Cost-Effective Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: Uday Allu, Sonu Kedia, Tanmay Odapally, Biddwan Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC), a cost-efficient chunking framework for RAG systems that decouples text extraction from semantic chunk planning using structured, ID-addressable units and LLM-based chunk boundary identification.

entry.title: EduIllustrate: Towards Scalable Automated Generation Of Multimodal Educational Content

author.name: Shuzhen Bi, Mingzi Zhang, Zhuoxuan Li, Xiaolong Wang, keqian Li, Aimin Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces EduIllustrate, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on generating interleaved text-diagram explanations for K-12 STEM problems, with 230 problems across five subjects and an 8-dimension evaluation rubric.

entry.title: From Use to Oversight: How Mental Models Influence User Behavior and Output in AI Writing Assistants

author.name: Shalaleh Rismani, Su Lin Blodgett, Q. Vera Liao, Alexandra Olteanu, AJung Moon

entry.summary: Studies how users' mental models (functional vs. structural) of AI writing assistants affect their control behavior and oversight. Finds structural mental models increase critical assessment while functional models affect automation trust differently.

entry.title: Modality-Aware and Anatomical Vector-Quantized Autoencoding for Multimodal Brain MRI

author.name: Mingjie Li, Edward Kim, Yue Zhao, Ehsan Adeli, Kilian M. Pohl

entry.summary: Proposes NeuroQuant, a modality-aware 3D vector-quantized VAE for reconstructing multi-modal brain MRIs that separates modality-specific and shared anatomical representations using factorized multi-axis attention.

entry.title: Neural Network Pruning via QUBO Optimization

author.name: Osama Orabi, Artur Zagitov, Hadi Salloum, Viktor A. Lobachev, Kasymkhan Khubiev, Yaroslav Kholodov

entry.summary: Proposes a hybrid QUBO framework for neural network pruning that integrates gradient-aware sensitivity metrics (Taylor, Fisher) into the optimization, bridging heuristic importance estimation with global combinatorial optimization.

entry.title: Stories of Your Life as Others: A Round-Trip Evaluation of LLM-Generated Life Stories Conditioned on Rich Psychometric Profiles

author.name: Ben Wigler, Maria Tsfasman, Tiffany Matej Hrkalovic

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs conditioned on real psychometric profiles from 290 participants can generate life stories that preserve personality differences, using round-trip evaluation beyond simple questionnaire self-report.

entry.title: DiffHDR: Re-Exposing LDR Videos with Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Zhengming Yu, Li Ma, Mingming He, Leo Isikdogan, Yuancheng Xu, Dmitriy Smirnov, Pablo Salamanca, Dao Mi, Pablo Delgado, Ning Yu, Julien Philip, Xin Li, Wenping Wang, Paul Debevec

entry.summary: DiffHDR formulates LDR-to-HDR video conversion as generative radiance inpainting in the latent space of a video diffusion model, operating in Log-Gamma color space for realistic detail restoration in over/underexposed regions.

entry.title: TalkLoRA: Communication-Aware Mixture of Low-Rank Adaptation for Large Language Models

author.name: Lin Mu, Haiyang Wang, Li Ni, Lei Sang, Zhize Wu, Peiquan Jin, Yiwen Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes TalkLoRA, which adds inter-expert communication to Mixture-of-Experts LoRA frameworks before routing decisions. A lightweight Talking Module enables information exchange across expert subspaces for more stable routing.

entry.title: Weighted Bayesian Conformal Prediction

author.name: Xiayin Lou, Peng Luo

entry.summary: Generalizes Bayesian conformal prediction to handle distribution shift by replacing the uniform Dirichlet prior with a weighted Dirichlet, combining the data-conditional guarantees of BQ-CP with the distributional flexibility of weighted conformal prediction.

entry.title: VLMShield: Efficient and Robust Defense of Vision-Language Models against Malicious Prompts

author.name: Peigui Qi, Kunsheng Tang, Yanpu Yu, Jialin Wu, Yide Song, Wenbo Zhou, Zhicong Huang, Cheng Hong, Weiming Zhang, Nenghai Yu

entry.summary: Proposes VLMShield, a lightweight safety detector for Vision-Language Models that identifies multimodal malicious attacks using CLIP-based feature extraction (MAFE framework) as a plug-and-play solution.

entry.title: Are Stochastic Multi-objective Bandits Harder than Single-objective Bandits?

author.name: Changkun Guan, Mengfan Xu

entry.summary: Resolves a question about whether stochastic multi-objective bandits are harder than single-objective ones, showing that Pareto regret need not increase with dimensionality in the stochastic setting, contradicting prior work.

entry.title: Selective Neuron Amplification for Training-Free Task Enhancement

author.name: Ryyan Akhtar

entry.summary: Proposes Selective Neuron Amplification (SNA), amplifying task-relevant neurons at inference time without changing model parameters. Shows this helps mainly when the model is uncertain, suggesting some failures are due to weak activation rather than missing capability.

entry.title: Mixture Proportion Estimation and Weakly-supervised Kernel Test for Conditional Independence

author.name: Yushi Hirose, Akito Narahara, Takafumi Kanamori

entry.summary: Proposes novel conditional independence assumptions for mixture proportion estimation (MPE) that ensure identifiability even when the standard irreducibility assumption fails. Develops method of moments estimators and weakly-supervised kernel tests for validating assumptions.

entry.title: Calibration of a neural network ocean closure for improved mean state and variability

author.name: Pavel Perezhogin, Alistair Adcroft, Laure Zanna

entry.summary: Uses Ensemble Kalman Inversion to calibrate neural network parameterizations of mesoscale ocean eddies, reducing errors in mean state and variability by roughly 2x compared to unparameterized or offline-trained models.

entry.title: A Generalized Sinkhorn Algorithm for Mean-Field Schr\"odinger Bridge

author.name: Asmaa Eldesoukey, Yongxin Chen, Abhishek Halder

entry.summary: Proposes a generalized Sinkhorn algorithm for mean-field Schrödinger bridge problems involving interacting agents, using a novel Hopf-Cole transform to handle the nonconvexity from nonlocal interactions.

entry.title: Variational Feature Compression for Model-Specific Representations

author.name: Zinan Guo, Zihan Wang, Chuan Yan, Liuhuo Wan, Ethan Ma, Guangdong Bai

entry.summary: Proposes a variational feature extraction framework that suppresses cross-model transfer while preserving accuracy for a designated classifier, preventing unauthorized model repurposing of submitted data.

entry.title: Adaptive Prompt Structure Factorization: A Framework for Self-Discovering and Optimizing Compositional Prompt Programs

author.name: Haoyue Liu, Zhichao Wang, Yongxin Guo, Haoran Shou, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: Proposes aPSF, a framework for automated prompt optimization that decomposes monolithic prompts into semantic factors and performs interventional single-factor updates with error-guided selection.

entry.title: Temporally Phenotyping GLP-1RA Case Reports with Large Language Models: A Textual Time Series Corpus and Risk Modeling

author.name: Sayantan Kumar, Jeremy C. Weiss

entry.summary: Develops a textual time-series corpus of 136 PubMed case reports involving GLP-1 drugs with clinical events mapped to reference times, evaluating LLM timeline extraction against expert annotations. Notes GPT5 achieves 0.871 event coverage.

entry.title: Tool-MCoT: Tool Augmented Multimodal Chain-of-Thought for Content Safety Moderation

author.name: Shutong Zhang, Dylan Zhou, Yinxiao Liu, Yang Yang, Huiwen Luo, Wenfei Zou

entry.summary: Tool-MCoT fine-tunes a small language model for content safety moderation using tool-augmented chain-of-thought data generated by LLMs, showing SLMs can learn to use external tools for improved reasoning in moderation tasks.

entry.title: CCD-CBT: Multi-Agent Therapeutic Interaction for CBT Guided by Cognitive Conceptualization Diagram

author.name: Chang Liu, Changsheng Ma, Yongfeng Tao, Bin Hu, Minqiang Yang

entry.summary: CCD-CBT introduces a multi-agent framework for CBT therapy simulation with dynamically reconstructed cognitive conceptualization diagrams and information-asymmetric therapist-client interaction, releasing CCDCHAT dataset.

entry.title: SQLStructEval: Structural Evaluation of LLM Text-to-SQL Generation

author.name: Yixi Zhou, Fan Zhang, Zhiqiao Guo, Yu Chen, Haipeng Zhang, Preslav Nakov, Zhuohan Xie

entry.summary: SQLStructEval analyzes structural behavior of LLM-generated SQL via canonical AST representations, finding LLMs produce structurally diverse queries even for correct results, with variance triggered by surface-level input changes.

entry.title: HingeMem: Boundary Guided Long-Term Memory with Query Adaptive Retrieval for Scalable Dialogues

author.name: Yijie Zhong, Yunfan Gao, Haofen Wang

entry.summary: Proposes HingeMem, a long-term memory system for dialogue based on event segmentation theory, using boundary-triggered hyperedges over person/time/location/topic elements with adaptive retrieval.

entry.title: Sell More, Play Less: Benchmarking LLM Realistic Selling Skill

author.name: Xuanbo Su, Wenhao Hu, Le Zhan, Yanqi Yang, Leo Huang

entry.summary: Introduces SalesLLM, a bilingual benchmark for evaluating LLMs in sales dialogues with controllable difficulty, automatic evaluation pipeline, and a trained customer simulator for realistic interactions.

entry.title: Yale-DM-Lab at ArchEHR-QA 2026: Deterministic Grounding and Multi-Pass Evidence Alignment for EHR Question Answering

author.name: Elyas Irankhah, Samah Fodeh

entry.summary: Describes a system for EHR question answering using model ensembles (o3, GPT-5.2, GPT-5.1, DeepSeek-R1) with few-shot prompting and voting, finding model diversity consistently improves performance.

entry.title: Digital Skin, Digital Bias: Uncovering Tone-Based Biases in LLMs and Emoji Embeddings

author.name: Mingchen Li, Wajdi Aljedaani, Yingjie Liu, Navyasri Meka, Xuan Lu, Xinyue Ye, Junhua Ding, Yunhe Feng

entry.summary: First large-scale study of bias in skin-toned emoji representations across emoji embedding models and four LLMs, revealing critical performance gaps in older emoji embedding models.

entry.title: DesigNet: Learning to Draw Vector Graphics as Designers Do

author.name: Tomas Guija-Valiente, Iago Su\'arez

entry.summary: Presents DesigNet, a hierarchical Transformer-VAE for generating vector graphics (SVG) that mimics human designer tools like axis alignment and continuity control. Introduces differentiable modules for continuity self-refinement at curve junctions.

entry.title: RePL: Pseudo-label Refinement for Semi-supervised LiDAR Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Donghyeon Kwon, Taegyu Park, Suha Kwak

entry.summary: Introduces RePL for semi-supervised LiDAR semantic segmentation that refines pseudo-labels through masked reconstruction. Provides theoretical analysis of when pseudo-label refinement is beneficial.

entry.title: Compression as an Adversarial Amplifier Through Decision Space Reduction

author.name: Lewis Evans, Harkrishan Jandu, Zihan Ye, Yang Lu, Shreyank N Gowda

entry.summary: Shows that image compression can act as an adversarial amplifier for deep classifiers, with compression-aware attacks being substantially more effective than pixel-space attacks under identical perturbation budgets.

entry.title: Not all tokens contribute equally to diffusion learning

author.name: Guoqing Zhang, Lu Shi, Wanru Xu, Linna Zhang, Sen Wang, Fangfang Wang, Yigang Cen

entry.summary: Proposes DARE, a framework addressing the issue that diffusion models neglect semantically important tokens during inference, due to distributional bias from long-tailed token frequency and spatial misalignment in cross-attention.

entry.title: Bridging MRI and PET physiology: Untangling complementarity through orthogonal representations

author.name: Sonja Adomeit, Kartikay Tehlan, Lukas F\"orner, Katharina Weisser, Helen Scholtiseek, David Kaufmann, Julie Steinestel, Constantin Lapa, Thomas Kr\"oncke, Thomas Wendler

entry.summary: Proposes a subspace decomposition framework for MRI-PET fusion that separates PSMA PET uptake into an MRI-explainable component and an orthogonal residual capturing information beyond MRI features.

entry.title: Geo-EVS: Geometry-Conditioned Extrapolative View Synthesis for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yatong Lan, Rongkui Tang, Lei He

entry.summary: Proposes Geo-EVS for extrapolative novel view synthesis in autonomous driving, using geometry-conditioned reprojection from VGGT-reconstructed point clouds to handle out-of-trajectory views.

entry.summary: Euclid space telescope collaboration presents AgileLens, a CNN-based pipeline for identifying strong gravitational lensing systems in the Euclid Q1 imaging data. Uses iterative VGG16-based classification on 96x96 pixel cutouts from VIS and NISP instruments.

entry.title: BATON: A Multimodal Benchmark for Bidirectional Automation Transition Observation in Naturalistic Driving

author.name: Yuhang Wang, Yiyao Xu, Chaoyun Yang, Lingyao Li, Jingran Sun, Hao Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces BATON, a large-scale naturalistic driving dataset capturing multimodal context (road scene, driver state, vehicle dynamics) for studying bidirectional automation transitions - both driver-to-automation and automation-to-driver handovers.

entry.title: Differentiable Environment-Trajectory Co-Optimization for Safe Multi-Agent Navigation

author.name: Zhan Gao, Gabriele Fadini, Stelian Coros, Amanda Prorok

entry.summary: Formulates multi-agent navigation as a bi-level optimization where environment configurations and agent trajectories are jointly optimized using differentiable optimization with interior point methods.

entry.title: Flow Motion Policy: Manipulator Motion Planning with Flow Matching Models

author.name: Davood Soleymanzadeh, Xiao Liang, Minghui Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces Flow Motion Policy, an open-loop neural motion planner using flow matching to capture multi-modality in planning datasets, enabling stochastic path generation and inference-time optimization for robotic manipulators.

entry.title: How Does an Agent with Multiple Goals Choose a Target?

author.name: sturb

entry.summary: Master's thesis findings on how maze-solving RL agents internally represent and switch between multiple goals, discovering spatial gating through negative activations as the key mechanism rather than channel specialization.

entry.title: Algebraic Structure Discovery for Real World Combinatorial Optimisation Problems: A General Framework from Abstract Algebra to Quotient Space Learning

author.name: Min Sun (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Federica Storti (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Valentina Martino (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Miguel Gonzalez-Andrades (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Tony Kam-Thong (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development)

entry.summary: Presents a framework from Roche that discovers algebraic structures in combinatorial optimization problems, constructs quotient spaces to collapse redundant representations, and optimizes over reduced spaces. Demonstrates isomorphism between conjunctive rules and Boolean hypercube with bitwise OR.

entry.title: Reason Analogically via Cross-domain Prior Knowledge: An Empirical Study of Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer for In-Context Learning

author.name: Le Liu, Zhiming Li, Jianzhi Yan, Zike Yuan, Shiwei Chen, Youcheng Pan, Buzhou Tang, Qingcai Chen, Yang Xiang, Danny Dongning Sun

entry.summary: Empirical study of cross-domain knowledge transfer under in-context learning, finding conditional positive transfer and an 'example absorption threshold' beyond which positive transfer becomes more likely.

entry.title: Experience Transfer for Multimodal LLM Agents in Minecraft Game

author.name: Chenghao Li, Jun Liu, Songbo Zhang, Huadong Jian, Hao Ni, Lik-Hang Lee, Sung-Ho Bae, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Chaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Echo, a transfer-oriented memory framework for multimodal LLM agents in Minecraft that decomposes reusable knowledge into five dimensions and uses In-Context Analogy Learning for cross-task experience transfer.

entry.title: A canonical generalization of OBDD

author.name: Florent Capelli, YooJung Choi, Stefan Mengel, Mart\'in Mu\~noz, Guy Van den Broeck

entry.summary: Introduces Tree Decision Diagrams (TDD), a generalization of OBDD for Boolean functions that maintains the same tractability properties while being more succinct. Shows CNF formulas of treewidth k can be represented by TDDs of FPT size.

entry.title: JTON: A Token-Efficient JSON Superset with Zen Grid Tabular Encoding for Large Language Models

author.name: Gowthamkumar Nandakishore

entry.summary: Presents JTON, a JSON superset that factors column headers into a single row and encodes values with semicolons, reducing token counts by 15-60% versus compact JSON while maintaining LLM comprehension accuracy.

entry.title: From PDF to RAG-Ready: Evaluating Document Conversion Frameworks for Domain-Specific Question Answering

author.name: Jos\'e Guilherme Marques dos Santos, Ricardo Yang, Rui Humberto Pereira, Alexandre Sousa, Br\'igida M\'onica Faria, Henrique Lopes Cardoso, Jos\'e Duarte, Jos\'e Lu\'is Reis, Lu\'is Paulo Reis, Pedro Pimenta, Jos\'e Paulo Marques dos Santos

entry.summary: Systematically compares four PDF-to-Markdown conversion frameworks for RAG systems across 19 pipeline configurations, finding significant impact on downstream QA accuracy. Tests on Portuguese administrative documents with LLM-as-judge evaluation.

entry.title: Prune-Quantize-Distill: An Ordered Pipeline for Efficient Neural Network Compression

author.name: Longsheng Zhou, Yu Shen

entry.summary: Studies a practical compression pipeline ordering (prune, quantize, distill) for neural networks, finding INT8 quantization provides the dominant runtime gain while unstructured pruning provides minimal acceleration despite reducing storage.

entry.title: ID-Sim: An Identity-Focused Similarity Metric

author.name: Julia Chae, Nicholas Kolkin, Jui-Hsien Wang, Richard Zhang, Sara Beery, Cusuh Ham

entry.summary: Proposes ID-Sim, a feed-forward metric for measuring identity-focused image similarity that reflects human selective sensitivity to identities across diverse contexts, trained on curated real and synthetic data.

entry.title: Curvature-Aware Optimization for High-Accuracy Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Anas Jnini, Elham Kiyani, Khemraj Shukla, Jorge F. Urban, Nazanin Ahmadi Daryakenari, Johannes Muller, Marius Zeinhofer, George Em Karniadakis

entry.summary: Presents advanced optimization strategies for PINNs including Natural Gradient, Self-Scaling BFGS, and Broyden optimizers, demonstrating faster convergence to high accuracy on challenging PDEs and ODEs.

entry.title: DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support

author.name: Vishaal Kapoor, Mariam Dundua, Sarthak Ahuja, Neda Kordjazi, Evren Yortucboylu, Vaibhavi Padala, Derek Ho, Jennifer Whitted, Rebecca Steinert

entry.summary: Introduces DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework for IT support that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases at the root-cause level rather than individual documents, enabling iterative evidence gathering across conversation turns.

entry.title: Multiscale Physics-Informed Neural Network for Complex Fluid Flows with Long-Range Dependencies

author.name: Prashant Kumar, Rajesh Ranjan

entry.summary: DDS-PINN introduces domain decomposition and shifted physics-informed neural networks for solving complex fluid flows with long-range dependencies, using localized networks with minimal supervision.

entry.title: Swiss-Bench 003: Evaluating LLM Reliability and Adversarial Security for Swiss Regulatory Contexts

author.name: Fatih Uenal

entry.summary: Swiss-Bench 003 extends the HAAS framework for evaluating LLM reliability and adversarial security in Swiss regulatory contexts, testing 10 frontier models across 808 items in four languages including Swiss German.

entry.title: "I See What You Did There": Can Large Vision-Language Models Understand Multimodal Puns?

author.name: Naen Xu, Jiayi Sheng, Changjiang Li, Chunyi Zhou, Yuyuan Li, Tianyu Du, Jun Wang, Zhihui Fu, Jinbao Li, Shouling Ji

entry.summary: MultiPun introduces a benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can understand multimodal puns, revealing that most models struggle to distinguish genuine puns from adversarial distractors.

entry.title: Saliency-Guided Representation with Consistency Policy Learning for Visual Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jingbo Sun, Qichao Zhang, Songjun Tu, Xing Fang, Yupeng Zheng, Haoran Li, Ke Chen, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes saliency-guided representation learning with consistency policy for visual unsupervised reinforcement learning, addressing issues where successor representations attend to dynamics-irrelevant regions.

entry.title: Stochastic Gradient Descent in the Saddle-to-Saddle Regime of Deep Linear Networks

author.name: Guillaume Corlouer, Avi Semler, Alexander Strang, Alexander Gietelink Oldenziel

entry.summary: Analyzes SGD dynamics in deep linear networks during saddle-to-saddle transitions, modeling training as stochastic Langevin dynamics with anisotropic noise and deriving exact per-mode decompositions showing maximal diffusion precedes convergence.

entry.title: Conformal Margin Risk Minimization: An Envelope Framework for Robust Learning under Label Noise

author.name: Yuanjie Shi, Peihong Li, Zijian Zhang, Janardhan Rao Doppa, Yan Yan

entry.summary: Proposes CMRM, a plug-and-play framework for learning with noisy labels that adds a conformal quantile-calibrated regularization term to any classification loss, requiring no clean subsets or noise transition matrices.

entry.title: Efficient Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts with Theoretical Generalization Guarantees

author.name: Mohammed Nowaz Rabbani Chowdhury, Kaoutar El Maghraoui, Hsinyu Tsai, Naigang Wang, Geoffrey W. Burr, Liu Liu, Meng Wang
