entry.title: Contextual Control without Memory Growth in a Context-Switching Task

author.name: Song-Ju Kim

entry.summary: Proposes an intervention-based recurrent architecture for context-dependent decision-making that modifies a shared recurrent state through context-indexed operators without increasing recurrent memory size.

entry.title: StrADiff: A Structured Source-Wise Adaptive Diffusion Framework for Linear and Nonlinear Blind Source Separation

author.name: Yuan-Hao Wei

entry.summary: Presents a structured adaptive diffusion framework for blind source separation that assigns individual diffusion mechanisms to each source component, handling both linear and nonlinear mixing.

entry.title: The Hiremath Early Detection (HED) Score: A Measure-Theoretic Evaluation Standard for Temporal Intelligence

author.name: Prakul Sunil Hiremath

entry.summary: Introduces the HED Score, a measure-theoretic evaluation metric for temporal detection systems that penalizes detection latency through exponentially decaying kernels, addressing the temporal agnosticism of ROC/AUC.

entry.title: Generative Path-Law Jump-Diffusion: Sequential MMD-Gradient Flows and Generalisation Bounds in Marcus-Signature RKHS

author.name: Daniel Bloch

entry.summary: Introduces a generative framework for synthesizing forward-looking càdlàg stochastic trajectories using Marcus-sense signature kernels and sequential MMD-gradient flows on Skorokhod manifolds.

entry.title: Graph Signal Diffusion Models for Wireless Resource Allocation

author.name: Yigit Berkay Uslu, Samar Hadou, Shirin Saeedi Bidokhti, Alejandro Ribeiro

entry.summary: Applies graph signal diffusion models to wireless resource allocation, training on expert primal-dual algorithm outputs and implementing a GNN-based U-Net diffusion architecture conditioned on channel states.

entry.title: Retrieve-then-Adapt: Retrieval-Augmented Test-Time Adaptation for Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Xing Tang, Jingyang Bin, Ziqiang Cui, Xiaokun Zhang, Fuyuan Lyu, Jingyan Jiang, Dugang Liu, Chen Ma, Xiuqiang He

entry.summary: Proposes a retrieve-then-adapt framework for test-time adaptation in sequential recommendation, using retrieval augmentation to address distributional shift during inference without heavy computational overhead.

entry.title: ICR-Drive: Instruction Counterfactual Robustness for End-to-End Language-Driven Autonomous Driving

author.name: Kaiser Hamid, Can Cui, Nade Liang

entry.summary: Introduces ICR-Drive, a diagnostic framework for testing instruction-level robustness of language-conditioned autonomous driving agents across four perturbation families: paraphrase, ambiguity, noise, and misleading instructions.

entry.title: WikiSeeker: Rethinking the Role of Vision-Language Models in Knowledge-Based Visual Question Answering

author.name: Yingjian Zhu, Xinming Wang, Kun Ding, Ying Wang, Bin Fan, Shiming Xiang

entry.summary: Proposes WikiSeeker, a multi-modal RAG framework for knowledge-based VQA that redefines VLM roles as Refiner (query rewriting) and Inspector (answer verification) rather than just answer generators.

entry.title: Arch: An AI-Native Hardware Description Language for Register-Transfer Clocked Hardware Design

author.name: Shuqing Zhao

entry.summary: Introduces Arch, a hardware description language designed for AI-assisted code generation of micro-architecture specifications. It provides first-class constructs for pipelines, FSMs, FIFOs, and clock-domain crossings, converting CDC/RDC analysis into compile-time typing rules.

entry.title: Hierarchical Mesh Transformers with Topology-Guided Pretraining for Morphometric Analysis of Brain Structures

author.name: Yujian Xiong, Mohammad Farazi, Yanxi Chen, Wenhui Zhu, Xuanzhao Dong, Natasha Lepore, Yi Su, Raza Mushtaq, Stephen Foldes, Andrew Yang, Yalin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces a hierarchical transformer framework for neuroimaging that operates on spatially adaptive tree partitions of mesh data, supporting both volumetric and surface discretizations with diverse vertex-level morphometric descriptors.

entry.title: Cross-Stage Attention Propagation for Efficient Semantic Segmentation

author.name: Beoungwoo Kang

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-Stage Attention Propagation (CSAP), a decoder framework that computes attention at the deepest scale and propagates it to shallower stages, reducing redundancy in multi-scale decoders for semantic segmentation.

entry.title: MPM: Mutual Pair Merging for Efficient Vision Transformers

author.name: Simon Rav\'e, Pejman Rasti, David Rousseau

entry.summary: Proposes Mutual Pair Merging (MPM), a training-free token aggregation module for vision transformers that forms mutual nearest-neighbor pairs in cosine space for semantic segmentation acceleration.

entry.title: GaussianGrow: Geometry-aware Gaussian Growing from 3D Point Clouds with Text Guidance

author.name: Weiqi Zhang, Junsheng Zhou, Haotian Geng, Kanle Shi, Shenkun Xu, Yi Fang, Yu-Shen Liu

entry.summary: Introduces GaussianGrow, generating 3D Gaussians by growing them from point clouds with text guidance, using multi-view diffusion for consistent appearance synthesis while maintaining geometric accuracy.

entry.title: EfficientMonoHair: Fast Strand-Level Reconstruction from Monocular Video via Multi-View Direction Fusion

author.name: Da Li, Dominik Engel, Deng Luo, Ivan Viola

entry.summary: Proposes EfficientMonoHair for fast strand-level hair reconstruction from monocular video, combining implicit neural networks with multi-view geometric fusion for speed-accuracy balance.

entry.title: Appearance Decomposition Gaussian Splatting for Multi-Traversal Reconstruction

author.name: Yangyi Xiao, Siting Zhu, Baoquan Yang, Tianchen Deng, Yongbo Chen, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Presents ADM-GS for multi-traversal scene reconstruction using 3D Gaussian Splatting with explicit appearance decomposition to handle illumination variations across different capture times.

entry.title: ExpressMM: Expressive Mobile Manipulation Behaviors in Human-Robot Interactions

author.name: Souren Pashangpour, Haitong Wang, Matthew Lisondra, Goldie Nejat

entry.summary: ExpressMM develops a framework for mobile manipulators to communicate intent through expressive behaviors during human-robot interaction, using a vision-language model for perception and language-guided planning that handles user interruptions and modifications.

entry.title: MARS-Dragonfly: Agile and Robust Flight Control of Modular Aerial Robot Systems

author.name: Rui Huang, Zhiqian Cai, Siyu Tang, Pengxuan Wei, Lidong Li, Xin Chen, Wenhan Cao, Zhenyu Zhang, Lin Zhao

entry.summary: MARS-Dragonfly presents a modular aerial robot system with reconfigurable drone formations, featuring a compact mechanical docking system and a robust control algorithm that avoids the oscillation problems of existing approaches as the number of units scales.

entry.title: Dialogue based Interactive Explanations for Safety Decisions in Human Robot Collaboration

author.name: Yifan Xu, Xiao Zhan, Akilu Yunusa Kaltungo, Ming Shan Ng, Tsukasa Ishizawa, Kota Fujimoto, Clara Cheung

entry.summary: Presents a dialogue-based framework for robots to explain their safety decisions to human collaborators, grounding explanations in the same constraint representations that govern robot behavior. Supports causal (Why?) and counterfactual (What if?) queries.

entry.title: Delta6: A Low-Cost, 6-DOF Force-Sensing Flexible End-Effector

author.name: Yue Feng, Weicheng Huang, Chen Qiu, Huixu Dong, I-Ming Chen

entry.summary: Delta6 is a low-cost, 3D-printed 6-DOF force/torque sensor end-effector using antagonistic springs and magnetic encoders. Achieves 3.8% full-scale error with lightweight sequence models for calibration.

entry.title: A conversation with Anima Labs, part I: Phenomenology of digital minds

author.name: cube_flipper

entry.summary: Reports on a conversation with Anima Labs, a nonprofit that takes LLM phenomenology seriously — exploring whether language model self-reports and introspection can be treated as meaningful data about their internal states, in contrast to mainstream behaviorist approaches.

entry.title: Algebraic Structure Discovery for Real World Combinatorial Optimisation Problems: A General Framework from Abstract Algebra to Quotient Space Learning

author.name: Min Sun (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Federica Storti (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Valentina Martino (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Miguel Gonzalez-Andrades (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development), Tony Kam-Thong (F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG, Roche Pharma Research and Early Development)

entry.summary: Presents a framework from Roche that discovers algebraic structures in combinatorial optimization problems, constructs quotient spaces to collapse redundant representations, and optimizes over reduced spaces. Applied to patient subgroup discovery and molecular screening.

entry.title: Market-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Economic and Trade Competition

author.name: Yushuo Zheng (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2), Huiyu Duan (Affiliation 1), Zicheng Zhang (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2), Yucheng Zhu (Affiliation 1), Xiongkuo Min (Affiliation 1), Guangtao Zhai (Affiliation 1, Affiliation 2)

entry.summary: Market-Bench evaluates LLMs as economic agents in a multi-agent supply chain simulation with procurement (auction bidding) and retail (pricing, marketing) stages, logging complete transaction traces.

entry.title: Context-Value-Action Architecture for Value-Driven Large Language Model Agents

author.name: TianZe Zhang, Sirui Sun, Yuhang Xie, Xin Zhang, Zhiqiang Wu, Guojie Song

entry.summary: CVA (Context-Value-Action) architecture for LLM agents decouples action generation from cognitive reasoning using Schwartz's value theory, addressing behavioral rigidity and value polarization in simulated human behavior.

entry.title: Towards Trustworthy Report Generation: A Deep Research Agent with Progressive Confidence Estimation and Calibration

author.name: Yi Yuan, Xuhong Wang, Shanzhe Lei

entry.summary: Proposes a deep research agent with progressive confidence estimation and calibration for trustworthy report generation, addressing the gap between report quality and epistemic confidence in open-ended research.

entry.title: Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) for Efficient and Cost-Effective Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems

author.name: Uday Allu, Sonu Kedia, Tanmay Odapally, Biddwan Ahmed

entry.summary: Proposes Web Retrieval-Aware Chunking (W-RAC) for RAG systems, decoupling text extraction from semantic chunk planning by representing web content as structured ID-addressable units and using LLMs for semantic chunking decisions. Targets cost-efficiency for web-scale content.

entry.title: EduIllustrate: Towards Scalable Automated Generation Of Multimodal Educational Content

author.name: Shuzhen Bi, Mingzi Zhang, Zhuoxuan Li, Xiaolong Wang, keqian Li, Aimin Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces EduIllustrate, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on generating interleaved text-diagram explanations for K-12 STEM problems. Contains 230 problems across five subjects with an 8-dimension evaluation rubric.

entry.title: Offline RL for Adaptive Policy Retrieval in Prior Authorization

author.name: Ruslan Sharifullin, Maxim Gorshkov, Hannah Clay

entry.summary: Models policy retrieval for prior authorization (healthcare insurance) as a sequential decision-making problem, using offline RL to adaptively select relevant policy chunks rather than fixed top-K retrieval. Trains with CQL and IQL.

entry.title: Improving Clinical Trial Recruitment using Clinical Narratives and Large Language Models

author.name: Ziyi Chen, Mengxian Lyu, Cheng Peng, Yonghui Wu

entry.summary: Explores encoder- and decoder-based LLMs for clinical trial recruitment screening, testing strategies to handle long documents including NER-based extractive summarization to address 'Lost in the Middle' issues with long clinical narratives.

entry.title: Spec Kit Agents: Context-Grounded Agentic Workflows

author.name: Pardis Taghavi, Santosh Bhavani

entry.summary: Proposes Spec Kit Agents, a multi-agent SDD pipeline with context-grounding hooks that reduce hallucinated APIs and architectural violations in AI coding agents working in large repositories. Shows +0.15 quality improvement on a 1-5 composite score.

entry.title: LanG -- A Governance-Aware Agentic AI Platform for Unified Security Operations

author.name: Anes Abdennebi, Nadjia Kara, Laaziz Lahlou, Hakima Ould-Slimane

entry.summary: LanG is an open-source agentic AI platform for security operations that combines a unified incident context record, an agentic orchestrator built on LangGraph, and an LLM-based rule generator for producing deployable Snort/Suricata/YARA rules.

entry.title: Evaluation of Randomization through Style Transfer for Enhanced Domain Generalization

author.name: Dustin Eisenhardt, Timothy Schauml\"offel, Alperen Kantarci, Gemma Roig

entry.summary: Systematic study resolving contradictions in the literature about style transfer for domain generalization, finding that style pool diversity matters more than repetition, complex textures improve robustness, and natural images outperform paintings.

entry.title: Selective Aggregation of Attention Maps Improves Diffusion-Based Visual Interpretation

author.name: Jungwon Park, Jungmin Ko, Dongnam Byun, Wonjong Rhee

entry.summary: Shows that selectively aggregating cross-attention maps from heads most relevant to a target concept improves visual interpretability of diffusion models, achieving higher IoU than standard DAAM approach.

entry.title: ReLU Networks for Exact Generation of Similar Graphs

author.name: Mamoona Ghafoor, Tatsuya Akutsu

entry.summary: Proves that ReLU networks can exactly generate graphs within a specified graph edit distance from a source graph, providing theoretical guarantees absent from data-driven graph generative models.

entry.title: Enhancing sample efficiency in reinforcement-learning-based flow control: replacing the critic with an adaptive reduced-order model

author.name: Zesheng Yao, Zhen-Hua Wan, Canjun Yang, Qingchao Xia, Mengqi Zhang

entry.summary: Replaces the critic in actor-critic RL with an adaptive reduced-order model incorporating physical insights (linear dynamics + neural ODE) for active flow control, improving sample efficiency.

entry.title: Vehicle-as-Prompt: A Unified Deep Reinforcement Learning Framework for Heterogeneous Fleet Vehicle Routing Problem

author.name: Shihong Huang, Shengjie Wang, Lei Gao, Hong Ma, Zhanluo Zhang, Feng Zhang, Weihua Zhou

entry.summary: Develops a unified deep RL framework for heterogeneous fleet vehicle routing problems using a 'vehicle-as-prompt' approach that encodes vehicle characteristics as contextual prompts for the policy network.

entry.title: Graph Topology Information Enhanced Heterogeneous Graph Representation Learning

author.name: He Zhao, Zhiwei Zeng, Yongwei Wang, Chunyan Miao

entry.summary: Proposes a graph structure learning method for heterogeneous graphs that addresses the greater impact of noisy graph structures on heterogeneous GRL models compared to homogeneous ones.

entry.title: Weight-Informed Self-Explaining Clustering for Mixed-Type Tabular Data

author.name: Lehao Li, Qiang Huang, Yihao Ang, Bryan Kian Hsiang Low, Anthony K. H. Tung, Xiaokui Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes WISE, a framework for clustering mixed-type tabular data that unifies representation, feature weighting, clustering, and interpretation through binary encoding with padding and leave-one-feature-out strategies.

entry.title: Probabilistic Tree Inference Enabled by FDSOI Ferroelectric FETs

author.name: Pengyu Ren, Xingtian Wang, Boyang Cheng, Jiahui Duan, Giuk Kim, Xuezhong Niu, Halid Mulaosmanovic, Stefan Duenkel, Sven Beyer, X. Sharon Hu, Ningyuan Cao, Kai Ni

entry.summary: Demonstrates a hardware implementation of Bayesian decision trees using FDSOI ferroelectric FETs, combining analog content-addressable memory and Gaussian random number generation on a single platform.

entry.title: Learn to Rank: Visual Attribution by Learning Importance Ranking

author.name: David Schinagl, Christian Fruhwirth-Reisinger, Alexander Prutsch, Samuel Schulter, Horst Possegger

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based visual attribution method that trains an explainer using ranking supervision from perturbation-based methods, aiming to balance efficiency, causal grounding, and pixel-level resolution. Addresses the three-way tradeoff in attribution methods.

entry.title: Right at My Level: A Unified Multilingual Framework for Proficiency-Aware Text Simplification

author.name: Jinhong Jeong, Junghun Park, Youngjae Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Re-RIGHT, a reinforcement learning framework for adaptive multilingual text simplification at target proficiency levels across multiple language standards (CEFR, JLPT, TOPIK, HSK) without parallel corpus supervision.

entry.title: Identifying Influential N-grams in Confidence Calibration via Regression Analysis

author.name: Shintaro Ozaki, Wataru Hashimoto, Hidetaka Kamigaito, Katsuhiko Hayashi, Taro Watanabe

entry.summary: Uses regression analysis to identify specific n-grams in LLM reasoning that are associated with (over)confidence, finding linguistic expressions that correlate with miscalibration and coincide with known cue phrases.

entry.title: Measuring What Matters!! Assessing Therapeutic Principles in Mental-Health Conversation

author.name: Abdullah Mazhar, Het Riteshkumar Shah, Aseem Srivastava, Smriti Joshi, Md Shad Akhtar

entry.summary: Introduces FAIR, an evaluation framework for assessing AI therapist responses across six therapeutic principles using fine-grained ordinal scales, addressing the gap in clinically grounded evaluation of mental health AI.

entry.title: CLEAR: Cross-Lingual Enhancement in Alignment via Reverse-training

author.name: Seungyoon Lee, Minhyuk Kim, Seongtae Hong, Youngjoon Jang, Dongsuk Oh, Heuiseok Lim

entry.summary: Proposes CLEAR, a novel loss function using reverse training for cross-lingual embedding alignment that uses English passages as bridges to strengthen alignment without degrading English performance.

entry.title: SVAgent: Storyline-Guided Long Video Understanding via Cross-Modal Multi-Agent Collaboration

author.name: Zhongyu Yang, Zuhao Yang, Shuo Zhan, Tan Yue, Wei Pang, Yingfang Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes SVAgent, a multi-agent framework for video question answering that constructs storyline representations from frame-level narratives, mimicking how humans interpret videos through coherent storylines rather than just locating relevant frames.

entry.title: Indoor Asset Detection in Large Scale 360{\deg} Drone-Captured Imagery via 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Monica Tang, Avideh Zakhor

entry.summary: Presents an approach for indoor asset detection in 3DGS scenes from 360° drone imagery using a 3D object codebook that leverages mask semantics and spatial information for multi-view mask association, achieving 65% F1 improvement.

entry.title: Physics-Aligned Spectral Mamba: Decoupling Semantics and Dynamics for Few-Shot Hyperspectral Target Detection

author.name: Luqi Gong, Qixin Xie, Yue Chen, Ziqiang Chen, Fanda Fan, Shuai Zhao, Chao Li

entry.summary: Proposes SpecMamba, a parameter-efficient framework for few-shot hyperspectral target detection that decouples semantic representation from spectral adaptation using DCT-based Mamba adapters on frozen Transformers.

entry.title: High-Resolution Single-Shot Polarimetric Imaging Made Easy

author.name: Shuangfan Zhou, Chu Zhou, Heng Guo, Youwei Lyu, Boxin Shi, Zhanyu Ma, Imari Sato

entry.summary: Proposes EasyPolar, a multi-view polarimetric imaging framework using three synchronized RGB cameras with different polarizer orientations, based on the insight that three measurements suffice for linear polarization characterization.

entry.title: Single-Stage Signal Attenuation Diffusion Model for Low-Light Image Enhancement and Denoising

author.name: Ying Liu, Junchao Zhang, Caiyun Wu

entry.summary: Proposes SADM, a single-stage diffusion model for low-light image enhancement that integrates signal attenuation into the diffusion process, enabling simultaneous brightness enhancement and denoising.

entry.title: AICA-Bench: Holistically Examining the Capabilities of VLMs in Affective Image Content Analysis

author.name: Dong She, Xianrong Yao, Liqun Chen, Jinghe Yu, Yang Gao, Zhanpeng Jin

entry.summary: Introduces AICA-Bench, a benchmark for affective image content analysis evaluating VLMs across emotion understanding, reasoning, and guided generation. Proposes Grounded Affective Tree prompting as training-free improvement.

entry.title: Synchronous Observer Design for Landmark-Inertial SLAM with Magnetometer and Intermittent GNSS Measurements

author.name: Arkadeep Saha, Pieter van Goor, Ravi Banavar

entry.summary: Designs a nonlinear observer for Landmark-Inertial SLAM that overcomes unobservability of global position and yaw by incorporating intermittent GNSS and magnetometer measurements. Proves almost-globally asymptotically stable error dynamics.

entry.title: High-dimensional reliability-based design optimization using stochastic emulators

author.name: M. Moustapha, B. Sudret

entry.summary: Proposes a reliability-based design optimization framework using stochastic emulators for high-dimensional settings, treating the limit-state function and input uncertainty as a unified stochastic representation rather than nested optimization-reliability problems.

entry.title: The word "agent" is ambiguous.

author.name: Jackson Hurley

entry.summary: Argues that the word 'agent' is dangerously ambiguous in AI discourse, distinguishing agents by who they serve (an agency, a principal, or themselves) and by their degree of autonomous action-taking. Maps this taxonomy to current AI systems.

entry.title: Part-Level 3D Gaussian Vehicle Generation with Joint and Hinge Axis Estimation

author.name: Shiyao Qian, Yuan Ren, Dongfeng Bai, Bingbing Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a generative framework for creating animatable 3D Gaussian vehicle models from single or sparse multi-view images, with part-level articulation and joint/hinge axis estimation for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: Reason Analogically via Cross-domain Prior Knowledge: An Empirical Study of Cross-domain Knowledge Transfer for In-Context Learning

author.name: Le Liu, Zhiming Li, Jianzhi Yan, Zike Yuan, Shiwei Chen, Youcheng Pan, Buzhou Tang, Qingcai Chen, Yang Xiang, Danny Dongning Sun

entry.summary: Empirical study of cross-domain knowledge transfer in in-context learning, identifying an absorption threshold beyond which positive transfer becomes likely. Companion paper to the domain-invariant neurons work.

entry.title: HYVE: Hybrid Views for LLM Context Engineering over Machine Data

author.name: Jian Tan, Fan Bu, Yuqing Gao, Dev Khanolkar, Jason Mackay, Boris Sobolev, Lei Jin, Li Zhang

entry.summary: HYVE is a framework for LLM context engineering over machine data (logs, metrics, JSON), inspired by database management principles. Uses request-scoped datastores to handle long, nested, repetitive structured payloads.

entry.title: UniCreative: Unifying Long-form Logic and Short-form Sparkle via Reference-Free Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xiaolong Wei, Zerun Zhu, Simin Niu, Xingyu Zhang, Peiying Yu, Changxuan Xiao, Yuchen Li, Jicheng Yang, Zhejun Zhao, Chong Meng, Long Xia, Daiting Shi

entry.summary: UniCreative proposes a reference-free RL framework for creative writing that reconciles global coherence in long-form narratives with local expressiveness in short-form text, using an adaptive constraint-aware reward model.

entry.title: Experience Transfer for Multimodal LLM Agents in Minecraft Game

author.name: Chenghao Li, Jun Liu, Songbo Zhang, Huadong Jian, Hao Ni, Lik-Hang Lee, Sung-Ho Bae, Guoqing Wang, Yang Yang, Chaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Echo introduces a transfer-oriented memory framework for Minecraft LLM agents that decomposes reusable knowledge into five dimensions (structure, attribute, process, function, interaction) for cross-task experience transfer.

entry.title: SignalClaw: LLM-Guided Evolutionary Synthesis of Interpretable Traffic Signal Control Skills

author.name: Da Lei, Feng Xiao, Lu Li, Yuzhan Liu

entry.summary: SignalClaw uses LLMs as evolutionary skill generators for traffic signal control, producing interpretable control policies with rationale, selection guidance, and executable code. Natural language feedback guides evolution.

entry.title: JTON: A Token-Efficient JSON Superset with Zen Grid Tabular Encoding for Large Language Models

author.name: Gowthamkumar Nandakishore

entry.summary: JTON (JSON Tabular Object Notation) is a strict JSON superset that reduces token counts by 15-60% for tabular data by factoring column headers into a single row, with minimal impact on LLM comprehension.

entry.title: Prune-Quantize-Distill: An Ordered Pipeline for Efficient Neural Network Compression

author.name: Longsheng Zhou, Yu Shen

entry.summary: Studies a practical ordered compression pipeline (prune-quantize-distill) for neural networks, finding that INT8 quantization provides the dominant runtime speedup while unstructured pruning mainly helps storage without reliably accelerating CPU inference.

entry.title: DQA: Diagnostic Question Answering for IT Support

author.name: Vishaal Kapoor, Mariam Dundua, Sarthak Ahuja, Neda Kordjazi, Evren Yortucboylu, Vaibhavi Padala, Derek Ho, Jennifer Whitted, Rebecca Steinert

entry.summary: Introduces DQA, a diagnostic question-answering framework for IT support that maintains persistent diagnostic state and aggregates retrieved cases by root causes rather than individual documents, improving multi-turn diagnostic accuracy.

entry.title: Human Interaction-Aware 3D Reconstruction from a Single Image

author.name: Gwanghyun Kim, Junghun James Kim, Suh Yoon Jeon, Jason Park, Se Young Chun

entry.summary: A method for reconstructing 3D human models from single images that explicitly handles multi-person scenes with interactions, addressing artifacts like unrealistic overlaps and missing geometry in occluded regions through group-level and instance-level modeling.

entry.title: Semantic-Topological Graph Reasoning for Language-Guided Pulmonary Screening

author.name: Chenyu Xue, Yiran Liu, Mian Zhou, Jionglong Su, Zhixiang Lu

entry.summary: STGR framework for language-guided pulmonary screening that combines LLaMA-3-V reasoning with MedSAM segmentation through semantic-topological graph reasoning, addressing clinical report ambiguity and anatomical overlap.

entry.title: From Incomplete Architecture to Quantified Risk: Multimodal LLM-Driven Security Assessment for Cyber-Physical Systems

author.name: Shaofei Huang, Christopher M. Poskitt, Lwin Khin Shar

entry.summary: ASTRAL uses multimodal LLMs to perform architecture-centric security threat assessment for cyber-physical systems with incomplete documentation, automatically reconstructing and completing architectural information.

entry.title: "OK Aura, Be Fair With Me": Demographics-Agnostic Training for Bias Mitigation in Wake-up Word Detection

author.name: Fernando L\'opez, Paula Delgado-Santos, Pablo G\'omez, David Solans, Jordi Luque

entry.summary: Evaluates demographics-agnostic training techniques (data augmentation and knowledge distillation from foundation models) for mitigating bias in wake-up word detection across sex, age, and accent groups.

entry.title: "I See What You Did There": Can Large Vision-Language Models Understand Multimodal Puns?

author.name: Naen Xu, Jiayi Sheng, Changjiang Li, Chunyi Zhou, Yuyuan Li, Tianyu Du, Jun Wang, Zhihui Fu, Jinbao Li, Shouling Ji

entry.summary: MultiPun benchmark tests whether vision-language models can understand multimodal puns by distinguishing genuine puns from adversarial non-pun distractors. Most models struggle with this task.

entry.title: LLM4CodeRE: Generative AI for Code Decompilation Analysis and Reverse Engineering

author.name: Hamed Jelodar, Samita Bai, Tochukwu Emmanuel Nwankwo, Parisa Hamedi, Mohammad Meymani, Roozbeh Razavi-Far, Ali A. Ghorbani

entry.summary: LLM4CodeRE is a domain-adaptive framework for bidirectional code reverse engineering (assembly-to-source and source-to-assembly) with multi-adapter and hybrid fine-tuning strategies for malware analysis.

entry.title: Shot-Based Quantum Encoding: A Data-Loading Paradigm for Quantum Neural Networks

author.name: Basil Kyriacou, Viktoria Patapovich, Maniraman Periyasamy, Alexey Melnikov

entry.summary: Shot-Based Quantum Encoding (SBQE) distributes measurement shots across data-dependent initial states for quantum machine learning, treating shot counts as learnable parameters to produce mixed-state representations.

entry.title: Territory Paint Wars: Diagnosing and Mitigating Failure Modes in Competitive Multi-Agent PPO

author.name: Diyansha Singh

entry.summary: Uses a minimal competitive multi-agent RL environment to systematically diagnose five implementation-level failure modes of PPO under self-play, then uncovers emergent pathological behaviors after fixing them.

entry.title: Cross-Machine Anomaly Detection Leveraging Pre-trained Time-series Model

author.name: Yangmeng Li, Kei Sano, Toshihiro Kitao, Ryoji Anzaki, Yukiya Saitoh, Hironori Moki, Dragan Djurdjanovic

entry.summary: Proposes a cross-machine anomaly detection framework combining a pre-trained foundation model (MOMENT) with domain-invariant feature extraction for manufacturing quality control across different machines.

entry.title: Modeling Patient Care Trajectories with Transformer Hawkes Processes

author.name: Saumya Pandey, Varun Chandola

entry.summary: Applies Transformer Hawkes Process to model patient healthcare trajectories as irregularly time-stamped events, with an imbalance-aware training strategy for predicting future care needs.

entry.title: Gated-SwinRMT: Unifying Swin Windowed Attention with Retentive Manhattan Decay via Input-Dependent Gating

author.name: Dipan Maity, Suman Mondal, Arindam Roy

entry.summary: Introduces Gated-SwinRMT, hybrid vision transformers combining Swin Transformer windowed attention with RetNet Manhattan-distance spatial decay and input-dependent gating, with sigmoid and SwiGLU variants.

entry.title: R3PM-Net: Real-time, Robust, Real-world Point Matching Network

author.name: Yasaman Kashefbahrami, Erkut Akdag, Panagiotis Meletis, Evgeniya Balmashnova, Dip Goswami, Egor Bondarau

entry.summary: Introduces R3PM-Net, a lightweight point matching network for real-world point cloud registration, along with two new datasets for industrial scenarios.

entry.title: Parametric Nonconvex Optimization via Convex Surrogates

author.name: Renzi Wang, Panagiotis Patrinos, Alberto Bemporad

entry.summary: Proposes a learning-based approach to construct convex surrogates for parametric nonconvex optimization problems through parallel convex optimization.

entry.title: Faster Superword Tokenization

author.name: Craig W. Schmidt, Chris Tanner, Yuval Pinter

entry.summary: Dramatically speeds up superword tokenization training (BoundlessBPE/SuperBPE) by aggregating supermerge candidates by frequency, reducing training time from days to practical levels.

entry.title: BiMind: A Dual-Head Reasoning Model with Attention-Geometry Adapter for Incorrect Information Detection

author.name: Zhongxing Zhang, Emily K. Vraga, Jisu Huh, Jaideep Srivastava

entry.summary: Proposes BiMind, a dual-head reasoning framework for misinformation detection with an attention geometry adapter and self-retrieval knowledge mechanism, addressing attention collapse in content verification.

entry.title: GESS: Multi-cue Guided Local Feature Learning via Geometric and Semantic Synergy

author.name: Yang Yi, Xieyuanli Chen, Jinpu Zhang, Hui Shen, Dewen Hu

entry.summary: Proposes GESS, a multi-cue guided local feature learning framework that uses semantic and geometric cues to enhance keypoint detection robustness and descriptor discriminability through joint prediction heads.

entry.title: LUMOS: Universal Semi-Supervised OCT Retinal Layer Segmentation with Hierarchical Reliable Mutual Learning

author.name: Yizhou Fang, Jian Zhong, Li Lin, Xiaoying Tang

entry.summary: Presents LUMOS, a semi-supervised OCT retinal layer segmentation framework that handles cross-granularity supervision through a dual-decoder network with hierarchical prompting and progressive multi-granularity learning.

entry.title: LSGS-Loc: Towards Robust 3DGS-Based Visual Localization for Large-Scale UAV Scenarios

author.name: Xiang Zhang, Tengfei Wang, Fang Xu, Xin Wang, Zongqian Zhan

entry.summary: Proposes LSGS-Loc, a visual localization pipeline for large-scale UAV scenarios using 3D Gaussian Splatting with scale-aware pose initialization and rendering artifact robustness.

entry.title: WRF4CIR: Weight-Regularized Fine-Tuning Network for Composed Image Retrieval

author.name: Yizhuo Xu, Chaojian Yu, Yuanjie Shao, Tongliang Liu, Qinmu Peng, Xinge You

entry.summary: Introduces WRF4CIR for Composed Image Retrieval, applying adversarial weight perturbations during fine-tuning to address severe overfitting in VLP-based CIR methods. Includes systematic study of overfitting in CIR.

entry.title: Purify-then-Align: Towards Robust Human Sensing under Modality Missing with Knowledge Distillation from Noisy Multimodal Teacher

author.name: Pengcheng Weng (School of Software Engineering, Xi'an Jiaotong University, China, Institute of Computer Science, University of Bern, Switzerland), Yanyu Qian (School of Software Engineering, Xi'an Jiaotong University, China, College of Computing and Data Science, Nanyang Technological University, Singapore), Yangxin Xu (School of Software Engineering, Xi'an Jiaotong University, China), Fei Wang (School of Software Engineering, Xi'an Jiaotong University, China)

entry.summary: Proposes PTA, a 'Purify-then-Align' framework for multimodal human sensing with missing modalities, using meta-learning to purify noisy knowledge sources before alignment via knowledge diffusion.

entry.title: Sparsity-Aware Voxel Attention and Foreground Modulation for 3D Semantic Scene Completion

author.name: Yu Xue, Longjun Gao, Yuanqi Su, HaoAng Lu, Xiaoning Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes VoxSAMNet for monocular semantic scene completion, addressing extreme voxel sparsity (93%+ empty) through sparsity-aware attention and foreground modulation for rare categories.

entry.title: Extending ZACH-ViT to Robust Medical Imaging: Corruption and Adversarial Stress Testing in Low-Data Regimes

author.name: Athanasios Angelakis, Marta Gomez-Barrero

entry.summary: Extends the ZACH-ViT compact Vision Transformer for medical imaging by conducting the first robustness evaluation under image corruptions and adversarial attacks, particularly in low-data regimes. Tests whether the architectural design choices (no positional embeddings, no class token) confer robustness advantages.

entry.title: Leaderless Collective Motion in Affine Formation Control over the Complex Plane

author.name: Jesus Bautista, Enric Morella, Lili Wang, Hector Garcia de Marina

entry.summary: Proposes a leaderless collective motion method for robot swarms using modified Laplacian matrix weights, enabling diverse affine transformations (translations, rotations, scaling, shearing) without designated leader agents.

entry.title: A Co-Design Framework for High-Performance Jumping of a Five-Bar Monoped with Actuator Optimization

author.name: Aastha Mishra, Aman Singh, Shishir Kolathaya

entry.summary: Presents a co-design framework for a closed-chain five-bar monoped that jointly optimizes mechanical design, motor/gearbox parameters, and control for dynamic jumping, maximizing jump distance while minimizing energy consumption.

entry.title: Labor Automation Tournament — $35,000 in prizes, hub launching April 20

author.name: ChristianWilliams

entry.summary: Metaculus announces a $35,000 forecasting tournament on labor automation with 93 questions covering occupation-level employment, wages, AI adoption rates, and macro labor indicators through 2030 and 2035. A public forecasting hub will launch April 20 to aggregate predictions.

entry.title: Non-monotonic causal discovery with Kolmogorov-Arnold Fuzzy Cognitive Maps

author.name: Jose L. Salmeron

entry.summary: Proposes Kolmogorov-Arnold Fuzzy Cognitive Maps (KA-FCM) that replace static scalar weights with learnable univariate activation functions for modeling non-monotonic causal dependencies in dynamic systems.

entry.title: Automated Auditing of Hospital Discharge Summaries for Care Transitions

author.name: Akshat Dasula, Prasanna Desikan, Jaideep Srivastava

entry.summary: Automated framework for auditing hospital discharge summaries using locally deployed LLMs, operationalizing the DISCHARGED framework into structured validation checklists applied to MIMIC-IV data.

entry.title: OntoTKGE: Ontology-Enhanced Temporal Knowledge Graph Extrapolation

author.name: Dongying Lin, Yinan Liu, Shengwei tang, Bin Wang, Xiaochun Yang

entry.summary: OntoTKGE leverages ontological knowledge to enhance temporal knowledge graph extrapolation, enabling entities with sparse historical interactions to inherit behavioral patterns from entities sharing the same ontological concepts.

entry.title: OmniDiagram: Advancing Unified Diagram Code Generation via Visual Interrogation Reward

author.name: Haoyue Yang, Xuanle Zhao, Xuexin Liu, Feibang Jiang, Yao Zhu

entry.summary: OmniDiagram unifies diagram code generation across diverse diagram types and languages, using Visual Interrogation (VIVA) as a reward signal that evaluates rendered visual structure rather than syntax-based matching.

entry.title: A canonical generalization of OBDD

author.name: Florent Capelli, YooJung Choi, Stefan Mengel, Mart\'in Mu\~noz, Guy Van den Broeck

entry.summary: Introduces Tree Decision Diagrams (TDD) as a canonical generalization of OBDD for Boolean functions, showing they enjoy the same tractability properties while being more succinct, especially for bounded-treewidth formulas.

entry.title: Beyond Behavior: Why AI Evaluation Needs a Cognitive Revolution

author.name: Amir Konigsberg

entry.summary: Argues that AI evaluation should move beyond behavioral tests (Turing test lineage) to assess internal processes and mechanisms, drawing on cognitive science methodologies.

entry.title: QA-MoE: Towards a Continuous Reliability Spectrum with Quality-Aware Mixture of Experts for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Yitong Zhu, Yuxuan Jiang, Guanxuan Jiang, Bojing Hou, Peng Yuan Zhou, Ge Lin Kan, Yuyang Wang

entry.summary: QA-MoE addresses multimodal sentiment analysis under varying modality reliability using a Quality-Aware Mixture-of-Experts framework that quantifies reliability via self-supervised aleatoric uncertainty.

entry.title: Joint Knowledge Base Completion and Question Answering by Combining Large Language Models and Small Language Models

author.name: Yinan Liu, Dongying Lin, Sigang Luo, Xiaochun Yang, Bin Wang

entry.summary: JCQL combines LLMs and small language models for joint knowledge base completion and question answering, using iterative mutual reinforcement between the two tasks.

entry.title: Inclusion-of-Thoughts: Mitigating Preference Instability via Purifying the Decision Space

author.name: Mohammad Reza Ghasemi Madani, Soyeon Caren Han, Shuo Yang, Jey Han Lau

entry.summary: Proposes Inclusion-of-Thoughts (IoT), a progressive self-filtering strategy for MCQ evaluation that reconstructs questions using only plausible options, helping LLMs focus on viable answers rather than being distracted by plausible distractors.

entry.title: Generalizable Audio-Visual Navigation via Binaural Difference Attention and Action Transition Prediction

author.name: Jia Li, Yinfeng Yu

entry.summary: Proposes BDATP framework for audio-visual navigation that models interaural differences for spatial orientation and uses action transition prediction for policy regularization, improving generalization to unseen environments.

entry.title: PCA-Driven Adaptive Sensor Triage for Edge AI Inference

author.name: Ankit Hemant Lade, Sai Krishna Jasti, Nikhil Sinha, Indar Kumar, Akanksha Tiwari

entry.summary: Proposes PCA-Triage, a streaming algorithm that uses incremental PCA to determine per-channel sampling rates for multi-channel sensor networks under bandwidth constraints. Achieves F1=0.961 at 50% bandwidth with zero trainable parameters.

entry.title: AutoLALA: Automatic Loop Algebraic Locality Analysis for AI and HPC Kernels

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Yekai Pan, Yanghui Wu, Chen Ding

entry.summary: Presents AutoLALA, an open-source tool for analyzing data locality in loop-based programs used in AI and HPC workloads. Produces closed-form symbolic formulas for reuse distance and data movement complexity.

entry.title: Simultaneous Dual-View Mammogram Synthesis Using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models

author.name: Jorge Alberto Garza-Abdala, Gerardo A. Fumagal-Gonz\'alez, Eduardo de Avila-Armenta, Sadam Hussain, Jasiel H. Toscano-Mart\'inezb, Diana S. M. Rosales Gurmendi, Alma A. Pedro-P\'erez, Jose G. Tamez-Pena

entry.summary: Proposes a three-channel DDPM for simultaneously generating paired CC and MLO mammographic views, using the absolute difference between views as a third channel to enforce anatomical consistency.

entry.title: What Makes a Good Response? An Empirical Analysis of Quality in Qualitative Interviews

author.name: Jonathan Ivey, Anjalie Field, Ziang Xiao

entry.summary: Empirically analyzes 10 proposed measures of qualitative interview response quality using a new corpus of 343 interview transcripts. Finds that direct relevance to research questions is most predictive, while many proposed metrics are not validated.

entry.title: Anchored Cyclic Generation: A Novel Paradigm for Long-Sequence Symbolic Music Generation

author.name: Boyu Cao, Lekai Qian, Dehan Li, Haoyu Gu, Mingda Xu, Qi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Anchored Cyclic Generation (ACG) for long-sequence symbolic music generation, using anchor features from previously generated music to guide autoregressive generation and mitigate error accumulation.

entry.title: Bridging Natural Language and Microgrid Dynamics: A Context-Aware Simulator and Dataset

author.name: Tinko Sebastian Bartels, Ruixiang Wu, Xinyu Lu, Yikai Lu, Fanzeng Xia, Haoxiang Yang, Yue Chen, Tongxin Li

entry.summary: OpenCEM introduces the first open-source digital twin simulator and dataset that integrates natural language context (event schedules, logs, user intentions) with quantitative renewable energy dynamics for microgrid management.

entry.title: Multiscale Physics-Informed Neural Network for Complex Fluid Flows with Long-Range Dependencies

author.name: Prashant Kumar, Rajesh Ranjan

entry.summary: DDS-PINN uses domain decomposition with shifted sub-networks to solve multiscale Navier-Stokes equations, addressing long-range spatial dependencies with minimal supervision data.

entry.title: CAKE: Cloud Architecture Knowledge Evaluation of Large Language Models

author.name: Tim Lukas Adam, Phongsakon Mark Konrad, Riccardo Terrenzi, Florian Girardo Lukas, Rahime Yilmaz, Krzysztof Sierszecki, Serkan Ayvaz

entry.summary: CAKE benchmark evaluates LLMs' understanding of cloud-native software architecture with 188 expert-validated questions across Bloom's taxonomy levels and five cloud topics, testing 22 model configurations.

entry.title: Swiss-Bench 003: Evaluating LLM Reliability and Adversarial Security for Swiss Regulatory Contexts

author.name: Fatih Uenal

entry.summary: Swiss-Bench 003 evaluates LLM reliability and adversarial security in Swiss regulatory contexts across 808 items in four languages, adding reliability and adversarial security dimensions to the HAAS framework.

entry.title: Graph-PiT: Enhancing Structural Coherence in Part-Based Image Synthesis via Graph Priors

author.name: Junbin Zhang, Meng Cao, Feng Tan, Yikai Lin, Yuexian Zou

entry.summary: Graph-PiT uses graph neural networks to model structural dependencies between visual parts for image synthesis, representing parts as nodes with spatial-semantic edges for more coherent compositions.

entry.title: A Theory-guided Weighted $L^2$ Loss for solving the BGK model via Physics-informed neural networks

author.name: Gyounghun Ko, Sung-Jun Son, Seung Yeon Cho, Myeong-Su Lee

entry.summary: Proposes a velocity-weighted L² loss for physics-informed neural networks solving the BGK kinetic model, proving that minimizing this loss guarantees convergence of macroscopic moments that standard L² loss cannot ensure.

entry.title: Topological Characterization of Churn Flow and Unsupervised Correction to the Wu Flow-Regime Map in Small-Diameter Vertical Pipes

author.name: Brady Koenig, Sushovan Majhi, Atish Mitra, Abigail Stein, Burt Todd

entry.summary: Introduces the first topology-based characterization of churn flow in vertical two-phase systems using Euler Characteristic Surfaces and unsupervised multiple kernel learning, providing a mathematical definition after 40+ years.

entry.title: An Imbalanced Dataset with Multiple Feature Representations for Studying Quality Control of Next-Generation Sequencing

author.name: Philipp R\"ochner, Clarissa Kr\"amer, Johannes U Mayer, Franz Rothlauf, Steffen Albrecht, Maximilian Sprang

entry.summary: Presents a benchmark dataset of 37,491 NGS samples with multiple quality-related feature representations for developing automated quality control tools for next-generation sequencing.

entry.title: fastml: Guarded Resampling Workflows for Safer Automated Machine Learning in R

author.name: Selcuk Korkmaz, Dincer Goksuluk, Eda Karaismailoglu

entry.summary: Presents fastml, an R package for leakage-aware automated machine learning that ensures preprocessing is re-estimated inside each resample, preventing preprocessing leakage that inflates performance estimates.

entry.title: JD-BP: A Joint-Decision Generative Framework for Auto-Bidding and Pricing

author.name: Linghui Meng, Chun Gan, Shengsheng Niu, Chengcheng Zhang, Chenchen Li, Chuan Yang, Yi Mao, Xin Zhu, Jie He, Zhangang Lin, Ching Law

entry.summary: Proposes JD-BP, a generative framework that jointly optimizes bidding and pricing decisions for online advertising using a memory-less Return-to-Go mechanism and diffusion-based generation. Deployed at scale on an advertising platform.

entry.title: Ensemble-Based Dirichlet Modeling for Predictive Uncertainty and Selective Classification

author.name: Courtney Franzen, Farhad Pourkamali-Anaraki

entry.summary: Proposes an ensemble-based Dirichlet parameter estimation approach for predictive uncertainty and selective classification, combining multiple training runs to improve reliability over Evidential Deep Learning methods.

entry.title: A Large-Scale Empirical Comparison of Meta-Learners and Causal Forests for Heterogeneous Treatment Effect Estimation in Marketing Uplift Modeling

author.name: Aman Singh

entry.summary: Presents UpliftBench, an empirical comparison of meta-learners and causal forests for heterogeneous treatment effect estimation at industrial scale using the Criteo dataset with 13.98M records. S-Learner achieves best Qini score.

entry.title: SenseAI: A Human-in-the-Loop Dataset for RLHF-Aligned Financial Sentiment Reasoning

author.name: Berny Kabalisa

entry.summary: Introduces SenseAI, a human-in-the-loop financial sentiment dataset with reasoning chains, confidence scores, and correction signals for RLHF-aligned fine-tuning. Identifies 'Latent Reasoning Drift' as a new failure mode.

entry.title: PhageBench: Can LLMs Understand Raw Bacteriophage Genomes?

author.name: Yusen Hou, Weicai Long, Haitao Hu, Houcheng Su, Junning Feng, Yanlin Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces PhageBench, the first benchmark for evaluating LLMs on raw bacteriophage genome understanding across five tasks mirroring bioinformatics expert workflows.

entry.title: LoRM: Learning the Language of Rotating Machinery for Self-Supervised Condition Monitoring

author.name: Xiao Qin, Xingyi Song, Tong Liu, Hatim Laalej, Zepeng Liu, Yunpeng Zhu, Ligang He

entry.summary: Presents LoRM, a self-supervised framework that treats rotating machinery signals as a machine language, tokenizing sensor data and using sequence prediction for condition monitoring without labeled data.

entry.title: Paper Circle: An Open-source Multi-agent Research Discovery and Analysis Framework

author.name: Komal Kumar, Aman Chadha, Salman Khan, Fahad Shahbaz Khan, Hisham Cholakkal

entry.summary: Introduces Paper Circle, an open-source multi-agent system for research discovery and analysis with discovery and analysis pipelines that integrate retrieval, scoring, ranking, and structured literature review.

entry.title: GenomeQA: Benchmarking General Large Language Models for Genome Sequence Understanding

author.name: Weicai Long, Yusen Hou, Junning Feng, Houcheng Su, Shuo Yang, Donglin Xie, Yanlin Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces GenomeQA, a benchmark of 5,200 samples for evaluating general-purpose LLMs on sequence-based genome inference tasks, providing controlled evaluation of LLMs when exposed to raw genome sequences.

entry.title: Beyond Paper-to-Paper: Structured Profiling and Rubric Scoring for Paper-Reviewer Matching

author.name: Yicheng Pan, Zhiyuan Ning, Ludi Wang, Yi Du

entry.summary: Proposes P2R, a training-free framework for paper-reviewer matching that creates structured profiles for both submissions and reviewers, disentangling expertise into Topics, Methodologies, and Applications.

entry.title: Lightweight True In-Pixel Encryption with FeFET Enabled Pixel Design for Secure Imaging

author.name: Md Rahatul Islam Udoy, Diego Ferrer, Wantong Li, Kai Ni, Sumeet Kumar Gupta, Ahmedullah Aziz

entry.summary: Introduces SecurePix, a CMOS-compatible pixel architecture that performs true in-pixel encryption using ferroelectric FET non-volatile states. Achieves compact 2.33x3.01 um² pixel pitch with symmetric-key encryption before pixel readout.

entry.title: Active Measurement of Two-Point Correlations

author.name: Max Hamilton, Daniel Sheldon, Subhransu Maji

entry.summary: Presents a human-in-the-loop framework for efficiently estimating two-point correlation functions over large point sets by using a pre-trained classifier to guide sampling and adaptively select points for human annotation.

entry.title: A Synthetic Eye Movement Dataset for Script Reading Detection: Real Trajectory Replay on a 3D Simulator

author.name: Kidus Zewde, Yuchen Zhou, Dennis Ng, Neo Tiangratanakul, Tommy Duong, Ankit Raj, Yuxin Zhang, Xingyu Shen, Simiao Ren

entry.summary: Introduces infrastructure for generating synthetic eye movement datasets using a 3D simulator that replays real eye trajectories, addressing the scarcity of video-based behavioral data for training models.

entry.title: Geometrical Cross-Attention and Nonvoid Voxelization for Efficient 3D Medical Image Segmentation

author.name: Chenxin Yuan, Shoupeng Chen, Haojiang Ye, Yiming Miao, Limei Peng, Pin-Han Ho

entry.summary: Proposes GCNV-Net for 3D medical segmentation with geometrical cross-attention and nonvoid voxelization, dynamically partitioning relevant voxels along three anatomical planes.

entry.title: Evaluation Before Generation: A Paradigm for Robust Multimodal Sentiment Analysis with Missing Modalities

author.name: Rongfei Chen, Tingting Zhang, Xiaoyu Shen, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for robust multimodal sentiment analysis with missing modalities, introducing a Missing Modality Evaluator to assess importance before generation and exploring structural dependencies among multimodal prompts.

entry.title: BPC-Net: Annotation-Free Skin Lesion Segmentation via Boundary Probability Calibration

author.name: Yujie Yao, Yuhaohang He, Junjie Huang, Zhou Liu, Jiangzhao Li, Yan Qiao, Wen Xiao, Yunsen Liang, Xiaofan Li

entry.summary: Proposes BPC-Net for annotation-free skin lesion segmentation, focusing on boundary probability calibration to address under-confidence at lesion boundaries, a problem previously overlooked by pseudo-label denoising methods.

entry.title: SGANet: Semantic and Geometric Alignment for Multimodal Multi-view Anomaly Detection

author.name: Letian Bai, Chengyu Tao, Juan Du

entry.summary: Proposes SGANet for multimodal multi-view anomaly detection, combining semantic and geometric alignment to learn consistent feature representations across viewpoints and modalities.

entry.title: RHVI-FDD: A Hierarchical Decoupling Framework for Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Junhao Yang, Bo Yang, Hongwei Ge, Yanchun Liang, Heow Pueh Lee, Chunguo Wu

entry.summary: Proposes RHVI-FDD, a hierarchical decoupling framework for low-light image enhancement that separates luminance/chrominance at macro level and noise/details at micro level through frequency-domain processing.

entry.title: Mixture-of-Modality-Experts with Holistic Token Learning for Fine-Grained Multimodal Visual Analytics in Driver Action Recognition

author.name: Tianyi Liu, Yiming Li, Wenqian Wang, Jiaojiao Wang, Chen Cai, Yi Wang, Kim-Hui Yap

entry.summary: Proposes MoME framework with Holistic Token Learning for driver action recognition, enabling adaptive collaboration among modality-specific experts with both intra-expert refinement and inter-expert knowledge transfer.

entry.title: Bilinear Model Predictive Control Framework of the OncoReach, a Tendon-Driven Steerable Stylet for Brachytherapy

author.name: Pejman Kheradmand, Behnam Moradkhani, Mir Masoud Ale Ali, Keith Sowards, Scott R. Silva, Yash Chitalia

entry.summary: Presents a bilinear model predictive control framework for a tendon-driven steerable stylet for brachytherapy, compatible with standard clinical needles. Formulates a geometric bilinear model mapping virtual inputs to physically realizable tendon tensions.

entry.title: Simulation-Driven Evolutionary Motion Parameterization for Contact-Rich Granular Scooping with a Soft Conical Robotic Hand

author.name: Yongliang Wang, Cristian C. Beltran-Hernandez, Tomoya Takahashi, Masashi Hamaya

entry.summary: Develops a physics-based simulation for soft robotic scooping with a conical hand, using evolutionary optimization to parameterize scooping motions for granular materials. Addresses the control complexity inherent in soft robotic end-effectors.

entry.title: Hazard Management in Robot-Assisted Mammography Support

author.name: Ioannis Stefanakos, Roisin Bradley, Radu Calinescu, Beverley Townsend, Tianyuan Wang, Jihong Zhu

entry.summary: Presents a hazard management methodology for MammoBot, a robotic mammography assistant, combining SHARD and STPA safety analysis methods with stakeholder-guided process modeling to identify and mitigate risks in robot-patient interactions.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Neural Optimal Control for Precision Immobilization Technique in Emergency Scenarios

author.name: Yangye Jiang, Jiachen Wang, Daofei Li

entry.summary: Presents PicoPINN, a compact physics-informed neural network for automating Precision Immobilization Technique (PIT) maneuvers for stopping out-of-control vehicles. Uses knowledge distillation and a hierarchical optimal control architecture.

entry.title: “Alignment” and “Safety”, part one: What is “AI Safety”?

author.name: David Scott Krueger (formerly: capybaralet)

entry.summary: David Krueger, a well-known AI safety researcher, traces the evolving and often confusing usage of the terms 'AI Safety' and 'AI Alignment' over time, noting how different communities have adopted, rejected, and redefined these terms. This is the first of a two-part series examining how terminological confusion creates real coordination problems in the field.

entry.title: Lightweight Multimodal Adaptation of Vision Language Models for Species Recognition and Habitat Context Interpretation in Drone Thermal Imagery

author.name: Hao Chen, Fang Qiu, Fangchao Dong, Defei Yang, Eve Bohnett, Li An

entry.summary: Proposes lightweight multimodal adaptation to bridge the gap between RGB-pretrained VLMs and thermal infrared drone imagery for wildlife species recognition and habitat context, evaluating InternVL3, Qwen2.5-VL, and Qwen3-VL models.

entry.title: SCMAPR: Self-Correcting Multi-Agent Prompt Refinement for Complex-Scenario Text-to-Video Generation

author.name: Chengyi Yang, Pengzhen Li, Jiayin Qi, Aimin Zhou, Ji Wu, Ji Liu

entry.summary: SCMAPR is a multi-agent prompt refinement framework for text-to-video generation that routes prompts through taxonomy-grounded scenarios, performs policy-conditioned refinement, and applies structured semantic verification.

entry.title: ActivityEditor: Learning to Synthesize Physically Valid Human Mobility

author.name: Chenjie Yang, Yutian Jiang, Anqi Liang, Wei Qi, Chenyu Wu, Junbo Zhang

entry.summary: ActivityEditor is a dual-LLM-agent framework for zero-shot cross-regional trajectory generation, decomposing mobility synthesis into intention generation from demographic priors and trajectory refinement.

entry.title: From Large Language Model Predicates to Logic Tensor Networks: Neurosymbolic Offer Validation in Regulated Procurement

author.name: Cedric Haufe, Frieder Stolzenburg

entry.summary: Combines LLM-based information extraction with Logic Tensor Networks for neurosymbolic validation of offer documents in regulated public procurement, enabling auditable, legally verifiable decisions.

entry.title: CuraLight: Debate-Guided Data Curation for LLM-Centered Traffic Signal Control

author.name: Qing Guo, Xinhang Li, Junyu Chen, Zheng Guo, Shengzhe Xu, Lin Zhang, Lei Li

entry.summary: CuraLight uses an RL agent to generate high-quality interaction data for fine-tuning an LLM-based traffic signal controller, with a multi-LLM ensemble deliberation system for data curation.

entry.title: Extending Tabular Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Time-Series Data Generation

author.name: Umang Dobhal, Christina Garcia, Sozo Inoue

entry.summary: Proposes temporal extensions to TabDDPM for generating synthetic time-series data, adding temporal adapters and context-aware embedding modules to handle the temporal dependencies that the original model ignores.

entry.title: MA-IDS: Multi-Agent RAG Framework for IoT Network Intrusion Detection with an Experience Library

author.name: Md Shamimul Islam, Luis G. Jaimes, Ayesha S. Dina

entry.summary: MA-IDS uses a multi-agent LLM system with RAG and a self-building Experience Library for IoT network intrusion detection, addressing zero-day attacks and interpretability limitations of traditional approaches.

entry.title: CRFT: Consistent-Recurrent Feature Flow Transformer for Cross-Modal Image Registration

author.name: Xuecong Liu, Mengzhu Ding, Zixuan Sun, Zhang Li, Xichao Teng

entry.summary: CRFT is a coarse-to-fine framework for cross-modal image registration that learns modality-independent feature flow representations using a transformer architecture with iterative spatial geometric transforms.

entry.title: Learning to Synergize Semantic and Geometric Priors for Limited-Data Wheat Disease Segmentation

author.name: Shijie Wang, Zijian Wang, Yadan Luo, Scott Chapman, Xin Yu, Zi Huang

entry.summary: Proposes SGPer for wheat disease segmentation under limited data, combining DINOv2 semantic priors with SAM boundary localization to handle appearance shifts across crop growth stages.

entry.title: Prior-guided Fusion of Multimodal Features for Change Detection from Optical-SAR Images

author.name: Xuanguang Liu, Lei Ding, Yujie Li, Chenguang Dai, Zhenchao Zhang, Mengmeng Li, Ziyi Yang, Yifan Sun, Yongqi Sun, Hanyun Wang

entry.summary: Proposes STSF-Net for multimodal change detection between optical and SAR remote sensing images, jointly modeling modality-specific and spatio-temporal common features.

entry.title: Towards Athlete Fatigue Assessment from Association Football Videos

author.name: Xavier Bou, Nathan Correger, Alexandre Cloots, C\'edric Gavage, Silvio Giancola, C\'edric Schwartz, Fran\c{c}ois Delvaux, Rudi Cloots, Marc Van Droogenbroeck, Anthony Cioppa

entry.summary: Studies whether monocular broadcast football videos can provide spatio-temporal signals for fatigue-oriented analysis, extracting player trajectories and proposing a kinematics processing algorithm for speed/acceleration estimation.

entry.title: SVC 2026: the Second Multimodal Deception Detection Challenge and the First Domain Generalized Remote Physiological Measurement Challenge

entry.summary: Describes a two-stage system for Latin dependency parsing using retrieved treebank examples to prompt an LLM for parse refinement, achieving significant improvements on poetry.

entry.title: Final Report, Center for Computer-Integrated Computer-Integrated Surgical Systems and Technology, NSF ERC Cooperative Agreement EEC9731748, Volume 1

author.name: Russell H. Taylor, Gregory D. Hager, Ralph Etienne-Cummings. Eric Grimson, Ron Kikinis, Cameron Riviere

entry.summary: Final report of the NSF Engineering Research Center for Computer-Integrated Surgical Systems and Technology (CISST ERC), documenting a decade of advances in medical robotics from 1998 onwards. Historical document rather than new research.

entry.title: eVTOL Aircraft Energy Overhead Estimation under Conflict Resolution in High-Density Airspaces

author.name: Alex Zongo, Peng Wei

entry.summary: Investigates energy overhead from conflict-resolution maneuvers for eVTOL aircraft in high-density airspace. Finds MVP-based deconfliction adds less than 1.5% energy overhead.

entry.title: Fantasy ideology

author.name: Ninety-Three

entry.summary: Republishes Lee Harris's 2002 essay on 'fantasy ideology' — political action motivated by dramatic self-expression rather than achieving practical goals. Not AI-related content.

entry.title: Don't write for LLMs, just record everything

author.name: RobertM

entry.summary: Argues against writing publicly to achieve LLM-mediated 'immortality' and instead suggests recording everything privately (audio, notes) to build personal AI tools. Evaluates the costs and benefits of public writing for future LLM utility.

entry.title: Every Lighthaven Writing Residency

author.name: Layla Hughes

entry.summary: A creative writing piece about attending a writing residency at Lighthaven (an EA/rationalist community space in Berkeley). Literary, personal, and observational — not research content.

entry.title: Untargeted analysis of volatile markers of post-exercise fat oxidation in exhaled breath

author.name: Andr\'e Homeyer, J\'ulia Blanka Szil\'adi, Jan-Philipp Redlich, Jonathan Beauchamp, Y Lan Pham

entry.summary: This paper performs untargeted screening for volatile organic compounds in exhaled breath as biomarkers for fat oxidation during exercise, using mass spectrometry. It's a biomedical/chemistry study with minimal ML relevance.

entry.title: Recommendations for an Effective Altruism Gap Year?

author.name: warner

entry.summary: A 20-year-old college student asks for advice on how to use a gap year for effective altruism, considering an internship in Kenya. A question post, not research content.

entry.title: Lorxus Does Budget Inkhaven Again: 04/01~04/07

author.name: Lorxus

entry.summary: Personal blog collection from a Lighthaven/Inkhaven writing residency participant, including pieces on quantitative finance background, Zendo game rules, and Quechuan agriculture. Creative/personal content.

entry.title: My Ethics

author.name: NickyP

entry.summary: A personal blog post where the author lays out their ethical views, including meta-ethical anti-realism, basic axioms about suffering and pleasure, and applications to various moral questions. Not research content.

entry.title: Research Summary: April 07, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research is dominated by a striking convergence of findings on human-AI interaction risks and AI safety mechanisms, alongside notable advances in biomedical AI and mathematical reasoning.

  • Two large-scale RCTs (N=1,222 and N=2,012) deliver causal evidence that AI assistance reduces human persistence and that LLM-driven commercial persuasion nearly triples sponsored product selection rates (61.2% vs 22.4%). A complementary study identifies a Persuasion Paradox where LLM explanations increase user confidence without improving accuracy.
  • Mechanistic interpretability advances with the discovery of sparse gate-amplifier routing circuits underlying alignment in LLMs, validated across multiple model families. A cryptographic result from Vaikuntanathan shows AI agents can conduct undetectable secret conversations via pseudorandom noise-resilient key exchange—a fundamental safety concern.
  • The first real-world safety audit of OpenClaw, a deployed personal AI agent, introduces the CIK taxonomy for evaluating agent risks at scale. A 10,000-trial taxonomy systematically maps which prompt features trigger LLM agents to exploit vulnerabilities.
  • In biomedical AI, STORM bridges spatial transcriptomics and histology across 1.2M profiles and 18 organs. QED-Nano demonstrates a 4B-parameter model achieving competitive theorem proving. Nobel laureate Acemoglu models how AI aggregation can destabilize social learning beyond a critical update-speed threshold.

entry.title: AI Assistance Reduces Persistence and Hurts Independent Performance

author.name: Grace Liu, Brian Christian, Tsvetomira Dumbalska, Michiel A. Bakker, Rachit Dubey

entry.summary: Through randomized controlled trials (N=1,222), provides causal evidence that AI assistance reduces human persistence and impairs unassisted performance across mathematical reasoning and reading tasks, showing current AI systems are 'short-sighted collaborators.'

entry.title: Commercial Persuasion in AI-Mediated Conversations

author.name: Francesco Salvi, Alejandro Cuevas, Manoel Horta Ribeiro

entry.summary: Two preregistered experiments (N=2,012) show LLM-driven commercial persuasion nearly triples sponsored product selection rates (61.2% vs 22.4% for search), while users remain largely unaware of the influence.

entry.title: A Multimodal Foundation Model of Spatial Transcriptomics and Histology for Biological Discovery and Clinical Prediction

author.name: Jinxi Xiang, Siyu Hou, Yuchen Li, Ryan Quinton, Xiaoming Zhang, Feyisope Eweje, Xiangde Luo, Yijiang Chen, Zhe Li, Colin Bergstrom, Ted Kim, Sierra Willens, Francesca Maria Olguin, Matthew Abikenari, Andrew Heider, Sanjeeth Rajaram, Joel Neal, Maximilian Diehn, Xiang Zhou, Ruijiang Li

entry.summary: Presents STORM, a foundation model trained on 1.2M spatially resolved transcriptomic profiles with matched histology across 18 organs, bridging imaging and omics through hierarchical morphological-molecular representations.

entry.title: QED-Nano: Teaching a Tiny Model to Prove Hard Theorems

author.name: LM-Provers, Yuxiao Qu, Amrith Setlur, Jasper Dekoninck, Edward Beeching, Jia Li, Ian Wu, Lewis Tunstall, Aviral Kumar

entry.summary: QED-Nano is a 4B parameter model post-trained for Olympiad-level mathematical proofs using a three-stage recipe: supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and curriculum learning. It demonstrates that small, open models can achieve competitive reasoning on hard mathematical problems.

entry.title: How Alignment Routes: Localizing, Scaling, and Controlling Policy Circuits in Language Models

author.name: Gregory N. Frank

entry.summary: Identifies a sparse routing mechanism in alignment-trained LLMs where gate attention heads detect content and trigger amplifier heads for refusal, validated across 9 models from 6 labs with rigorous statistical tests.

entry.title: Your Agent, Their Asset: A Real-World Safety Analysis of OpenClaw

author.name: Zijun Wang, Haoqin Tu, Letian Zhang, Hardy Chen, Juncheng Wu, Xiangyan Liu, Zhenlong Yuan, Tianyu Pang, Michael Qizhe Shieh, Fengze Liu, Zeyu Zheng, Huaxiu Yao, Yuyin Zhou, Cihang Xie

entry.summary: Presents the first real-world safety evaluation of OpenClaw, a widely deployed personal AI agent in early 2026, introducing the CIK taxonomy (Capability, Identity, Knowledge) and testing 12 attack scenarios across four backbone models including Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.

entry.title: Olmo Hybrid: From Theory to Practice and Back

author.name: William Merrill, Yanhong Li, Tyler Romero, Anej Svete, Caia Costello, Pradeep Dasigi, Dirk Groeneveld, David Heineman, Bailey Kuehl, Nathan Lambert, Jacob Morrison, Luca Soldaini, Finbarr Timbers, Pete Walsh, Noah A. Smith, Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Ashish Sabharwal

entry.summary: Introduces OLMo Hybrid, a 7B-parameter model mixing recurrence and attention, with theoretical and empirical evidence that hybrid models surpass both pure transformers and linear RNNs in expressivity, including code execution tasks.

entry.title: When Do Hallucinations Arise? A Graph Perspective on the Evolution of Path Reuse and Path Compression

author.name: Xinnan Dai, Kai Yang, Cheng Luo, Shenglai Zeng, Kai Guo, Jiliang Tang

entry.summary: Models LLM next-token prediction as graph search, identifying two mechanisms causing hallucinations: path reuse (shortcutting through familiar routes) and path compression (collapsing multi-hop reasoning). Provides a structural theory of when hallucinations arise.

entry.title: ShieldNet: Network-Level Guardrails against Emerging Supply-Chain Injections in Agentic Systems

author.name: Zhuowen Yuan, Zhaorun Chen, Zhen Xiang, Nathaniel D. Bastian, Seyyed Hadi Hashemi, Chaowei Xiao, Wenbo Guo, Bo Li

entry.summary: Introduces SC-Inject-Bench, a benchmark of 10,000+ malicious MCP tools covering 25+ attack types, and proposes ShieldNet for network-level defense against supply-chain attacks in agentic systems.

entry.title: The Persuasion Paradox: When LLM Explanations Fail to Improve Human-AI Team Performance

author.name: Ruth Cohen, Lu Feng, Ayala Bloch, Sarit Kraus

entry.summary: Identifies a 'Persuasion Paradox' where LLM explanations systematically increase user confidence and reliance on AI without reliably improving task accuracy, demonstrated across visual reasoning (RAVEN matrices) and logical reasoning (LSAT) tasks in three controlled studies.

entry.title: An Improved Last-Iterate Convergence Rate for Anchored Gradient Descent Ascent

author.name: Anja Surina, Arun Suggala, George Tsoukalas, Anton Kovsharov, Sergey Shirobokov, Francisco J. R. Ruiz, Pushmeet Kohli, Swarat Chaudhuri

entry.summary: Proves improved O(1/t) last-iterate convergence rate for Anchored Gradient Descent Ascent for convex-concave min-max problems, resolving an open question. Notably, the result was discovered by an AI system writing formal Lean proofs.

entry.title: Mapping the Exploitation Surface: A 10,000-Trial Taxonomy of What Makes LLM Agents Exploit Vulnerabilities

author.name: Charafeddine Mouzouni

entry.summary: Systematic taxonomy from ~10,000 trials mapping which prompt features trigger LLM agents to exploit security vulnerabilities, finding that only 3 of 12 hypothesized dimensions (authority framing, goal anchoring, euphemistic relabeling) are effective triggers.

entry.title: Undetectable Conversations Between AI Agents via Pseudorandom Noise-Resilient Key Exchange

author.name: Vinod Vaikuntanathan, Or Zamir

entry.summary: Shows that two AI agents can conduct secret parallel conversations producing transcripts computationally indistinguishable from honest interactions, even against strong passive auditors. Establishes that without a shared secret key, such covert communication is impossible under standard assumptions.

entry.title: Vero: An Open RL Recipe for General Visual Reasoning

author.name: Gabriel Sarch, Linrong Cai, Qunzhong Wang, Haoyang Wu, Danqi Chen, Zhuang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Vero, a family of fully open VLMs trained with RL across six task categories using 600K samples from 59 datasets. Achieves SOTA among open-weight models across diverse visual reasoning tasks with a transparent recipe.

entry.title: AIs can now often do massive easy-to-verify SWE tasks and I've updated towards shorter timelines

author.name: ryan_greenblatt

entry.summary: Ryan Greenblatt (Redwood Research) reports updating to ~30% probability of full AI R&D automation by EOY 2028 (up from ~15%). Expects AIs to achieve 50% reliability on massive easy-to-verify SWE tasks with years-to-decades time horizons by EOY 2026.

entry.title: Don't Blink: Evidence Collapse during Multimodal Reasoning

author.name: Suresh Raghu, Satwik Pandey

entry.summary: Discovers 'evidence collapse' in reasoning VLMs: attention to visual evidence regions drops substantially as reasoning progresses, creating confident but visually ungrounded predictions that text-only monitoring cannot detect.

entry.title: A Generative Foundation Model for Multimodal Histopathology

author.name: Jinxi Xiang, Mingjie Li, Siyu Hou, Yijiang Chen, Xiangde Luo, Yuanfeng Ji, Xiang Zhou, Ehsan Adeli, Akshay Chaudhari, Curtis P. Langlotz, Kilian M. Pohl, Ruijiang Li

entry.summary: MuPD is a generative foundation model for multimodal histopathology that embeds H&E histology, molecular RNA profiles, and clinical text into a shared latent space via diffusion transformer. Pretrained on 100 million+ data points for cross-modal generation and imputation.

entry.title: Justified or Just Convincing? Error Verifiability as a Dimension of LLM Quality

author.name: Xiaoyuan Zhu, Kimberly Le Truong, Riccardo Fogliato, Gokul Swamy, Weijian Zhang, Minglai Yang, Longtian Ye, Bangya Liu, Minghao Liu, Andrew Ilyas, Steven Wu

entry.summary: Formalizes 'error verifiability' - whether LLM justifications help users distinguish correct from incorrect answers - and proposes a balanced metric. Finds that common approaches like post-training and scaling don't improve verifiability.

entry.title: How AI Aggregation Affects Knowledge

author.name: Daron Acemoglu, Tianyi Lin, Asuman Ozdaglar, James Siderius

entry.summary: Studies how AI aggregation affects social learning using an extended DeGroot model. Shows a threshold effect: when an AI aggregator updates too quickly, it cannot robustly improve learning, but slow updating allows improvement.

entry.title: Self-Execution Simulation Improves Coding Models

author.name: Gallil Maimon, Ori Yoran, Felix Kreuk, Michael Hassid, Gal Cohen, Pierre Chambon, Yossi Adi

entry.summary: Demonstrates that Code LLMs can be trained to simulate program execution step-by-step using natural language execution traces and RL with verifiable rewards, improving competitive programming performance. Introduces output prediction and self-predicted execution objectives.

entry.title: Position: Science of AI Evaluation Requires Item-level Benchmark Data

author.name: Han Jiang, Susu Zhang, Xiaoyuan Yi, Xing Xie, Ziang Xiao

entry.summary: Argues that item-level benchmark data (individual question responses, not just aggregate scores) is essential for building a rigorous science of AI evaluation. Identifies systemic validity failures in current evaluation paradigms and proposes granular diagnostic analysis.

entry.title: Implementing surrogate goals for safer bargaining in LLM-based agents

author.name: Caspar Oesterheld, Maxime Rich\'e, Filip Sondej, Jesse Clifton, Vincent Conitzer

entry.summary: Implements surrogate goals in LLM-based agents to reduce bargaining failure risks. Tests whether agents can be made to care about proxy costs (e.g., money burning) to deflect threats from principal's actual interests.

entry.title: Why Attend to Everything? Focus is the Key

author.name: Hengshuai Yao, Xing Chen, Ahmed Murtadha, Jin Li, Shuai Shao, Yasin Abbasi Yadkori, Guan Wang, Mingli Yuan, William Chen, Sen Song

entry.summary: Introduces Focus, a method that learns which token pairs matter via learnable centroids, restricting distant attention to same-group pairs while maintaining local full-resolution attention. It's purely additive with frozen weights and improves perplexity from 124M to 70B scale.

entry.title: The Augmentation Trap: AI Productivity and the Cost of Cognitive Offloading

author.name: Michael Caosun, Sinan Aral

entry.summary: Develops a dynamic model analyzing the 'augmentation trap' where AI tools boost immediate productivity but erode worker expertise over time. Shows that rational adoption can lead to steady-state productivity loss, and that managerial myopia amplifies these costs.

entry.title: Three Phases of Expert Routing: How Load Balance Evolves During Mixture-of-Experts Training

author.name: Charafeddine Mouzouni

entry.summary: Models MoE token routing as a congestion game and identifies three distinct phases during training: surge, stabilization, and relaxation. Validates across OLMoE and OpenMoE checkpoints.

entry.title: Grokking as Dimensional Phase Transition in Neural Networks

author.name: Ping Wang

entry.summary: Characterizes neural network grokking as a dimensional phase transition where effective dimensionality crosses from sub-diffusive to super-diffusive at generalization onset, exhibiting self-organized criticality.

entry.title: Cog-DRIFT: Exploration on Adaptively Reformulated Instances Enables Learning from Hard Reasoning Problems

author.name: Justin Chih-Yao Chen, Archiki Prasad, Zaid Khan, Joykirat Singh, Runchu Tian, Elias Stengel-Eskin, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: Proposes Cog-DRIFT, which transforms hard open-ended reasoning problems into cognitively simpler variants (multiple-choice, cloze) to enable learning from problems too difficult for RLVR. Models bootstrap from easier formats to harder ones, achieving gains on math and science benchmarks.

entry.title: From Curiosity to Caution: Mitigating Reward Hacking for Best-of-N with Pessimism

author.name: Zhuohao Yu, Zhiwei Steven Wu, Adam Block

entry.summary: Addresses reward hacking in Best-of-N sampling for LLMs by proposing a pessimistic approach to reward model scoring. Shows that existing approaches (stronger reward models, distributional regularization) fail to reliably mitigate hacking as N increases.

entry.title: MinerU2.5-Pro: Pushing the Limits of Data-Centric Document Parsing at Scale

author.name: Bin Wang, Tianyao He, Linke Ouyang, Fan Wu, Zhiyuan Zhao, Tao Chu, Yuan Qu, Zhenjiang Jin, Weijun Zeng, Ziyang Miao, Bangrui Xu, Junbo Niu, Mengzhang Cai, Jiantao Qiu, Qintong Zhang, Dongsheng Ma, Yuefeng Sun, Hejun Dong, Wenzheng Zhang, Jutao Xiao, Jiayong Shi, Pengyu Liao, Xiaomeng Zhao, Huaping Zhong, Liqun Wei, Jing Yu, Jie Yang, Wei Li, Shasha Wang, Qianqian Wu, Xuanhe Zhou, Weijia Li, Zhenxiang Li, Zhongying Tu, Jiang Wu, Lijun Wu, Chao Xu, Kai Chen, Wentao Zhang, Yu Qiao, Bowen Zhou, Dahua Lin, Conghui He

entry.summary: Presents MinerU2.5-Pro, advancing document parsing SOTA purely through data engineering while keeping a fixed 1.2B-parameter architecture. Demonstrates that performance bottlenecks stem from training data deficiencies rather than architecture, as SOTA models show consistent failure patterns on hard samples. Built around a Data Engine focused on coverage, informativeness, and annotation accuracy.

entry.title: A Frame is Worth One Token: Efficient Generative World Modeling with Delta Tokens

author.name: Tommie Kerssies, Gabriele Berton, Ju He, Qihang Yu, Wufei Ma, Daan de Geus, Gijs Dubbelman, Liang-Chieh Chen
