entry.summary: Evaluates lightweight classifier-based routing for RAG pipelines on RAGRouter-Bench, comparing five classical classifiers under three feature regimes for selecting between factual, reasoning, and summarization retrieval strategies.

entry.title: ReinVBC: A Model-based Reinforcement Learning Approach to Vehicle Braking Controller

author.name: Haoxin Lin, Junjie Zhou, Daheng Xu, Yang Yu

entry.summary: Applies offline model-based reinforcement learning to vehicle braking control (ReinVBC), introducing engineering designs for reliable vehicle dynamics model learning and policy optimization. Addresses the labor-intensive manual calibration in vehicle production.

entry.title: Hybrid Fourier Neural Operator for Surrogate Modeling of Laser Processing with a Quantum-Circuit Mixer

author.name: Mateusz Papierz, Asel Sagingalieva, Alix Benoit, Toni Ivas, Elia Iseli, Alexey Melnikov

entry.summary: Introduces HQ-LP-FNO, a hybrid quantum-classical Fourier Neural Operator that replaces dense spectral mixing blocks with variational quantum circuit mixers for laser processing surrogate modeling, achieving comparable accuracy with fewer parameters.

entry.title: BLADE: Better Language Answers through Dialogue and Explanations

author.name: Chathuri Jayaweera, Bonnie J. Dorr

entry.summary: Presents BLADE, a RAG-based educational assistant that guides learners to relevant instructional resources rather than providing direct answers, supporting conceptual understanding through dialogue. Evaluated in an undergraduate course.

entry.title: Hierarchical Awareness Adapters with Hybrid Pyramid Feature Fusion for Dense Depth Prediction

author.name: Wuqi Su, Huilun Song, Chen Zhao, Chi Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a multilevel perceptual CRF model for monocular depth estimation using Swin Transformer with adaptive hybrid pyramid feature fusion and hierarchical awareness adapters. Combines short-range and long-range dependencies through multi-scale spatial pyramid pooling. Standard depth estimation contribution.

entry.title: SBF: An Effective Representation to Augment Skeleton for Video-based Human Action Recognition

author.name: Zhuoxuan Peng, Yiyi Ding, Yang Lin, S. -H. Gary Chan

entry.summary: Proposes Scale-Body-Flow (SBF), a representation augmenting 2D skeleton for video-based human action recognition that captures depth, body contour, and human-object interaction information. Addresses limitations of skeleton-only approaches in capturing critical action-related information. Practical contribution to action recognition pipelines.

entry.title: Do Robots Need Body Language? Comparing Communication Modalities for Legible Motion Intent in Human-Shared Spaces

author.name: Jonathan Albert Cohen, Kye Shimizu, Allen Song, Vishnu Bharath, Kent Larson, Pattie Maes

entry.summary: Online video study evaluating how different signaling modalities (expressive motion, lights, text, audio) affect humans' ability to understand a Boston Dynamics Spot robot's navigation intentions. Measures prediction accuracy, confidence, and trust across four scenarios.

entry.title: Efficient Multi-Objective Planning with Weighted Maximization Using Large Neighbourhood Search

author.name: Krishna Kalavadia, Shamak Dutta, Yash Vardhan Pant, Stephen L. Smith

entry.summary: Proposes a Large Neighbourhood Search algorithm for weighted maximum multi-objective planning, which can find all Pareto-optimal solutions including those in non-convex regions that weighted sum methods miss.

entry.title: To Throw a Stone with Six Birds: On Agents and Agenthood

author.name: Ioannis Tsiokos

entry.summary: Presents a formal account of agency within Six Birds Theory, treating agents as maintained theory objects whose policies can steer outside futures while remaining viable. Operationalizes agency through four checkable components in finite controlled systems.

entry.title: Domain-Contextualized Inference: A Computable Graph Architecture for Explicit-Domain Reasoning

author.name: Chao Li, Yuru Wang, Chunyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a domain-contextualized inference architecture where domain is an explicit computational parameter, enabling domain-scoped pruning that reduces search from O(N) to O(N/K).

entry.title: Gradual Cognitive Externalization: A Framework for Understanding How Ambient Intelligence Externalizes Human Cognition

author.name: Zhimin Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes Gradual Cognitive Externalization (GCE), a framework arguing that human cognitive functions are migrating into digital substrates through ambient intelligence co-adaptation rather than deliberate mind uploading.

entry.title: Scalable and Explainable Learner-Video Interaction Prediction using Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Dominik Glandorf, Fares Fawzi, Tanja K\"aser

entry.summary: Proposes a pipeline using multimodal LLMs to predict student video interaction behaviors (pausing, rewinding, skipping) as proxies for cognitive load, using video embeddings and neural classifiers for temporally fine-grained predictions.

entry.title: ANX: Protocol-First Design for AI Agent Interaction with a Supporting 3EX Decoupled Architecture

author.name: Xu Mingze

entry.summary: Presents ANX, an agent-native protocol and framework for AI agent interaction that integrates CLI, Skill, and MCP approaches with innovations in token efficiency, security, and adaptability.

entry.title: Customized User Plane Processing via Code Generating AI Agents for Next Generation Mobile Networks

author.name: Xiaowen Ma, Onur Ayan, Yunpu Ma, Xueli An

entry.summary: Proposes using AI agents with code generation capabilities to customize user plane processing for 6G mobile networks, enabling dynamic creation of protocol-aware processing blocks from text-based service requests.

entry.title: CoLoRSMamba: Conditional LoRA-Steered Mamba for Supervised Multimodal Violence Detection

entry.title: ART: Adaptive Relational Transformer for Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction with Temporal-Aware Relations

author.name: Ruochen Li, Ziyi Chang, Junyan Hu, Jiannan Li, Amir Atapour-Abarghouei, Hubert P. H. Shum

author.name: Zhifu Wei, Yizhou Dang, Guibing Guo, Chuang Zhao, Zhu Sun

entry.title: When Does Multimodal AI Help? Diagnostic Complementarity of Vision-Language Models and CNNs for Spectrum Management in Satellite-Terrestrial Networks

author.name: Yuanhang Li

author.name: Dalal Alharthi, Ivan Roberto Kawaminami Garcia

entry.title: Symbolic-Vector Attention Fusion for Collective Intelligence

author.name: Hongwei Xu

entry.summary: SVAF introduces a content-evaluation mechanism for inter-agent communication that decomposes signals into typed semantic fields and evaluates them through learned fusion gates for collective intelligence.

entry.title: Parent Selection Mechanisms in Elitist Crossover-Based Algorithms

author.name: Andre Opris, Denis Antipov

entry.summary: Analyzes parent selection mechanisms in genetic algorithms, showing that maximally distant parent selection solves Jump_k in O(k·4^k·n·log(n)) expected time, significantly faster than previous bounds.

entry.title: Toward a Sustainable Software Architecture Community: Evaluating ICSA's Environmental Impact

author.name: Mahyar T. Moghaddam, Mina Alipour, Torben Worm, Mikkel Baun Kj{\ae}rgaard

entry.summary: First systematic audit of the carbon footprint of GenAI usage in research papers and conference activities at IEEE ICSA. Estimates emissions from both GenAI inference in accepted papers and traditional conference attendance.

entry.title: Graphic-Design-Bench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating AI on Graphic Design Tasks

author.name: Adrienne Deganutti, Elad Hirsch, Haonan Zhu, Jaejung Seol, Purvanshi Mehta

entry.summary: arXiv:2604.04192v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We introduce GraphicDesignBench (GDB), the first comprehensive benchmark suite designed specifically to evaluate AI models on the full breadth of pro...

entry.title: Robots Need Some Education: On the complexity of learning in evolutionary robotics

author.name: Fuda van Diggelen

entry.summary: Surveys the integration of robot learning within evolutionary robotics, analyzing the complexity of designing suitable learning algorithms when both morphology and controllers co-evolve.

entry.title: Governance-Constrained Agentic AI: Blockchain-Enforced Human Oversight for Safety-Critical Wildfire Monitoring

author.name: Ali Akarma, Toqeer Ali Syed, Salman Jan, Hammad Muneer, Abdul Khadar Jilani

entry.summary: Proposes a blockchain-based governance framework for agentic AI wildfire monitoring that models the problem as a constrained POMDP with human oversight and cryptographic accountability.

entry.title: Integer-Only Operations on Extreme Learning Machine Test Time Classification

author.name: Emerson Lopes Machadoa, Cristiano Jacques Miosso, Ricardo Pezzuol Jacobi

entry.summary: Shows that extreme learning machine classifiers can perform test-time classification using only integer operations by using ternary input weights and exploiting normalization properties.

entry.title: Towards Considerate Human-Robot Coexistence: A Dual-Space Framework of Robot Design and Human Perception in Healthcare

author.name: Yuanchen Bai, Zijian Ding, Ruixiang Han, Niti Parikh, Wendy Ju, Angelique Taylor

entry.summary: Qualitative study on human-robot coexistence in healthcare through follow-up interviews, examining how perceptions evolve and proposing a dual-space framework of design and perception.

entry.title: Cardinality Estimation for High Dimensional Similarity Queries with Adaptive Bucket Probing

author.name: Zhonghan Chen, Qintian Guo, Ruiyuan Zhang, Xiaofang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes an LSH-based framework for cardinality estimation of high-dimensional similarity queries, using adaptive bucket probing and progressive sampling for efficiency.

entry.title: Strengthening Human-Centric Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Integrity in LLMs via a Structured Prompt Framework

author.name: Jiling Zhou, Aisvarya Adeseye, Seppo Virtanen, Antti Hakkala, Jouni Isoaho

entry.summary: Proposes a structured prompt engineering framework to improve Chain-of-Thought reasoning integrity for security threat detection in local LLM deployments, evaluated with human assessment.

entry.title: Online learning of smooth functions on $\mathbb{R}$

author.name: Jesse Geneson, Kuldeep Singh, Alexander Wang

entry.summary: Studies adversarial online learning of smooth functions on the real line, showing standard models become ill-posed and analyzing three modified scenarios that limit adversary influence.

entry.title: Spatiotemporal Interpolation of GEDI Biomass with Calibrated Uncertainty

author.name: Robin Young, Srinivasan Keshav

entry.summary: Develops spatiotemporal interpolation methods for GEDI satellite biomass data with calibrated uncertainty, addressing gaps from orbital sampling and operational interruptions.

entry.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Sepsis Outcome Prediction Using a Novel Romanian Electronic Health Record Dataset

author.name: Andrei-Alexandru Bunea, Ovidiu Ghibea, Dan-Matei Popovici, Ion Daniel, Octavian Andronic

entry.summary: Develops explainable ML models for sepsis outcome prediction using a novel Romanian EHR dataset of 12,286 hospitalizations, achieving state-of-the-art results on three classification tasks while maintaining clinical interpretability.

entry.title: Optimizing LLM Prompt Engineering with DSPy Based Declarative Learning

author.name: Shiek Ruksana, Sailesh Kiran Kurra, Thipparthi Sanjay Baradwaj

entry.summary: Studies DSPy-based declarative learning for optimizing LLM prompts, examining prompt synthesis, correction, calibration, and adaptation. Compares automated prompt optimization against manual heuristic approaches.

entry.title: SDVDiag: Using Context-Aware Causality Mining for the Diagnosis of Connected Vehicle Functions

author.name: Matthias Wei{\ss}, Falk Dettinger, Elias Detrois, Nasser Jazdi, Michael Weyrich

entry.summary: Introduces SDVDiag, a multimodal approach integrating human feedback and system-specific context into causal analysis for diagnosing connected vehicle function failures across cloud, edge, and networking infrastructure.

entry.title: Avoiding Non-Integrable Beliefs in Expectation Propagation

author.name: Zilu Zhao, Jichao Chen, Dirk Slock

entry.summary: Proposes methods to handle non-integrable beliefs in Expectation Propagation by allowing beliefs rather than messages to remain integrable, connecting to Bethe Free Energy optimization. This is a technical improvement to a classical approximate inference algorithm.

entry.title: SLSREC: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Adaptive Fusion of Long- and Short-Term User Interests

author.name: Wei Zhou, Yue Shen, Junkai Ji, Yinglan Feng, Xing Tang, Xiuqiang He, Liang Feng, Zexuan Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes SLSRec, a session-based recommendation model using self-supervised contrastive learning to adaptively fuse long-term preferences and short-term intentions by segmenting user behavior over time.

entry.title: CommonMorph: Participatory Morphological Documentation Platform

author.name: Aso Mahmudi, Sina Ahmadi, Kemal Kurniawan, Rico Sennrich, Eduard Hovy, Ekaterina Vylomova

entry.summary: Introduces CommonMorph, a participatory platform for morphological data collection and annotation with a three-tiered workflow (expert definition, contributor elicitation, community validation) incorporating active learning and cross-lingual adaptation.

entry.title: Formal Constraints on Dependency Syntax

author.name: G\'omez-Rodr\'iguez, Carlos, Alemany-Puig, Llu\'is

entry.summary: Provides a comprehensive survey and formal analysis of constraints on dependency syntax trees (beyond projectivity), characterizing subsets of trees fitting real linguistic phenomena for better description, faster parsing, and insights on language processing.

entry.title: Lexical Indicators of Mind Perception in Human-AI Companionship

author.name: Jaime Banks, Jianghui Li

entry.summary: Analyzes mind perception in human-AI companionship by examining Reddit discussions about AI companions using lexical indicators. Categorizes visual sinks into ViT-emerged and LLM-emerged types. Studies the psychological phenomenon of humans inferring mental capacities in AI systems.

entry.title: FAVE: Flow-based Average Velocity Establishment for Sequential Recommendation

author.name: Ke Shi, Yao Zhang, Feng Guo, Jinyuan Zhang, JunShuo Zhang, Shen Gao, Shuo Shang

entry.summary: Proposes FAVE, a flow-based framework for sequential recommendation that addresses inefficiencies in diffusion-based generative recommendation through one-step generation from an informative prior. Tackles prior mismatch and linear redundancy in existing noise-to-data paradigms. Technical contribution to recommendation systems.

entry.title: Shower-Aware Dual-Stream Voxel Networks for Structural Defect Detection in Cosmic-Ray Muon Tomography

author.name: Parthiv Dasgupta, Sambhav Agarwal, Palash Dutta, Raja Karmakar, Sudeshna Goswami

entry.summary: Presents SA-DSVN for voxel-level segmentation of structural defects in reinforced concrete using cosmic-ray muon tomography. Jointly processes scattering kinematics and electromagnetic shower multiplicities through dual encoder streams with cross-attention. Uses Geant4 simulations for training data generation.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Mural Restoration via a Unified Hybrid Mask-Aware Transformer

entry.title: Hierarchical Co-Embedding of Font Shapes and Impression Tags

author.name: Yugo Kubota, Kaito Shiku, Seiichi Uchida

entry.title: Cost-Efficient Multi-Scale Fovea for Semantic-Based Visual Search Attention

author.name: Jo\~ao Luzio, Alexandre Bernardino, Plinio Moreno

author.name: Meng Xu, Jiao Liu, Hua Yu, Yew Soon Ong

entry.title: Safe Decentralized Operation of EV Virtual Power Plant with Limited Network Visibility via Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Paul Saves, Matthieu Mastio, Nicolas Verstaevel, Benoit Gaudou

entry.summary: Presents a multi-stage pipeline for exploring stochastic agent-based models that integrates automated model-based screening with ML surrogates to identify dominant variables and nonlinear interaction effects.

entry.title: Can LLMs Reason About Attention? Towards Zero-Shot Analysis of Multimodal Classroom Behavior

author.name: Nolan Platt, Sehrish Nizamani, Alp Tural, Elif Tural, Saad Nizamani, Andrew Katz, Yoonje Lee, Nada Basit

entry.summary: Presents a privacy-preserving pipeline for analyzing student classroom attention from video using OpenPose and gaze estimation, with immediate frame deletion and zero-shot analysis by QwQ-32B reasoning model.

entry.title: Multi-Robot Multi-Queue Control via Exhaustive Assignment Actor-Critic Learning

author.name: Mohammad Merati, H. M. Sabbir Ahmad, Wenchao Li, David Casta\~n\'on

entry.summary: Develops an exhaustive-assignment actor-critic architecture for multi-robot multi-queue task allocation with asymmetric stochastic arrivals and switching delays.

entry.title: Learning Superpixel Ensemble and Hierarchy Graphs for Melanoma Detection

author.name: Asmaa M. Elwer, Muhammad A. Rushdi, Mahmoud H. Annaby

entry.summary: Introduces graph learning approaches for melanoma detection using superpixel ensemble and hierarchy graphs on dermoscopic images.

entry.title: Embedding Enhancement via Fine-Tuned Language Models for Learner-Item Cognitive Modeling

author.name: Yuanhao Liu, Zihan Zhou, Kaiying Wu, Shuo Liu, Yiyang Huang, Jiajun Guo, Aimin Zhou, Hong Qian

entry.summary: Studies how fine-tuned language models enhance embeddings for learner-item cognitive modeling in online education, addressing misalignment between LM and cognitive diagnosis training objectives.

author.name: Ali Akarma, Toqeer Ali Syed, Abdul Khadar Jilani, Salman Jan, Hammad Muneer, Muazzam A. Khan, Changli Yu

entry.summary: Presents an interrogator-based trust monitoring system for autonomous underwater vehicles that uses lightweight transformers to compute dynamic trust scores from communication metadata.

entry.title: BiST: A Gold Standard Bangla-English Bilingual Corpus for Sentence Structure and Tense Classification with Inter-Annotator Agreement

author.name: Abdullah Al Shafi, Swapnil Kundu Argha, M. A. Moyeen, Abdul Muntakim, Shoumik Barman Polok

entry.summary: Explores using LLMs and vision models as proxies for human aesthetic preferences in network visualization, comparing their alignment with human judgments across different graph layouts.

entry.title: Evaluation of Bagging Predictors with Kernel Density Estimation and Bagging Score

author.name: Philipp Seitz, Jan Schmitt, Andreas Schiffler

author.name: Poornima Kumaresan, Shwetha Singaravelu, Lakshmi Rajendran, Santhosh Sivasubramani

entry.summary: Proposes a framework-agnostic quantum neural network architecture to eliminate vendor lock-in across QML platforms (TensorFlow Quantum, PennyLane, Qiskit). Enables model portability across quantum computing ecosystems.

entry.title: Safe and Near-Optimal Gate Control: A Case Study from the Danish West Coast

author.name: Martin Kristjansen (Aalborg University), Kim Guldstrand Larsen (Aalborg University), Marius Miku\v{c}ionis (Aalborg University), Christian Schilling (Aalborg University)

entry.title: HUKUKBERT: Domain-Specific Language Model for Turkish Law

entry.title: Deep Image Clustering Based on Curriculum Learning and Density Information

author.name: In Seon Kim, Ali Moghimi

entry.summary: Introduces a multimodal framework integrating satellite imagery with Google Street View for urban tree detection under limited annotations. Uses satellite imagery for localization and street-level imagery for detailed characterization. Addresses annotation cost challenges in urban environmental monitoring.

entry.title: HistoFusionNet: Histogram-Guided Fusion and Frequency-Adaptive Refinement for Nighttime Image Dehazing

Uses transformer-enhanced architecture with multi-scale encoder-decoder backbone. Addresses the specific challenges of nighttime conditions.

author.name: Meilun Zhou, Alina Zare

entry.title: Ranking Constraints via Topological Dual-Directional Search in Evolutionary Multi-Objective Optimization

author.name: Ruiqing Sun, Dawei Feng, Sheng Qi, Xing Zhou, Lianghao Li, Bo Ding, Yijie Wang, Rui Wang, Huaimin Wang

entry.summary: RCCMO proposes ranking constraints by their geometric relationship to the true Pareto front in constrained multi-objective optimization. Uses a novel dual-directional search and constraint prioritization to improve optimization.

entry.title: Real-Time Projected Adaptive Control for Closed-Chain Co-Manipulative Continuum Robots

author.name: Rana Danesh, Farrokh Janabi-Sharifi, Farhad Aghili

entry.title: Paper close reading: "Why Language Models Hallucinate"

author.name: LawrenceC

entry.title: Noisy Nonreciprocal Pairwise Comparisons: Scale Variation, Noise Calibration, and Admissible Ranking Regions

author.name: Jean-Pierre Magnot

entry.summary: Proposes an additive model for noisy pairwise comparisons that separates genuine scale variation from random noise, rather than treating non-reciprocity as a defect. Introduces admissible ranking regions under noise.

entry.title: Structural Segmentation of the Minimum Set Cover Problem: Exploiting Universe Decomposability for Metaheuristic Optimization

author.name: Isidora Hern\'andez, H\'ector Ferrada, Crist\'obal A. Navarro

entry.summary: Proposes exploiting structural decomposition (universe segmentability) in the Minimum Set Cover Problem to improve metaheuristic optimization. Uses union-find preprocessing to detect connected components for divide-and-conquer approaches.

entry.title: Hume's Representational Conditions for Causal Judgment: What Bayesian Formalization Abstracted Away

author.name: Yiling Wu

entry.summary: Examines how Bayesian formalizations of Hume's causal judgment theory abstracted away key representational conditions (experiential grounding, structured retrieval, vivacity transfer). Connects this to limitations of LLMs and predictive processing.

entry.title: SuperLocalMemory V3.3: The Living Brain -- Biologically-Inspired Forgetting, Cognitive Quantization, and Multi-Channel Retrieval for Zero-LLM Agent Memory Systems

author.name: Varun Pratap Bhardwaj

entry.summary: Presents SuperLocalMemory V3.3, a local-first agent memory system implementing cognitive memory taxonomy with Fisher-Rao-based distance metrics, biologically-inspired forgetting, and multi-channel retrieval without requiring cloud LLMs.

entry.title: On the "Causality" Step in Policy Gradient Derivations: A Pedagogical Reconciliation of Full Return and Reward-to-Go

author.name: Nima H. Siboni

entry.summary: A pedagogical paper that provides a mathematically explicit derivation of the 'causality' step in policy gradient methods, showing how reward-to-go arises naturally from prefix trajectory distributions rather than as a post-hoc replacement.

entry.title: BLK-Assist: A Methodological Framework for Artist-Led Co-Creation with Generative AI Models

author.name: Daniel Grimes, Rachel M. Harrison

entry.summary: Presents BLK-Assist, a modular framework for artist-specific fine-tuning of diffusion models using LoRA adaptation, transparency-preserving generation, and hybrid upscaling, demonstrated as a case study with a single professional artist.

entry.title: Toward Artificial Intelligence Enabled Earth System Coupling

author.name: Maria Kaselimi, Anna Belehaki

entry.summary: Reviews how AI methods can enhance Earth system coupling in multi-component models, focusing on cross-domain interactions between Earth's spheres beyond just climate models.

entry.title: Embedding-Only Uplink for Onboard Retrieval Under Shift in Remote Sensing

author.name: Sangcheol Sim

entry.summary: Studies an embedding-only uplink pipeline for onboard satellite image retrieval under distribution shift, evaluating whether compact embeddings can support effective triage across different types of remote sensing shifts.

entry.title: InCaRPose: In-Cabin Relative Camera Pose Estimation Model and Dataset

author.name: Felix Stillger, Lukas Hahn, Frederik Hasecke, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: InCaRPose is a Transformer-based model for relative camera pose estimation in constrained in-cabin automotive environments, using DINOv3 features for metric-scale translation prediction.

entry.title: Regime-Calibrated Demand Priors for Ride-Hailing Fleet Dispatch and Repositioning

author.name: Indar Kumar, Akanksha Tiwari

entry.summary: Proposes regime-calibrated demand priors for ride-hailing dispatch using historical trip data segmentation and similarity-based matching with LP-based repositioning.

entry.title: NetSecBed: A Container-Native Testbed for Reproducible Cybersecurity Experimentation

author.name: Leonardo Bitzki, Diego Kreutz, Tiago Heinrich, Douglas Fideles, Leandro Bertholdo, Silvio Quincozes, Angelo Diniz

entry.summary: Presents NetSecBed, a container-native testbed for reproducible cybersecurity experimentation with 60 attack scenarios and 9 target services, particularly suited for IoT environments.

entry.title: An AI Teaching Assistant for Motion Picture Engineering

author.name: Deirdre O'Regan, Anil C. Kokaram

entry.summary: Describes implementation of an AI Teaching Assistant using RAG for a Motion Picture Engineering course, with quantitative evaluation of student impact.

entry.title: Understanding When Poisson Log-Normal Models Outperform Penalized Poisson Regression for Microbiome Count Data

author.name: Daniel Agyapong, Julien Chiquet, Jane Marks, Toby Dylan Hocking

entry.summary: Compares Poisson Log-Normal models vs. penalized Poisson regression for microbiome count data, providing practical guidance on when latent dependence modeling helps.

entry.title: Improving Model Performance by Adapting the KGE Metric to Account for System Non-Stationarity

author.name: M Jawad, HV Gupta, YH Wang, MA Farmani, A Behrangi, GY Niu

entry.summary: Introduces JKGE_ss metric that accounts for temporal non-stationarity in geoscientific model evaluation, adapting the KGE metric to detect and handle dynamical changes in statistical properties.

entry.title: Towards Agentic Defect Reasoning: A Graph-Assisted Retrieval Framework for Laser Powder Bed Fusion

author.name: Muhammad Rizwan Awan, Volker Pickert, Muhammad Waqar Ashraf, Saleh Ali, Farshid Mahmouditabar, Shafiq Odhano

entry.summary: Presents a graph-assisted retrieval framework for defect reasoning in laser powder bed fusion manufacturing, encoding parameter-mechanism-defect relationships into a knowledge graph.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Training-free Urban Food Delivery System using Resilient UMST Network

author.name: Md Nahid Hasan, Vishwam Tiwari, Aditya Challa, Vaskar Raychoudhury, Snehanshu Saha

entry.summary: Proposes a Union of Minimum Spanning Trees (UMST) approach for resilient urban food delivery networks, balancing efficiency and fault tolerance without requiring ML training.

entry.title: InsightBoard: An Interactive Multi-Metric Visualization and Fairness Analysis Plugin for TensorBoard

author.name: Ray Zeyao Chen, Christan Grant

entry.summary: Presents InsightBoard, a TensorBoard plugin for synchronized multi-metric visualization and slice-based fairness diagnostics during ML training.

entry.title: Text Summarization With Graph Attention Networks

author.name: Mohammadreza Ardestani, Yllias Chali

entry.summary: Experiments with Graph Attention Networks and MLPs to incorporate RST and co-reference graph information into text summarization, finding mixed results. Also provides RST annotations for XSum dataset.

entry.title: 'Layer su Layer': Identifying and Disambiguating the Italian NPN Construction in BERT's family

author.name: Greta Gorzoni, Ludovica Pannitto, Francesca Masini

entry.title: Edge-Based Standing-Water Detection via FSM-Guided Tiering and Multi-Model Consensus

author.name: Oliver Aleksander Larsen, Mahyar T. Moghaddam

Combines camera input with environmental sensors through a finite-state machine for tiered inference. Uses multi-model YOLO ensemble with sensor fusion.

entry.title: PollutionNet: A Vision Transformer Framework for Climatological Assessment of NO$_2$ and SO$_2$ Using Satellite-Ground Data Fusion

entry.summary: Proposes PollutionNet, a Vision Transformer framework for assessing NO2 and SO2 by fusing satellite (Sentinel-5P) with ground-level observations. Leverages self-attention to capture spatiotemporal dependencies missed by traditional methods. Applied environmental monitoring contribution.

entry.title: Detecting Media Clones in Cultural Repositories Using a Positive Unlabeled Learning Approach

author.name: V. Sevetlidis, V. Arampatzakis, M. Karta, I. Mourthos, D. Tsiafaki, G. Pavlidis

entry.summary: Applies Positive-Unlabeled learning to detect duplicate artifacts in cultural repositories using a lightweight Clone Encoder trained on augmented views. Achieves strong F1 scores on both CIFAR-10 and the AtticPOT cultural heritage dataset.

entry.title: RAIN-FIT: Learning of Fitting Surfaces and Noise Distribution from Large Data Sets

author.name: Omar M. Sleem, Sahand Kiani, Constantino M. Lagoa

entry.summary: RAIN-FIT estimates surfaces and noise distributions from noisy point measurements using basis functions, with computational efficiency for large datasets.

entry.title: Finding Sets of Pareto Sets in Real-World Scenarios -- A Multitask Multiobjective Perspective

author.name: Jiao Liu, Yew Soon Ong, Melvin Wong

entry.summary: Demonstrates the 'set of Pareto sets' concept using evolutionary multitasking across engineering design, inventory management, and hyperparameter optimization problems. Shows practical applicability of generating repositories of specialized solution models for diverse task settings.

entry.title: Levels of superpersuasion

author.name: Bill Jackson

entry.summary: Explores levels of AI superpersuasion capability, arguing there are meaningful gradations between trivially convincing someone of a math fact and arbitrary manipulation. Analyzes I/O limitations on even superintelligent persuasion.

entry.title: Classifying Problem and Solution Framing in Congressional Social Media

author.name: Misha Melnyk, Mitchell Dolny, Joshua D. Elkind, A. Michael Tjhin, Saisha Chebium, Blake VanBerlo, Annelise Russell, Michelle M. Buehlmann, Jesse Hoey

entry.summary: Develops automated methods to classify US Senator Twitter posts as 'problem' or 'solution' framing using LLMs and supervised learning approaches on a dataset of 1.68M tweets.

entry.title: AI Governance Control Stack for Operational Stability: Achieving Hardened Governance in AI Systems

author.name: Horatio Morgan

entry.summary: Introduces a six-layer AI Governance Control Stack for operational stability, integrating version governance, verification, explainability logging, telemetry monitoring, model drift detection, and human escalation.

entry.title: AICCE: AI Driven Compliance Checker Engine

author.name: Mohammad Wali Ur Rahman, Martin Manuel Lopez, Lamia Tasnim Mim, Carter Farthing, Julius Battle, Kathryn Buckley, Salim Hariri

entry.summary: Presents AICCE, a generative AI system for automated IPv6 compliance verification combining dual-architecture reasoning with RAG for semantic encoding of protocol specifications.

entry.title: 15 Years of Augmented Human(s) Research: Where Do We Stand?

author.name: Steeven Villa, Abdallah El Ali

entry.summary: Scientometric analysis of 15 years of the Augmented Human(s) conference series (735 papers), examining geographical aspects, topic evolution, and research trends.

entry.title: Integrating Artificial Intelligence, Physics, and Internet of Things: A Framework for Cultural Heritage Conservation

author.name: Carmine Valentino, Federico Pichi, Francesco Colace, Dajana Conte, Gianluigi Rozza

entry.summary: Presents a framework combining IoT, AI, and physics-informed neural networks for cultural heritage conservation, structured in four layers for 3D model analysis and physics-based simulation.

entry.title: Apparent Age Estimation: Challenges and Outcomes

author.name: Justin Rainier Go, Lorenz Bernard Marqueses, Mikaella Kaye Martinez, John Kevin Patrick Sarmiento, Abien Fred Agarap

entry.summary: Reviews apparent age estimation methods, evaluating DEX with distribution learning techniques. Finds AMRL achieves SOTA accuracy but demographic biases persist, particularly for Asian and African American populations.

entry.title: Autoencoder-Based Parameter Estimation for Superposed Multi-Component Damped Sinusoidal Signals

author.name: Momoka Iida, Hayato Motohashi, Hirotaka Takahashi

entry.summary: Develops autoencoder-based parameter estimation for multi-component damped sinusoidal signals, using the latent space for frequency, phase, decay time, and amplitude estimation.

entry.title: Peoples Water Data: Enabling Reliable Field Data Generation and Microbial Contamination Screening in Household Drinking Water

author.name: Suzan Kagan, Shira Spigelman, Sankar Sudhir, Thalappil Pradeep, Hadas Mamane

entry.summary: Develops a two-stage ML framework for predicting E. coli contamination in drinking water in Chennai, India using low-cost physicochemical indicators, achieving practical screening capability.

entry.title: Convolutional Neural Network and Adversarial Autoencoder in EEG images classification

author.name: Albert Nasybullin, Semen Kurkin

entry.summary: Applies CNNs and adversarial autoencoders to classify EEG topograms for motor cortex activity classification during hand movement. Converts EEG signals to 2D images and uses both supervised and semi-supervised approaches.

entry.title: How Long short-term memory artificial neural network, synthetic data, and fine-tuning improve the classification of raw EEG data

author.name: Albert Nasybullin, Vladimir Maksimenko, Semen Kurkin

entry.summary: Proposes an ML pipeline combining synthetic data generation, LSTM networks, and fine-tuning for EEG classification of visual stimuli experiments (Necker cube). Claims improved classification of raw EEG data.

entry.title: Towards a theory of morphology-driven marking in the lexicon: The case of the state

author.name: Mohamed El Idrissi

entry.summary: Proposes a formal model of morphology-driven marking in language, using Riffian as a reference point to explain noun type marking differences within and across languages through modular cognitive sets with morphological templates.

entry.title: Evaluating Digital Inclusiveness of Digital Agri-Food Tools Using Large Language Models: A Comparative Analysis Between Human and AI-Based Evaluations

author.name: Githma Pewinya, Carolina Martins, Garcia Mariangel

entry.summary: Explores whether LLMs (Grok, Gemini, GPT-4o, GPT-5) can replace human evaluators for assessing digital inclusiveness of agricultural tools in the Global South. Benchmarks AI assessments against expert-led evaluations using the Multidimensional Digital Inclusiveness Index. A niche application paper with limited methodological novelty.

entry.title: Robust Multi-Source Covid-19 Detection in CT Images

author.name: Asmita Yuki Pritha, Jason Xu, Daniel Ding, Justin Li, Aryana Hou, Xin Wang, Shu Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-task learning approach for COVID-19 detection from multi-source CT scans by jointly predicting diagnosis and originating data center. Uses EfficientNet with shared representations to reduce center-specific bias. Addresses domain shift in medical imaging.

entry.title: SAGE-GAN: Towards Realistic and Robust Segmentation of Spatially Ordered Nanoparticles via Attention-Guided GANs

author.name: Anindya Pal, Varun Ajith, Saumik Bhattacharya, Sayantari Ghosh

entry.summary: Develops SAGE-GAN combining self-attention U-Net with conditional GAN for nanoparticle segmentation in electron microscopy. Addresses the challenge of limited labeled training data for nanoparticle analysis. Two-step solution learning from real images and generating synthetic training data.

entry.title: Loop-Extrusion Linkage: Spectral Ordering and Interval-Based Structure Discovery for Continuous Optimization

author.name: Eren Unlu

entry.summary: Introduces Loop-Extrusion Linkage (LEL), a structure-learning optimization wrapper inspired by chromatin loop extrusion biology. It combines variable-interaction estimation, spectral ordering, and adaptive subspace search to improve continuous optimization.

entry.title: Towards Edge Intelligence via Autonomous Navigation: A Robot-Assisted Data Collection Approach

author.name: Tingting Huang, Yingyang Chen, Sixian Qin, Zhijian Lin, Jun Li, Li Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a communication-and-learning dual-driven autonomous navigation scheme for robot-assisted data collection in edge intelligence systems, incorporating region-aware propagation characteristics for non-line-of-sight environments.

entry.title: Are there Multiple Moral Endpoints?

author.name: Vaniver

entry.summary: Zvi argues that the US faces multiple moral endpoints for the long-term future depending on AI development, discusses Mass Effect as an analogy, and explores whether moral convergence or divergence is more likely.

entry.title: Estimates of the expected utility gain of AI Safety Research

author.name: Sean Herrington

entry.summary: Back-of-envelope estimates of the expected utility of AI safety research, considering different assumptions about population growth, life expectancy, and extinction risk reduction. Provides rough quantification of hours-of-life saved per hour of safety work.

entry.title: Evaluating Artificial Intelligence Through a Christian Understanding of Human Flourishing

author.name: Nicholas Skytland, Lauren Parsons, Alicia Llewellyn, Steele Billings, Peter Larson, John Anderson, Sean Boisen, Steve Runge

entry.summary: Introduces the Flourishing AI Benchmark (FAI-C-ST) to evaluate frontier LLM responses against a Christian understanding of human flourishing across seven dimensions. Compares 20 frontier models against pluralistic and Christian-specific criteria.

entry.title: The Topology of Multimodal Fusion: Why Current Architectures Fail at Creative Cognition

author.name: Xiujiang Tan (Guangzhou Academy of Fine Arts, Guangzhou, China)

entry.summary: This paper argues that current multimodal AI architectures (CLIP, GPT-4V, Gemini) share a structural limitation rooted in 'modal separability' topology. It draws on Wittgenstein and Chinese craft epistemology to propose a philosophical framework for understanding why these architectures fail at creative cognition.

entry.title: LLMs-Healthcare : Current Applications and Challenges of Large Language Models in various Medical Specialties

author.name: Ummara Mumtaz, Awais Ahmed, Summaya Mumtaz

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey of LLM applications across medical specialties including cancer care, dermatology, dental care, neurodegenerative disorders, and mental health, covering diagnostic and treatment functionalities.

entry.title: Towards Intelligent Energy Security: A Unified Spatio-Temporal and Graph Learning Framework for Scalable Electricity Theft Detection in Smart Grids

author.name: AbdulQoyum A. Olowookere, Usman A. Oguntola, Ebenezer. Leke Odekanle, Maridiyah A. Madehin, Aisha A. Adesope

entry.summary: Introduces SmartGuard Energy Intelligence System (SGEIS) for electricity theft detection combining supervised ML, deep learning time-series modeling, NILM, and graph-based learning for smart grid security.

entry.title: AI Appeals Processor: A Deep Learning Approach to Automated Classification of Citizen Appeals in Government Services

author.name: Vladimir Beskorovainyi

entry.summary: Evaluates multiple NLP approaches (Bag-of-Words, TF-IDF, fastText, Word2Vec, BERT) for classifying citizen appeals to government agencies, achieving improvements over manual processing.

entry.title: RDEx-CMOP: Feasibility-Aware Indicator-Guided Differential Evolution for Fixed-Budget Constrained Multiobjective Optimization

author.name: Sichen Tao, Yifei Yang, Ruihan Zhao, Kaiyu Wang, Sicheng Liu, Shangce Gao

entry.summary: Documents RDEx-CMOP, a differential evolution variant for the IEEE CEC 2025 constrained multiobjective optimization competition, integrating feasibility scheduling and SPEA2-style fitness assignment.

entry.title: Artificial Intelligence and Cost Reduction in Public Higher Education: A Scoping Review of Emerging Evidence

author.name: Diamanto Tzanoulinou, Loukas Triantafyllopoulos, George Vorvilas, Evgenia Paxinou, Nikolaos Karousos, Thomas Dasaklis, Athanassios Mihiotis, Manolis Koutouzis, Dimitris Kalles, Vassilios S. Verykios

entry.summary: A scoping review of AI applications in public higher education for cost reduction, analyzing 21 empirical studies. Finds AI enables savings through automation but evidence on large-scale cost reduction remains limited.

entry.title: Gaze to Insight: A Scalable AI Approach for Detecting Gaze Behaviours in Face-to-Face Collaborative Learning

author.name: Junyuan Liang, Qi Zhou, Sahan Bulathwela, Mutlu Cukurova

entry.summary: Proposes a scalable AI approach for detecting gaze behaviors in face-to-face collaborative learning from video data. Addresses the challenge of requiring large labeled datasets and cross-configuration robustness. Educational technology application of computer vision.

entry.title: Review and Evaluation of Point-Cloud based Leaf Surface Reconstruction Methods for Agricultural Applications

author.name: Arif Ahmed, Parikshit Maini

entry.summary: Presents a comparative study of nine surface reconstruction methods for leaf surfaces from 3D point clouds across three public datasets. Evaluates parametric, triangulation-based, implicit, and learning-based approaches. Survey/benchmark paper for agricultural computer vision.

entry.title: A Physics-Informed, Behavior-Aware Digital Twin for Robust Multimodal Forecasting of Core Body Temperature in Precision Livestock Farming

author.name: Riasad Alvi, Mohaimenul Azam Khan Raiaan, Sadia Sultana Chowa, Arefin Ittesafun Abian, Reem E Mohamed, Md Rafiqul Islam, Yakub Sebastian, Sheikh Izzal Azid, Sami Azam

entry.summary: Presents a physics-informed digital twin framework for predicting core body temperature in dairy cattle, combining ODE-based thermoregulation models, Gaussian processes, Kalman filtering, and behavioral Markov chains. Targets heat stress prediction for precision livestock farming.

entry.title: Outlier-Robust Nonlinear Moving Horizon Estimation using Adaptive Loss Functions

author.name: Nestor Deniz, Guido Sanchez, Fernando Auat Cheein, Leonardo Giovanini

entry.summary: Proposes an adaptive robust loss function for Moving Horizon Estimation (MHE) that reduces outlier impact while avoiding naive solutions through a regularization term. A tuning parameter controls robustness to outliers.

entry.title: Periodic Event-Triggered Explicit Reference Governor for Constrained Attitude Control on SO(3)

author.name: Satoshi Nakano, Masahiro Suzuki, Misa Ohashi, Noboru Chikami, Shusuke Otabe

entry.summary: Proposes a Periodic Event-Triggered Explicit Reference Governor for constrained attitude control on SO(3), avoiding singularities from Euler angle parameterizations. Enforces constraints without online optimization using periodic event-triggered updates.

entry.title: Greedy and Transformer-Based Multi-Port Selection for Slow Fluid Antenna Multiple Access

author.name: Darian Perez-Adan, Jose P. Gonzalez-Coma, F. Javier Lopez-Martinez, Luis Castedo

entry.summary: Proposes greedy and Transformer-based methods for port selection in fluid antenna multiple access (FAMA) systems, using imitation learning and REINFORCE to achieve near-optimal spectral efficiency at lower computational cost.

entry.title: A reconfigurable smart camera implementation for jet flames characterization based on an optimized segmentation model

author.name: Gerardo Valente Vazquez-Garcia, Carmina Perez Guerrero, Eduardo Gardu\~no, Miguel Gonzalez-Mendoza, Adriana Palacios, Gerardo Rodriguez-Hernandez, Vahid Foroughi, Alba \`Agueda, Elsa Pastor, Gilberto Ochoa-Ruiz

entry.summary: Presents a smart camera platform for jet flame characterization using optimized AI segmentation models on SoC FPGAs for real-time edge processing in industrial fire safety applications.

entry.title: Impact of geophysical fields on Deep Learning-based Lagrangian drift simulations

author.name: Daria Botvynko (Lab-STICC_OSE, IMT Atlantique - MEE, IMT Atlantique), Carlos Granero-Belinchon (ODYSSEY, IMT Atlantique - MEE, Lab-STICC_OSE), Simon Van Gennip (MOi), Abdesslam Benzinou (ENIB), Ronan Fablet (IMT Atlantique - MEE, Lab-STICC_OSE, ODYSSEY)

entry.summary: Assesses how different geophysical input fields affect deep learning-based Lagrangian drift simulations on the sea surface, comparing fully numerical and real-world drifter experiments across different ocean regions.

entry.title: Agile Story-Point Estimation: Is RAG a Better Way to Go?

author.name: Lamyea Maha, Tajmilur Rahman, Chanchal Roy

entry.summary: Investigates using RAG with LLMs to automate Agile story point estimation, comparing RAG-based approaches against traditional methods on software development effort prediction.

entry.title: YOLOv11 Demystified: A Practical Guide to High-Performance Object Detection

author.name: Nikhileswara Rao Sulake

entry.summary: Provides a detailed analysis of YOLOv11's architecture including C3K2 blocks, SPPF, and C2PSA modules, comparing performance against prior YOLO versions. A practical guide rather than a novel contribution. Tutorial-style paper on existing architecture.

entry.title: Automated Segmentation and Tracking of Group Housed Pigs Using Foundation Models

author.name: Ye Bi, Bimala Acharya, David Rosero, Juan Steibel

entry.summary: Presents a foundation model workflow for automated monitoring of group-housed nursery pigs using Grounding-DINO and modular post-processing. Demonstrates that foundation models can reduce reliance on task-specific supervised learning in precision livestock farming. Applied agricultural AI.

entry.title: Confidence-Driven Facade Refinement of 3D Building Models Using MLS Point Clouds

author.name: Xiaoyu Huang

entry.summary: Presents a confidence-driven framework for refining facades of 3D building models using Mobile Laser Scanning point clouds. Uses coarse CityGML models as geometric priors rather than reconstructing from scratch. Applied geospatial/digital twin contribution.

entry.title: Inside Omega

author.name: 0xA

entry.summary: Philosophical thought experiment exploring moral internalism and its implications for AI alignment. Proposes that indexical uncertainty (uncertainty about one's own identity) might provide rational grounds for moral behavior.

entry.title: The slow death of the accelerationist.

author.name: Arch223

entry.summary: Essay tracing the rise and decline of the e/acc (effective accelerationism) movement from 2024, arguing that the movement's optimistic predictions about AI solving all problems have not materialized and its cultural influence has waned.

entry.title: Toward a Universal Color Naming System: A Clustering-Based Approach using Multisource Data

author.name: Aruzhan Sabitkyzy, Maksat Shagyrov, Pakizar Shamoi

entry.summary: Proposes a clustering-based framework using multisource data to build a universal color naming system, addressing inconsistencies in color naming across industries like fashion, cosmetics, and web design.

entry.title: Intelligent Traffic Monitoring with YOLOv11: A Case Study in Real-Time Vehicle Detection

author.name: Shkelqim Sherifi

entry.summary: Offline real-time traffic monitoring system coupling YOLOv11 with BoT-SORT/ByteTrack for vehicle detection and counting, achieving 66-96% counting accuracy.

entry.title: A Quantum Search Approach to Magic Square Constraint Problems with Classical Benchmarking

author.name: Rituparna R, Harsha Varthini, Aswani Kumar Cherukuri

entry.summary: Applies Grover's algorithm to magic square constraint satisfaction problems with classical pre-processing, benchmarking quantum vs. classical approaches.

entry.title: On the First Computer Science Research Paper in an Indian Language and the Future of Science in Indian Languages

author.name: Siddhartha Visveswara Jayanti

entry.summary: Describes the experience of writing the first computer science research paper entirely in Telugu, an Indian language with ~100 million speakers. Addresses the challenge of developing technical terminology using Paninian Sanskrit grammar. A cultural and linguistic contribution rather than a technical ML paper.

entry.title: A Novel Hybrid PID-LQR Controller for Sit-To-Stand Assistance Using a CAD-Integrated Simscape Multibody Lower Limb Exoskeleton

author.name: Ranjeet Kumbhar, Rajmeet Singh, Appaso M Gadade, Ashish Singla, Irfan Hussain

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid PID-LQR controller for sit-to-stand assistance with a lower limb exoskeleton, using a high-fidelity CAD-integrated Simscape model for simulation and comparison of control strategies.

entry.title: Surrogate Model-Based Near-Optimal Gain Selection for Approach-Angle-Constrained Two-Phase Pure Proportional Navigation

author.name: Abhigyan Roy, Shreeya Padte, Abel Viji George, Vivek A, Satadal Ghosh

entry.summary: Addresses near-optimal gain selection for two-phase pure proportional navigation guidance using surrogate models. Optimizes navigation gains for approach-angle-constrained missile guidance scenarios.

entry.title: Precommitments

author.name: berns

entry.summary: Essay on precommitments using the Odysseus/Sirens example, discussing how binding yourself to future actions can be strategically valuable. Explores applications to decision theory and self-control.

entry.title: Contra The Usual Interpretation Of “The Whispering Earring”

author.name: AlphaAndOmega

entry.summary: Literary analysis essay arguing against the standard interpretation of 'The Whispering Earring' as a cautionary tale about AI agency delegation, proposing instead that it's about the nature of cognitive enhancement and identity.

entry.title: Supervised Dimensionality Reduction Revisited: Why LDA on Frozen CNN Features Deserves a Second Look

author.name: Indar Kumar, Girish Karhana, Sai Krishna Jasti, Ankit Hemant Lade

entry.summary: Paper title mentions LDA on frozen CNN features but abstract describes ride-hailing dispatch. Appears to be a metadata/abstract mismatch.

entry.title: The Thousand Brains of the Galactic Senate

author.name: Abraham Haskins

entry.summary: Uses a Star Wars Galactic Senate metaphor to explain the Thousand Brains theory of consciousness, connecting it to the Free Energy Principle and active inference. More of a pedagogical piece than research.

entry.title: Conditional Gates and Patches (working notes)

author.name: watermark

entry.summary: Working notes on anthropic reasoning proposing 'conditional gates' to define reference classes via observable properties, avoiding debates about which reference class is correct by making it a degree of freedom.

entry.title: Significance and Stability Analysis of Gene-Environment Interaction using RGxEStat

author.name: Meng'en Qin, Zhe Li, Xiaohui Yang

entry.summary: Introduces RGxEStat for significance and stability analysis of gene-environment interactions in breeding research. Not primarily a computer vision or AI paper despite its categorization. Agricultural genetics tool.

entry.title: Mapping Transit Equity in NYC

author.name: hassandawy

entry.summary: Analysis of transit equity in NYC with a focus on fare-free bus policy, examining how transit changes impact different communities. Follow-up to a presentation at the NYC School of Data Conference.

entry.title: On Ambiguity: The case of fraction, its meanings and roles

author.name: Jan A Bergstra, John V Tucker

entry.summary: Contemplates ambiguity in mathematical discourse, specifically around the term 'fraction', introducing precise terminology like 'fracterm', 'fracvalue', and 'fracsign'. A philosophy of mathematics paper about semantic precision in elementary arithmetic. Not an AI/ML paper.

entry.title: What is a meaningful Life? Mathematics, Buddhism and Neuroscience Perspective.

author.name: Yasiru Raveen

entry.summary: Personal reflection on finding meaning in life, drawing on Buddhism, mathematics, and neuroscience. First LessWrong post sharing the author's personal journey from Sri Lanka.

entry.title: Contra Nina Panickssery on advice for children

author.name: Sean Herrington

entry.summary: Responds to Nina Panickssery's advice for gifted children, arguing that several recommendations (like 'don't be a sheep') are potentially harmful and that children benefit from following social norms more than assumed.

entry.title: Housing Roundup #13: More Dakka

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's comprehensive housing policy roundup discussing supply-side solutions, Trump's anti-building stance, and various housing policy developments. Argues building more housing is the fundamental solution to affordability.

entry.title: Destruction of Infrastructure for the Impact on Civilians is Manifestly Illegal

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: Analysis of threats by the US president to destroy Iranian civilian infrastructure, arguing this would constitute a war crime under established international law and US military doctrine.

entry.title: New (Unofficial) Fatebook Android App

author.name: japancolorado

entry.summary: Announces a new unofficial Android app for Fatebook.io, a prediction tracking platform. Features include making forecasts, commenting, resolving predictions, and viewing calibration statistics.

entry.title: The Garden

author.name: sturb

entry.summary: Short fiction about angels creating paradise on earth, exploring themes of design trade-offs in creating ecosystems. Allegorical piece touching on optimization and values.

entry.title: Talking to strangers: an app adventure

author.name: henryaj

entry.summary: Lighthearted post about an app-based study showing that talking to strangers improves wellbeing and disproves people's negative expectations about such interactions.

entry.title: Defending Habit Streaks

author.name: Ian McKenzie

entry.summary: Practical advice on maintaining habit streaks, with strategies for what to do when streaks break. Draws on personal experience with meditation, language learning, and other daily habits.

entry.title: Birmingham LW/ACX meetups everywhere: Spring 26

author.name: Sachit Daniel

entry.summary: Announcement of a LessWrong/ACX spring meetup in Birmingham at Tim Hortons on New Street.
